text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Republic Act 7080 ukon ang Anti-Plunder Act, ang plunder amo ang krimen nga nakomiter sang public official nga nakatipon sang at least P75 million nga ill-gotten wealth paagi sa kriminal nga mga akto kaangay sang illegal use of funds, pagbaton sang kickbacks, kag paghingalit sang ila nga posisyon.
english: Under Republic Act 7080 or the Anti-Plunder Act, plunder is a crime committed by a public official who has accumulated at least P75 million of ill-gotten wealth through criminal acts such as illegal use of funds, acceptance of kickbacks, and abuse of their position.

text: Gin-akusaran anay si Estrada nga nagpatigayon sang alokasyon sang P355 million para mapondohan ang Bulacan first district kabaylo sang alleged 30-percent cut, apang ginpanginwala ini sang senador.
english: Estrada was previously accused of making an allocation of P355 million to fund the Bulacan first district in exchange for an alleged 30-percent cut, but the senator denied it.

text: Nalakip naman si Bonoan sa rekomendasyon sang Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI) sa Ombudsman para sa dugang nga imbestigasyon, samtang sanday Alcantara, Bernardo, and Opulencia ang ginakabig na nga state witnesses sa flood control corruption.#
english: Bonoan was included in the recommendation of the Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI) to the Ombudsman for further investigation, while Alcantara, Bernardo, and Opulencia are already considered state witnesses in flood control corruption.

text: Inspired sa sporting hero kag Olympic swimmer nga si Teofilo Yldefonso ang logo sang 65th Palarong Pambansa.
english: The logo of the 65th Palarong Pambansa is inspired by sporting hero and Olympic swimmer Teofilo Yldefonso.

text: Base sa gin-release nga logo features, makit-an ang pixelated human figure nga amo ang iconic nga swimming posture ni Yldefonso nga tumandok sang host province nga Ilocos Norte.
english: Based on the released logo features, the pixelated human figure can be seen which is the iconic swimming posture of Yldefonso who is a native of the host province of Ilocos Norte.

text: Kilala si Yldefonso nga “Ilocano Shark” kag naga-uyat sang rekord bilang una nga Pinoy kag Southeast Asian nga nakadaog sang Olympic medal sang nakuha sini ang bronze medal sa 200-meter breaststroke sa 1928 Amsterdam kag sa 1932 Los Angeles Olympic Games.
english: Yldefonso is known as the “Ilocano Shark” and holds the record as the first Filipino and Southeast Asian to win an Olympic medal when he won the bronze medal in the 200-meter breaststroke in 1928 Amsterdam and the 1932 Los Angeles Olympic Games.

text: Yara man sa desinyo sang logo ang intricate inabel textile tradition sang rehiyon nga may pixel patterns nga nagarepresentar sang warps kag wefts sang traditional weaving.
english: Also present in the logo design is the intricate inabel textile tradition of the region with pixel patterns representing the warps and wefts of traditional weaving.

text: Ang mga letra nga “I” kag “N” sa logo ang nagapasundayag sang sinan-bola (ball-like) pattern — isa ka signature motif halin sa inabel designs sang National Living Treasure awardee nga si Magdalena Gamayo.
english: The letters “I” and “N” in the logo display a sinan-bola (ball-like) pattern — a signature motif from the inabel designs of National Living Treasure awardee Magdalena Gamayo.

text: Maga-umpisa ang Palarong Pambansa sa Mayo 24 kag magalawig tubtub sa Hunyo 2.
english: The Palarong Pambansa will start on May 24 and run until June 2.

text: Ginalauman nga 15,000 ka mga atleta, mga coach, kag DepEd officials halin sa nagkalain-lain nga rehiyon ang magapasakop sa sini nga pinakadaku nga grassroots sporting event para sa student-athletes sa pagpanguna sang Department of Education.
english: An estimated 15,000 athletes, coaches, and DepEd officials from various regions are expected to participate in this largest grassroots sporting event for student-athletes under the leadership of the Department of Education.

text: ANG aton inisyal nga experyensya sa pag-away batok sa COVID-19 nagapakita nga 80 ka porsyento sang mga pasyente nagbatyag lang sang “mild” nga igu sang COVID-19, nga madali naman napaayo.
english: OUR initial experience in the fight against COVID-19 shows that 80 percent of patients suffered only “mild” COVID-19 infections, which recovered quickly.

text: Samtang 15% ang “serious” kag 5% ang “critical”.
english: While 15% are “serious” and 5% are “critical”.

text: Diri sa grupo sang mga pasyente nga “serious” kag “critical” ang aton pagkahangawa gid.
english: Here in the group of patients who are “serious” and “critical” we are very concerned.

text: Diri ang posible madamo gid ang magkalamatay, labi na gid sa grupo sang mga “critical”.
english: Here, there is a possibility of many deaths, especially in the critical group.

text: As of January 17, 2021 sunu sa Worldometer, mga 500,577 na ang aton kaso sang COVID-19 sugod sang magpakita ini diri sa aton mga siyam ka bulan ang nagligad.
english: As of January 17, 2021 according to Worldometer, we have about 500,577 cases of COVID-19 since it appeared here in our country about nine months ago.

text: Ang napatay naglab-ut sa 9,895, samtang 465,991, ukon 93.09%, ang naka-recover.
english: The death toll rose to 9,895, while 465,991, or 93.09%, recovered.

text: Assuming lang nga ang mga “critical” (5%) mapatay tanan, ini sila makalab-ut sa mga 25,028.85 ka Filipino, pero sa aktwal nga natabo mga 9,895, ukon 1.98%, lang ang napatay.
english: Assuming that the “critical” (5%) will all die, this will reach about 25,028.85 Filipinos, but in actuality only about 9,895, or 1.98%, died.

text: Obviously natabo ina  tungod sa maayo nga pagtatap sang aton mga health workers.
english: Obviously that happened because of the good care of our health workers.

text: Ini nga klase sang pagkabalaka ang luyag man naton ipatuman sa pagpili sang vaccine ukon mga vaccine nga i-procure naton sa aton mga pumuluyo, nga kon indi gid man lubos nga “effective”sa tanan masaligan ini agud ipaiway bisan sin-o sa ila sa peligro.
english: This kind of concern is also what we want to implement in the selection of the vaccine or vaccines that we will procure for our people, which if not fully “effective” for all can be trusted to keep any of them out of danger.

text: Dapat ang vaccine ukon mga vacine nga ma-procure naton amo ang “vaccines that save lives”!
english: The vaccine or vaccines we can procure should be “vaccines that save lives”!

text: Indi kay tungod lang sa pulitika, katulad sang gina-insistir gid ni Presidente Duterte nga kuhaon ang Sinovac sang China, nga hadlok niya kontrahon, bisan pa manubo ang “efficacy” sini sa Fiipinas kag wala pa kita kahibalo parti sa “safety” sini.
english: Not just because of politics, like President Duterte's insistence on taking China's Sinovac, which he is afraid to oppose, even though its efficacy in the Philippines is low and we do not know about its safety.

text: Tungod wala pa sing na-oficially register for commercial distribution kundi tubtub pa lang ini pang-emergency, matugutan lang ang paggamit sang vaccine nga available sa subong sa idalom sang Emergency Use Authorization sang World Health Organization (WHO) kag WHO-recognized nga mga national Food and Drug Administration.
english: Since nothing has been officially registered for commercial distribution but is only for emergency use, the use of the vaccine is only allowed under the Emergency Use Authorization of the World Health Organization (WHO) and WHO-recognized national Food and Drug Administrations.

text: Indi bale basta wala lang tani sing may madisgrasya bisan diutay lang anay ang ma-immunize.
english: It doesn't matter as long as no one gets hurt even if a few are immunized.

text:
***

Importante kaayo sa tawo ang iya kabuhi kag ikaayong lawas, labi na gid ang may “higher risk” batok sa COVID-19, katulad sang mga senior citizen, may pondo nga balatian, kag ang may serious nga allergy.
english:
***

People's lives and health are very important, especially those at higher risk against COVID-19, such as senior citizens, those with chronic illnesses, and those with serious allergies.

text: Tungod sini mas dapat naton tagaan sing pag-focus ang “safety” naton sa vaccine.
english: Therefore, we should focus more on our vaccine safety.

text: Anhon mo nga mapatay sang vaccine ang mikrobyo kon ang resulta sini ang imo man kamatayon ukon paglala pa sang imo ginabatyag.
english: How can a vaccine kill a germ if the result is your death or worsening of your condition.

text: Tungod pang-EUA pa lang ini, okey lang gani sa WHO ang “efficacy” nga 50% sang vaccine nga may precaution sa mga adverse effects.
english: Because it is still for EUA, the WHO is okay with the “efficacy” of 50% of the vaccine with precautions against adverse effects.

text: In other words, okey lang anay ang vaccine nga pwede makatapna 50-50 sang COVID-19, meaning nga ang 50% lang ang segurado nga ma-immunize samtang ang 50% galangoy pa sa sabaw.
english: In other words, the vaccine that can prevent 50-50 of COVID-19 is okay, meaning that only 50% are sure to be immunized while 50% are still swimming in the soup.

text: Either wala nag-epekto ang vaccine sa ila ukon nangin asymptomatic sila, ukon wala  matuod sing sintoma pero dala nila ang virus kag kinahanglan liwat mabakunahan.
english: Either the vaccine did not work on them or they became asymptomatic, or they did not have symptoms but they carried the virus and needed to be vaccinated again.

text: Posible man nga may mapatay.
english: It is also possible that someone will die.

text: Well, mas maayo gid kon mataas ang “effectiveness” kag mataas man ang “safety profile” sang vaccine, kon may makakita kita sini kag masarangan man lang naton i-procure.
english: Well, it's better if the vaccine has a high effectiveness and a high safety profile, if we can find it and we can procure it.

text: Kon indi gid man masarangan baklon, ugaling, ano pa abe ang aton mahimo kundi mag-mantener sang vaccine nga manubo ang “efficacy” nga manubo man  ang ma-immunize sini.
english: If we can't afford it, however, what else can we do but maintain a vaccine with low efficacy that will also immunize low.

text: Magpabakuna lang ugaling kita liwat.
english: Let's just get vaccinated again.

text: Sa karon, may mga vaccine na nga ginatugutan gamiton itublok sa mga pumuluyo sang Food and Drug Adminstration (FDA) sang pila ka pungsod.
english: Currently, there are vaccines that are approved for use in the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of some countries.

text: Lakip diri ang Pfizer/bioNTech kag Moderna sa Uropa, Estados Unidos kag Canada, ang Sinovac sang China, kag bati naton pati na ang AstraZeneca.
english: These include Pfizer/bioNTech and Moderna in Europe, the United States and Canada, China's Sinovac, and we hear even AstraZeneca.

text: Natuslokan naman gani sing una nga dose si Pope Francis kag ang retirado nga Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI sangVatican City State.
english: Pope Francis and retired Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI of the Vatican City State have even been injected with the first dose.

text: Ginsiling nga may 95% nga “efficacy and safety” ang Pfizer/bioNTech kag Moderna.
english: Pfizer/bioNTech and Moderna are said to have 95% “efficacy and safety”.

text: Ang Sinovac ginsiling nga may inconsistent nga “efficacy” nga 49% sa Filipinas tubtub sa 70% sa Indonesia , 86% sa United Arab Emirate, kag 91% sa Turkey.
english: Sinovac is said to have an inconsistent “efficacy” of 49% in the Philippines to 70% in Indonesia, 86% in the United Arab Emirates, and 91% in Turkey.

text: Ang AstraZeneca, nga madamo nga LGU ang nag-order, may 70.4% nga “efficacy” kag daw amo gid ang pinakabarato, gani agaw ini sa mga pulupigado nga mga pungsod kag mga siyudad.
english: AstraZeneca, which many LGUs have ordered, has 70.4% efficacy and seems to be the cheapest, so it is available to poor countries and cities.

text: Kabay nga ini tanan may mataas sing “safety profile” agud masaligan, labi na gid sa pag-amlig sa mga senior citizen, may pondo nga balatian kag ang may serious allergy./PN
english: Hopefully all of these have a high safety profile to be trusted, especially in protecting senior citizens, those with funding illnesses and those with serious allergies./PN

text: Ginpasirado na ang tanan nga eskwelahan sa Nigeria matapos gin-kidnap ang 303 ka mga estudyante kag 12 ka manunudlo sang wala pa nakilala nga mga armado nga mga lalaki.
english: All schools in Nigeria have been closed after 303 students and 12 teachers were kidnapped by unidentified gunmen.

text: Suno sa report, natabo ang pag-atake sang mga suspek sa isa ka Catholic School.
english: According to the report, the attack took place at a Catholic school.

text: Ang mga biktima nagaedad sang 10 tubtob 18-anyos.
english: The victims ranged in age from 10 to 18-years-old.

text: May iban naman nga mga estudyante nga nakapalagyo.
english: Other students escaped.

text: Ginaimbestigaran pa kun diin ginpangdala ang mga biktima kag kun ano ang motibo sa pag-atake sa amo nga eskwelahan.
english: The whereabouts of the victims and the motive behind the attack on the school are still being investigated.

text: Natukiban sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) subong nga adlaw ang paghulag sang duha ka mga sakayan sang Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) mga 34 nautical miles gikan sa baybayon sang Pangasinan.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) today detected the movement of two Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) vessels about 34 nautical miles off the coast of Pangasinan.

text: Suno sa PCG, ang mga foreign nga sakayan pandagat malapit sa Pangasinan, ang yara sa sulod sang 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone sang Pilipinas, ang nakit-an paagi sa ila Dark Vessel Detection program.
english: According to the PCG, foreign vessels near Pangasinan, which are within the 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone of the Philippines, were detected through its Dark Vessel Detection program.

text: Si PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan nagmando sa isa ka eroplano sang Coast Guard BN-2 Islander nga biswal nga makilala ang mga sakayan sang CCG kag magsugod sang isa ka radio challenge.
english: PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan ordered a Coast Guard BN-2 Islander aircraft to visually identify CCG vessels and initiate a radio challenge.

text: Duha ka 44-meter PCG vessels nga BRP Cabra (MRRV-4409) kag BRP Bagacay (MRRV-4410) ang ginpadala sa Bolinao, Pangasinan agud atubangon ang pagsulod sang mga Chinese vessels.
english: Two 44-meter PCG vessels BRP Cabra (MRRV-4409) and BRP Bagacay (MRRV-4410) were dispatched to Bolinao, Pangasinan to deal with the intrusion of Chinese vessels.

text: Ini agud masabat ang iligal nga presensya sang China Coast Guard kag mapabaskog ang panindugan sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas batok sa normalisasyon sang iligal nga pagpatrolya sang People’s Republic of China (PRC) sa sulod sang Philippine Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).
english: This is to address the illegal presence of the China Coast Guard and strengthen the Philippine government's stand against the normalization of illegal patrols by the People's Republic of China (PRC) within the Philippine Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).

text: Wala gid siguro sang tawo nga may luyag nga magtinir sa presuhan bangud lugar ini nga ginadingot sa imo ang imo kahilwayan.
english: I don't think anyone wants to stay in prison because it's a place where you're denied your freedom.

text: Well, except siguro sa isa ka lalaki didto sa Italya nga nag-presentar mismo sang iya kaugalingon nga presuhon siya bangud natak-an ini sa iya nga asawa sa ila nga balay!
english: Well, except maybe for a man in Italy who presented himself to be imprisoned because he was bored with his wife in their house!

text: Nagapuyo ini nga 30 anyos nga Albanian nga lalaki sa Guidonia Montecelio.
english: This 30-year-old Albanian man lives in Guidonia Montecelio.

text: Naka-house arrest ini bangud sa iya kahilabtanan sa iligal nga droga.
english: He is under house arrest for his involvement in illegal drugs.

text: Suno sa otoridad, may nabilin pa nga pila ka tuig antes matapos ang house arrest sa amo nga lalaki.
english: According to the authorities, there are still several years left before the man's house arrest ends.

text: Isa ka adlaw, nakibot na lang ang mga tawo sa police barracks bangud gulpi nga nagpakita ini nga lalaki kag nagpakitluoy nga isaylo na lang siya sa presuhan.
english: One day, the people in the police barracks were surprised when the man suddenly appeared and begged to be transferred to jail.

text: Rason sang lalaki, daw impyerno na ang iya nga kabuhi kun upod niya ang iya asawa sa puluy-an kag indi na gid siya makabatas.
english: The man said his life is like hell when he is with his wife at home and he can't stand it anymore.

text: Bangud sang natabo, gin-aresto matuod ang lalaki bangud sa iya paglapas sa house arrest rules.
english: Because of the incident, the man was arrested for violating house arrest rules.

text: Ginmandu man sang judicial authorities nga sayluhon siya sa presuhan.
english: The judicial authorities also ordered that he be transferred to jail.

text: Nagbulos ang Chinese monster ship sa iligal nga pagpatrolya sa teritoryo sang Pilipinas matapos nga gintabog sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang isa pa ka barko sang China.
english: The Chinese monster ship took over illegal patrols in Philippine territory after the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) chased away another Chinese ship.

text: Suno sa ahensya, nagmadinalag-on ang BRP Teresa Magbanua nga mapunggan ang China Coast Guard vessel CCG-3304 nga mag-abante pa sa baybayon sang Zambales.
english: According to the agency, BRP Teresa Magbanua succeeded in preventing the China Coast Guard vessel CCG-3304 from advancing further off the coast of Zambales.

text: Apang sa subong, nag-abot ang monter ship ukon ang CCG 5901 nga amo liwat ang ginabantayan sang barko sang Pilipinas.
english: But now, the monter ship or CCG 5901 has arrived which is again the guard of the Philippine ship.

text: Ginatinguhaan sang PCG nga mapabilin ang distansya sang monster ship sa ginabanta 110-115 nautical miles halin sa coast sang Zambales.
english: The PCG is trying to keep the distance of the monster ship at approximately 110-115 nautical miles from the coast of Zambales.

text: Nagabalusay man sa pag-radyo ang PCG kag CCG sa isa kag isa, kun sa diin ginasulit-sulit sang Pilipinas nga nagalapas ang China sa United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) kun sa diin signatory man ang Beijing.
english: The PCG and CCG have also been exchanging radio calls, with the Philippines repeating that China is violating the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to which Beijing is also a signatory.

text: Magluwas sa monster ship nga amo ang pinakadaku nga coast guard ship sa kalibutan, may na-monitor man anay ang PCG nga CCG-3502 kag CCG-3103 nga malapit man sa probinsya sang Zambales sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Besides the monster ship, which is the largest coast guard ship in the world, the PCG also monitored CCG-3502 and CCG-3103 near Zambales province last week.

text: Nagpasar ang China sang education law nga may katuyuan nga buhinan ang pressure sa tuman ka damo nga homework sa mga kabataan.
english: China has passed an education law aimed at reducing the pressure of too much homework on children.

text: Kinahanglan siguruhon sang mga ginikanan nga may yara sang tion ang ila mga bata sa pagpahuway kag pag-exercise kag wala nagababad sang madugay sa online.
english: Parents need to make sure that their children have time to rest and exercise and do not spend too much time online.

text: Sang Agosto, gin-ban man sang China ang written exams para sa mga anom kag pito ka tuig nga mga kabataan.
english: In August, China also banned written exams for six- and seven-year-olds.

text: Nagpaandam ang mga opisyal nga mahimo maapektuhan ang physical kag mental health sang mga bata.
english: Officials warned that children's physical and mental health could be affected.

text: Wala pa ginpaguwa sa publiko ang kabug-usan nga detalye sang layi apang base sa media reports, naga-engganyo ini sa mga ginikanan nga pasangkaron ang intellectual development kag social habits sang bata.
english: The full details of the law have not been released to the public but based on media reports, it encourages parents to enhance the child's intellectual development and social habits.

text: Ang local government amo ang responsable sa implementasyon kaangay sang paghatag sang pondo para sa exta-curricular activities.
english: The local government is responsible for implementation such as providing funding for extra-curricular activities.

text: ILOILO CITY- Milagro nga nakaluwas ang tanan nga sakay sang isa ka eroplano matapos nga naglupok kag nagkalayo sang nakasagaid sa kudal sang hana na ini nga magtake-off sa Houston Executive Airport sa Texas, USA.
english: ILOILO CITY – All passengers of a plane miraculously survived after it exploded and caught fire when it hit a fence when it was about to take off at the Houston Executive Airport in Texas, USA.

text: Padulong kuntani sa Boston ang eroplano apang wala ini naka-attain sang altitude sa punta sang runway rason nga natabo ang disgrasya.
english: The plane was heading to Boston but failed to reach altitude at the end of the runway causing the accident.

text: Suno kay Texas Department of Public Safety spokesman Sgt.
english: According to Texas Department of Public Safety spokesman Sgt.

text: Stephen Woodard, madasig nga nakagwa sa eroplano ang tanan nga sakay kag wala nakaagom sang pilas apang may yara lang sang pila sa ila nga nagreklamo sang pagpalanakit sang lawas.
english: Stephen Woodard, all passengers were quickly evacuated from the plane and were not injured but only a few of them complained of body aches.

text: Pangitaan sang paagi sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga ma-impluwensyahan ang polisa sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ilabi na sa isyu sang immigration.
english: Find ways for the Philippine government to influence the policy of the United States of America especially on the issue of immigration.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This was announced by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kadungan sang iya pagkumpirma sang iya nga meeting kay US President Donald Trump.
english: while confirming his meeting with US President Donald Trump.

text: Base sa Presidential Communications Office (PCO), wala pa subong sang petsa kun san-o ang scheduled meeting.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO), there is no date for the scheduled meeting.

text:
Lakip sa ginaplano sini nga istoryahan sa ila pagkit-anay amo ang isyu sa foreign assistance, trade, defense kag security, kag bag-o nga polisa sa immigration samtang nga padayon subong ang mass deportation sa amo nga pungsod kun sa diin ginatawag ang undocumented migrants bilang “criminal aliens.”

“I will meet with President Trump because I should.
english:
Among the issues he plans to discuss during their meeting are issues of foreign assistance, trade, defense and security, and new immigration policies while the mass deportation continues in the country where undocumented migrants are called “criminal aliens.”

“I will meet with President Trump because I should.

text: Because there’s much that we need to discuss between the US and the Philippines in terms of trade, in terms of defense and security, and now the new policy on immigration,” suno kay Marcos.
english: Because there’s much that we need to discuss between the US and the Philippines in terms of trade, in terms of defense and security, and now the new policy on immigration,” according to Marcos.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) nga imposible man nga ma-deport ang 300,000 Filipinos nga wala sang legal status sa US antes magtakop ang Trump administration.
english: Earlier, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) said it was also impossible to deport 300,000 Filipinos without legal status in the US before the end of the Trump administration.

text: Base sa nauna nga Trump administration, ginatos lamang ka undocumented nga mga Pinoy suno sa ahensya ang na-deport pabalik diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Based on the previous Trump administration, only hundreds of undocumented Filipinos, according to the agency, were deported back to the Philippines.

text: Indi naman makakomento si Marcos sa temporary suspension sang foreign assistance halin sa US bangud indi pa maathag suno sa iya kun ano ang polisa, ano ang maapektuhan, kag ano ang buhinan nga aid funds.
english: Marcos could not comment on the temporary suspension of foreign assistance from the US because it is not yet clear what the policy is, what will be affected, and what aid funds will be reduced.

text: “It’s very unclear what it is.
english: “It’s very unclear what it is.

text: It’s even the agencies in the US government, hindi nila naintindihan what it means – ano ‘yung tatamaan, saan babawasan ang aid funds,” pahayag sang chief executive.
english: It's even the agencies in the US government, they don't understand what it means – what will be hit, where will the aid funds be reduced,” the chief executive said.

text: “Well, this is what happens.
english: “Well, this is what happens.

text: These are the growing pains of a new administration.
english: These are the growing pains of a new administration.

text: But I’m sure, with time these policies will crystalize and will become clearer, by which time I will have a chance to visit with President Trump and we can discuss it with a better understanding of what the policies are,” dugang sini.
english: But I’m sure, with time these policies will crystallize and will become clearer, by which time I will have a chance to visit with President Trump and we can discuss it with a better understanding of what the policies are,” it added.

text: Sa mandu ni Trump, 90 ka adlaw ang foreign assistance suspension samtang pending ang pag-review sa efficiencies and consistency sa iya nga foreign policy.#
english: Under Trump's order, foreign assistance is suspended for 90 days pending a review of the efficiencies and consistency of his foreign policy.

text: Ginhangkat ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. challenged

text: ang China sa isa ka kasugtanan kaangot sa pag-pull out sang Typhon missiles sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga yara subong sa pungsod.
english: China in an agreement to pull out the Typhon missiles of the United States of America that are currently in the country.

text: Suno kay Marcos, handa siya nga kuhaon ang missiles sang US kun untaton man sang China ang ila agresibo nga mga aktwasyon kag pagpang-harass sa mga manugpangisda nga Pinoy sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Marcos said he is ready to remove the US missiles if China stops its aggressive actions and harassment of Filipino fishermen in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Dugang sini, dapat nga untaton man sang China ang paggamit sang water cannon kag lasers amo man ang pagpangbunggo sa mga vessel sang Pilipinas.
english: He added that China should also stop using water cannons and lasers as well as hitting Philippine vessels.

text: “Let’s make a deal with China: Stop claiming our territory, stop harassing our fishermen and let them have a living, stop ramming our boats, stop water cannoning our people, stop firing lasers at us, and stop your aggressive and coercive behavior, and I’ll return the Typhon missiles.
english: “Let’s make a deal with China: Stop claiming our territory, stop harassing our fishermen and let them have a living, stop ramming our boats, stop water cannoning our people, stop firing lasers at us, and stop your aggressive and coercive behavior, and I’ll return the Typhon missiles.

text: Itigil nila ‘yung ginagawa nila, ibabalik ko lahat ‘yan,” suno kay Marcos.
english: They stop what they are doing, I will give it all back,” Marcos said.

text: Ini nga statement sang presidente ang ginbuy-an matapos nagpahayag si Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning nga dapat nga tadlungon sang Philippine government nga sala sini nga ginahimo sa labing-madali nga tion paagi sa pag-pullout sa missile launchers nga una na nga gin-report nga gin-relocate lamang.
english: The president's statement came after Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said the Philippine government should correct its mistake as soon as possible by pullout of the missile launchers that were previously reported to have been relocated.

text: Pahayag naman ni Marcos, indi siya makahangop kun ngaa nagapahilabot ang China bangud wala man gani nagakomento ang Pilipinas sa missile systems sang Beijing nga indi hamak nga mas gamhanan.
english: Marcos said he does not understand why China is interfering because the Philippines does not even comment on Beijing's missile systems, which are not much more powerful.

text: “Well, I don’t understand the comments on the Typhon missile system.
english: “Well, I don’t understand the comments on the Typhon missile system.

text: We don’t make any comments on their missile systems, and their missile systems are a thousand times more powerful than what we have,” dugang sang chief executive.
english: We don’t make any comments on their missile systems, and their missile systems are a thousand times more powerful than what we have,” added sang chief executive.

text: Una na nga ginkumpirma sang isa ka senior Philippine government source nga ginsaylo sang US military ang Mid-Range Capability missile system halin sa Laoag airfield pakadto sa isa ka lokasyon sa Luzon.
english: Earlier, a senior Philippine government source confirmed that the US military has moved the Mid-Range Capability missile system from the Laoag airfield to a location in Luzon.

text: Gin-alegar nga ini nga redeployment ang makabulig sa pagtumod kun ano kadasig masaylo ang missile battery sa bag-o nga firing position.
english: It is alleged that this redeployment will help determine how quickly the missile battery can be moved to the new firing position.

text: Ini nga Tomahawk cruise missiles sa launchers ang sarang maka-igu sang mga target sini pati sa China kag Russia kun ipalupad ini halin sa Pilipinas.
english: These Tomahawk cruise missiles in launchers can hit targets including China and Russia if launched from the Philippines.

text: Ang SM-6 missiles naman ang mahimo maka-igu sang air kag sea targets apisar sa kalayuon nga 200 kilometros.
english: The SM-6 missiles can hit air and sea targets even at a distance of 200 kilometers.

text: Una naman nga ginklaro sang Philippine Army nga indi man paggamiton ang Typhon missile launchers sa live-fire exercises sa palaabuton nga military drills kundi gamiton lamang para sa training sa payload delivery system.
english: Earlier, the Philippine Army clarified that the Typhon missile launchers will not be used in live-fire exercises in future military drills but will only be used for training in the payload delivery system.

text: Nakita nga naka-park sa kilid sang ancestral house sa Moroboro, Dingle, Iloilo ang ginapahayag salakyan nga gingamit sa pagpang-hold up sang mga suspek sa Pilar, Capiz.
english: The alleged vehicle used in the hold up by the suspects in Pilar, Capiz was found parked next to the ancestral house in Moroboro, Dingle, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Alwin Salmon, Officer-In-Charge sang Dingle Municipal Police Station (MPS), iya ginpahayag nga ginapanag-iyahan sang isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) ang amo nga salakyan nga Mitsubishi Mirage.
english: Alwin Salmon, Officer-In-Charge of the Dingle Municipal Police Station (MPS), said the Mitsubishi Mirage was owned by an Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW).

text: Dugang pa ni Salmon, nagpadulong sa Dumarao, Capiz ang asawa sang OFW sang Sabado nga adlaw dala ang salakyan agud magbisita sa iya himata.
english: Salmon said the OFW's wife went to Dumarao, Capiz on Saturday with a vehicle to visit her relative.

text: Didto kag ginhulam ini sang iya nga brother-in-law sang Domingo sang aga kag ginbalik man sang hapon.
english: His brother-in-law borrowed it on Sunday morning and returned it in the afternoon.

text: Nakabalik naman ang asawa sang OFW sa banwa sang Dingle sang hapon sang amo man nga adlaw.
english: The OFW's wife returned to Dingle town in the afternoon of the same day.

text: Kon balikan, ginharangan kag ginpauntat ang mga biktima sang robbery sang tatlo ka mga wala makilan-an nga kalalakihan nga nakasuksok sang Police Athletic Uniform kag ini sila ang gintutukan sang caliber .45 pistol nga armas-luthang.
english: The victims of the robbery were stopped by three unidentified men wearing Police Athletic Uniforms who pointed a caliber .45 pistol at them.

text: Ginapahayag nga madasig nga nagsulod ang tatlo ka mga suspek sa amo nga salakyan kag pwersa nga gintaban mas ukon menus P1 milyon nga balor sang kwarta, cellphones, yabi sang salakyan, kag iban pa.
english: The three suspects allegedly quickly entered the vehicle and forcibly stole approximately P1 million worth of cash, cellphones, vehicle keys, and other items.

text: Ginapasanyog sang Iloilo provincial government ang 5Rs sang waste management pareho sang reduce, reuse, recycle, repurpose, kag rot para madugangan ang ihibalo sa nagakaigo nga pamaagi sa pagbuhin sang mga solid wastes.
english: The Iloilo provincial government is promoting the 5Rs of waste management such as reduce, reuse, recycle, repurpose, and rot to increase awareness on proper ways to reduce solid wastes.

text: Ini ang kaangot man sa pag-obserbar sang Zero Waste Month subong nga bulan sang Enero.
english: This is also in connection with the observance of Zero Waste Month this January.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mitz Peñaflorida, Senior Environmental Management sang Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO), iya ginpahayag bilang kabahin sang selebrasyon sang Kasadyahan sa Kabanwahanan 2025, ang talatapan ang magahiwat man sang monitoring kag evaluation sang pagsunod sa nagakaigo nga solid waste management humalin Enero 20 tubtob 26.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mitz Peñaflorida, Senior Environmental Management of the Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO), said that as part of the celebration of Kasadyahan sa Babanwahan 2025, the office will also conduct monitoring and evaluation of compliance with proper solid waste management from January 20 to 26.

text: Suno kay Peñaflorida, sa Enero 31, may yara sang learning exposure kag benchmarking sang mga solid waste management technologies kag pasilidad nga ginapatuman sang probinsya.
english: According to Peñaflorida, on January 31, there will be a learning exposure and benchmarking of solid waste management technologies and facilities implemented by the province.

text: Ini ang ginalakipan sang Tapon to Ipon Project nga nagatuyo sa pagtipon sang clear bottles kag i-recycle paagi sa mga collection hub nga gintukod sa pila ka mga munisipalidad.
english: This is part of the Tapon to Ipon Project which aims to collect clear bottles and recycle them through collection hubs established in several municipalities.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Iloilo, 38 sa 43 ka mga local government units, may yara na sang existing ordinance nga naga-regulate sa paggamit sang single-use plastics.
english: Iloilo, 38 out of 43 local government units, already has an existing ordinance regulating the use of single-use plastics.

text: Naghatag sang mensahe sang pagdayaw, pagpasalamat, kag pagpaalam ang Kongreso matapos ang kumpirmasyon nga nagtaliwan na si Albay First District Rep.
english: Congress issued a message of praise, gratitude, and farewell after the confirmation of the passing of Albay First District Rep.

text: kag Liberal Party President Edcel Lagman.
english: and Liberal Party President Edcel Lagman.

text: Napatay si Lagman sa edad nga 82-anyos matapos nagsuprer sang cardiac arrest.
english: Lagman died at the age of 82 after suffering a cardiac arrest.

text: Base sa statement sang iya pamilya, padayon nila nga dumdumon ang kongresista bilang maprinsipyo kag wala nagakalingkang nga advocate sang human rights.
english: Based on the statement of his family, they will continue to remember the congressman as a principled and unwavering advocate of human rights.

text: “He left this world the way he lived his life – with integrity, compassion, and fearlessness.
english: “He left this world the way he lived his life – with integrity, compassion, and fearlessness.

text: He fought until the end with the dogged determination, tenacity, and unshakable hopefulness that defined all that he stood for,” suno kay Tabaco Mayor Krisel Lagman, anak sang kongresista.
english: He fought until the end with the dogged determination, tenacity, and unshakable hopefulness that defined all that he stood for,” said Tabaco Mayor Krisel Lagman, son of the congressman.

text: “He will be remembered and honored by his family, friends, and colleagues as a remarkable and generous father; a warm, thoughtful and loving brother, uncle and lolo; a true and loyal friend; and an upright, principled, and unwavering advocate of human rights and the rule of law.
english: “He will be remembered and honored by his family, friends, and colleagues as a remarkable and generous father; a warm, thoughtful and loving brother, uncle and lolo; a true and loyal friend; and an upright, principled, and unwavering advocate of human rights and the rule of law.

text: He will live on in our hearts and we will continue to honor his memory by living our lives the way that would make him proud,” dugang sini.
english: He will live on in our hearts and we will continue to honor his memory by living our lives the way that would make him proud,” it added.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang Liberal Party kay Lagman sa pagpakigbato sini sa kinamatarong sang mga tawo bilang abogado kag bilang mamalidha.
english: The Liberal Party also thanked Lagman for his fight for human rights as a lawyer and as a lawmaker.

text: “Sa kanyang mahabang karera bilang abogado ng karapatang pantao at mambabatas, walang kapaguran niyang ipinaglaban ang mga biktima ng pang-aabuso, ang kalusugan at kapakanan ng kababaihan, kabataan at LGBT, at ang tapat at mahusay na pamamahala.
english: “In her long career as a human rights lawyer and legislator, she has tirelessly fought for victims of abuse, the health and well-being of women, youth and LGBT people, and honest and good governance.

text: Sa kanyang pagkawala, nabawasan ng isang matalas, masipag, at matapang na lingkod-bayan ang Pilipinas,” pahayag sang partido.
english: With his absence, the Philippines has lost a sharp, hardworking, and courageous citizen,” the party said in a statement.

text: Sa statement naman sang opisina ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez, ginpahayag nga bisan may mga wala man naga-ugyon sa pahayag sang kongresista kun kaisa, indi manegar ang iya dedikasyon kag kapisan sa trabaho para sa human rights, social justice, kag maayo nga panggobyerno.
english: In a statement, the office of House Speaker Martin Romualdez said that although there are those who sometimes disagree with the congressman's statement, there is no denying his dedication and hard work for human rights, social justice, and good governance.

text: Ginsiling man nga daku ang nadula sa Kongreso kag sa Philippine public service kasunod sang pagtaliwan sini.
english: It was also said that Congress and the Philippine public service suffered a great loss following his passing.

text: “Whether one agreed with him or not, no one could deny his dedication to his work and his tireless advocacy for human rights, good governance and social justice.
english: “Whether one agreed with him or not, no one could deny his dedication to his work and his tireless advocacy for human rights, good governance and social justice.

text: His voice—always firm, always eloquent—pushed important debates forward and challenged us all to think more critically and act more decisively,” kabahin sang statement ni Romualdez.
english: His voice—always firm, always eloquent—pushed important debates forward and challenged us all to think more critically and act more decisively,” Romualdez’s statement said.

text: “His absence leaves a great void, not just in Congress but in Philippine public service.
english: “His absence leaves a great void, not just in Congress but in Philippine public service.

text:
On behalf of the House of Representatives, I extend my deepest condolences to his family, friends and colleagues in the Liberal Party.”

Nahibaluan nga nakaserbe si Lagman bilang congressman sang First District of Albay sa walo ka termino: halin sang 1987 tubtub 1998, halin sang 2004 tubtub 2013, kag halin sang 2016 tubtub subong.
english:
On behalf of the House of Representatives, I extend my deepest condolences to his family, friends and colleagues in the Liberal Party.”

Lagman served as congressman of the First District of Albay for eight terms: from 1987 to 1998, from 2004 to 2013, and from 2016 to the present.

text: Siya man ang party president sang Liberal Party halin sang 2022.
english: He is also the party president of the Liberal Party since 2022.

text: Lakip sa mga layi nga siya ang author amo ang Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Law, ang Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Law, ang Compensation to Martial Law Victims, ang Anti-Torture Act, kag ang layi nga nagadula sang death penalty sa Pilipinas.
english: Among the laws he is the author of are the Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Law, the Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Law, the Compensation to Martial Law Victims, the Anti-Torture Act, and the law abolishing the death penalty in the Philippines.

text: Isa man siya sa principal authors sang Absolute Divorce Bill.#
english: He is also one of the principal authors of the Absolute Divorce Bill.#

text: Naghatag na ang eight-division legend nga si Manny Pacquiao sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon sang iya natalana nga pagbalik sa ring.
english: Eight-division legend Manny Pacquiao has given official confirmation of his scheduled return to the ring.

text: “I’m back.
english: “I’m back.

text: On July 19, I return to the ring to face WBC Welterweight Champion Mario Barrios at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.
english: On July 19, I return to the ring to face WBC Welterweight Champion Mario Barrios at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.

text: Let’s make history!
english: Let’s make history!

text: #TeamPacquiao,” kabahin sang nangin social media post sang 46-anyos nga Pinoy fighter subong nga adlaw.
english: #TeamPacquiao,” part of the 46-year-old Filipino fighter's social media post today.

text: Nahibaluan nga gina-umpisahan na sini ang iya nga training sa Los Angeles, California agud nga mokondisyon ang lawas ilabi na bangud 2021 pa ang iya katapusan nga professional fight.
english: It is known that he is already starting his training in Los Angeles, California to condition his body especially since 2021 is his last professional fight.

text: Kaupod ni Pacquiao sa Los Angeles ang iya asawa nga si Jinkee kag iya anak nga si Jimuel nga didto na nga daan sa amo nga state.
english: Pacquiao was accompanied in Los Angeles by his wife Jinkee and son Jimuel who are already in the state.

text: Natalana nga mag-atubang si Pacquiao kay defending World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion Mario Barrios sa Hulyo 19, 2025 sa Las Vegas, Nevada.
english: Pacquiao is scheduled to face defending World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion Mario Barrios on July 19, 2025 in Las Vegas, Nevada.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana nagpaguwa sang latest ranking ang WBC.
english: Last week the WBC released the latest ranking.

text: Gin-lista ang Filipino southpaw sa numero singko sa 147-pound class apisar nga indi na ini aktibo sa boksing halin pa sang Agusto 2021 sang nalutos siya sa hampang sa idalom sang World Boxing Association.
english: The Filipino southpaw was listed at number five in the 147-pound class despite not being active in boxing since August 2021 when he lost a match under the World Boxing Association.

text: Base sa nauna nga reports, may plano man nga ibutang ang anak ni Pacquiao nga si Jimuel sa professional boxing sa undercard sang Barrios fight.
english: According to previous reports, there are also plans to put Pacquiao's son Jimuel in professional boxing on the undercard of the Barrios fight.

text: Antes ang pagbalik sa ring, natalana anay nga magpahuway ang amay nga Pacquaio sa training kag magatambong ini sa enshrinement sa iya sa International Boxing Hall of Fame sa Canastota, New York.
english: Before returning to the ring, Pacquaio's father is scheduled to take a break from training and will attend his enshrinement at the International Boxing Hall of Fame in Canastota, New York.

text: Nagpanguna ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Alexie Mae Brooks sa pre-arrival race nga parte sang 2025 Miss Eco International pageant.
english: Philippine representative Alexie Mae Brooks led the pre-arrival race as part of the 2025 Miss Eco International pageant.

text: Base sa anunsyo sang international pageant, nangibabaw ang Ilongga beauty queen sa Eco Tourism Video challenge na gin-conduct via YouTube.
english: Based on the announcement of the international pageant, the Ilongga beauty queen won the Eco Tourism Video challenge conducted via YouTube.

text: “The votes are in!
english: “The votes are in!

text: Here are the top three contestants leading in the Eco Tourism Video challenge on YouTube!
english: Here are the top three contestants leading in the Eco Tourism Video challenge on YouTube!

text: [graph emoji][camera emoji],” post sang organizers online.
english: [graph emoji][camera emoji],” organizers posted online.

text: Nagpangaduha naman ang delegate sang United Kingdom nga may yara man sang Filipino heritage, samtang pangatlo ang candidate sang Indonesia.
english: The United Kingdom delegate, who also has Filipino heritage, came second, while the Indonesian candidate came third.

text: Patigayunon ang koronasyon sang 2025 Miss Eco International pageant sa Alexandria, Egypt sa Abril 8 kun sa diin iga-turn over ni Angelina Usanova sang Ukraine ang iya titulo sa iya mangin successor.
english: The coronation of the 2025 Miss Eco International pageant will be held in Alexandria, Egypt on April 8 where Angelina Usanova of Ukraine will turn over her title to her successor.

text: Si Brooks nga kilala man nga parte sang Philippine National Team sa Southeast Asian Games ang igapadala nga mag-compete sa global tilt matapos ini nakasulod sa Top 10 sang 2024 Miss Universe Philippines pageant.
english: Brooks, who is also known to be part of the Philippine National Team at the Southeast Asian Games, will be sent to compete on the global tilt after she made it to the Top 10 of the 2024 Miss Universe Philippines pageant.

text: Sa nagligad nga interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Brooks, ginpahayag sini nga paspas na ang ila preparasyon para ma-deliver ang best performance sa stage lakip na ang question-and-answer, runway performance, kag advocacy work nga naka-sentro sa women empowerment.
english: In a previous interview with Bombo Radyo, Brooks said they are preparing fast to deliver the best performance on stage including question-and-answer, runway performance, and advocacy work centered on women empowerment.

text: Ini ang iya una nga international pageant, gani may pressure suno sa iya, apang ginakabig man niya ini nga pribilehiyo.
english: This is her first international pageant, so there is pressure she said, but she also considers it a privilege.

text: Pananglitan magdaog ini, siya ang ikatlo halin sa Pilipinas nga may korona sa Miss Eco International pageant.
english: If she wins, she will be the third from the Philippines to be crowned in the Miss Eco International pageant.

text: INDI kita matingala kon ngaa sa karon laban sang aton mga pumuluyo indi luyag magpabakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: We are not surprised why most of our citizens do not want to be vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Ang isa ka rason amo nga ang mga vaccine nga available sa karon pwede makuha lang anay sa idalom sang Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) sang World Health Organization kag sang mga WHO-recognized Food and Drug Administration FDA).
english: One reason is that the vaccines currently available can only be obtained under the Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) of the World Health Organization and the WHO-recognized Food and Drug Administration FDA).

text: In other words, yara pa ining mga vaccine sa experimental stage, although samtang yara pa sa third kag final clinical maka-claim na ini nga “effective and safe”.
english: In other words, these vaccines are still in the experimental stage, although while they are still in the third and final clinical they can claim to be “effective and safe”.

text: Sa karon ugaling, isa pa lang ka brand ang na-validate sang World Health Organization bilang “effective and safe” – ang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine.
english: Currently however, only one brand has been validated by the World Health Organization as “effective and safe” – the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine.

text: Ang buot silingon sini amo nga “pwede masaligan” pa lang, although kon mataas ang probability sini, katulad sang 95 ka porsyento sa kaso sang sining German-made vaccine, pwede na ini risguhan tutal wala man gani sing vaccine nga 100 percent nga “masaligan gid”.
english: This means that it is still “reliable”, although if the probability is high, such as 95 percent in the case of this German-made vaccine, it can be risked since there is no vaccine that is 100 percent “reliable”.

text: Ang vaccine batok sa measles, for example, sunu sa US FDA, may 93 percent kag 97 percent “efficacy” man lang sa duha sini ka dose pero ginasaligan na ini sang tanan sa kalibutan sa pagtapna sang measles.
english: The measles vaccine, for example, according to the US FDA, has only 93 percent and 97 percent efficacy in its two doses but is already trusted by everyone in the world to prevent measles.

text: Ikaduha nga rason amo nga luyag mahibal-an anay sang aton mga pumuluyo kon ano ang posible nga adverse effects sang sining vaccine kon matublukan ka na, kag kon bala matambagan ini kon matabo.
english: The second reason is that our citizens want to know first what the possible adverse effects of this vaccine are when you get it, and whether it can be advised if it happens.

text: Sa aton pagkahibalo, kon ma validate na kon “effective and safe” ang isa ka vaccine, lakip na dira ang ihibalo sa posible nga mga adverse effect sini kag kon paano ini posible matambagan.
english: To our knowledge, once a vaccine is validated as “effective and safe”, it includes knowledge of its possible adverse effects and how they can be treated.

text: Kon may adverse effect nga posible matabo sa imo, dapat mapaathag ini sa imo sang mga health authorities.
english: If an adverse effect is likely to happen to you, the health authorities should be able to explain it to you.

text: Ma-tolerar bala ini ukon posible magbutang ini sa imo sa daku nga peligro?
english: Is it tolerable or is it likely to put you at serious risk?

text: Kon nahadlok ka gid, indi ka na gid lang magpabakuna tutal boluntaryo man lang ini.
english: If you're too scared, don't get vaccinated since it's voluntary.

text:
***

Sa mga naga-presentar sa pagbaton na sing order para sa vaccine baok sa COVID-19, una na dira syempre ang Pfizer/bioNTech nga na-validate na sang WHO.
english:
***

Among those presenting to receive orders for the COVID-19 vaccine, the first is of course Pfizer/bioNTech which has been validated by the WHO.

text: Lakip man dira ang European Moderna vaccine, Oxford-AstraZeneca,  Chinese Sinovac kag Sinopharm, Zydus Cadila sang India, kag ang Novavax sang United States upod sa India nga nagahulat lang ma-isyuhan sang EUA.
english: These include the European Moderna vaccine, Oxford-AstraZeneca, Chinese Sinovac and Sinopharm, India's Zydus Cadila, and the United States' Novavax with India awaiting EUA approval.

text: Samtang, ginagamit na sa karon  ang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine sa Germany, United Kingdom, kag iban pa ka pungsod sa Uropa; subong man sang United States kag iban pa nga pungsod sa Amerika.
english: Meanwhile, the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine is now being used in Germany, the United Kingdom, and other European countries; as well as the United States and other American countries.

text: In fact, isa sang naka-order sang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine amo si Pope Francis para sa Vatican City.
english: In fact, one of those who ordered the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine was Pope Francis for Vatican City.

text: May problem ugaling ini tungod ang storage requirement sini yara sa negative freezing point, although indi ini problema sang mga manggaranon nga mga pungsod kag bisan sang mga highly urbanized cities sa Filipinas.
english: However, it has a problem because its storage requirement is at the negative freezing point, although this is not a problem of rich countries and even highly urbanized cities in the Philippines.

text: Ang Iloilo City, on the other hand, kag madamo pa nga lugar sa Filipinas, mas luyag mag-order sang Oxford-AstraZeneca, nga ang storage requirement yara lang sa normal cooling sang refrigerator halin sa 2-8 ka degrees Celsius.
english: Iloilo City, on the other hand, and many other places in the Philippines, prefer to order Oxford-AstraZeneca, whose storage requirement is only in the normal cooling of the refrigerator from 2-8 degrees Celsius.

text: Ang siyudad sang Iloilo naka-order na gani sang initial nga 600,000 ka dose.
english: Iloilo City has already ordered an initial 600,000 doses.

text: AstraZeneca man ang gina-order ni Iloilo Gov.
english: AstraZeneca is also being ordered by Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr.

text:
***

Luas sa storage requirement, posible maluyag man mag-order sang iban nga klase sang vaccine tungod sa iban nga rason.
english:
***

In addition to the storage requirement, you may also want to order other types of vaccines for other reasons.

text: Pwede mabasehan ang kadamuon sang vaccine nga makuha, ang “effectiveness” sang vaccine, ang presyo kon kinahanglan baklon, ang convenience sa pagpanagtag sang vaccine, adverse effects nga nahibal-an nga pwede malikawan, kon bala mas malawakan ang gamit sini sa general population, kag iban pa nga konsiderasyon pabor sa pungsod ukon partikular nga siyudad.
english: It can be based on the amount of vaccine available, the effectiveness of the vaccine, the price if it needs to be purchased, the convenience of distributing the vaccine, adverse effects that are known to be avoidable, whether it is more widely used in the general population, and other considerations in favor of the country or particular city.

text: Sin-o ang pwede mabakunahan sang Pfizer vaccine?
english: Who can get the Pfizer vaccine?

text: Tan-awon ta abe kon ngaa na-validate sang WHO bilang “effective and safe” ang Pizer/bioNTech vaccine.
english: Let's see why the WHO validated the Pizer/bioNTech vaccine as “effective and safe”.

text: Una gid tungod applicable ini sa may 16-85 nga pang-edaron nga makasakop sang madamo nga pumuluyo.
english: First, because it is applicable to those aged 16-85, which covers a large population.

text: Malawak man ang representasyon sang experimento sini sa mga puti, africano, Filipino kag Asyano, latino, kag iban pa.
english: Its experiment is also widely representative of whites, Africans, Filipinos and Asians, Latinos, and others.

text: Lakip diri sa experimento ang mga healthy kag bisan ang may masakit katulad sang diabetes, high blood, heart failure kag iban pa nga pwede mabakunahan.
english: The experiment includes healthy people and even those with diseases such as diabetes, high blood, heart failure and others who can be vaccinated.

text: Sin-o ang indi pwede mabakunahan?
english: Who cannot be vaccinated?

text: Una, ang mga kabataan nga kubos sa 16 anyos ang edad, kag ang sobra sa 85 anyos ang edad nga wala nalakip sa experimento.
english: First, children less than 16 years of age, and those over 85 years of age were excluded from the experiment.

text: Ginatun-an pa sini kon pwede malakip sa experimento ining kabataan.
english: It is still studying whether these children can be included in the experiment.

text: Ikaduha, ang ma-sertipayahan sang health authorities nga indi bagay bakunahan tungod sang ila delikado nga ginabatyag, katulad sang may serious allergic reaction sa bakuna kag iban pa nga masertipayan sang health authorities nga indi dapat bakunahan.
english: Second, those who are certified by the health authorities as not suitable for vaccination because of their dangerous condition, such as those who have a serious allergic reaction to the vaccine and others who are certified by the health authorities as not suitable for vaccination.

text: Ang WHO wala naga-rekomendar nga magpabakuna ang mga nagabusong.
english: The WHO does not recommend that pregnant women get vaccinated.

text: Ikatatlo, wala man gina-rekomendar sang US FDA nga malakip sa experimento kag mabakunahan sing anti-Covid-19 vaccine ang mga kabataan nga kubos ang edad sa 12 anyos.
english: Third, the US FDA also does not recommend that children under the age of 12 be included in the experiment and vaccinated with anti-Covid-19 vaccine.

text: Ano kalawak ang dapat nga immunization?

english: At 4 pm, the Holy Mass will be celebrated at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral presided over by Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D. along with other priests.

english: After the mass, a candle-lighting will be held to conclude the mobilization for the day.

text: “This will be a prayerful expression of our righteous anger sa makahuluya kag makaulugot nga pagpangurakot sa aton nga pungsod,” suno sa JASAC director.
english: “This will be a prayerful expression of our righteous anger at the shameful and outrageous corruption in our country,” the JASAC director said.

text: Ginmensyonar man sini ang political dynasty nga lakip man sa ila ipanawagan nga tapnaon bangud ginakabig man ini nga ugat sang kurapsyon.
english: He also mentioned the political dynasty which is also among their calls to stop because it is also considered the root of corruption.

english: The Anti-Corruption Movement (KKK) also confirmed that it will join the Church in the activity on February 25.

text: Sa schedule sang KKK ukon ang multi-sectoral alliance sang mga Ilonggo batok sa kurapsyon, magatipon ang nagkalain-lain nga cause-oriented groups kag protesters sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol 12:30 sang hapon kag pagasundan sang mga ambahanon kag mga speech.

english: Both the KKK and the Archdiocese of Jaro require the wearing of white clothing on that day.

text: Tuigan nga ginakomemorar sa Pilipinas ang 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution nga amo ang nagtapos sang diktadurya ni anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Sr., ang amay ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.#
english: The Philippines annually commemorates the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution that ended the dictatorship of former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr., the father of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.#

text: Hugot nga gina-monitor sang Japan ang aktibidad sang 10 ka Chinese kag Russian naval vessels nga naglabay sa dagat nga amo ang nagaseparar sa main island sang Hokkaido kag sa Japan.
english: Japan is closely monitoring the activities of 10 Chinese and Russian naval vessels that have passed through the sea that separates the main island of Hokkaido from Japan.

text: Suno kay Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihiko Isozaki, wala man sang ginlapas ang duha ka pungsod apang dapat gihapon bantayan.
english: Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Yoshihiko Isozaki said the two countries have not violated anything but should still be monitored.

text: Ini ang una nga bes nga nag-agi sang dungan ang vessels sang China kag Russia sa Tsugaru Strait agud makasulod sa Pacific.
english: This is the first time that Chinese and Russian vessels have passed simultaneously through the Tsugaru Strait to enter the Pacific.

text: Suno sa security analyst sang National Institute of Defence Studies (NIDS), nga affiliated sa Defence Ministry sa Tokyo, daw kaangay nga ginapakita sang China sa Japan ang ila nga pwersa militar kag ang abilidad sini nga makalayag bisan diin nila gusto.
english: According to a security analyst at the National Institute of Defense Studies (NIDS), affiliated with the Defense Ministry in Tokyo, it seems that China is showing Japan its military force and its ability to sail wherever they want.

text: Ang Russia naman ang ginalantaw nga nagapalab-ot sang kaangay man nga mensahe sa Estados Unidos.
english: Russia, on the other hand, is seen as conveying a similar message to the United States.

text: Todo-panginwala ang China nga nagpatigayon sila sang missile test sang ila nuclear-capable hypersonic missile.
english: China has denied conducting a missile test of its nuclear-capable hypersonic missile.

text: Nagguwa ang initial report sa Financial Times newspaper nga ginkakibot sang US intelligence.
english: The initial report appeared in the Financial Times newspaper to the surprise of US intelligence.

text: Ang hypersonic missiles ang mas madasig ipaanggid sa normal lang nga missile — buot silingon mas mabudlay ini nga punggan.
english: Hypersonic missiles are faster than normal missiles — meaning they are harder to intercept.

text: Suno kay foreign ministry spokesman Zhao Lijian, nakapatigayon sang routine test ang China sang Hulyo agud nga i-verify ang nagkalain-lain nga sahi sang reusable spacecraft technology.
english: According to foreign ministry spokesman Zhao Lijian, China conducted a routine test in July to verify various types of reusable spacecraft technology.

text: Apang indi ini missile pahayag niya kundi isa ka spacecraft.
english: But it is not a missile, he said, but a spacecraft.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang tensyon sa tunga sang US kag China sa diin gina-akusaran sang Beijing ang administrasyon ni President Joe Biden nga mga kaaway.
english: It is known that there is tension between the US and China with Beijing accusing the administration of President Joe Biden of being enemies.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, ginbuyagyag sang North Korea nga nangin madinalag-on ang ila nga missile test.
english: Last month, North Korea revealed that its missile test was successful.

text: Kag sang Hulyo, kaangay man nga announcement ang ginhimo sang Russia kag ginpahayag nga ang ila nga missile ang ginlunsyar halin sa frigate ukon sa isa ka sahi sang warship sa White Sea.
english: And in July, Russia made a similar announcement and said its missile was launched from a frigate or a type of warship in the White Sea.

text: Maga-deploy sang 2,000 ka mga kapulisan ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) sa palaabuton nga Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) will deploy 2,000 policemen for the upcoming Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, iya ginpahayag nga kon kinahanglanon, may mga reserved na nga dugang nga kapulisan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky said that if necessary, there are reserved additional policemen.

text: Suno kay Wanky, nakadependi pa sa gihapon ang numero bangud mahimo pa nga madugangan ang mga aktibidad sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: According to Wanky, the number is still dependent because the activities of the Dinagyang Festival may be increased.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga subject to discuss ang signal jamming kon ini ang igapatuman sa Dinagyang Festival.
english: He also said that signal jamming is subject to discussion if it will be implemented during the Dinagyang Festival.

text: Gin-athag man ni Wanky nga kon kinahanglanon gid, mahimo magpatuman sang signal jamming, apang kon wala lang man sang pagpamahog sa seguridad, ipaiway na lang ang amo nga tikang.
english: Wanky also explained that if necessary, signal jamming can be implemented, but if there is no threat to security, the move should be postponed.

text: Matapos ang 12 ka adlaw nga pagtinir sa International Space Station (ISS), nakabalik na sa Earth ang Russian actor kag film director nga amo ang naga-shoot sang first movie in space.
english: After 12 days on the International Space Station (ISS), the Russian actor and film director, who is shooting the first movie in space, has returned to Earth.

text: Ginkumpirma sang Russian space agency nga Roscosmos nga nag-land na sa remote area sa guwa sang western Kazakhstan ang Soyuz MS-18 space capsule nga amo ang ginsakyan nanday Russian ISS crew member Oleg Novitskiy, Yulia Peresild kag Klim Shipenko.
english: Russian space agency Roscosmos has confirmed that the Soyuz MS-18 space capsule carrying Russian ISS crew members Oleg Novitskiy, Yulia Peresild and Klim Shipenko has landed in a remote area outside western Kazakhstan.

text: Kulang para sa 37 anyos nga aktres nga si Peresild ang 12 ka adlaw nga iya gintinir sa space.
english: The 12 days she spent in space were not enough for 37-year-old actress Peresild.

text: “I’m in a bit of a sad mood today..
english: “I’m in a bit of a sad mood today..

text: That’s because it had seemed that 12 days was such a long period of time, but when it was all over, I didn’t want to bid farewell,” suno sa aktres.
english: That’s because it had seemed that 12 days was such a long period of time, but when it was all over, I didn’t want to bid farewell,” according to the actress.

text: Ginpadala na sanday Peresild kag Shipenko sa Russian Star City — home sang space program sang Russia — para sa ila nga post-flight recovery.
english: Peresild and Shipenko have been sent to Russian Star City — home of Russia's space program — for their post-flight recovery.

text: Gin-ako sang city government nga ang National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) ang wala pa sang device agud nga makapatuman sang signal jamming sa pila ka mga designated area sa Iloilo City kaangot sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The city government acknowledged that the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) does not yet have the device to implement signal jamming in some designated areas in Iloilo City in connection with the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, Spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong wala pa sang gamit ang NTC kag wala sang technical capabilities agud magpatuman sang amo nga tikang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, Spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Treñas, said that at present the NTC is not equipped and does not have the technical capabilities to implement the measure.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, kon ang signal jamming ang intended agud nga makasekyar sang seguridad kag safety sang mga turista, bukas siya sa tuyo sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga signal jamming.
english: According to Fantilaga, if the signal jamming is intended to ensure the security and safety of tourists, he is open to the intention of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) to signal jamming.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga targeted lamang ang mga lugar kaangay sang mga judging area ang butangan sang signal jamming.
english: He also clarified that only targeted areas such as judging areas will be equipped with signal jamming.

text: Indi naman magpasugot ang alkalde sa tikang kon ang signal jamming ang makaapekto sa pila kabanwahanan nga malapit sa syudad lakip na ang isla sang Guimaras.
english: The mayor said he will not agree to the move if the signal jamming will affect some towns near the city including the island of Guimaras.

text: Panibag-o nga reklamo ang ginapangatubang ni anay Health Secretary Janette Garin kag iban pa sa Department of Justice (DOJ) may kaangtanan sa mga napatay sa Dengvaxia vaccine.
english: Former Health Secretary Janette Garin and others are facing a new complaint with the Department of Justice (DOJ) regarding the deaths from the Dengvaxia vaccine.

text: Apat ka mga indibidwal ang nagpasaka sang reklamo bangud sa reckless imprudence resulting in homicide batuk kay Garin kag iban pa nga mga anay opisyal.
english: Four individuals filed a complaint of reckless imprudence resulting in homicide against Garin and other former officials.

text: Gin-akusaran man ang mga ini nga naglapas sa Republic Act 9745 ukon Anti-Torture Act of 2009.
english: They were also accused of violating Republic Act 9745 or the Anti-Torture Act of 2009.

text: Magluwas diri, gin-alegar sang mga tagreklamo nga naglapas si Garin kag iban pa sa Consumer Act of the Philippines kag Philippine Pharmacy Act.
english: In addition, the complainants alleged that Garin and others violated the Consumer Act of the Philippines and the Philippine Pharmacy Act.

text: Natabo ini isa ka adlaw matapos nga ginbawi sang Department of Justice (DOJ) ang 19 ka kaso para sa reckless imprudence nga nagresulta sa homicide nga ginpasaka batok kay Garin kag sa duha ka iban pa.
english: This comes a day after the Department of Justice (DOJ) withdrew 19 counts for reckless imprudence resulting in homicide filed against Garin and two others.

text:
Una na nga ginlaragway ni Garin ang desisyon sang DOJ nga i-drop ang mga nauna nga panumbungon batuk sa iya bilang “victory for science.”

Sang 2017, ginmando sang Food and Drug Administration ang pagsuspinde sang pagpanagtag kag pagpamaligya sang Dengvaxia vaccine kag ang pag-withdraw sang produkto sa merkado.
english:
Garin earlier described the DOJ's decision to drop the previous charges against him as a “victory for science.”

In 2017, the Food and Drug Administration ordered the suspension of the distribution and marketing of the Dengvaxia vaccine and the withdrawal of the product from the market.

text: Ini matapos nga nagpaandam ang Dengvaxia manufacturer nga Sanofi nga posible makatuga sang malala nga balatian ang bakuna sa malawig nga panahon para sa mga wala pa natapikan sang dengue antes ang pagbakuna.
english: This comes after Dengvaxia manufacturer Sanofi warned that the vaccine could cause serious illness in the long term for those who were not infected with dengue before vaccination.

text: Gin-kidnap sang ginapahayag mga miyembro sang gang sa Haiti ang 17 tanan ka mga American kag Canadian missionaries.
english: Alleged gang members in Haiti kidnapped a total of 17 American and Canadian missionaries.

text: Suno sa organisasyon nga Christian Aid Ministries, sa 17 ka gin-kidnap, 16 ang halin sa Estados Unidos: lima ka lalaki, pito ka babayi, lima ka kabataan.
english: According to the organization Christian Aid Ministries, of the 17 abductees, 16 were from the United States: five men, seven women, five children.

text: Suno sa security forces, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa subong kag hugot man ang ila pagpakig-angot sa US State Department.
english: According to the security forces, the investigation is ongoing and they are in close cooperation with the US State Department.

text: Natabo ang insidente sang nagabyahe ang missionaries padulong sa Titanyen matapos nga nagbisita sa orphanage sa Croix des Bouquets area
english: The incident occurred when the missionaries were traveling to Titanyen after visiting the orphanage in the Croix des Bouquets area

text: Indi imbitado ang Russia sa virtual meeting sang 30 ka mga pungsod nga ginapamunuan sang Estados Unidos nga may katuyuan nga papason ang lapnagon nga ransomware kag iban pa nga cyber crime.
english: Russia is not invited to the virtual meeting of 30 countries led by the United States aimed at stamping out widespread ransomware and other cyber crime.

text: Suno sa private sector cybersecurity experts, madamo nga mga ransomware gangs ang naga-operate sa Ukraine kag Rusia.
english: According to private sector cybersecurity experts, many ransomware gangs operate in Ukraine and Russia.

text: Pahayag naman sang US officials kag analysts, ang mga Russian ransomware gangs ang naga-operate nga may approval nagikan sa Kremlin apang indi direkta nga gina-kontrol sang gobyerno.
english: US officials and analysts say Russian ransomware gangs operate with approval from the Kremlin but are not directly controlled by the government.

text: Ang US ang gina-updan sang India, Australia, Germany kag United Kingdom nga amo ang magapamuno sang diskusyon tuhoy sa mga topiko kaangay sang disruption, virtual currency kag diplomacy.
english: The US is joined by India, Australia, Germany and the United Kingdom who will lead discussions on topics such as disruption, virtual currency and diplomacy.

text: Lakip man sa pagsinapol ang Canada, France, Brazil, Mexico, Japan, Ukraine, Ireland, Israel, South Africa, kag European Union.
english: The meeting also included Canada, France, Brazil, Mexico, Japan, Ukraine, Ireland, Israel, South Africa, and the European Union.

text: 32 ang kumpirmado nga patay kag masobra 10 ang pilason matapos naglapaw sa dalan ang isa ka bus sa northwestern Nepal.
english: 32 confirmed dead and more than 10 injured after a bus crossed the road in northwestern Nepal.

text: Nahulog gid ang salakyan sa Pina isa ka suba sa Chhayanath Rara Municipality.
english: The vehicle actually fell into Pina a river in Chhayanath Rara Municipality.

text: Ginapahayag 45 ang sakay sang amo nga bus kag padulong kuntani sa Mugu area — kalabanan sang sakay sini ang maga-selebrar kuntani sang Hindu festival sang Dashain.
english: The bus was reportedly carrying 45 people and was heading to the Mugu area — most of the passengers were supposed to celebrate the Hindu festival of Dashain.

text: Nagbulig ang mga helicopter agud madala ang mga pilason sa ospital.
english: Helicopters helped to take the wounded to the hospital.

text: Ginakahangaw-an nga labi pa nga magasaka ang death toll.
english: The death toll is feared to rise further.

text: Nakaguwa na sa Pilipinas ang isa ka police general nga natalana kuntani nga arestuhon bangud sa ginaalegar nga involvement sa mishandling sang P6.7-billion drug case.
english: A police general who was scheduled to be arrested for alleged involvement in the mishandling of a P6.7-billion drug case has been released from the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Philippine National Police (PNP) spokesperson Brig Gen.
english: According to Philippine National Police (PNP) spokesperson Brig Gen.

text: Jean Fajardo, ini nga general ang nakabiya na sa Pilipinas sang Enero 8 ukon antes pa man nagguwa ang arrest warrant.
english: Jean Fajardo, the general left the Philippines on January 8 or before the arrest warrant was issued.

text: Nakasentro ini nga kaso kay dismissed Police Master Sergeant Rodolfo Mayo Jr.
english: This case centers on dismissed Police Master Sergeant Rodolfo Mayo Jr.

text: nga nadakpan kadungan man sang pagkumpiskar sang mga otoridad sang 990 kilograms sang suspected shabu nga may estimated value nga masobra P6.7 billion sa drug operations sa Manila sang 2022.
english: who was arrested in conjunction with the seizure of 990 kilograms of suspected shabu with an estimated value of more than P6.7 billion in drug operations in Manila in 2022.

text: Si Mayo ang nakaserbe anay nga intelligence officer sang PNP Drug Enforcement Group.
english: Mayo was a former intelligence officer of the PNP Drug Enforcement Group.

text: Nangin mas kontrobersyal ang amo nga kaso bangud sa gin-alegar nga tuyo sang mga police officers nga luwason kag tabun-tabunan pa ang sala ni Mayo.
english: The case became more controversial because of the alleged intention of the police officers to save and cover up Mayo's crime.

text: Lakip sa ginkasuhan sang piskalya amo ang 30 ka aktibo kag anay mga pulis lakip ang duha ka ranking police generals bangud sa paglapas sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Among those charged by the prosecution were 30 active and former police officers including two ranking police generals for violating the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Sa 30 nga ginkasuhan, 29 ang may arrest warrants.
english: Of the 30 charged, 29 have arrest warrants.

text: 20 ang yara na sa kustodiya sang pulis, kag siyam na lang ang at large lakip na ang absent nga police general.
english: 20 are already in police custody, and only nine are at large including the absent police general.

text: Magluwas sa iya, ang walo nga iban pa nga ginapangita amo ang apat ka aktibo nga pulis, tatlo ka retired personnel, isa nga nag-resign, kag isa nga nasipa man sa serbisyo.
english: Besides him, the eight other wanted persons are four active police officers, three retired personnel, one who resigned, and one who was also kicked out of service.

text: Isa sa pinaka-memorable nga mga tinion sang kita yara sa elementarya amo ang paghampang kaupod sa aton damo-damo nga classmates.
english: One of the most memorable moments when we were in elementary school was playing with our many classmates.

text: Na-imagine mo bala ang imo kaugalingon kun halimbawa, absent ang imo nga mga friends kag playmates kag ikaw lang isa ang nag-eskwela?
english: Can you imagine yourself if, for example, your friends and playmates were absent and you were alone in school?

text: Kasubo, indi bala?
english: Sadness, isn’t it?

text: Sa isa ka distrito sa Japan, Grade 1 pa lang kag anum ka tuig ang edad sang bata nga si Nozomi Fujioka apang naagaw na sini ang atensyon sang bilog nga faculty sa eskwelahan!
english: In one district in Japan, six-year-old Nozomi Fujioka was in Grade 1 but had already caught the attention of the entire school faculty!

text: Ini bangud isahanon lang ini nga estudyante nga nag-enrol sa Grade I sa Yanagidani Elementary School sa ila nga lugar.
english: This is because he is the only student who enrolled in Grade I at Yanagidani Elementary School in their area.

text: Bisan isahanon lang si Nozomi, malipayon siya nga gin-abi-abi sang eskwelahan paagi sa isa ka entrance ceremony nga isa ka tradisyon sa Japanese schools.
english: Although Nozomi was alone, the school happily welcomed her with an entrance ceremony that is a tradition in Japanese schools.

text: Sang 2021 tubtub sang 2023, wala gid sang bisan isa nga nag-enroll sa Grade 1 amo gani nga ginsirado na lang ang eskwelahan sang nagligad nga tuig bangud wala man sang enrollees.
english: From 2021 to 2023, no one enrolled in Grade 1 so the school was closed last year because there were no enrollees.

text: Ina bangud ang Yanagidani district sa banwa sang Kumakogencho ang may yara lamang sang 540 populasyon, kag sa sini nga mga tawo, gamay lang gid ang mga bata.
english: That’s because the Yanagidani district in Kumakogencho town only has a population of 540, and of these people, very few are children.

text: Isa sa pinakamalipayon sa pag-eskwela ni Nozomi amo ang iya amay nga si Tsuyoshi nga ginbata kag nagdaku gid sa Yanagidani, lugar nga ginbayaan na sang iban bangud nagakadto ang iban nga mga residente sa mas dalagku nga syudad para sa mas daku nga academic kag professional opportunities.
english: One of the happiest about Nozomi’s schooling is her father Tsuyoshi who was born and actually raised in Yanagidani, area that has been abandoned by some as other residents go to bigger cities for greater academic and professional opportunities.
