text: Sa bilog nga eskwelahan, apat sanday Nozomi kag siya ang agot apang wala ini nahadlok bangud friendly man ang iban nga kabataan nga yara sa mas mataas nga grade level.
english: In the whole school, there are four children and Nozomi is the youngest but she is not afraid because the other children in the higher grade level are friendly.

text: Isa man sa naplanuhan sang eskwelahan amo nga tingubon ang mga bata sa tion sang Physical Education ukon PE para mas mangin masadya kag makapartisipar ang mga ini sa group games.
english: One of the plans of the school is to bring the children together during Physical Education or PE so that they can have more fun and participate in group games.

text: Posible nga ipaidalom sa lockdown ang anom ka mga barangay sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Six barangays in Iloilo City are likely to be placed under lockdown.

text:
Kasunod sang pagsaka sang COVID-19 cases, ginaplanuhan na sang COVID-19 team nga i-lockdown ang pila ka bahin ukon ang bug-os nga barangay sang:

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jeck Conlu, spokesperson sang COVID-19 Team sang Iloilo City Government, iya ginpahayag nga nakigsapol na sila sa mga barangay officials sang nasambit nga mga lugar agud makahatag sang giya kun paano patigayunon ang plano nga paglockdown.
english:
Following the increase in COVID-19 cases, the COVID-19 team is planning to lockdown some parts or the entire barangay of:

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jeck Conlu, spokesperson of the COVID-19 Team of the Iloilo City Government, said they have already met with the barangay officials of these areas to provide guidance on how to implement the planned lockdown.

text: Suno kay Conlu, ginapreparar naman ang tanan nga kinahanglanon sang mga barangay kaangay sang bulig nga ayuda.
english: According to Conlu, all the needs of the barangays such as relief goods are being prepared.

text: May iga-augment man nga mga police personnel nagikan sa Iloilo City Police Office agud magbantay kag magpatigayon sang checkpoint sa anom ka barangay.
english: Police personnel from the Iloilo City Police Office will also be augmented to guard and conduct checkpoints in the six barangays.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ang nutumod nga mga barangay ang may pinakamataas nga narekord nga COVID-19 cases humalin Mayo 1 tubtob Mayo 23.
english: He said the identified barangays had the highest recorded COVID-19 cases from May 1 to May 23.

text: Nag-file man subong nga adlaw sang counter-affidavit si former DPWH Manuel Bonoan kaangot sa reklamo nga plunder batok sa iya sa Department of Justice.
english: Former DPWH Manuel Bonoan also filed a counter-affidavit today regarding the plunder complaint against him with the Department of Justice.

text: Suno kay DOJ Spokesperson Atty. Polo Martinez, indi lang isa ka proyekto o lugar ang dala sang reklamo nga plunder.
english: According to DOJ Spokesperson Atty. Polo Martinez, it is not just one project or place that is brought about by the complaint of plunder.

text: Natungod man ini sa gina-alegar pagkuha sang ill-gotten wealth nga masobra P50 million nga nakuha sini paagi sa nagkalain-lain nga trasaksyon.
english: It is also related to the alleged taking of ill-gotten wealth of more than P50 million that he obtained through various transactions.

text:
Ginkumpirma man ni Bonoan nga may plano ini nga magkadto sa Estados Unidos apang wala pa sini mahibalui kun san-o.

Suno pa kay Bonoan nga ginpasugtan man ini sang Department of Justice

Sa matandaan nga nagbiyahe si Bonoan padulong sa Estados Unidos paagi sa Taiwan sang Nobyembre 2025 agud updan ang iya asawa nga mag-paidalum sa isa ka medical procedure.
english:
Bonoan also confirmed that he plans to go to the United States but he does not know when.

Bonoan said the Department of Justice has also approved this

Bonoan traveled to the United States via Taiwan in November 2025 to accompany his wife to undergo a medical procedure.

text: Nagbalik ini sa Pilipinas sang Enero 18, 2026.
english: It returns to the Philippines on January 18, 2026.

text: Nauna na sini ginpanginwala ang alegasyon nga nagbaton ini sang masobra P2 bilyon nga kickback halin sa mga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: He earlier denied allegations that he received more than P2 billion in kickbacks from government projects.

text: Nag-abot na si eight-division legend Manny Pacquiao sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika agud umpisahan ang training para sa iya natalana nga pagbalik sa hampang.
english: Eight-division legend Manny Pacquiao has arrived in the United States of America to begin training for his scheduled return to the ring.

text: Kaupod ni Pacquiao sa Los Angeles, California ang iya asawa nga si Jinkee kag iya anak nga si Jimuel nga didto na nga daan sa amo nga state.
english: Pacquiao was accompanied in Los Angeles, California by his wife Jinkee and son Jimuel who is already in the state.

text: Yara man sa flight ang abyan sini kag trainer nga si Buboy Fernandez.
english: His friend and trainer Buboy Fernandez was also on the flight.

text: Amo ini ang ginalantaw nga pag-umpisa sang duha ka bulan nga paghanas sang Pinoy boxer, apang wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun makaupod sini si Coach Freddie Roach sa Wild Card Boxing Club sa Hollywood ukon magasaylo sa lain nga training facility.
english: This is expected to be the beginning of the Pinoy boxer's two-month training, but there is no confirmation whether Coach Freddie Roach will join him at the Wild Card Boxing Club in Hollywood or move to another training facility.

text: Natalana nga mag-atubang si Pacquiao kay defending World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion Mario Barrios sa Hulyo 19, 2025 sa Las Vegas, Nevada.
english: Pacquiao is scheduled to face defending World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight champion Mario Barrios on July 19, 2025 in Las Vegas, Nevada.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana nagpaguwa sang latest ranking ang WBC.
english: Last week the WBC released the latest ranking.

text: Gin-lista ang 46-anyos nga Filipino southpaw sa numero singko sa 147-pound class apisar nga indi na ini aktibo sa boksing halin pa sang Agusto 2021 sang nalutos siya sa hampang sa idalom sang World Boxing Association.
english: The 46-year-old Filipino southpaw is listed at number five in the 147-pound class despite not being active in boxing since August 2021 when he lost a match under the World Boxing Association.

text: Base sa nauna nga reports, may plano man nga ibutang ang anak ni Pacquiao nga si Jimuel sa professional boxing sa undercard sang Barrios fight.
english: According to previous reports, there are also plans to put Pacquiao's son Jimuel in professional boxing on the undercard of the Barrios fight.

text: Antes ang pagbalik sa ring, natalana anay nga magpahuway ang amay nga Pacquaio sa training kag magatambong ini sa enshrinement sa iya sa International Boxing Hall of Fame sa Canastota, New York.
english: Before returning to the ring, Pacquaio's father is scheduled to take a break from training and will attend his enshrinement at the International Boxing Hall of Fame in Canastota, New York.

text: Naglab-ot sa 51 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa lapnagon nga pag-ulan kag baha sa central Vietnam.
english: At least 51 people have been killed in widespread rains and floods in central Vietnam.

text: Bangud sa pila ka adlaw nga pag-ulan, lubog ang masobra 52,000 ka mga kabalayan kun sa diin ma na-report nga siyam ka tawo ang na-missing.
english: Due to several days of heavy rains, more than 52,000 houses were flooded and nine people were reported missing.

text: Masobra tunga sa milyon ka mga kabalayan kag establishimento ang nadulaan man sang suplay sang kuryente.
english: More than half a million homes and establishments also lost power supply.

text: Halin pa sang Enero tubtob Oktubre, naglab-ot na sa masobra $2 billion ang halit nga gintuga sang mga mabaskog nga bagyo nga nag-agi sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: From January to October, more than $2 billion in damage was caused by the strong typhoons that passed through the country.

text: GIN-ATAKE sadtong Enero 6 sang linibu nga supporter ni President Donald Trump ang US Capitol, ang “seat of power” sang pungsod sa Washington, D.C., nga ginbasol sa pang-udyok ni Trump sa iya supporters.
english: ON January 6, thousands of supporters of President Donald Trump stormed the US Capitol, the country's “seat of power” in Washington, D.C., blaming Trump for inciting his supporters.

text: Gin-okupar nila ang capitol grounds kag pilit nga magsulod.
english: They occupied the capitol grounds and forced their way inside.

text: Nakigtulakan sa mga security personnel kag namuka pa sang mga bintana kag ganhaan agud makasulod.
english: He fought with security personnel and even opened windows and doors to get inside.

text: Pinunggan kag ginhabuyan sang smoke bomb, apang nakasulod gid.
english: Stopped and thrown a smoke bomb, but managed to get inside.

text: Tinultol ang mga hulot, lakip na ang session hall sang Senado kag ang mga hulot sang mga lawmakers.
english: The rooms, including the Senate session hall and the lawmakers' chambers, were cleared.

text: Nangguba man sila sang mga kagamitan diri kag may nangawat pa samtang ginasinggit ang ila pagsuporta kay Trump.
english: They also destroyed equipment here and even stole some while shouting their support for Trump.

text: Maayo lang kay natapos gid man ang pagbotohay sang Senado – upod man ang mga kapartido ni Trump sa Republican Party.
english: Fortunately, the Senate vote did end – along with Trump’s Republican Party allies.

text: Diri gin-confirmar na nila ang pagdaug ni President-elect Joe Biden upod kay Vice President-elect Kamala Harris halin sa electoral votes.
english: Here they have confirmed the victory of President-elect Joe Biden along with Vice President-elect Kamala Harris from the electoral votes.

text: Sa natabo nga “riot”, isa ka Trump supporter ang naluthangan patay; ang pila pa gid tungod sa atake sa korason kag sang pagdinagoso.
english: In the riot, a Trump supporter was shot dead; others because of heart attacks and strokes.

text: Madamo man ang nasamaran kag na-ospital lakip ang pila ka security personnel sa kapitolyo.
english: Many were also injured and hospitalized including some security personnel in the capitol.

text: So far, 83 ang naaresto samtang ginapangita pa ang iban.
english: So far, 83 have been arrested while others are still being sought.

text: May nasapwan pa nga 11 ka molotov bomb sa isa ka van sang isa ka protester kag madamo nga inuglampos nga mga bagay nga dala sang iban.
english: Eleven Molotov cocktails were also found in a protester's van and several explosives carried by others.

text: Samtang, nahimo pa ni Trump nga ipahibalo sa iya tweet sa Twitter nga wala siya plano agud patigayunon ang isa ka malinong kag orderly nga pagbulos sa poder ni Biden.
english: Meanwhile, Trump was able to announce in a tweet on Twitter that he has no plans to conduct a peaceful and orderly transition of power to Biden.

text: “They will have a giant voice into the future; and they will not be disrespected or treated unfairly in any way, shape or form,” paathag pa niya.
english: “They will have a giant voice into the future; and they will not be disrespected or treated unfairly in any way, shape or form,” he explained.

text: Ginpat-ud man niya nga indi siya magtambong sa inagurasyon ni Biden  sa Enero 20 tungod wala niya ginakilala ang pagdaug ni Biden.
english: He also confirmed that he will not attend Biden's inauguration on January 20 because he does not recognize Biden's victory.

text: Kag ina bisan pa sa iya pagkalutos sa inisipay sang boto, sa pagkalutos sa korte, kag bisan pa sa pagbaton sang iya mga kapartido sang iya kalutosan.
english: And that despite his loss in the vote count, his loss in court, and despite his party members accepting his defeat.

text: Tungod sini, gin-supende na sang Twitter kag bisan sang Facebook ang mga account ni Trump agud indi na mabasahan pa, sandig sa ila polisa batok sa “misinformation” kag “inciting to violence”.
english: As a result, Twitter and even Facebook have suspended Trump's accounts, citing their policies against "misinformation" and "inciting to violence".

text:
Naakig na gani si Biden kag nagpaandam sing: “Enough is enough is enough is enough…!”

Sa ulihi na lang nagpanawagan si Trump – sang madamo na ang nadisgrasya kag nahalitan – nga magpakalinong na ang mga supporter niya kag indi na pagsamungan ang pagpungko sa poder ni Biden.
english:
Biden even went so far as to warn: “Enough is enough is enough is enough…!”

It was only later that Trump called – when many were injured and injured – for his supporters to calm down and not interfere with Biden's presidency.

text: Samtang, ginpakamalaut sang madamo ining pag-atake sa kapitolyo sang mga supporter ni Trump.
english: Meanwhile, many condemned this attack on the capitol by Trump supporters.

text: Indi lang sang mga Democrat, kundi pati na sang mga kapareho niya nga Republican, kag bisan sang madamo nga lideres sang iban nga pungsod.
english: Not just by Democrats, but also by his fellow Republicans, and even by many foreign leaders.

text:
***

Wala ugaling salig sa panawagan ni Trump si House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (Democrat), labi na gid sang nagwa ang intelligence report nga gaplano pa ang mga supporter ni Trump sang liwat nga pag-atake sa kapitolyo sa Enero 17.
english:
***

However, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (Democrat) did not trust Trump's call, especially after intelligence reports came out that Trump's supporters were still planning another attack on the capitol on January 17.

text: Ginakulbaan gani ang iban sa pagpakita ni Trump sing “unbalanced behavior”, samtang presidente gihapon tubtub Enero 19, 2021.
english: Some are even worried about Trump showing “unbalanced behavior”, while still president until January 19, 2021.

text: Basi kuno mag-order ini,  sa hingapos sang iya termino, sang “nuclear strike”, ukon ang paggamit sang armas nuclear.
english: He may order, at the end of his term, a “nuclear strike”, or the use of nuclear weapons.

text: Batok kay sin-o pa kundi sa China, nga ginadumtan gid niya kag ginagarit-garit sa mga isyu sa China Sea, nga makadabuk sang makasiligni nga 3rd World War!
english: Against whom but China, whom he hates so much and is being bullied over China Sea issues, that could ignite a terrible 3rd World War!

text: Tungod sini, nanawagan na si Pelosi sa Joint Chiefs of Staff sang US Armed Forces nga indi gid pagpasugtan si Trump sa pag-order sang “nuclear strike”.
english: Pelosi has called on the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the US Armed Forces not to allow Trump to order a nuclear strike.

text: Maayo man kay nagpasalig sila nga indi nila pagtumanon ining isugo ni Trump, labi na sa pagkilala na sang pagdaug ni Biden.
english: Fortunately, they have promised not to obey Trump's order, especially in recognition of Biden's victory.

text: Pila ka kasuguan nga ginaduso ni Trump wala na gani ginsapak sang Kongreso.
english: Several laws proposed by Trump have even been ignored by Congress.

text: Gin-aha man si Vice President Pence agud mag-takeover sa presidency ni Trump tungod indi na ini “able to govern the US government”.
english: Vice President Pence was also urged to take over Trump's presidency because he is no longer "able to govern the US government".

text: Namalibad si Pence, gani nagplano na ang House nga mag-file sang impeachment batok sa kay Trump.
english: Pence refused, so the House planned to file impeachment charges against Trump.

text: Kon ano man ang matabo thereafter, kabay lang nga magbalik na sa normal ang kahimtangan sa United States nga sa karon nabutang sa daku nga kahuy-anan.
english: Whatever happens thereafter, I hope that things will return to normal in the United States, which is currently in great shame.

text: Kag syempre sang paglibak sang iban nga pungsod sa ginapabugal gid sini bilang ejemplo sang Demokrasya sa bilug nga kalibutan./PN
english: And of course the ridicule of other countries for what it is so proud of as an example of democracy in the world./PN

text: Ginpasar sang Senado sa third and final reading ang hagna nga nagatuyo nga maghatag sang Filipino citizenship sa Chinese national nga si Li Duan Wang ukon kilala man nga si Mark Ong apisar pa nga ginaalegar nga may kaangtanan man ini sa Philippine offshore gaming operators (Pogos).
english: The Senate passed on third and final reading a bill aimed at granting Filipino citizenship to Chinese national Li Duan Wang or also known as Mark Ong despite allegations that he is also linked to Philippine offshore gaming operators (Pogos).

text: Sa plenary session, Enero 28, nakakuha ang hagna sang 19 affirmative votes, isa nga negative, kag zero abstention.
english: In the plenary session, January 28, the bill received 19 affirmative votes, one negative, and zero abstentions.

text: Ang isahanon nga nagpamatok diri amo si Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros nga nagpaathag nga indi masarangan sang iya konsensya nga paboran ang pag-grant sang Filipino citizenship kay Wang.
english: The only objector was Senate Deputy Minority Leader Risa Hontiveros who explained that her conscience could not allow her to favor the granting of Filipino citizenship to Wang.

text: Antes sini, nag-apelar ang senadora sa iya kaupdanan nga ibasura ang hagna bangud ginpahayag sini nga “junket operator” si Wang sang Nine Dynasty Casino nga isa sa pinakadaku nga Pogo actors na nabuyagyag sang hearings nga ginpatigayon anay sang Senate panel on women.
english: Earlier, the senator appealed to her colleagues to reject the bill because she said Wang was a “junket operator” of the Nine Dynasty Casino, one of the biggest Pogo actors exposed during the hearings conducted by the Senate panel on women.

text: Suno sa Senadora, sang nag-apply si Wang para sa naturalization, wala sini ginsugid nga junket operator siya sang Nine Dynasty.
english: The senator said that when Wang applied for naturalization, he did not disclose that he was a junket operator of Nine Dynasty.

text: Para kay Hontiveros, makaalarma ini, bangud suno sa iya, kun legal ang junket, indi man ini kinahanglan nga taguon sa publiko.
english: For Hontiveros, this is alarming, because according to him, if the junket is legal, it does not need to be hidden from the public.

text: Dugang diri, ginaalegar nga may kaangtanan man ini kay Duanren Wu nga amo ang “big boss” sang gin-raid nga POGO hub sa Porac, Pampanga.
english: In addition, it is alleged that it is also related to Duanren Wu who is the “big boss” of the raided POGO hub in Porac, Pampanga.

text: Magluwas diri, ginbuyagyag man ni Senator Hontiveros nga may yara si Wang sang madamo nga taxpayer identification numbers nga nagalapas sa polisa sang Pilipinas.
english: Senator Hontiveros also revealed that Wang has multiple taxpayer identification numbers that violate Philippine policy.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Hontiveros nga makaalarma man ang affiliation ni Wang sa Philippine Jinjiang Yu Shi Association nga ginapatihan nga related sa united front sang Communist Party of China.
english: Hontiveros also said Wang's affiliation with the Philippine Jinjiang Yu Shi Association, which is believed to be related to the united front of the Communist Party of China, is also alarming.

text: Gin-athag sang senadora nga wala siya nagasiling nga guilty si Wang, apang may ‘red flags’ na siya nga nakit-an kag bastante ini para sa iya agud nga indi paghatagan sang Filipino citizenship ang amo nga Chinese national.
english: The senator explained that she is not saying that Wang is guilty, but she has already seen red flags and this is enough for her not to grant Filipino citizenship to the Chinese national.

text: Dugang sini, kuntani nakatuon na ang mga Pilipino sa natabo kay dismissed Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo nga sang ulihi nabalahuba nga isa gali ka Chinese national nga si Guo Hua Ping.
english: He added that Filipinos should have learned from what happened to dismissed Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo who was later exposed as a Chinese national named Guo Hua Ping.

text: “Hindi pa ba tayo natuto sa panloloko ni Guo Hua Ping, alias Alice Guo, o kay Yang Jianxin, alias Tony Yang?
english: “Aren't we used to the deception of Guo Hua Ping, alias Alice Guo, or Yang Jianxin, alias Tony Yang?

text: Hindi pa ba tayo nadala sa mga abusadong dayuhang nagpanggap na Pilipino para pagkakitaan ang taumbayan at dungisan ang ating mga sistema?” kabahin sang pahayag sini sa plenaryo.
english: Have we not been carried away by abusive foreigners who pretend to be Filipinos to make money from the people and pollute our systems?” part of its statement to the plenary.

text: “Susugal pa ba tayo muli sa isang taong ikinubli sa Kongreso ang kanyang mga kaduda-dudang kaugnayan?” dugang sini kasunod sang binotohay.
english: “Should we gamble again on a man who has inherited his dubious connections in Congress?” he added following the vote.

text: “Hindi ko po hinatulan na guiilty sa anumang krimen si Li Duan Wang… pero sapat ang mga red flag na ito para hindi siya pagkalooban ng pagiging Pilipino nang ganito lamang kadali.”#
english: “I did not find Li Duan Wang guilty of any crime... but these red flags are enough to prevent him from being a Filipino so easily.”#

text: Kapin 2 million na nga mga tawo ang ginpang-evacuate bangud sa mabaskog nga ulan kag lapnagon nga pagbaha sa Shanxi province sa China sa diin dugang nga 60 ka mga coal mines ang gin-untat sa pihak sang energy crisis sang pungsod.
english: More than 2 million people have been evacuated due to heavy rains and widespread flooding in China's Shanxi province where an additional 60 coal mines have been shut down despite the country's energy crisis.

text: Humalin pa sang tinalikdan nga semana nga malain ang tyempo sa nasambit nga lugar sa diin may mga balay nga nagguba, may mga landslides kag 70 ka mga distrito kag syudad sa Shanxi ang ginbaha.
english: Since last week, the weather in the area has been bad with houses destroyed, landslides and 70 districts and cities in Shanxi flooded.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, 17,000 ka mga panimalay ang nag-collapse kag apat ka mga pulis ang napatay sa landslide.
english: Authorities said 17,000 households collapsed and four policemen were killed in the landslide.

text: Nagapangatubang subong ang China sang energy shortage nga amo ang nagahatag sang supply sang kuryente sa mga ports, factories kag mga balay.
english: China is currently facing an energy shortage that supplies electricity to ports, factories and homes.

text: Magluwas sa 60 ka mga coal mines nga ginpa-untat ang produksyon, una na nga gin-shutdown ang 70 sini sang Oktubre 4.
english: In addition to the 60 coal mines that stopped production, 70 of them were shutdown on October 4.

text: Dayunon na gid sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) subong nga adlaw ang pag-imprinta sang mga balota para sa May 2025 midterm elections.
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) will resume printing of ballots for the May 2025 midterm elections today.

text: Suno kay Comelec Chairman George Garcia, maga-resume sila sa printing sa National Printing Office sa Quezon City 10:00 subong nga aga bisan ano pa ang matabo.
english: According to Comelec Chairman George Garcia, they will resume printing at the National Printing Office in Quezon City at 10:00 this morning no matter what happens.

text: Indi na pwede ang anuman nga delay suno sa opisyal bangud tuman na sila ka late sa oras kag makabig na ini nga self-imposed deadline.
english: Any delay is not allowed, the official said, because they are already too late and it is considered a self-imposed deadline.

text: Tatlo ka semana man nga naatrasar ang printing sang official ballots bangud sa temporary restraining orders nga gin-isyu sang Supreme Court batok sa desisyon sang poll body nga i-disqualify ukon i-declare nga nuisance candidates ang pila ka national and local aspirants.
english: The printing of official ballots was also delayed for three weeks due to temporary restraining orders issued by the Supreme Court against the poll body's decision to disqualify or declare some national and local aspirants as nuisance candidates.

text: Nagdangat na sa six million ballots na ang ginbasura sa nauna gin-print nga mga balota bangud sa desisyon sang Korte Suprema.
english: Six million ballots have been rejected from the previously printed ballots due to the Supreme Court's decision.

text: Ini katumbas sang kantidad nga P132-million.
english: This is equivalent to an amount of P132-million.

text: Ang ulihi nga rason nga na-delay ang Comelec amo bangud kay Francis Leo Marcos nga isa ka stage name sa matuod nga pangalan nga Norman Mangusin.
english: The last reason the Comelec was delayed was because of Francis Leo Marcos who is a stage name under the real name Norman Mangusin.

text: Una siya gindeklarar sang Comelec nga nuisance candidate, apang ginlakip siya sang Korte Suprema sa mandu nga dapat ibutang sa balota.
english: He was initially declared a nuisance candidate by the Comelec, but the Supreme Court included him in the order to be placed on the ballot.

text: Antes ang reprinting, nag-anunsyo naman ini nga maga-withdraw sa iya pagpadalagan rason nga wala naman nadayon ang Comelec sa ila schedule.
english: Before the reprinting, he announced that he would withdraw from his race, which is why the Comelec did not proceed with their schedule.

text: Target subong sang poll body nga maka-print sang 1.5-million nga mga balota sa kada adlaw para makabawi sa tiyempo nga ila nauyang bangud sa sini nga mga isyu.
english: The poll body now targets to print 1.5-million ballots per day to make up for the time they lost due to these issues.

text: Umpisahan sang gobyerno subong nga tuig ang pagtukod sang 99 cold storage facilities para nga mapalawig ang shelf life sang mga produkto — ukon malikawan nga madunot gilayon — kag mapabilin man nga estable ang suplay kag ang presyo.
english: The government will begin this year to build 99 cold storage facilities to extend the shelf life of products — or prevent them from spoiling immediately — while also keeping supply and prices stable.

text: Suno sa Department of Agriculture (DA), kabahin ini sang P3-billion project sang ahensya.
english: According to the Department of Agriculture (DA), this is part of the agency's P3-billion project.

text: Ini nga mga pasilidad ang may manubo nga operating costs suno sa department kag pagagamitan sang renewable energy sources kag sang power grid.
english: These facilities will have low operating costs, according to the department, and will be powered by renewable energy sources and the power grid.

text: Dugang pa sang ahensya, ginalauman nga mangin operational naman subong nga 2025 ang kadam-an sa magagmay nga cold storage facilities ukon modular chillers.
english: The agency added that most of the small cold storage facilities or modular chillers are expected to be operational by 2025.

text: Madugayan naman ukon ginabanta 18-22 ka bulan ang pagtukod sa larger facilities nga sarang makatago sang 2,800 to 3,500 pallet positions.
english: The construction of the larger facilities that can accommodate 2,800 to 3,500 pallet positions will take longer or approximately 18-22 months.

text: May plano man nga tukuron sa Camarines Sur, Oriental Mindoro, kag Nueva Ecija.
english: There are also plans to build in Camarines Sur, Oriental Mindoro, and Nueva Ecija.

text: Ang magadumala sini nga mega-cold storage facilities amo ang DA kaupod sa local government units kag farmers’ cooperatives and associations.
english: These mega-cold storage facilities will be managed by the DA in collaboration with local government units and farmers’ cooperatives and associations.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang kakulangan sa cold storage facilities ang isa man sa nangin rason kun ngaa madasig mapierde ang mga produkto kag nagresulta pa gid sa pagpanglakaak sa presyo kaangay sa natabo anay sa bombay.
english: It is known that the lack of cold storage facilities is also one of the reasons why the products are quickly lost and resulted in price increases similar to what happened in Bombay.

text: 16 ang patay kag anum ang yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon bangud sa pagtibusok sang isa ka eroplano sa Tatarstan, Russia.
english: 16 people are dead and six are in critical condition after a plane crashed in Tatarstan, Russia.

text: Sakay sang amo nga Russian plane ang 20 ka parachutists kag duha ka crew members.
english: The Russian plane was carrying 20 parachutists and two crew members.

text: Sandig sa report sang pilots pila ka ginutlo antes ang insidente, nagpalya ang left engine sang eroplano rason nga nag-attempt sila nga mag-emergency land malapit sa syudad sang Menzelinsk.
english: According to the pilots' report, moments before the incident, the plane's left engine failed and they attempted an emergency landing near the city of Menzelinsk.

text: Gintilawan sang pilots nga ipa-wala ang eroplano agud nga malikawan ang residential area apang naigu ang wing sang eroplano sa Gazelle vehicle sang nag-land na ini rason nga nagbaliskad ang aircraft.
english: The pilots tried to divert the plane to avoid the residential area but the wing of the plane hit the Gazelle vehicle when it landed causing the aircraft to overturn.

text: Ang Let L-410 Turbolet twin-engine short-range transport aircraft ang ginapanag-iyahan sang aeroclub sa city of Menzelinsk.
english: The Let L-410 Turbolet twin-engine short-range transport aircraft is owned by the aeroclub in the city of Menzelinsk.

text: Wala pa naghatag sang statement ang aeroclub bangud nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon.
english: The aeroclub has not yet issued a statement as the investigation is ongoing.

text: Patay ang anum ka tawo kag pilason ang 11 ka iban pa matapos ginbombahan ang isa ka salakyan sa tuyo nga patyon ang gobernador sang Aden sa Yemen.
english: Six people were killed and 11 others wounded after a car bomb attacked the governor of Aden in Yemen.

text: Sandig sa reports, nakaluwas sa amo nga pagpang-atake si Aden governor Ahmed Lamlas kag ang government minister nga si Salem al-Socotri.
english: According to reports, Aden governor Ahmed Lamlas and government minister Salem al-Socotri survived the attack.

text: Ang duha ka nasambit nga opisyal ang lunsay myembro sang separatist group sa southern Yemen.
english: The two officials are both members of the separatist group in southern Yemen.

text: Si Lamlas ang secretary-general sang Southern Transitional Council (STC), ang separatist group nga nagakontra sa Saudi-backed government sa pagkontrol sa Aden kag sa wider south sang Yemen.
english: Lamlas is secretary-general of the Southern Transitional Council (STC), the separatist group that opposes the Saudi-backed government for control of Aden and the wider south of Yemen.

text: Si Al-Suqatri naman ang myembro sang United Arab Emirates-backed STC.
english: Al-Suqatri is a member of the United Arab Emirates-backed STC.

text: Lakip sa napatay amo ang press secretary sang gobernador, ang photographer, ang head sang iya nga security detail, ang isa pa nila ka upod, kag ang civilian bystander.
english: Among the dead were the governor's press secretary, the photographer, the head of his security detail, another of their companions, and a civilian bystander.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon angot sa amo nga “terrorist assassination attempt”.
english: The investigation into the terrorist assassination attempt is ongoing.

text: Mas nagadamo ang numero sang Japanese nga mga lalaki ang nagapili nga magpungko sa toilet kun magpangihi.
english: More and more Japanese men are choosing to sit on the toilet when urinating.

text:
Ginapahayag nga better choice ini para sa mga lalaki sa Japan ipaanggid sa pagtindog bangud sang indi hungod nga “splashbacks.”

Sandig sa resulta sang survey sang nagligad nga Hunyo, 60 percent sang mga lalaki ang nagapili nga magpungko; kapin tunga sa sini ang nagpahayag nga nag-switch sila ‘from standing’.
english:
It is said to be a better choice for men in Japan compared to standing because of unintentional “splashbacks.”

According to the results of the survey last June, 60 percent of men choose to sit; more than half of these stated that they had switched ‘from standing’.

text: Quarter naman sini nga porsyento ang nagsiling nga “native toilet sitters” sila ukon naanad na nga daan nga magpungko kada magpangihi.
english: A quarter of this percentage said they were “native toilet sitters” or used to sitting every time they urinate.

text: Ang online survey sang Japanese toiletries manufacturer nga Lion Corporation ang nagkolekta sang sabat sa 1,500 ka mga lalaki nga nagaedad 20 anyos tubtub 60 anyos.
english: The online survey by Japanese toiletries manufacturer Lion Corporation collected responses from 1,500 men aged 20 to 60 years.

text: Total nga 60.9 percent ang naga-prefer nga magpungko sa bowl.
english: A total of 60.9 percent prefer to sit in the bowl.

text: Sa mga nag-switch halin sa standing to sitting, ang una nga rason amo ang talsik nga ila mahimo sa kada pagpangihi, 37.3 percent ang nagsiling nga may ill effects ang urine splashbacks sa ila mismo mata.
english: Among those who switched from standing to sitting, the first reason was the splash they could make every time they urinate, 37.3 percent said that urine splashbacks had ill effects on their own eyes.

text: Nagkit-anay sanday Pope Francis kag si U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi sa Vatican.
english: Pope Francis met with U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi at the Vatican.

text: Kilala si Pelosi nga ginapakamalaot sang pila ka mga bishops sa Estados Unidos bangud sang iya pagsuporta sa abortion rights.
english: Pelosi is known to be criticized by some bishops in the United States for her support of abortion rights.

text: Ang pagkitaay sang Santo Papa kag ni Pelosi ang natabo pila ka semana antes ang ginalauman nga pagpakigkita man ni US President Joe Biden kay Pope Francis.
english: The meeting between the Pope and Pelosi comes weeks before US President Joe Biden is also expected to meet with Pope Francis.

text: Si Biden, ikaduha nga Catholic U.S. president, ang nagapamatok sa abortion.
english: Biden, the second Catholic U.S. president, is opposed to abortion.

text: Si Pelosi, may lima ka kabataan, ang una na nagsiling nga ginasuportahan niya ang kinamatarong sang mga babayi nga makapili.
english: Pelosi, a mother of five, has previously said she supports women’s right to choose.

text: Si Pelosi man ang ikatatlo nga high-level U.S. official nga ginbaton ni Pope Francis kag sang senior Vatican officials subong nga tuig.
english: Pelosi is also the third high-level U.S. official to be received by Pope Francis and senior Vatican officials this year.

text: Ang duha ka iban pa amo sanday John Kerry, special presidential envoy for climate, kag si Antony Blinken, U.S. secretary of state.
english: The other two are John Kerry, special presidential envoy for climate, and Antony Blinken, U.S. secretary of state.

text: Nag-resign gilayon ang Austrian leader nga si Sebastian Kurz pila ka adlaw matapos gin-umpisahan ang imbestigasyon batok sa iya kaangot sa ginapahayag nakomiter nga bribery kag breach of trust.
english: Austrian leader Sebastian Kurz immediately resigned days after an investigation was launched against him for alleged bribery and breach of trust.

text:
Sa iya speech, ginpahayag ni Kurz nga luyag niya maghatag sang space agud masigurado ang “stability.”

Apisar nanaog sa pwesto, ginpanindugan sang 35-anyos nga Chancellor nga sala ang corruption allegations batok sa iya.
english:
In his speech, Kurz said he wanted to provide space to ensure “stability.”

Despite stepping down, the 35-year-old Chancellor insisted that the corruption allegations against him were false.

text: Ginpanginwala man sini nga gingamit niya ang kwarta sang gobyerno para sa iya pagpamulitika.
english: He also denied using government money for his politicking.

text: Suno kay Kurz, si Foreign Minister Alexander Schallenberg ang mangin bag-o nga chancellor sang Austria.
english: According to Kurz, Foreign Minister Alexander Schallenberg will be the new chancellor of Austria.

text: Hilway na sa katalagman ang Pinay sa Taiwan nga nasamaran matapos ini nag-selfie bisan nga manug-abot na ang tren.
english: The Filipina in Taiwan who was injured after taking a selfie even though the train was about to arrive is safe.

text: Suno kay Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO) chairperson Cheloy Garafil, nangin madinalag-on ang spine injury operation sa Filipina tourist apang nagakinahanglan pa ini sang duha ka semana nga rehabilitation antes ini makapungko liwat.
english: According to Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO) chairperson Cheloy Garafil, the spine injury operation on the Filipina tourist was successful but he still needs two weeks of rehabilitation before he can sit again.

text: Kun matapos na ang treatment, amo pa lang kag ginalantaw nga makapauli ini sa Pilipinas.
english: Once the treatment is completed, he is expected to return to the Philippines.

text: Base sa CCTV footage sa aksidente, nagatindog ang Pinay nga tuman ka lapit sa train tracks sa Shifen Sky Lantern Old Street kag ginapahayag nga naga-selfie samtang gina-alsa sini ang wala nga butkon.
english: Based on CCTV footage of the accident, the Filipina was standing very close to the train tracks at Shifen Sky Lantern Old Street and was allegedly taking a selfie while raising her left arm.

text: Bangud nag-abot ang tren, naigu ini kag natumba.
english: Because the train arrived, it was hit and fell.

text: Nayudyod pa ini sang pila ka tapak kag nakaangkon sang injuries sa iya nga ulo, dughan, kag sa pelvis nga nagkinahanglan gid sang operasyon.
english: He was dragged several feet and sustained injuries to his head, chest, and pelvis that required surgery.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag sang Taiwan Railway Police Bureau nga mahimo pa multahan ang biktima sang tubtub sa TWD50,000 ukon malapit sa P100,000 bangud sa trespassing sa train railing santo sa nakasaad sa Taiwan Railway Act.
english: In addition, the Taiwan Railway Police Bureau said the victim could be fined up to TWD50,000 or close to P100,000 for trespassing on the train railing under the Taiwan Railway Act.

text: Suno sa Philippine government official, maga-apelar sila nga ipaiway na lamang ang multa bangud malala na nga daan ang injuries nga naangkon sang Pinay.
english: According to the Philippine government official, they will appeal to waive the fine because the injuries sustained by the Filipina are already serious.

text: Nagpasalig man ang MECO nga mag-assist sila kun padayunon gid ang kaso sa iya violation sa safety protocol.
english: MECO also assured that they will assist if the case continues for his violation of safety protocol.

text: Nagalaum man si Garafil nga ini nga insidente ang indi makaapekto sa visa-free status sang Taiwan para sa Filipino tourists bangud isa lamang ini ka isolated occurrence.
english: Garafil also hopes that this incident will not affect Taiwan's visa-free status for Filipino tourists as it is only an isolated occurrence.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa iban nga Pinoy tourists nga magsunod man sa tanan nga mga regulasyon sang pungsod nga ila ginakadtuan.
english: He also appealed to other Filipino tourists to follow all the regulations of the country they are visiting.

text: Indi matupungan ang kalipay nga nabatyagan sang P100K regional winner sa One Two Panalo Part 23 Promo sang Bombo Radyo kag Star FM!
english: The P100K regional winner was overjoyed at the One Two Panalo Part 23 Promo of Bombo Radyo and Star FM!

text: Ini amo si Rosalia Alavez, 56-anyos, residente sang Veterans Village, Iloilo City kag naggamit sang proof of purchase nga MX3 Capsule.
english: Rosalia Alavez, 56, resident of Veterans Village, Iloilo City, used a proof of purchase MX3 Capsule.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alavez, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang labing-una nga kahigayonan nga nagdaog siya sa amo nga promo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alavez said this is the first time he has won the promo.

text: Suno kay Alavez, wala siya nagalaum nga siya ang makakuha sang first prize nga P100,000 sa Visayas Region.
english: Alavez said he did not expect to win the first prize of P100,000 in the Visayas Region.

text: Gamiton ni Alavez ang iya nadag-an sa pagpakay-o sang iya nga balay bangud masami ini nga nagatulo kon mag-ulan.
english: Alavez will use the winnings to repair his house because it often leaks when it rains.

text: Para sa iya, isa ini ka dako nga bugay bangud wala siya naga-untat sa pagpamati sa Bombo Radyo sugod sign on tubtob sign off.
english: For him, this is a great blessing because he does not stop listening to Bombo Radyo from sign on to sign off.

text: Naglab-ot sa third alarm ang sunog nga nagluntad sa Barangay Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The fire that broke out in Barangay Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City reached third alarm.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Glen Poral, residente sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang iya pagpasalamat nga wala gid tuman naapektohan sang sunog ang iya balay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Glen Poral, a resident of the said area, said he is grateful that his house was not badly affected by the fire.

text: Suno kay Poral, ubos gid lamon sang kalayo ang balay sang iya mga utod.
english: According to Poral, his brothers' house was completely destroyed by the fire.

text: Apang, nagapasalamat siya sa gihapon bangud wala sang may napilasa sa iya pamilya samtang nagapalagyo sa sunog.
english: However, he is still grateful that no one in his family was injured while fleeing the fire.

text: Ginkakibot man sang natungdan ang singgitan sang ila kasilingan nga may sunog rason nga gilayon siya napadulong sa Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Jaro.
english: He was also surprised when his neighbor shouted that there was a fire and immediately went to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Jaro.

text: Ginkasubo man sini ang mga natupok nga balay bangud halos sa ila ang wala sang may nasalbar.
english: He also expressed his condolences to the burned houses because almost none of them were saved.

text: Padayon naman nga ginaimbestigaran sang Bureau of Fire Protection ang insidente agud matumod ang ginhalinan sang kalayo kag ang balor nga nahalit sini.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection is still investigating the incident to determine the cause of the fire and the value of the damage.

text: Sa insyal nga impormasyon sang talatapan, yara sa 14 ka mga balay ang totally burned bangud sa nagluntad nga sunog.
english: According to the initial information of the office, 14 houses were totally burned due to the fire.

text: Nag-atubang subong nga adlaw ang anay tiglikom sang Department of Public Works and Highways nga si Manuel Bonoan sa ginpatigayon nga preliminary investigation sa Department of Justice.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways secretary Manuel Bonoan appeared today in the preliminary investigation conducted by the Department of Justice.

text: Ginapangatubang sini ang rekalmo nga plunder nga ginpasaka batok sa iya kaangot sa isyu sang korapsyon nga may kahilabtanan sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: He is facing a complaint of plunder filed against him in connection with the issue of corruption related to anomalous flood control projects.

text: Ginkumpirma ang pagsumite sa prosecution sang ‘counter-affidavit’ bangud sa reklamo.
english: The prosecution confirmed the submission of a counter-affidavit on the complaint.

text: Dala man sa respondent sang plunder case si Sen.
english: Also brought to the respondent of the plunder case is Sen.

text: Jinggoy Estrada.
english: Jinggoy Estrada.

text: Magluwas kay Estrada, nadala man sa mga respondents ang mga state witnesses nga sanday former Public Works Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo kag former district engineers Henry Alcantara kag Gerard Opulencia.
english: Besides Estrada, the respondents also brought state witnesses former Public Works Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo and former district engineers Henry Alcantara and Gerard Opulencia.

text: Dala man ang napatay nga si anaay DPWH undersecretary Catalina Cabral nga respondent man sa reklamo.
english: The deceased was also accompanied by former DPWH undersecretary Catalina Cabral, who is also a respondent in the complaint.

text: Magluwas sa plunder, ginapangatubang man sini ang paglapas sa Section 3(e) sang Republic Act 3019 ukon ang Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, ang reklamo nga Direct Bribery and Receiving Gifts by Public Officers kag Corruption of Public Officers.
english: Besides plunder, he is also facing violation of Section 3(e) of Republic Act 3019 or the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, the complaint Direct Bribery and Receiving Gifts by Public Officers and Corruption of Public Officers.

text: Nakatalana naman ang masunod nga preliminary investigation sa Pebrero 23.
english: The next preliminary investigation is scheduled for February 23.

text: Bulan sang Mayo, bulan sang matam-is nga mga paho bangud ini ang ginakabig isa sa mga summer fruits kag perfect gid para sa desserts.
english: May is the month of sweet potatoes because they are considered one of the summer fruits and are perfect for desserts.

text: Apang sin-o bala magdumdom nga ang matam-is, juicy kag manamit nga prutas kaangay sang paho ang mangin healthy superfood?
english: But who would have thought that a sweet, juicy and delicious fruit like paho would be a healthy superfood?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga may yara man sang benepisyo ang mango leaves?
english: Did you know that mango leaves also have benefits?

text: Suno kay Dr. Farrah Agustin-Bunch, ang dahon sang paho ang tuman ka mapuslanon sa pagbulong sang diabetes.
english: According to Dr. Farrah Agustin-Bunch, smoke leaves are very useful in the treatment of diabetes.

text: Kun mataas ang imo nga blood pressure, ang dahon sang paho ang makabulig sa pagpanubo sang imo nga dugo bangud may yara ini sang hypotensive properties.
english: If you have high blood pressure, paho leaves can help lower your blood pressure because it has hypotensive properties.

text: Sa mga tawo nga nagasuprer gikan sa restlessness tuga sang anxiety, ang dahon sang paho ang mahimo man nga mangin maayo nga home remedy.
english: For people suffering from restlessness caused by anxiety, smoke leaves can also be a good home remedy.

text: Butangi lang sang mga dahon ang imo nga tubig pampaligo.
english: Just add the leaves to your bath water.

text: Ini ang makabulig sa imo nga maka-relax kag marefresh ang imo nga lawas.
english: This will help you relax and refresh your body.

text: Ma-imagine mo bala ang imo kaugalingon nga nagalantaw sang isa ka hampang nga nagalawig sang masobra isa ka adlaw?
english: Can you imagine yourself watching a game that lasts more than a day?

text: Pat-od nga nagasalakit na ang imo likod kag matup-ay na ikaw sa katuyo.
english: No doubt your back is aching and you are about to fall asleep.

text: Apang ano pa gid ayhan kun ikaw mismo ang nagahampang?
english: But what if you're playing yourself?

text: Sa isa ka football field sa Luzhniki Olympic Sports Complex sa Moscow sa Russia, ginpatigayon sang damlag lang ang ginakabig pinakalawig nga football game!
english: On a football field at the Luzhniki Olympic Sports Complex in Moscow in Russia, what is considered the longest football game was recently played!

text: Indi ini basta-basta bangud 26 ka oras ang ginlawig antes ini matapos!
english: It was no coincidence as it took 26 hours to complete!

text: Agud iselebrar ang All-Russian Football Day sang nagligad nga weekend, duha ka teams nga may tag-pito ka players ang nagtipon sa amo nga venue agud gub-on ang record sang longest football match sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: To celebrate the All-Russian Football Day last weekend, two teams of seven players each gathered at the venue to break the record for the longest football match in the world.

text: Nagsugod ang game sang Sabado sang udto kag nagtapos sang alas dos na sang hapon sang Domingo.
english: The game started on Saturday at noon and ended just after 2pm on Sunday.

text: Ang nauna nga record ang na-set sang 2014 sang naghampang ang duha ka teams sang dire-diretso sa sulod sang 24 hours.
english: The previous record was set in 2014 when the two teams played straight for 24 hours.

text: Sa sini naman nga tion, ginlutos sang Red Team ang White Team sa skor nga 416 goals to 409.
english: This time, the Red Team defeated the White Team with a score of 416 goals to 409.

text: Bangud ginhampang ini sa 7 vs 7 format, indi ini makonsiderar nga official football game.
english: Since it was played in a 7 vs 7 format, it cannot be considered an official football game.

text: Wala man ini sang tyansa nga ma-validate sang Guinness Records apang sigurado nga magamarka ini sa Russian Book of Records.
english: It has no chance of being validated by Guinness Records but will surely be included in the Russian Book of Records.

text: Magasapol ang Department of Energy (DOE) sa mga kumpaniya sang langis kag stakeholders sa masunod nga semana agud nga ma-diskusyunan ang inventories kag ang discount programs para sa mga motorista.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) will meet with oil companies and stakeholders next week to discuss inventories and discount programs for motorists.

text: Suno kay DOE Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad, luyag sang ahensya nga indi mag-untat ang discount kundi dugangan pa para sa ikaayo sang mga consumer.
english: DOE Oil Industry Management Bureau Director Rino Abad said the agency wants the discount not to stop but to be increased for the benefit of consumers.

text: Gin-imbitahan man ang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) kag ang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga mag-intra sa diskusyon kag maghatag sang updates sa status sang fuel subsidy distribution.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) and the Department of Agriculture (DA) were also invited to participate in the discussion and provide updates on the status of fuel subsidy distribution.

text: Sa idalom sang 2025 national budget, P2.5 billion ang ginpain para sa fuel subsidy program para sa public transport kag P485 million para naman sa mga mangunguma.
english: Under the 2025 national budget, P2.5 billion has been allocated for the fuel subsidy program for public transport and P485 million for farmers.

text:
Base sa abiso sang ahensya, yari ang posible nga adjustment sa masunod nga semana sandig sa 4 days of trading sa Mean of Platts Singapore:

Gasoline – P2.50-P3 per literDiesel – P4.30-P4.80 per literKerosene – P4.25-P4.40 per liter

Pahayag pa sang DOE, mahimo pa gani maglab-ot sa singko pesos ang isaka sa diesel.
english:
Based on the agency's notification, here are the possible adjustments next week based on 4 days of trading in the Mean of Platts Singapore:

Gasoline – P2.50-P3 per literDiesel – P4.30-P4.80 per literKerosene – P4.25-P4.40 per liter

According to the DOE, the price of diesel can even reach five pesos.

text: Katapusan nga naka-eksperyensya ang Pilipinas sang singko pesos nga saka sa diesel prices sang Marso 2022 matapos nga gin-ban ni anay US President Joe Biden ang pag-import sang Russian oil, liquefied natural gas, kag coal sa United States.
english: The Philippines last experienced a five-peso increase in diesel prices in March 2022 after former US President Joe Biden banned the import of Russian oil, liquefied natural gas, and coal into the United States.

text: MAY namangkot kon ngaa nasiling naton sang nagligad nga pwede pa ma-reinfect, ukon ma-infect liwat, ang isa nga nabakunahan na batok sa COVID-19.
english: SOMEONE asked why we said in the past that someone who has been vaccinated against COVID-19 can still be reinfected, or reinfected.

text: Well, amo ina ang impormasyon nga nakuha naton sa mga health experts nga ginsulat man naton diri sa aton kolum, nga indi ko naman seguro kinahanglan i-explicar pa liwat.
english: Well, that's the information we got from the health experts that we also wrote here in our column, which I probably don't need to explain again.

text: Bastante naman seguro ang testimonya ni Senador Sonny Angara nga na-infect kag nag-ayo na siya, kag na-ospital liwat tungod na-reinfect siya pagkatapos lang sang pila ka semana nga nakagwa siya sa ospital.
english: Senator Sonny Angara's testimony is probably enough that he was infected and recovered, and was hospitalized again because he was reinfected just a few weeks after he was discharged from the hospital.

text: Okey naman siya subong.
english: He's okay now.

text: Idugang na gid lang naton seguro ang panugyan gid sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga “No one is safe, unless everyone is safe!”, kag dapat mabakunahan gid ang at least 70 tubtub 80 ka porsyento sang populasyon agud ang tanan protektado batok sa COVID-19 virus tungod sa herd immunity.
english: Let's just add the World Health Organization (WHO) advice that “No one is safe, unless everyone is safe!”, and at least 70 to 80 percent of the population should be vaccinated so that everyone is protected against the COVID-19 virus because of herd immunity.

text:
***

Nalangkag na gid si Iloilo City mayor Jerry Treñas nga samtang madamo na nga mga pungsod ang nakakuha sang COVID-19 vaccine, ang Filipinas daw nawigit sa pagkuha sining vaccine.
english:
***

Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas is very excited that while many countries have already received the COVID-19 vaccine, the Philippines seems to be lagging behind in getting this vaccine.

text: Tungod sini, ginhingyo na ni meyor nga ang local government unit (LGU), katulad sang Iloilo City, magbulig bakal sang COVID-19 vaccine halin sa kon sin-o ang maka-offer sang “effective and safe” nga bakuna nga masarangan baklon sini.
english: The mayor has requested that local government units (LGUs), such as Iloilo City, help buy COVID-19 vaccines from those who can offer an “effective and safe” vaccine that they can afford.

text: Gindala na ining hingyo ni meyor sa meeting sang League of Cities sadtong Enero 5, sa diin tsirman siya sang Committee on Procurement on COVID-19 Vaccine.
english: The mayor's request was brought to the League of Cities meeting on January 5, where he chaired the Committee on Procurement on COVID-19 Vaccine.

text: May blessing na ini ni Secretary Carlito Galvez, ang chief implementer sang National Task Force against COVID-19, nga may pasalig man ni Presidente Duterte paagi sa isa ka tripartite agreement sa tunga sang gobyerno nasyonal, sang manufacturer kag sang LGU nga luyag mag-participar.
english: It has the blessing of Secretary Carlito Galvez, the chief implementer of the National Task Force against COVID-19, with the assurance of President Duterte through a tripartite agreement between the national government, the manufacturer and the LGU that wants to participate.

text: Ginahingyo man gani ni meyor ang private sector agud magbulig procure sining COVID-19 vaccine.
english: The mayor also urged the private sector to help procure this COVID-19 vaccine.

text: “Maayo gid kon nagabuligay kita tanan,”siling gani niya.
english: “It's good when we all work together,” he said.

text: In fact, sang nagligad pa nga tuig may gin-preparar na si meyor nga pondo para sa procurement sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english: In fact, last year the mayor had already prepared funds for the procurement of the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Ginapadungangan pa gani niya ini sa tuig nga ini agud makadangat sa P2 ka milyon nga maamot sang siyudad sa gobyerno nasyonal sa patigayunon nga tripartite procurement agreement.
english: He even extended it this year to reach P2 million that the city will contribute to the national government in the tripartite procurement agreement.

text: Napirmahan naman ni meyor ang Confidentiality Disclosure Agreement (CDA) para sa procurement sang British AstraZeneca vaccine nga may go-signal sang Department of Health sadtong Enero 4.
english: The mayor signed a Confidentiality Disclosure Agreement (CDA) for the procurement of the British AstraZeneca vaccine with the go-signal of the Department of Health on January 4.

text: Gin-ratify naman ini sa isa ka resolusyon sang Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) sa ila special session sang Enero 5.
english: This was ratified in a resolution by the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) during its special session on January 5.

text: Ang CDA isa ka preliminary document sa diin gina-share sang manufacturer ang clinical data nga ma-verify sang aton Food and Drug Administration (FDA), apang in confidence lang nga indi pwede kopyahon ukon ipahibalo sa iban kay sa exclusive lang nga pagpanag-iya ini sang manufacturer.
english: A CDA is a preliminary document where the manufacturer shares the clinical data that can be verified by our Food and Drug Administration (FDA), but only in confidence that it cannot be copied or disclosed to others because it is the exclusive property of the manufacturer.

text: Tig-una nga requirement ini sa pagbakal sang vaccine.
english: This is a prerequisite for the purchase of the vaccine.

text: Nagpasar man ang SP sang ikaduha nga resolusyon nga nagahatag kay meyor sing poder agud magsulod sa sining tripartite agreement.
english: The SP also passed a second resolution giving the mayor the power to enter into this tripartite agreement.

text: Na-mensyonar sa SP nga mga 200,000 ka doses ang panugod nga order sang siyudad para sa 100,000 ka pumuluyo sang malapit 500,000 nga populasyon sang siyudad.
english: The SP mentioned that about 200,000 doses are the city's initial order for 100,000 residents of the city's nearly 500,000 population.

text: Gina-target ni meyor nga bakunahan gid ang tanan.
english: The mayor targets to vaccinate everyone.

text: Ginsiling nga ginabaligya ining vaccine sang AstraZeneca sa $5, ukon mga P250 kada dose sa Filipinas.
english: AstraZeneca's vaccine is said to be sold for $5, or about P250 per dose in the Philippines.

text: Duha ka dose ang kinahanglan sang mabakunahan.
english: Two doses are required to be vaccinated.

text: Amo man ini nga presyo ang nabalitaan naton halin sa Pfizer/bioNTech pharmaceutical nga wala nagapangayo sang down payment.
english: It’s the same price we hear from Pfizer/bioNTech pharmaceutical that doesn’t ask for a down payment.

text: Ang Department of Health nakabaton man sing offer sang vaccine halin sa Pfizer/bioNTech sang United Kingdom, nga sa karon amo ang nagaisahanon nga na-validate sang World Health Organization (WHO) bilang “effective and safe”.
english: The Department of Health has also received an offer of a vaccine from Pfizer/bioNTech of the United Kingdom, which is currently the only one validated by the World Health Organization (WHO) as “effective and safe”.

text: Ang vaccines sang AstraZeneca kag Moderna nga luyag man baklon sang iban nga pungsod naka-submit naman sang ila petition for validation sa WHO.
english: The vaccines of AstraZeneca and Moderna, which other countries also want to buy, have already submitted their petition for validation to the WHO.

text: Ginahanda man sang siyudad ang mga kinahanglan nga mga kagamitan, katulad sang refrigerators, cold storage, transportasyon kag ang iban pa nga kinahanglanon katulad sang ambulansya, vaccination areas, vaccination personnel, priority listing sang magpabakuna, kag iban pa.
english: The city is also preparing the necessary equipment, such as refrigerators, cold storage, transportation and other necessities such as ambulances, vaccination areas, vaccination personnel, priority listing of those to be vaccinated, and others.

text: Sa subong ginatun-an pa ugaling sing maayo sang aton mga otoridad kon ano nga klase kag kon ano kadamo ang baklon naton nga COVID-19 vaccines.
english: However, our authorities are still studying what kind and how many COVID-19 vaccines we will buy.

text: Basi kuno abtan pa ugaling sa second quarter sang 2021 ang pag-procure sang vaccines, nga maangan-angan man naton para maseguro gid nga ini “effective and safe” para sa aton pumuluyo./PN
english: However, the procurement of vaccines may reach the second quarter of 2021, which we can expect to ensure that it is “effective and safe” for our people./PN

text: Dinipensahan ni US President Donald Trump si Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman kaugnay sa pagpaslang sa Saudi journalist na si Jamal Ahmad Hamza Khashoggi.
english: US President Donald Trump has defended Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman over the murder of Saudi journalist Jamal Ahmad Hamza Khashoggi.

text: Matatandaan, in-assassinate ang mamamahayag sa Istanbul noong Oktubre 2, 2018 ng mga ahente ng Saudi government sa utos ng Saudi Crown Prince, base sa inilabas na U.S. intelligence report noong February 2021.
english: The journalist was assassinated in Istanbul on October 2, 2018 by agents of the Saudi government on the orders of the Saudi Crown Prince, according to a U.S. intelligence report released in February 2021.

text: Sa unang pagbisita ng Saudi Crown Prince sa White House nitong Martes, Nov.
english: During the Saudi Crown Prince's first visit to the White House on Tuesday, Nov.

text: 18 (eastern tme) makalipas ang pitong taon, nakipagpulong siya kay US President Donald Trump.
english: 18 (eastern tme) seven years later, he met with US President Donald Trump.

text: Sa kanilang pag-uusap, hindi napigilan ni Trump na pagalit na depensahan ang Saudi royal kaugnay sa naturang kontrobersiya kung saan inilarawan ng US President ang nagawa ni Mohammed Bin Salman bilang kahanga-hanga umano pagdating sa karapatang pantao.
english: During their conversation, Trump could not help but angrily defend the Saudi royal in connection with the controversy where the US President described Mohammed Bin Salman's actions as admirable when it comes to human rights.

text: Depensa pa ni Trump nang matanong ang Crown Prince sa pagpatay kay Khashoggi, “nangyayari ang mga bagay-bagay,” subalit walang alam dito ang Crown Prince.
english: Trump defended that when the Crown Prince was asked about Khashoggi's murder, “things happen,” but the Crown Prince did not know about it.

text: Binara din ni Trump ang journalist na nagtanong sa crown prince kaugnay sa pagpaslang kay Kashoggi at sa September 11 attack, kung saan nagpahayag ng galit ang mga pamilya ng mga biktima sa pagbisita ng crown prince dahil sa naging papel umano niya sa pag-atake.
english: Trump also blocked a journalist who asked the crown prince about Kashoggi's execution and the September 11 attack, where the families of the victims expressed anger at the crown prince's visit because of his alleged role in the attack.

text: Pinagsabihan ni Trump ang mamamahayag na hindi dapat ipahiya ang kanilang bisita sa pagtatanong ng naturang katanungan at pinuri ang Saudi Crown Prince para sa kaniyang nagawang “phenomenal job”.
english: Trump told reporters that their guest should not be embarrassed by asking such questions and praised the Saudi Crown Prince for his “phenomenal job”.

text: Samantala, sinagot na rin ng Crown Prince ang mga alegasyon laban sa kaniya, kung saan nagpahayag ito ng pakikiisa sa sakit na nararamdaman ng mga pamilya ng September 11 attack sa Amerika.
english: Meanwhile, the Crown Prince has also responded to the allegations against him, expressing solidarity with the families of the September 11 attacks in the United States.

text: Inakusahan niya si Osama bin Laden na ginamit ang Saudi para sirain ang relasyon sa pagitan nila ng Amerika.
english: He accused Osama bin Laden of using Saudi Arabia to destroy relations with the United States.

text: Pagdating naman sa napatay na journalist, nagpahayag din ng kalungkutan ang Crown Prince at sinabing masakit na marinig na nasawi ang isang indibidwal nang walang kabuluhan.
english: Regarding the deceased journalist, the Crown Prince also expressed his condolences and said it was painful to hear that an individual had lost his life.

text: Aniya, masakit at isang malaking pagkakamali ito.
english: So, it hurts and it's a big mistake.

text: Ginawa din aniya nila ang lahat ng legal na hakbang sa imbestigasyon sa kaso at pinapahusay pa ang sistema sa Saudi para matiyak na hindi na maulit pa ang kaparehong insidente.
english: He said they have taken all legal steps to investigate the case and are improving the system in Saudi Arabia to ensure that a similar incident will not happen again.

text: Matatandaan, nauna ng itinanggi ng Crown Prince ang pag-utos na ipapatay ang journalist subalit inako niya ang responsibilidad bilang de facto ruler ng Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
english: The Crown Prince had earlier denied the order to kill the journalist but accepted responsibility as the de facto ruler of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

text: Indi matakos ang kalipay sang pamilya sang Ilonggo seafarer matapos nga isa ini sa 17 ka mga Pinoy nga ginhilway matapos gin-hijack sang Houthi rebels ang ila ginasakyan nga barko.
english: The family of the Ilonggo seafarer is overjoyed after he was one of 17 Filipinos released after Houthi rebels hijacked their ship.

text: Una na gin-anunsyo sang rebelde nga Houthis nga ginhilway na nila ang crew sang commercial vessel nga Galaxy Leader nga ila gin-hijack sang Nobyembre 2023.
english: Earlier, the Houthis rebels announced that they had released the crew of the commercial vessel Galaxy Leader that they hijacked in November 2023.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mary Jane Benigay, iya ginpahayag nga sa Bombo Radyo nila nabatian ang balita nga ginhilway na sang mga rebelde ang ila utod nga si Leonardo Junjun Flores sang Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mary Jane Benigay said they heard the news from Bombo Radyo that the rebels have released their brother Leonardo Junjun Flores of Pagsangaan, Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Benigay, kaangay nga nagabutan sang tunok ang bug-os nga pamilya nga makapauli ini nga buhi.
english: According to Benigay, it was like the whole family was pulling a thorn to get him home alive.

text: Ginsaysay niya nga humalin sang nakumpirma sadto nga isa ang iya utod sa mga seafarers nga ginkidnap, gintugyan na nila sa Diyos ang kahimtangan sang ila utod.
english: He explained that since it was confirmed that his brother was one of the seafarers who was kidnapped, they have left their brother's condition to God.

text: Pahayag niya, wala gid sila napaslawan bangud paagi sa ila pagpangamuyo kag pagtuo, wala gid ginpabay-an sang Mahal nga Makaako ang nasambit nga seafarer.
english: He said they never failed because through their prayers and faith, the Almighty never abandoned the said seafarer.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang update kun san-o makapauli sa Pilipinas ang iya utod.
english: At present, there is no update on when his brother will be able to return to the Philippines.

text: Matandaan nga halin sang nag-ibwal ang giyera sa Gaza, ang Galaxy Leader amo ang isa sa una nga mga barko nga gin-atake sang Houthis sa southern Red Sea nga amo ang mayor nga alagyan sang trade sa tunga sang Asya kag Europa.
english: Since the outbreak of the war in Gaza, the Galaxy Leader was one of the first ships attacked by the Houthis in the southern Red Sea, the main trade route between Asia and Europe.

text: Suno kay Houthi leader Abdulmalik Al Houthi, siya ang nagmandu nga pagguwaon na ang seafarers.
english: According to Houthi leader Abdulmalik Al Houthi, he ordered the release of the seafarers.

text: Ginpahayag nga gintugyan na sila sa Omani officials.
english: They were reportedly handed over to Omani officials.

text: 25 ang miyembro sang crew sang barko lakip ang 17 Filipinos, tatlo ka Ukrainians, duha ka Mexicans, duha ka Bulgarians kag isa ka Romanian.
english: 25 crew members of the ship including 17 Filipinos, three Ukrainians, two Mexicans, two Bulgarians and one Romanian.

text: Naghatag sang abiso si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa mga telecommunication companies sa Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City nga himuson ang ila linya sang mga kable.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas has issued a notice to telecommunication companies in Diversion Road, Mandurriao, Iloilo City to repair their cable lines.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginapatigayon sang syudad nga underground cabling.
english: This is also in line with the city's underground cabling.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga hitsuon sang mga telco companies ang mga naga-cross nga mga kable sa Diversion Road.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Jerry Treñas, said the telco companies need to fix the crossing cables on Diversion Road.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, parte ini sang ordinansa nga ginpasar sang 2023 bangud indi manami lantawon ang mga linya sang kuryente nga naga-cross halin sa service road padulong sa piyak nga kalye.
english: According to Fantilaga, this is part of the ordinance passed in 2023 because it is not good to see the power lines that cross from the service road to the other street.

text: Tubtob Enero 16, 2025 naman ang ginhatag nga deadline sang alkalde agud himuson ang mga kable sa nasambit nga dalan.
english: The mayor gave a deadline of January 16, 2025 to repair the cables on the said road.

text: Una na nga ginkaakig sang alkalde ang pagkadula sang internet connection sang PLDT kahapon nga adlaw, apisar nga nagpromisa ang internet provider nga i-dismantle ang ila linya kasunod sang operasyon sang Iloilo City Engineers Office.
english: Earlier, the mayor was angry about the loss of internet connection of PLDT yesterday, despite the internet provider's promise to dismantle their line following the operation of the Iloilo City Engineers Office.

text: Nagkitaay na sa labing una nga tion ang US kag Taliban sa diin nagpatigayon sila sang face-to-face talks humalin sang nag-withdraw ang Washington sang ila mga militar sa Afghanistan sang Agosto.
english: The US and Taliban have met for the first time where they have held face-to-face talks since Washington withdrew its military from Afghanistan in August.

text: Ang dayalogo ang nakasentro sa evacuation sang US citizens kag humanitarian aid.
english: The dialogue focused on the evacuation of US citizens and humanitarian aid.

text: Ginapanindugan sang US nga ang pagsinapol ang indi buot silingon sang pagmayohay nila sa Taliban.
english: The US insists that the meeting does not mean that it is reconciling with the Taliban.

text: Ang pagsinapol sang duha ka mga grupo ang natabo pagkatapos sang deadliest attack humalin sang nagwithraw ang US forces.
english: The meeting between the two groups came after the deadliest attack since the withdrawal of US forces.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra 50 ang napatay kag masobra 100 man ang pilason sa suicide bombing sa mosque sa Kunduz City.
english: More than 50 people were killed and more than 100 wounded in a suicide bombing at a mosque in Kunduz City.

text: Ginsaylo sang US military ang Typhon launchers sini nga sarang maglunsar sang multipurpose missiles sang tubtob sa linibo ka kilometros.
english: The US military has moved its Typhon launchers that can launch multipurpose missiles up to thousands of kilometers.

text: Halin sa Laoag airfield, ginsaylo ini sa lain nga lokasyon sa Luzon.
english: From Laoag airfield, it was moved to another location in Luzon.

text: Ang Tomahawk cruise missiles ang sarang mag-igo sang targets sa China kag Russia halin sa Pilipinas.
english: Tomahawk cruise missiles can hit targets in China and Russia from the Philippines.

text: Ang SM-6 missiles nga may yara ini ang sarang mag- strike sang air ukon sea targets nga masobra sa 200 km (165 miles) ang kalayuon.
english: The SM-6 missiles are capable of striking air or sea targets more than 200 km (165 miles) away.

text: Suno sa isa ka senior Philippine government source, ang redeployment makabulig sa pagdeterminar sang kadasigon nga ang missile battery ang mahulag sa bag-o nga firing position.
english: According to a senior Philippine government source, the redeployment will help determine the speed at which the missile battery can be moved to the new firing position.

text: Ang amo nga mobility ang ginalantaw nga pamaagi agud nga mas mangin survivable ini sa tion nga inaway.
english: Such mobility is seen as a way to make it more survivable in times of war.

text: Ang Typhon system ang kabahin sang US drive agud magtipon sang nagkalain-lain nga anti-ship weapons sa Asia.
english: The Typhon system is part of a US drive to accumulate a variety of anti-ship weapons in Asia.

text: Gin-clear sang Jaro Police Station 3 nga may bomba sa Central Philippine University (CPU).
english: Jaro Police Station 3 cleared that there was a bomb at the Central Philippine University (CPU).

text: Ini matapos nakabaton sang report ang kapulisan nahanungod sa bomb threat.
english: This was after the police received a report about a bomb threat.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Mary Jane Panes, Chief of Police sang Jaro Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga matapos sila nakabaton sang report, nagpadulong gilayon sila sa uniberisdad agud sekyaron ang lugar kag makapatuman sang paneling.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Mary Jane Panes, Chief of Police of Jaro Police Station, said that after receiving the report, they immediately went to the university to check the area and implement the paneling.

text: Suno kay Panes, gilayon nga ginapaguwa ang mga estudyante agud nga mapalayo sa ano man nga kahalitan nga posible matuga sang bomb threat.
english: Panes said the students were immediately evacuated to avoid any damage that might be caused by the bomb threat.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga pasado ala-1 sang hapon sang na-clear ang eskwelahan.
english: He said the school was cleared around 1 pm.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabaton ang bomb threat paagi sa official page sang nasambit nga unibersidad kon sa diin, nagasaad sa mensahe ang mga tinaga nga “may malupok subong nga adlaw”.
english: The bomb threat was received through the official page of the university where the message promised the words “something will explode today”.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga hilway sa ano man nga bomba ang Central Philiippine University.
english: He also explained that the Central Philippine University is free from any bomb.

text: Nakaabot sa International Space Station ang isa ka Russian actress kag isa ka film director sa misyon nga makahimo sang labing-una nga movie sa kalibutan nga gin-film sa space.
english: A Russian actress and a film director have arrived at the International Space Station on a mission to make the world's first movie filmed in space.

text: Nag-byahe ang aktres nga si Yulia Peresild kag ang director nga si Klim Shipenko sakay sa Russian Soyuz spacecraft kaupod ang cosmonaut nga si Anton Shkaplerov, ang pinaka-beterano sa ila nga tatlo sa amo nga space mission.
english: Actress Yulia Peresild and director Klim Shipenko traveled aboard the Russian Soyuz spacecraft with cosmonaut Anton Shkaplerov, the most veteran of the three on that space mission.

text: Tatlo ka oras kag tunga ang ginlawig antes nakaaabot sa space ang tatlo.
english: It took three and a half hours for the three to reach space.

text: Naghalin sila sa Russian space launch facility sa Baikonur, Kazakhstan.
english: They came from the Russian space launch facility in Baikonur, Kazakhstan.

text: Gina-film sang mga natungdan ang bag-o nga movie nga may titulo “Challenge”.
english: The actors are filming a new movie titled “Challenge”.

text: Pagkatapos sang 12 ka adlaw sa space outpost, natalana nga magabalik sila sa Earth.
english: After 12 days at the space outpost, they were scheduled to return to Earth.

text: Suno kay Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, ang mission sang space crew ang makabulig agud mapadayaw ang space prowess sang Russia.
english: According to Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, the space crew's mission will help boast Russia's space prowess.

text: Naka-jackpot ang isa ka Ilonggo sang kapin P18.44 million sa 6/49 Super Lotto draw.
english: An Ilonggo won the jackpot of more than P18.44 million in the 6/49 Super Lotto draw.

text: Ang draw ginpatigayon sang Huwebes, Enero 2, 2025.
english: The draw was conducted on Thursday, January 2, 2025.

text: Suno sa PCSO, ang nagtaya sa lotto outlet sa Sta.
english: According to the PCSO, the bettor at the lotto outlet in Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo ang amo nga Ilonggo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo is the Ilonggo.

text: Ang winning combination nga naghatag sa iya sang swerte amo ang 19-48-15-11-07-24.
english: The winning combination that gave him luck was 19-48-15-11-07-24.

text: Sa paghigugma, wala pili — wala edad, wala gender, wala sang maniwang ukon matambok, wala sang manggaranon ukon imol.
english: In love, there is no choice — no age, no gender, no thin or fat, no rich or poor.

text:
Kun paghigugma na ang hambalan, may ara kita sang mga makabuluang nga istorya nga haluson mapatihan sang iban apang siling gani sa Misteryo, “matuod nga nagakatabo.”

Didto sa Indonesia, viral ang isa ka lalaki matapos ini nagpakasal sa iya nga rice cooker.
english:
When it comes to love, we have crazy stories that some people almost believe but as the Mystery says, “it really happens.”

In Indonesia, a man went viral after he married his rice cooker.

text: Suno kay Khoirul Anam nga residente sang Magelang, Java, ‘fair, masinulundon, hipuson, kag makahibalo magluto’ ang iya nga rice cooker gani nga ginpakaslan niya ini.
english: According to Khoirul Anam, a resident of Magelang, Java, his rice cooker was 'fair, obedient, quiet, and good at cooking' so he married her.

text: Sa ila kasal, nakasuksok sang traditional white wedding attire si Anam samtang ang iya naman nga electrical “bride” ang may yara man sang pandong nga puti.
english: At their wedding, Anam wore a traditional white wedding attire while her electrical bride wore a white veil.

text: Nagsumpa pa ang duha kag nag-kiss pa si Anam sa iya nga rice cooker.
english: The two even swore and Anam even kissed her rice cooker.

text: Kun indi ka magpati sa sini, abaw, ano na lang abi sa sugpon sa sining ila nga istorya?
english: If you don't believe this, well, what's the point of adding to their story?

text: Apat ka adlaw ang nagligad, nagpahibalo si Anam nga divorced na sila sang iya nga asawa.
english: Four days later, Anam announced that he and his wife were divorced.

text: Suno sa natungdan, mabug-at man ang iya nga desisyon apang na-realisar niya nga wala sang perpekto nga partner para sa iya.
english: According to her, it was a difficult decision for her but she realized that there is no perfect partner for her.

text: Nagbukas na ang Queenbank sa Zarraga Branch, Iloilo.
english: Queenbank has opened in Zarraga Branch, Iloilo.

text: Ang Queenbank Zarraga Branch nahamtang sa Jalandoni St., Poblacion Ilaud, Zarraga.
english: The Queenbank Zarraga Branch is located in Jalandoni St., Poblacion Ilaud, Zarraga.

text: Nagatanyag ini sang mga serbisyo kaangay sang Savings and Checking Account, Dollar Deposit Account, ATM, Loan Services, Foreign Exchange, Western Union, Bayad Center, Bills Payment kag Mobile Banking.
english: It offers services like Savings and Checking Account, Dollar Deposit Account, ATM, Loan Services, Foreign Exchange, Western Union, Bayad Center, Bills Payment and Mobile Banking.
