text: Sa three point Seven (3.7) Billion Pesos nga resources, ginapasiguro sang Queenbank nga mahatag sa tawo ang kinahanglanon nga financial services.
english: With three point Seven (3.7) Billion Pesos resources, the Queenbank is ensuring that the people are provided with the necessary financial services.

text: Ang Queenbank ginpundar sang isa ka Ilonggo nga si Dr. Rogelio Florete, masobra 40-anyos na ang nagligad kag nagaserbisyo sang tampad nationwide.
english: Queenbank was founded by an Ilonggo named Dr. Rogelio Florete, more than 40-years ago and serving faithfully nationwide.

text: Ang Queenbank nagapakigbahin kag nagaupod man sa digital age through mobile banking service, QR Ph cashless transaction kag bank to bank transfer everywhere in the Philippines.
english: Queenbank is also participating and joining the digital age through mobile banking service, QR Ph cashless transaction and bank to bank transfer everywhere in the Philippines.

text: Ang Queenbank, member sang Bancnet, PDIC kag sang Florete Group.
english: Queenbank is a member of Bancnet, PDIC and the Florete Group.

text: Sa interview naman sang Bombo Radyo kay Zarraga Mayor Jofel Maranon-Soldevilla, iya ginpahayag nga bilang isa na ka 3rd class municipality,dako gid ang mabulig sang Queenbank sa economic activities sang banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Zarraga Mayor Jofel Maranon-Soldevilla said that as a 3rd class municipality, Queenbank will contribute greatly to the economic activities of the town.

text: Suno sa iya, mas mangin accessible na sa mga pumuluyo ang banking kag indi na nila kinahanglan magkadto pa sa iban nga banwa bangud nga mas ginpalapit kag ginpahapos na ang serbisyo para sa tawo.
english: He said banking will be more accessible to the people and they will not have to go to other towns because the service has been made closer and easier for the people.

text: Ginbali ni Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero ang mga alegasyon sang kampo ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga may mga blangko nga items sa bicameral conference committee report sa 2025 national budget.
english: Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero broke the allegations of former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp that there are blank items in the bicameral conference committee report on the 2025 national budget.

text: Suno kay Escuero, wala siya sang ihibalo kun ano nga report ang ginpakita ni Davao City 3rd District Representative Isidro Ungab nga kaupod ni Duterte.
english: Escuero said he does not know what report was shown by Davao City 3rd District Representative Isidro Ungab who is with Duterte.

text: Pahayag sini, indi maayo nga mang-akusar nga blangko nga items sa report sang bicam bangud lunsay lang ini kabutigan.
english: He said it is not good to accuse blank items in the bicam report because they are all lies.

text: “Anuman ‘yung pinapakita niyang committee report o diumanong bicameral conference committee report… hindi ko nakikita ‘yung pirma ko dun so hindi ko alam kung ano yun,” suno kay Escudero.
english: “Whatever committee report he is showing or bicameral conference committee report... I don't see my signature there so I don't know what it is,” Escudero said.

text: “Hindi tama na mag-akusang may blank check na binigay ang Kongreso, mali yun.
english: “It's not right to accuse Congress of giving a blank check, that's wrong.

text:
Kasinungalingan yun at hindi totoo yun.”

Dugang sang senate president, ang bicam report nga iya ginpirmahan ang may probisyon nga nagatugot sa committee on appropriations and finance nga i-correct kag i-fill in ang items nga posible na-overlook.
english:
It's a lie and it's not true.”

The senate president added that the bicam report he signed has a provision that allows the committee on appropriations and finance to correct and fill in items that may have been overlooked.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga may 200,000 line items sa amo nga budget measure.
english: He said there are 200,000 line items in the budget measure.

text: Ginpahangop man ni Escudero kun may probisyon sa bicam report nga nagasaad nga kun may deperesensya sa General Appropriations Act (GAA) kag sa bicam report, ang dapat sundon amo ang enrolled copy sang GAA.
english: Escudero also explained that if there is a provision in the bicam report that promises that if there is a defect in the General Appropriations Act (GAA) and the bicam report, the enrolled copy of the GAA should be followed.

text: Sa tunga sining mga alegasyon, ginpahayag ni Escudero (nga isa man ka abogado) nga ang bersyon sang budget nga mahimo lamang makwestyon amo ang napirmahan na sang presidente.
english: In the midst of these allegations, Escudero (who is also a lawyer) said that the version of the budget that can only be questioned is the one that has already been signed by the president.

text: “Ang batas ay yung pinirmahan na enrolled copy nung bill ng Pangulo.
english: “The law is the signed enrolled copy of the President's bill.

text: Yun ang pwedeng kwestiyunin dahil sa tinagal tagal kong abogado, wala pa yata akong nabalitaan na pinadeklarang iligal at unconstitutional na committee report,” pahayag sini.
english: That can be questioned because as a lawyer, I have never heard of a committee report being declared illegal and unconstitutional,” he said.

text: Antes kay Escudero, may tatlo ka mga senador nga nagpanginwala nga may blank items sa bicam report sa 2025 national budget.
english: Before Escudero, there were three senators who denied that there were blank items in the bicam report on the 2025 national budget.

text: Apang ang presidential sister nga si Senator Imee Marcos nga kabahin sang bicam sa 2025 national budget nga absent man sa pagpirma sang report ang nag-insister nga may blangko gid man nga items rason nga wala na lang siya nagpirma.
english: However, the presidential sister, Senator Imee Marcos, who is part of the bicam on the 2025 national budget, who was also absent from the signing of the report, insisted that there were blank items, which is why she did not sign.

text: Matandaan nga bangud sa alegasyon sang anomaliya kag iregularidad, gintawag ni former President Duterte nga imbalido ang GAA nga pirmado na ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: It can be recalled that due to allegations of anomalies and irregularities, former President Duterte called the GAA signed by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. invalid.

text: Nagsabat naman si Marcos nga nagabinutig si Duterte.
english: Marcos replied that Duterte was lying.

text: Nagpaguwa man sang statement ang Malacañang nga nagsiling nga “criminal” ang amo nga mga alegasyon.
english: Malacañang also issued a statement saying the allegations were “criminal”.

text: Walo ang patay matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka private plane sa Milan, Italy.
english: Eight people were killed after a private plane crashed in Milan, Italy.

text: Naghalin sa Linate airport sa Milan ang eroplano kag padulong sa Sardinia island sang nagtibusok ini sa isa ka building malapit sa suburban metro station.
english: The plane was flying from Milan's Linate airport to Sardinia island when it crashed into a building near the suburban metro station.

text: Ginapahayag anum ang pasahero sini kag duha ang crew — lunsay ginbawian sang kabuhi.
english: Six passengers and two crew members were reportedly killed.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad kun ano ang rason sang pagtibusok.
english: Authorities are still investigating the cause of the stabbing.

text: Wala sang napilasan ukon nahalitan sa lugar kun sa diin nagtupa ang private plane apang nasunog ang pila ka naka-park nga salakyan.
english: No one was injured or damaged in the area where the private plane crashed but several parked vehicles were burned.

text: 20 ang pilason kag ginatos ang gin-evacuate kasunod sang paglupok sang isa ka apartment building sa Gothenburg, Sweden.
english: 20 injured and hundreds evacuated following an apartment building explosion in Gothenburg, Sweden.

text: Sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon sang mga pulis, naga-guwa nga may explosive device nga ginbutang sa amo nga building.
english: Initial investigation of the police revealed that an explosive device was placed in the building.

text: Naglapta pa ang kalayo sa kaiping nga mga apartments.
english: The fire spread to neighboring apartments.

text: Ginapahayag natabo ang paglupok sa inner courtyard sang building kag sang amo nga tion, naglumpat ang mga tawo gikan sa mga bintana sang ila hulot agud nga makapalagyo.
english: The explosion reportedly occurred in the inner courtyard of the building and at that time, people jumped from the windows of their room to escape.

text: Gina-imbestigaran pa sang matul-id ang ginhalinan sang paglupok apang ginapahayag nga may foul play nga natabo kag ginalantaw kun may yara sang target sa mga tenant sa amo nga building.
english: The cause of the explosion is still being investigated but it is believed that there was foul play and it is being looked into whether there is a target for the tenants in the building.

text: Duha ka suldado ang ginapatihan nga napatay kag 12 ang pilason sang gin-ambush sang armado nga grupo ang tropa sang military sa Basilan.
english: Two soldiers are believed to have been killed and 12 wounded when an armed group ambushed military troops in Basilan.

text: Base sa impormasyon, ang armado nga grupo ang ginapamunuan ni certain Alharan nga ginapahayag nga member sang MILF sa Brgy Lower Cabengbeng, Sumisip, Basilan.
english: According to information, the armed group is led by certain Alharan who is allegedly a member of the MILF in Brgy Lower Cabengbeng, Sumisip, Basilan.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang encounter sang militar batok sa MILF.
english: The military's encounter with the MILF is still ongoing.

text: Ginapahayag nga nagbulig man sa grupo ni Alharan ang grupo nga ginapamunuan naman nanday Kumander Mande kag Kumander Mamir.
english: The group led by Commander Mande and Commander Mamir also reportedly helped Alharan's group.

text: Gin-athag sang punong barangay sang Brgy.
english: The barangay captain of Brgy.

text: M.V. Hechanova, Jaro, Iloilo City nga lunsay may mga blotter reports batok sa isa kag isa ang pamilya Roscales kag Semeniego.
english: M.V. Hechanova, Jaro, Iloilo City that both the Roscales and Semeniego families have blotter reports against each other.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginreklamo ni Engineer Brian Semeniego si Mervin Roscales nga iya manlang kaingod-balay.
english: This follows the complaint of Engineer Brian Semeniego against Mervin Roscales, who is also his neighbor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Nestor Ledesma, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na nga nagabanggi-anay ang duha ka pamilya, kon sa diin, matapos nga magpa-blotter ang isa, mabalos man blotter ang isa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Nestor Ledesma said the two families have been fighting for a long time.

text: Suno kay Ledesma, ang gintunaan gid sang ila indi pag-intindihanay, amo ang ‘tarog’ sang atop nanday Roscales bangud suno sa pamilya Semeniego, nagalapaw ini sa ila.
english: According to Ledesma, the main cause of their misunderstanding was the 'tarog' of the roof of the Roscales because according to the Semeniego family, it overtook them.

text: Gin-athag man sang punong barangay nga ang insidente ang una na nga na-report sa Office of the Building Official (OBO).
english: The barangay captain also explained that the incident was first reported to the Office of the Building Official (OBO).

text: Natukiban man sang opisina nga ang ang duta nga ginatindogan sang ila tagsa ka balay ang wala sang nagapanag-iya, rason man nga wala sila napamatbatan.
english: The office also discovered that the land on which their houses were built was not owned, which is why they were not convicted.

text: Ginklaro naman ni Barangay Kagawad Ronnie Solido nga una nga wala ginpakita sang pamilya Semeniego sa kapulisan ang kuha sang closed circuit television ukon CCTV.
english: Barangay Kagawad Ronnie Solido clarified that the Semeniego family did not show the closed circuit television or CCTV footage to the police.

text: Ini agud kontani nga mangin ebidensya sa panumbungon batok sa pamilya Roscales.
english: This was supposed to be evidence in the charges against the Roscales family.

text: Suno kay Solido, kontani napalantaw gilayon sa kapulisan ang video agud nga natigayon nga madakop si Mervin Roscales, apang ulihi na kag yara na sa Jaro Police Station sang ginpakita ini sang pamilya Semeniego.
english: Solido said the video should have been shown to the police immediately so that Mervin Roscales could be arrested, but it was too late and he was already at the Jaro Police Station when the Semeniego family showed it.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga si Roscales mismo ang ginhaboy man sang mga botelya sang pamilya Semeniego samtang ini ang nagpanghampak sang kabilya sa gate.
english: He also explained that Roscales himself was also thrown bottles by the Semeniego family while he hit the cable on the gate.

text: Indi naman ini una nga bes natabo ang insidente bangud masami nga nagabaisay ang duha ka pamilya.
english: This is not the first time the incident has happened as the two families often quarrel.

text: Nagbawi sang ila suporta ang apat ka mga senador para sa hagna nga natuyo nga matapna ang adolescent pregnancies sa Pilipinas.
english: Four senators have withdrawn their support for a bill aimed at preventing adolescent pregnancies in the Philippines.

text: Sa sulat nga ginpadala kay Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero, sanday Senador JV Ejercito, Nancy Binay, Cynthia Villar, kag Christopher “Bong” Go ang nag-request nga kakason ang ila pirma sa Committee Report No.
english: In a letter sent to Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero, Senators JV Ejercito, Nancy Binay, Cynthia Villar, and Christopher “Bong” Go requested that their signatures be removed from Committee Report No.

text: 41, nga nagaunod sang Senate Bill No.
english: 41, containing Senate Bill No.

text:
1979 ukon ang “Prevention of Adolescent Pregnancy Act of 2023.”

Suno sa mga senador, ang nagadamo nga concerns kag feedback sang publiko ang rason sang ila pag-atras.
english:
1979 or the “Prevention of Adolescent Pregnancy Act of 2023.”

The senators said the growing concerns and feedback from the public are the reason for their withdrawal.

text:
Yari ang ila statement:

“While we recognize the urgency of addressing adolescent pregnancy, we believe further consultation with stakeholders is necessary to clarify misconceptions and refine objectionable provisions.”

Ang bill nagaduso sang national strategy agud mabuhinan ang adolescent pregnancies, kalakip diri ang integration sang Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) sa public kag private school curricula,nga nagasunod sa guidelines halin sa Department of Education (DepEd) kag international standards.
english:
Here is their statement:

“While we recognize the urgency of addressing adolescent pregnancy, we believe further consultation with stakeholders is necessary to clarify misconceptions and refine objectionable provisions.”

The bill proposes a national strategy to reduce adolescent pregnancies, including the integration of Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE) into public and private school curricula,following guidelines from the Department of Education (DepEd) and international standards.

text: Sanday senador Imee Marcos kag Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr., nga orihinal nga nag- propose sang hagna batok sa teen pregnancies, ang nagdistansya gikan sa Senate Bill No.
english: Senators Imee Marcos and Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr., who originally proposed the bill against teen pregnancies, distanced themselves from Senate Bill No.

text: Ila ginpahayag nga ang substitute bill ang indi pareho sa ila original drafts kag ginsiling ni Revilla nga ang mga probisyon diri ang indi iya proposals.
english: They said the substitute bill is not the same as their original drafts and Revilla said the provisions here are not his proposals.

text: Pasakaan sang kaso nga frustrated murder ang suspek sa pagbuno sa iya kontra sa Barangay Cuyad, Alimodian, Iloilo.
english: The suspect will be charged with frustrated murder for stabbing his opponent in Barangay Cuyad, Alimodian, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Ricky Anib, 34 , samtang ang suspek amo si Alyas Lamang yara sa legal ang edad.
english: The victim was identified as Ricky Anib, 34, while the suspect was identified as Alyas Lamang of legal age.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Chief of Police sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga natigayon na nga mapasaka ang kaso batok sa suspek sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Chief of Police of the Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said a case was filed against the suspect yesterday.

text: Suno kay Sorongon, samtang nagasug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig, nagasaot ang biktima sang hinali nga ginbuno ini sang suspek.
english: According to Sorongon, while celebrating the new year, the victim was dancing when the suspect suddenly stabbed her.

text: Nag-agom sang pilas sa dughan ang biktima kag gilayon naman nga gindala sa Aleosan District Hospital.
english: The victim sustained injuries to his chest and was rushed to the Aleosan District Hospital.

text: Sa subong, gin-transfer ang biktima sa Western Visayas Medical Center kag padayon nga ginalapatan nga pagbulong.
english: The victim was transferred to the Western Visayas Medical Center for treatment.

text: Patay ang 22-anyos nga lalaki sa Beijing, China matapos gin-ubos inom ang unod sang 1.5-liter bottle sang Coca-Cola sa sulod lamang sang 10 ka minutos.
english: A 22-year-old man died in Beijing, China after drinking the contents of a 1.5-liter bottle of Coca-Cola in just 10 minutes.

text: Sandig sa report sang Clinics and Research in Hepatology and Gastroenterology, gin-ubos inom sang wala ginhingadlan nga lalaki ang soft drink bangud luyag niya mangin hydrated bangud tuman kainit sang tyempo.
english: According to the report of the Clinics and Research in Hepatology and Gastroenterology, the unnamed man drank the soft drink because he wanted to stay hydrated because the weather was so hot.

text: Anum ka oras pagkatapos, nagpadulong siya sa Chaoyang Hospital sa Beijing bangud sang swollen stomach kag severe pain.
english: Six hours later, he went to Chaoyang Hospital in Beijing with a swollen stomach and severe pain.

text: May elevated heart rate ang pasyente, low blood pressure kag rapid ang pagginhawa pag-abot sa opital apisar nga wala man siya sang daan nga mga balatian sa lawas.
english: The patient had an elevated heart rate, low blood pressure and rapid breathing on arrival at the hospital despite having no previous medical illnesses.

text: 18 ka oras ang nagligad, ginbawian siya sang kabuhi.
english: 18 hours later, he passed away.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, may gas buildup nga natabo sa lawas sang biktima bangud sang tuman ka damo nga soft drink nga iya nainom.
english: According to experts, a gas buildup occurred in the victim's body due to the large amount of soft drink he drank.

text: Nadiskubrehan nga ang gas buildup ang nag-umpisa sa iya intestines, nagkadto sa liver, kag amo ang nangin rason sang hepatic ischemia ukon “shock liver.”
english: It was discovered that the gas buildup started in his intestines, traveled to the liver, and caused hepatic ischemia or “shock liver.”

text: Patay ang 6-anyos nga bata sa Brgy.
english: A 6-year-old boy died in Brgy.

text: Buhay, Alimodian, Iloilo matapos nga nabunggo-an sang isa ka motorsiklo.
english: Buhay, Alimodian, Iloilo after being hit by a motorcycle.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Cop sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagtabok ang bata sa dalan kaupod ang iya nga iloy.
english: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Cop of Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said the child crossed the road with his mother.

text: Suno kay Sorongon, sang nagatabok na ang mag-iloy, nagbalik pa ang menor-de-edad nga bata rason nga nabunggo-an ini sang motorsiklo.
english: According to Sorongon, when the mother and daughter were crossing the road, the minor child returned and was hit by a motorcycle.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga bangud sa impact sang pagkabunggo, natam-an gid ang bata sa iya ulo.
english: He also said that due to the impact of the collision, the child was severely injured in the head.

text: Gindala pa sa Aleosan District Hospital ang biktima apang ginbawian sa gihapon sang kabuhi.
english: The victim was rushed to the Aleosan District Hospital but died on the spot.

text: Nakatalana naman nga pasakaan sang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting to homicide ang driver sang motorsiklo.
english: The driver of the motorcycle is scheduled to face charges of reckless imprudence resulting in homicide.

text: Patay ang 40 anyos nga babayi kag anak sini nga nagaedad 2 ka tuig matapos nadagdag sa baseball stadium sa San Diego sa California, USA.
english: A 40-year-old woman and her 2-year-old son died after falling into a baseball stadium in San Diego, California, USA.

text: Natabo ang insidente antes nag-umpisa ang hampang sa tunga sang San Diego Padres kag Atlanta Braves.
english: The incident occurred before kickoff between the San Diego Padres and Atlanta Braves.

text: Nadagdag ang mag-iloy halin sa third-level concourse, ukon equivalent sang anum ka panalgan nga kataason.
english: The mother and daughter fell from the third-level concourse, or the equivalent of six stories high.

text: Ang amay sang bata ang ginapahayag yara sa ballpark sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The boy's father was reportedly at the ballpark when the incident occurred.

text: Suspicious ang amo nga insidente suno sa mga pulis — ginaimbestigaran pa kun aksidente ini ukon hungod nga gintiklod ang mga biktima.
english: The incident is suspicious, police said — they are still investigating whether it was an accident or the victims were deliberately pushed.

text: Madamo ka bala sang balatian?
english: Do you have a lot of illnesses?

text: ukon luyag mo nga makalikaw sa balatian?
english: or do you want to avoid disease?

text: Ang bulong ang mahimo yara lang makit-an sa imo nga ugsaran ukon dira man sa imo nga kasilingan.
english: The cure may be found in your yard or in your neighborhood.

text: Ini amo ang lomboy.
english: This is blackberry.

text: Panigurado nga ma pa WOW ka sa mga benepisyo nga mahatag sini sa imo ikaayong lawas.
english: You are sure to be WOWed by the benefits it can give to your health.

text: Kadam-an sa inyo ang wala na kun kaisa ginasapak ang prutas nga lomboy ukon Java Plum kun sa ingles.
english: Most of you sometimes ignore the blackberry fruit or Java Plum.

text:
Manggaranon ini sa iron, magnesium kag vitamin C.

Suno kay Pooja Makhija, isa ka Nutritionist, kun may diabetes ikaw, indi magkabalaka bangud ang lomboy ang mahimo mo sa gihapon nga makaon bangud may yara ini sang nutrient nga ginatawag jambosin compounds, alkaloids, kag jambosin glycosides nga makabulig agud i-convert ang sugar sa energy agud mangin estable ang imo nga blood sugar level.
english:
It is rich in iron, magnesium and vitamin C.

According to Pooja Makhija, a Nutritionist, if you have diabetes, don't worry because blackberries can still be eaten because they contain nutrients called jambosin compounds, alkaloids, and jambosin glycosides that help convert sugar into energy to keep your blood sugar level stable.

text: Bangud man nga may yara sang madamo nga antioxidant ang lomboy, makabulig ini agud malikawan ang cancer.
english: Because blackberries are rich in antioxidants, they can help prevent cancer.

text: Kun nagaproblema ka naman sa imo nga panit bangud luyag mo ini nga mangin soft, indi na magbakal pa sang mga habon ukon cream bangud ang lomboy ang makahatag man sa imo sang glowing skin bangud may yara ini sang antioxidant compounds kag vitamin C kun masami mo ini ginakaon.
english: If you are having problems with your skin because you want it to be soft, do not buy soaps or creams because lomboy can also give you glowing skin because it contains antioxidant compounds and vitamin C if you eat it often.

text: Gani kun wala ka sang lomboy sa inyo ugsaran kag ang imo nga kasilingan ang may yara, indi maghuya-huya nga magpangayo kag ipakigbahin man sa iya ang amazing benefits sang lomboy.
english: So if you don't have lomboy in your yard and your neighbor does, don't hesitate to ask and share with him the amazing benefits of lomboy.

text: ILOILO – Excited na ang tiglawas sang Iloilo Province sa patigayunon nga coronation sang Miss Universe Philippines 2025.
english: ILOILO – The representative of Iloilo Province is excited about the coronation of Miss Universe Philippines 2025.

text: Ini amo si Angeline Cordero Kailani, tumandok sang Pototan, Iloilo.
english: This is Angeline Cordero Kailani, a native of Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Si Kailani ang nagpadulong sa London, England sang naga-edad pa lang ini sang pito ka tuig.
english: Kailani made her way to London, England when she was just seven years old.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kailani, iya ginpabugal nga itiglawas ang probinsya sa national stage.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kailani said he is proud to represent the province on the national stage.

text: Suno kay Kailani, single mom ang iya iloy nga isa ka nurse sa diin ini man ang nagtulod sa iya nga mangin isa ka nurse sa London, England.
english: According to Kailani, her mother is a single mom who is a nurse which also led her to become a nurse in London, England.

text: Ang advocacy naman sini amo ang mental health awareness sa mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs).
english: Its advocacy is mental health awareness among Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs).

text: Patigayunon ang coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines sa Mayo 2, sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City.
english: The coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines will be held on May 2, at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.

text: Magabalik sa Madison Square Garden sa New York City ang makahalawat-hawat nga hampang sang Knicks kag Boston Celtics 8:00 subong nga aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: The Knicks and Boston Celtics will return to Madison Square Garden in New York City at 8:00 this morning.

text: Ini na ang Game 6 sa Eastern Conference semifinals.
english: It’s Game 6 in the Eastern Conference semifinals.

text: Tinguhaan sang defending champions nga mapatas ang serye sa 3-3 kag mapwersa nga matabo ang Game 7 sa Boston.
english: The defending champions will try to tie the series at 3-3 and force a Game 7 in Boston.

text: 13 ka teams lamang sa NBA ang nakatigayon nga makabangon sa 3-1 deficit kag tinguhaan sang Celtics nga mahimo man ini nga wala ang ila star player nga si Jason Tatum nga nakaangkon sang injury sa Game 4.
english: 13 teams in the NBA have only managed to rally from a 3-1 deficit and the Celtics will try to do the same without their star player Jason Tatum suffering a Game 4 injury.

text: Kun indi nila ini mahimo, maga-abante si Karl Anthony Towns kag ang Knicks sa conference finals sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 25 ka tuig.
english: If they don't, Karl Anthony Towns and the Knicks will advance to the conference finals for the first time in 25 years.

text: Nagahulat na sa conference finals ang Indiana Pacers nga amo ang naglutos sa top-seeded nga Cleveland Cavaliers.
english: The Indiana Pacers, who beat the top-seeded Cleveland Cavaliers, are now in the conference finals.

text: Pananglitan mapalawig ang serye kag may matabo nga Game 7 sa tunga sang Celtics kag Knicks, isa ka adlaw lang ang pahuway sang winner antes atubangon ang Pacers sa finals sang Eastern Conference.
english: If the series is extended and there is a Game 7 between the Celtics and Knicks, the winner will have only one day of rest before facing the Pacers in the Eastern Conference finals.

text: KON indi man mauna sang aton gobyerno ang mga kubos ta nga mga pumuluyo sa pag-angkon sang COVID-19 vaccine, samtang ginahingyo na sini kon diin makakuha sining vaccine, indi ina tungod indi sila prioridad sang aton gobyerno.
english: IF our government does not prioritize our poor people in getting the COVID-19 vaccine, while it is already asking where to get this vaccine, it is not because they are not a priority of our government.

text: Sa matuod prioridad gihapon sila sang aton gobyerno bisan paunahon pa ang pagbakuna sa mga health workers kag frontliners.
english: In fact, they are still a priority of our government even if the vaccination of health workers and frontliners is given priority.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Tungod sa pagbakuna una sa mga health workers kag frontliners mapaseguro naton ang madasig kag wala sablag nga pagtatap sang ikaayong lawas sang tanan, nga kalabanan sina ang mga kubos ta nga mga utod.
english: By vaccinating health workers and frontliners first, we can ensure the prompt and uninterrupted health care of all, most of whom are our poor brothers and sisters.

text: Wala gid man gani sing problema kon maulihi gawa ang iban ta nga mga utod tungod, sa pabutyag sang World Health Orgnization (WHO), “No one is safe unless everyone is safe!” Which means nga kinahanglan dasigon ang pagbakuna sa tanan agud lubos na matapna ang COVID-19.
english: There is no problem if some of our brothers and sisters are late because, as the World Health Organization (WHO) puts it, “No one is safe unless everyone is safe!” Which means that it is necessary to accelerate the vaccination of all in order to completely prevent COVID-19.

text: Understandable man kon ngaa mauna mabakunahan man ang mga tigulang kag ang may mataas nga risgo batok sa COVID-19 tungod vulnerable man sila sa sining salot.
english: It is also understandable why the elderly and those at high risk should be vaccinated against COVID-19 first because they are also vulnerable to this disease.

text: Ini nga prioridad ang ginapanugyan mismo sang World Health Organization (WHO) sa tanan nga pungsod.
english: This priority is recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO) itself in all countries.

text:
***

Sa nahibal-an na, ang Pfizer/bioNtech vaccine sang United Kingdom pa lang ang na-validate sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga “effective and safe” batok sa COVID-19.
english:
***

As already known, only the United Kingdom's Pfizer/bioNtech vaccine has been validated by the World Health Organization (WHO) as “effective and safe” against COVID-19.

text: Ni isa sang Chinese vaccines ang na-validate na sang WHO.
english: None of the Chinese vaccines have been validated by the WHO.

text: In other words, ang China lang ang nag-validate sa iya kaugalingon  nga “effective and safe” ang iya vaccine, bisan manubo kaayo ang “efficacy” sini ikumparar sa Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine nga na-validate nga “effective and safe” sang WHO.
english: In other words, only China has validated itself that its vaccine is “effective and safe”, even though its efficacy is very low compared to the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine that was validated as “effective and safe” by the WHO.

text: Kon sa bagay, risgo kag salabton na ina sang mga gobyerno nga nagsalig sa Chinese vaccines (Sinovac kag Sinofarm) agud pabakunahan ang ila pumuluyo, lakip na yadtong mga kaalyado nila kag na-kontrata nga mabakal sini sugod pa sadtong Nobyembre 2020.
english: In fact, it is the risk and responsibility of the governments that relied on Chinese vaccines (Sinovac and Sinofarm) to vaccinate their people, including those who are their allies and have been contracted to buy them since November 2020.

text: Kita sa Filipinas indi dapat magpasakop sa sining Chinese vaccine nga wala na-validate sang WHO.
english: We in the Philippines should not submit to this Chinese vaccine that has not been validated by the WHO.

text: Dapat may leksyon na kita sa natabo sa pagdale-dale gamit sang dengvaxia para sa dengue.
english: We should learn a lesson from what happened in the use of dengvaxia for dengue.

text: Samtang sige naman ang pag-vaccinate sang Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine sa US, Canada, United Kingdom, kag iban nga nasyon sa Uropa kag sa Amerika.
english: Meanwhile, the Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine continues to be vaccinated in the US, Canada, the United Kingdom, and other European and American countries.

text: Nagahulat man ang Filipinas nga makaangkon sining Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine pagkatapos nga ma-confirm sang aton FDA nga “effective and safe” ini sa aton pumuluyo.
english: The Philippines is also waiting to receive this Pfizer/bioNTech vaccine after our FDA confirms that it is “effective and safe” for our people.

text: Napamatud-an sang WHO ang ka “effective and safe” sini sa  mga clinical trial nga ginpasakupan sang lain-lain nga rasa – puti, africano, asyano kag iban pa.
english: The WHO has proven its effectiveness and safety in clinical trials involving different races – white, African, Asian and others.

text: Kag indi lang sang mga healthy kundi pati na ang may mga masakit,  nga ang tanan sini nagpakita nga pwede ini sila mabakunahan kon ano man ang ila kahimtangan.
english: And not only the healthy but also the sick, all of which have shown that they can be vaccinated regardless of their condition.

text: In fact, ang na-infect na sang COVID-19 pwede gihapon mabakunahan sining vaccine, kasubong sa pwede mahimo sang mga vaccine kontra measles, rabies kag iban pa.
english: In fact, those who have already been infected with COVID-19 can still be vaccinated with this vaccine, just like vaccines against measles, rabies and others can be done.

text: Samtang nagahulat man nga ma-validate sang WHO ang pila pa ka candidate vaccines sang Moderna, AstraZeneca, kag iban pa sa diin pwede ang Filipinas makapili sa idugang sa kinahanglanon sini nga vaccines sa iya sobra 100 ka milyon nga pumuluyo.
english: Meanwhile, the WHO is also waiting to validate several other candidate vaccines from Moderna, AstraZeneca, and others where the Philippines can choose to add to its need for vaccines for its more than 100 million people.

text:
***

Sang sini lang nabalahuba ang balita nga nagpatusok ang mga myembro sang Presidential Security Group (PSG) sang COVID-19 vaccine.
english:
***

Recently, news broke that members of the Presidential Security Group (PSG) were injected with the COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Gin-aku nila ini, apang wala sing nag-aku kon diin nila nakuha ini, kon sin-o ang nag-authorize nga gamiton ini sang PSG, kag kon sin-o ang mga doktor nga nag-administrar.
english: They acknowledged it, but no one acknowledged where they got it, who authorized PSG to use it, and who the doctors were who administered it.

text: Gin-smuggle lang nila kuno ini.
english: They say they just smuggled it.

text: Nagpaseguro gani si Health Secretary Duque III nga ang nag-administar sang sining vaccine nga mga doktor madulaan sing lisensya sa pag-praktis sang medisina.
english: Health Secretary Duque III even assured that the doctors who administered the vaccine will lose their license to practice medicine.

text:
***

Ang sole distributor sang Sinofarm maabtik nga nag-deny nga sa ila naghalin ang vaccine nga gingamit sang PSG.
english:
***

Sinopharm’s sole distributor quickly denied that the vaccine used by PSG came from them.

text: Indi ayhan ang Sinovac gid man?
english: Could it be Sinovac?

text: Pero, sin-o ang nag-authorize sa paggamit sining vaccine sa PSG?
english: But, who authorized the use of this vaccine in PSG?

text: Si Presidente Duterte?
english: President Duterte?

text: Pero indi bala ginduso gid gani sini nga aprubahan anay sang FDA ang sin-o man ang mag-“offer” sang vaccine sa Filipinas?
english: But didn't it even propose that the FDA first approve anyone who offers a vaccine in the Philippines?

text: Posible ang isa ka malapit nga himata nga nagakabalaka sa iya, nga wala mahadlok akigan sang Presidente sa iya sayop tungod kay malapit kaayo ang ila relasyon ukon pag-abyanay.
english: Possibly a close relative who is worried about him, who is not afraid of being angry with the President for his mistake because their relationship or friendship is so close.

text: Si Paolo?
english: Paolo?

text: Si Sara?
english: Sarah?

text: Si BongBong Marcos nga nahadlok mag-Presidente si Leni Robredo kon ano ang matabo kay Presidente bag-o matapos ang iya termino?
english: BongBong Marcos who is afraid that Leni Robredo will become President. What will happen to the President before the end of his term?

text: Etcetera!
english: Etcetera!

text: Sin-o gid ayhan?
english: Who exactly?

text: Palihog abe bulig lili sa inyo crystal ball./PN
english: Please help lili with your crystal ball./PN

text: Gin-ako sang Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporation Inc.
english: The Western Visayas Alliance of Transport Cooperatives and Corporation Inc. acknowledged that

text:
(WVATCCI) nga may yara sang paglapas ang ila nga mga unit nahanungod sa ‘Anti-Sardinas Policy.’

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Halley Alcarde, Vice President sang nasambit nga kooperatiba, iya ginpahayag nga strikto ang ila opisina sa pagsunod sa mga ginapatuman nga mga ordinansa sang gobyerno, apang may mga tion nga indi mapunggan ang mga pasahero sa pagsakay ilabi na kun rush hour ukon malain ang panahon.
english:
(WVATCCI) that their units have violated the Anti-Sardinas Policy.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Halley Alcarde, Vice President of the said cooperative, said that their office is strict in following the enforced government ordinances, but there are times when passengers cannot be prevented from boarding especially during rush hour or bad weather.

text: Suno pa kay Alcarde, ginatutukan lang sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) kag Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang mga naga overload nga mga modernized jeep.
english: Alcarde said the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and LTFRB are only focusing on overloading modernized jeeps.

text: Apang suno man sa iya, wala sini ginasapak kag wala ginapangdakop ang mga colorum, unregistered kag wala sang prangkisa nga mga jeep.
english: However, he said, it ignores and does not arrest colorum, unregistered and unfranchised jeeps.

text: Bangdu diri, nagapanawagan sila sa mga nasambit nga ahensya nga mangin patas man kun tani ang pagpatuman sang mga ordinansa kag dakpon ang mga nagakadapat nga dakpon.
english: Therefore, they call on the said agencies to be fair in the implementation of ordinances and arrest those who deserve to be arrested.

text: Madumduman nga mas nangin hugot subong ang pagpangdakup sang mga naga-overload nga mga pampubliko nga salakyan bangud sa naglapta nga social meadia post nga naga reklamo sa tuman kagutok nga modernized jeep.
english: It can be recalled that the arrest of overloading public vehicles has become stricter due to the spread of social media posts complaining about the overcrowding of modernized jeeps.

text: Ginkaakig ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang pagkadula sang internet connection sang PLDT sa JM Basa St., City Proper.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas is angry over the loss of internet connection of PLDT in JM Basa St., City Proper.

text: Ini kasunod man sang pagbaklas sang City Engineers Office sang kable sang internet provider bangud nag-expired na ang ila extension sang exemption sang Disyembre 31, 2024.
english: This follows the City Engineers Office's disconnection of the internet provider's cable because their extension of exemption expired on December 31, 2024.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga nadulaan sang internet connection ang Iloilo City Hall, rason man nga disappointed gid ang alkalde sa natabo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that the Iloilo City Hall was among those who lost their internet connection, which is why the mayor is disappointed with what happened.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, antes ginpatigayon ang operasyon, ginsapol ang mga telecommunication companies kon sa diin, nagpasalig ang PLDT nga na-dismantle na ang ila linya.
english: According to Fantilaga, before the operation, telecommunication companies were met where PLDT assured that their lines have been dismantled.

text: Apang, gulpi lang nga nadula ang koneksyon sang internet sang udto sang Enero 3, 2024.
english: However, the internet connection was suddenly lost at noon on January 3, 2024.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may mga customers man kag subscribers ang ginkadismaya ang pagkadula sang internet kon sa diin, naapektohan man ang operasyon sang Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office.
english: He also said that some customers and subscribers were disappointed with the loss of internet which also affected the operation of the Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office.

text: Mabakal ka bala sang nagamit na nga underwear sa balor nga masobra 100,000 pesos?
english: Can you buy used underwear for more than 100,000 pesos?

text: Gapang-abaw abaw ka, indi bala?
english: You're kidding, aren't you?

text: Ano abi kun ang una nga nakasuksok sini amo ang basketball legend nga si Michael Jordan?
english: What if the first person to wear it was basketball legend Michael Jordan?

text: Indi ka na magka-interes bangud may nakabakal na sini!
english: Don't be interested because someone has already bought it!

text: Suno sa Lelands Auctions, nabakal ang pares sang underpants ni Jordan sa bili nga $3,000 ukon yara sa masulusobra 152,000 pesos!
english: According to Lelands Auctions, Jordan's pair of underpants was bought for $3,000 or more than 152,000 pesos!

text: Kapin isa ka bulan ang bidding kag 19 man ka bidders ang nagka-interes antes nabakal ang amo nga underwear.
english: The bidding lasted more than a month and 19 bidders were interested before the underwear was purchased.

text: Ang amo nga underwear ang gintago sang abyan kag bodyguard sang Chicago Bulls star nga si John Michael Wozniak.
english: That underwear was kept by Chicago Bulls star friend and bodyguard John Michael Wozniak.

text: Mas pabaskugon pa sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) ang kampanya batok sa iligal nga boga ukon improvised cannon subong nga tuig.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) will intensify its campaign against illegal boga or improvised cannon this year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, Spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga kalabanan subong nga nabiktima sang boga ang naga-edad isa tubtob pulo ka tuig.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said most of the victims are aged one to ten years old.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, out of curiosity ang rason kon ngaa naga-engage ang kabataan sa paggamit sang improvised cannon.
english: According to Sangrines, out of curiosity is the reason why children engage in the use of improvised cannon.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga sa pito nga kabug-usan sang kaso sang firecracker related injuries sa Iloilo City, apat diri ang bangud sa paggamit sang boga.
english: He also said that of the seven total cases of firecracker related injuries in Iloilo City, four of them were due to the use of firecrackers.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga ginikanan nga i-supervise ang ila kabataan nga likawan ang paggamit sang improvised cannon agud nga indi na mahalitan pa.
english: He also advised parents to supervise their children to avoid using improvised cannons to avoid further injury.

text: Ginpangsab-it sang mga Taliban ang bangkay sang apat ka mga ginaalegar kidnappers sa western city sang Herat sa Afghanistan bilang “warning” sa publiko.
english: The Taliban hung the bodies of four alleged kidnappers in the western Afghan city of Herat as a “warning” to the public.

text: Gindisplay para sa public view ang mga bangkay nga yara sa crane matapos ang mga ini napatay sa natabo nga shootout.
english: The bodies on the crane were displayed for public view after they were killed in the shootout.

text: Suno kay Mawlawi Shir Ahmad Muhajir, deputy governor sang Herat province, ang bangkay sang mga lalaki ang gin-display sa nagkalain-lain nga mga pampubliko nga lugar agud nga magserbe leksyon nga ang pagpang-kidnap ang wala ginatolerar sa Afghanistan.
english: According to Mawlawi Shir Ahmad Muhajir, deputy governor of Herat province, the bodies of the men were displayed in various public places to serve as a lesson that kidnapping is not tolerated in Afghanistan.

text: Madamo naman sang mga tawo ang nagtipon sa main square sang Herat City sa diin nakasab-it sa crane ang bangkay.
english: Many people gathered in the main square of Herat City where the body was hanging from a crane.

text: Humalin sang Agosto 15, ang adlaw nga nakuha sang Taliban ang gahom sang gobyerno, nangako sila sang mas halog nga sahi sang pagdumala sa pungsod indi kaangay sadto nga tuman ka hugot.
english: Since August 15, the day the Taliban seized power of the government, they have promised a more lenient form of governance in the country unlike before which was so tight.

text: Apang may pila na ka mga reports sang human right abuses subong nga nagaguwa nga nagakatabo na ini sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: However, there are already several reports of human right abuses now emerging that are already happening in the said country.

text: Patay ang 20-anyos nga cashier sa Germany matapos ginluthang sang isa ka kustomer nga ginsugo niya nga magsuksok sang face mask samtang nagabakal sang beer.
english: A 20-year-old cashier in Germany was shot dead by a customer who ordered him to wear a face mask while buying beer.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Idar-Oberstein.
english: The incident took place in Idar-Oberstein.

text: Sandig sa report, ginhambalan sang cashier ang lalaki nga customer nga magsuksok sang face mask.
english: According to the report, the cashier told the male customer to wear a face mask.

text: Naakig ang lalaki, natabo ang pagbaisay, kag sang ulihi naghalin ang lalaki sa German nshop.
english: The man became angry, an argument ensued, and eventually the man left the German nshop.

text: Matapos ang isa ka oras kag tunga, nagbalik ang lalaki kag nakasuksok na sang face mask apang natabo liwat ang argumento sa tunga niya kag sang biktima.
english: After an hour and a half, the man returned wearing a face mask but the argument between him and the victim broke out again.

text: Sunod nga gingabot sang lalaki ang iya nga revolver kag ginluthang ang biktima sa ulo.
english: The man then pulled out his revolver and shot the victim in the head.

text: Ang 49 anyos nga suspek ang nagsungka man sa mga pulis pagkasunod nga aga.
english: The 49-year-old suspect also surrendered to police the following morning.

text: Gin-ako sini ang krimen.
english: He confessed to the crime.

text:
Ginpahayag sini nga ‘cornered’ siya sa pagsulundan angot sa COVID-19 nga iya pa ginlaragway bilang “ever-growing infringement” sa iya kinatamatarong kag “there is no way out.”

Ini nga pagluthang-patay sa cashier ang ginapahayag labing-una nga krimen nga naangot sa coronavirus rules sang pungsod.
english:
He said he was cornered by the COVID-19 rules which he described as an “ever-growing infringement” on his rights and “there is no way out.”

The shooting death of a cashier is allegedly the first crime linked to the country's coronavirus rules.

text: Ginadumilian ang mga manugpangisda sa paglayag sa Rozul Reef (Iroquois) kag sa kadagatan sa Puerto Princesa, Palawan halin alas singko sa hapon tubtub alas nueve sa gab-i sa Enero 25-27 bangud sa posible mahulog nga mga debris halin sa rocket.
english: Fishermen are prohibited from sailing at Rozul Reef (Iroquois) and in the waters of Puerto Princesa, Palawan from 5 pm to 9 pm on January 25-27 due to possible falling debris from the rocket.

text: Santo ini sa advisory nga ginpaguwa sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) MIMAROPA.
english: This is according to an advisory issued by the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) MIMAROPA.

text: Naangot ini sa pagpalupad sang China sang ila nga Long March 8A rocket halin sa Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site sa Hainan province.
english: This is in connection with China's launch of its Long March 8A rocket from the Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site in Hainan province.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ginapanan-aw nga may mga rocket debris nga mahulog ginabanta 106 nautical miles ang distansya halin sa Rozul Reef, 34 nautical miles halin sa Puerto Princesa, kag 34 nautical miles halin sa Hadji Muhtamad, Basilan.
english: According to the agency, rocket debris is expected to fall approximately 106 nautical miles from Rozul Reef, 34 nautical miles from Puerto Princesa, and 34 nautical miles from Hadji Muhtamad, Basilan.

text: May gin-isyu man ang BFAR nga specific drop zones apang suno pa sa ahensya, wala man ginalauman nga magtupa ini sa mga lugar nga ginapuy-an sang mga tawo sa sulod sang teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: The BFAR has also issued specific drop zones but the agency said they are not expected to fall in residential areas within the Philippine territory.

text: Ang ginalantaw nga delikado amo ang vessels nga maglabay sa rocket debris zones.
english: What is considered dangerous are vessels that pass through rocket debris zones.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) nga indi pagpudyuton ukon uyatan ang rocket debris kaangay sang rocket fuel bangud mahimo nga naga-unod ini sang toxins.
english: Earlier, the Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) warned against picking up or handling rocket debris such as rocket fuel because it may contain toxins.

text: Naglahog si Pope Francis nga may pila ka mga tawo nga luyag nga mapatay na siya.
english: Pope Francis has said that some people want him dead.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga may mga cardinal na nga nagapreparar agud nga buslan siya bilang Santo Papa pagkatapos sang iya colon surgery.
english: He also revealed that some cardinals are already preparing to replace him as Pope after his colon surgery.

text: Sabat ini sang 84-anyos nga Santo Papa sang ginpamangkot kun kamusta na ang iya nga kondisyon.
english: The 84-year-old Pope said this when asked how his condition was.

text: “Still alive, even though some people wanted me dead.
english: “Still alive, even though some people wanted me dead.

text: I know there were even meetings between prelates who thought the pope’s condition was more serious than what was said.
english: I know there were even meetings between prelates who thought the pope’s condition was more serious than what was said.

text: They were preparing for the conclave.
english: They were preparing for the conclave.

text:
Ah well!”

Nahibaluan nga sandig sa pagsulundan, kun mag-retire ukon mapatay ang pope, sekreto nga nagasapol ang mga cardinal agud nga mangita sang ibulos sa posisyon.
english:
Ah well!”

It is known that according to the rules, when the pope retires or dies, the cardinals meet secretly to find a replacement for the position.

text: “Thank God, I’m well.
english: “Thank God, I’m well.

text: Undergoing that surgery was a decision I didn’t want to take,” pahayag pa ni Francis.
english: Undergoing that surgery was a decision I didn’t want to take,” Francis said.

text: “It was a nurse who convinced me.
english: “It was a nurse who convinced me.

text:
Nurses sometimes understand the situation more than doctors because they are in direct contact with the patients.”

Matandaan nga nagpaidalom sa operasyon si Pope Francis sang Hulyo 4 matapos nagsuprer sang diverticulitis apang nakaguwa man sa ospital pagkatapos sang 10 ka adlaw.
english:
Nurses sometimes understand the situation more than doctors because they are in direct contact with the patients.”

Pope Francis underwent surgery on July 4 after suffering from diverticulitis but was discharged from the hospital after 10 days.

text: Anom patay samtang 28 naman ang pilason sa Perm University sa Perm City sa Russia.
english: Six people were killed and 28 injured at Perm University in Perm City, Russia.

text: Ang gunman ang ginkilala nga estudyante man sang unibersidad.
english: The gunman was also identified as a university student.

text: Suno kay President Vladimir Putin, aga sang nagsulod sa buluthuan ang estudyante kag gilayon na lang nga nagpangluthang.
english: According to President Vladimir Putin, the student entered the school in the morning and immediately opened fire.

text: Ang iban nga mga estudyante kag manunudlo ang nagpanago sa sulod sang university building samtang ang iban naman ang nagasininggitan kag may nagalumpat pa halin sa bintana agud nga makapalagyo.
english: Some students and teachers hid inside the university building while others shouted and some even jumped from windows to escape.

text: Pahayag sang mga otoridad, preso na subong ang gunman matapos matirohan sang pulis.
english: Authorities say the gunman is now in custody after being shot by a policeman.

text: May yara sang bitbit nga armas kag kutsilyo ang nasambit nga susepek.
english: The suspect was armed with a firearm and a knife.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang pagpakig-unong si President Putin sa mga pamilya sang mga napatay nga mga kabataan.
english: President Putin expressed his condolences to the families of the children who died.

text: Sa subong, ginahibalo pa sang mga kapulisan ang motibo sang pagpangluthang sang gunman.
english: Police are still investigating the motive behind the shooting.

text: Apektado ang operasyon sang Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office kasunod sang pagpangbaklas sang kable sang Iloilo City Engineers Office.
english: The operation of the Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office was affected following the unwinding of the Iloilo City Engineers Office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Velma Lao, head sang Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office, iya ginpahayag nga handa na kontani ang talatapan sa renewal sang mga business permit, apang atrasado ini halin kagapon nga adlaw bangud man sa pagbaklas sang linya sang mga telecommunications company.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Velma Lao, head of the Local Economic Development and Investment Promotions Office, said the office was supposed to be ready for the renewal of business permits, but it was delayed since yesterday due to the disconnection of lines by telecommunications companies.

text: Suno kay Lao, naka-eksperyensya sila sang ‘downtime’ bangud sa nasambit nga tikang.
english: Lao said they experienced downtime due to the move.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga bangud nag-offline ang operasyon sa city hall, down man ang sistema sa offsites, rason nga indi sila maka-communicate sa city hall nga amo ang server.
english: He also explained that because the operation at the city hall went offline, the system at the offsites is also down, which is why they cannot communicate with the city hall which is the server.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga mahimo naman nga makabayad kag renew sang permit sa city hall apang, lauman lang mas madamo nga tawo.
english: He also said that it is possible to pay and renew the permit at the city hall but, expect more people.

text: Gindeklara sang Guinea nga wala na sang outbreak sang Marburg virus sa nasambit nga pungsod– anom ka bulan humalin sang na-detect ang una nga kaso sang nasambit nga balatian.
english: Guinea has declared that there is no outbreak of the Marburg virus in the country – six months since the first case of the disease was detected.

text: Ang outbreak ang nagtuhaw sa Guinea duha ka bulan matapos gindeklara nga hilway na sa Ebola ang pungsod .
english: The outbreak emerged in Guinea two months after the country was declared free of Ebola .

text: Wala sang bulong ukon bakuna nga naga-eksister para sa nasambit nga balatian nga nalakip sa filovirus family.
english: No treatment or vaccine exists for the disease, which belongs to the filovirus family.

text: Ang sintomas sini ang ginalakipan sang mataas nga hilanat kag internal/external bleeding.
english: Its symptoms include high fever and internal/external bleeding.

text: Agud malikawan ang paglapta sang virus, nag-umpisa ang Guinean health authorities sa pag-monitor sa 170 ka mga high-risk contact cases sang una nga biktima sang Marburg.
english: To prevent the spread of the virus, Guinean health authorities have begun monitoring 170 high-risk contact cases of the first Marburg victim.

text: Sa statement sang World Health Organization (WHO), ila ginpahayag nga wala na sang iban pa nga kaso nga na-detect kag tapos na ang outbreak.
english: In a statement, the World Health Organization (WHO) said no more cases have been detected and the outbreak is over.

text: Pahayag pa sang WHO, ang maayo nga response sang Guinea sa outbreak ang nagsalbar sa kabuhi sang mga tawo.
english: The WHO said Guinea's good response to the outbreak saved lives.

text: Ginsirado na ang mga port kag ginkansela ang mga flights kag byahe sang mga train sa Taiwan bangud sa Bagyo Chanthu ukon Bagyo Kiko.
english: Ports have been closed and flights and train services have been canceled in Taiwan due to Typhoon Chanthu or Typhoon Kiko.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Dan Amorsolo, direkta sa Taiwan, ginakabig na subong nga medium typhoon ang bagyo Chanthu.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Dan Amorsolo, directly from Taiwan, Typhoon Chanthu is now considered a medium typhoon.

text: Santo man sa weather authorities sa nasambit nga pungsod, magadala sang mamunog nga pag-ulan kag mabaskog nga pagmadlos sang hangin ang bagyo Chanthu kun maglandfall sa kabukiran sang nasidlangan nga bahin sang Taiwan.
english: According to weather authorities in the country, Typhoon Chanthu will bring heavy rains and strong winds if it makes landfall in the mountains of eastern Taiwan.

text: Ang bagyo Chanthu ang nakit-an man nga magalabay sa Zhejiang province kag Shanghai sa China.
english: Typhoon Chanthu is also forecast to pass through Zhejiang province and Shanghai in China.

text: Pahayag ni Amorsolo, kahapon pa lang, Septyembre 11, ginkansela na sang Taiwanese airlines ang tanan nga domestic flights.
english: Amorsolo said that as of yesterday, September 11, Taiwanese airlines have canceled all domestic flights.

text: Ginmanduan naman ni Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen, ang mga pumuluyo ilabi na ang mga nagapuyo malapit sa coastal areas kag kabukiran nga mangin alerto.
english: Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen has ordered residents, especially those living near coastal areas and mountains, to be alert.

text: Handa man ang disaster preparations sang gobyerno sa posibilidad sang pagbaha kag pagluntad sang landslides.
english: The government's disaster preparations are also ready for the possibility of flooding and landslides.

text: Mahimo nga ipaidalom sa Alternative Delivery Mode ang klase sang mga estudyante nga nabiktima sang palupok kasunod sang pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: Classes of students who were victims of fireworks following the New Year's Eve may be placed under Alternative Delivery Mode.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., Spokesperson sang Department of Education Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga kon mabudlayan gid ang estudyante sa pagtuon bangud sa pilas nga naangkon bangud sa palupok, mahimo nga mag-offer ang manunudlo sang Alternative Delivery Mode.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., Spokesperson of the Department of Education Region 6, said that if the student has difficulty learning due to injuries sustained due to fireworks, the teacher can offer an Alternative Delivery Mode.

text: Suno kay Escullar, ini agud nga mas mapadasig man ang pagpaayo sang estudyante samtang ini ang nagapadayon sang pag-eskwela.
english: According to Escullar, this is to accelerate the improvement of the student while he continues his studies.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga mahimo lang nga mag-untat ang amo nga delivery mode kon makumpirma na sang doktor nga maayo na sa injuries ang estudyante.
english: He also said that the delivery mode can only stop when the doctor confirms that the student is cured of his injuries.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang natungdan nga may mga activity sheets ang estudyante samtang ini ang yara sa Alternative Delivery Mode.
english: He also assured that the students have activity sheets while they are in Alternative Delivery Mode.

text: Ginpa-check ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa City Council ang mga existing ordinances nga naga-regulate sa paggamit sang boga ukon improvised cannon.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas asked the City Council to check the existing ordinances that regulate the use of boga or improvised cannon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, Spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga kon wala pa sang ordinansa, iduso sang alkalde nga makahimo agud nga mabuhinan ang mga insidente nga tuga sang boga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said that if there is no ordinance, the mayor will propose one to reduce incidents caused by boga.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, ini kasunod man sang na-record nga pito ka mga firecracker related injuries sa syudad nga nagaangot sa improvised cannon.
english: Fantilaga said this follows the recording of seven firecracker related injuries in the city involving improvised cannons.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga apisar sang manubo nga numero sang kaso, kinahanglan sa gihapon nga pabaskugon ang kampanya batok sa iligal nga boga.
english: He also said that despite the low number of cases, the campaign against illegal boga still needs to be strengthened.

text: Suportado naman sang Committee on Public Safety sang city council ang ginaduso nga review sang ordinansa ni Mayor Treñas.
english: The Committee on Public Safety of the city council supported the proposed review of Mayor Treñas' ordinance.

text: Suno kay Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman sang Committee on Public Safety, iya ginpahayag nga tinutuyo lamang nga mapabilin nga hilway sa kasablagan ang mga residente.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, chairman of the Committee on Public Safety, said the aim is to keep the residents safe.

text: Nagmandu man si Cabaluna sa iya staff nga magsugod na review sang mga orinansa nga posible naga-cover sa iligal nga boga.
english: Cabaluna also ordered his staff to start reviewing offers that may cover illegal gambling.

text: Ipaidalom sa ballistic examination ang bala nga nagtalang kag nag-igo sa atop sang isa ka balay sa Barangay Tarug, Alimodian, Iloilo.
english: The bullet that strayed and hit the roof of a house in Barangay Tarug, Alimodian, Iloilo will be subjected to ballistic examination.

text: Ang amo nga balay ang ginapanag-iyahan ni Francisco Guardia, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The house is owned by Francisco Guardia, resident of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Cop sang Alimodian Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nag-request na sila sang ballistic examination sa Regional Forensic Unit agud matumod kon ano nga sahi sang pusil ang gingamit sa insidente.
english: Rolly Sorongon, Deputy Cop of Alimodian Municipal Police Station, said they have requested a ballistic examination from the Regional Forensic Unit to determine the type of firearm used in the incident.

text: Suno kay Sorongon, sang nabaton nila ang impormasyon, insigida nga nagpadulong sila sa balay ni Guardia kag didto nakumpirma nga may yara sang stray bullet.
english: Sorongon said when they received the information, they immediately went to Guardia's house and confirmed that there was a stray bullet.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagpatuman sila sang ocular inspection kag imbestigasyon kon sa diin, naguwa nga sa atop nag-agi ang bala kag nakit-an ini sa salog sang sala sang balay.
english: He also said that they conducted an ocular inspection and investigation where, it turned out that the bullet went through the roof and it was found on the floor of the living room of the house.

text: Maswerte naman nga wala sang may naigo nga indibidwal sa nagtalang nga bala.
english: Fortunately, no individual was hit by the stray bullet.

text: Ini naman ang labing-una nga tion nga may natabo nga insidente sa lugar.
english: This is the first time that an incident has occurred in the area.

text: Nag-anunsyo na ang Taliban sang bag-o nga interim government sa Afghanistan.
english: The Taliban have announced a new interim government in Afghanistan.

text: Pamunuan ni Mullah Mohammad Hassan Akhund ang bag-o nga gobyerno.
english: Mullah Mohammad Hassan Akhund will lead the new government.

text: Mangin deputy naman ni Akhund ang Taliban co-founder nga si Mulla Abdul Ghani Baradar.
english: Taliban co-founder Mulla Abdul Ghani Baradar will be Akhund's deputy.

text: Kalakip sa mga ginhatagan sang pwesto amo si Sarajuddin Haqqani nga amo ang mangin acting interior minister sang pungsod.
english: Among those given the post is Sarajuddin Haqqani who will be the acting interior minister of the country.

text: Si Haqqani ang nagapamuno sa militant group nga ginatawag Haqqani network — grupo sa likod sang pagpamomba sa Afghanistan sang 2017 sa diin napatay ang masobra 150 ka mga indibidwal.
english: Haqqani heads the militant group called the Haqqani network — group behind the bombings in Afghanistan in 2017 that killed more than 150 individuals.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginakabig sang Estados Unidos ang Haqqani network bilang foreign terrorist organisation.
english: It is known that the United States considers the Haqqani network as a foreign terrorist organization.

text: Lakip pa sa mga gin-assign sa pwesto amo sanday Mullay Yaqoob bilang acting defense minister, Amir Khan Muttaqi bilang acting foreign minister kag Mullah Salam Hanafi bilang second deputy.
english: Also assigned to the post are Mullay Yaqoob as acting defense minister, Amir Khan Muttaqi as acting foreign minister and Mullah Salam Hanafi as second deputy.

text: Matandaan nga Agusto 15 sang ginsakop sang Taliban ang halos bug-os nga Afghanistan kag gintabog ang administrasyon sang gobyerno.
english: It can be recalled that on August 15, the Taliban took control of almost all of Afghanistan and ousted the government administration.

text: Nagpasalig si former Justice Secretary Vitaliano Aguirre II nga indi siya magpanago pananglitan nga may ipaguwa na nga arrest warrant ang International Criminal Court (ICC) batok sa iya.
english: Former Justice Secretary Vitaliano Aguirre II has assured that he will not hide if the International Criminal Court (ICC) issues an arrest warrant against him.

text: Isa ang former justice official sa ginhingadlan nga co-perpetrator sa drug war ni former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte nga subong nagapangatubang sang kaso nga crimes against humanity sa korte sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The former justice official is one of the named co-perpetrators of former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte's drug war who is now facing charges of crimes against humanity in a court in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Apisar indi siya magpanago suno kay Aguirre, magapamatok siya nga arestuhon, apang suno sa iya, himuon niya ini sa legal nga paagi, kaangay sang pagdangop sa korte bangud nagapati siya nga isa ka pagsupak sa layi pananglitan nga i-subject siya sa trial sa ICC.
english: Although he will not hide, Aguirre said, he will resist being arrested, but he said he will do so legally, such as going to court because he believes it is a violation of the law if he is subjected to trial at the ICC.

text: Nagalaum man si Aguirre nga magpaguwa sang ruling ang Korte Suprema nga naga-athag sang proseso nga sundon pananglitan nga may arrest warrant halin sa amo nga korte.
english: Aguirre also hopes that the Supreme Court will issue a ruling clarifying the process to be followed in the event of an arrest warrant from the court.

text: Nagpanindugan man si Aguirre nga wala siya sang involvement sa ginasiling sang ICC nga “common plan” ukon “national network” sa implementasyon sang drug war.
english: Aguirre also insisted that he had no involvement in the ICC's so-called “common plan” or “national network” in the implementation of the drug war.

text: Nagapati man ang anay opisyal nga gindugang lang siya sa listahan agud nga mapatihan ini ukon agud nga may kredibilidad ang kaso.
english: The former official also believes that he was added to the list to make it believable or to give credibility to the case.

text: Pahayag sang anay DOJ Secretary, wala siya sang kahilabtanan sa anuman nga extrajudicial killings, kag sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, nangin instrumento pa siya gani agud nga makuha sang pila ka drug war victims ang hustisya.
english: The former DOJ Secretary said he had nothing to do with any extrajudicial killings, and in fact, he said he was even instrumental in getting some drug war victims justice.

text:
Magluwas kay Aguirre, yara sa listahan sang alleged co-perpetrators sanday:

Senator Bong GoSenador Bato dela RosaFormer PNP chief Vicente DanaoAng nagtaliwan nga former PNP chief Camilo CascolanFormer PNP chief Oscar AlbayaldeFormer National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) chief Dante Gierrankag Former Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency chief Isidro Lapeña.
english:
In addition to Aguirre, the list of alleged co-perpetrators includes:

Senator Bong GoSenator Bato dela RosaFormer PNP chief Vicente DanaoThe late former PNP chief Camilo CascolanFormer PNP chief Oscar AlbayaldeFormer National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) chief Dante Gierrankag Former Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency chief Isidro Lapeña.

text: Una naman nga nagpahayag ang defense team ni Duterte sa pagpanguna ni Atty. Nicholas Kaufman nga wala pa sang arrest warrant sa sini nga mga indibidwal.
english: Earlier, Duterte's defense team led by Atty. Nicholas Kaufman said there are no arrest warrants for these individuals.

text: Gintawag man ni Kaufman nga pamulitika ang pagpagwa sang listahan.#
english: Kaufman also called the release of the list political.

text: “Love triangle” ang ginalantaw nga anggulo kun ngaa gintiro sang isa ka pulis ang isa ka officer sang Philippine Air Force (PAF) sa Zamboanga.
english: “Love triangle” is believed to be the angle why a policeman shot a Philippine Air Force (PAF) officer in Zamboanga.

text: Ang biktima amo si Staff Sgt.
english: The victim was identified as Staff Sgt.

text: Roliver Anang, 41-anyos, nga yara sa kritikal nga kondisyon.
english: Roliver Anang, 41, who is in critical condition.

text: Ang suspek amo si Police Patrolman Elshiemer Kamlian, assigned sa Sumisip Municipal Police Station (MPS) sa Basilan.
english: The suspect was identified as Police Patrolman Elshiemer Kamlian, assigned to the Sumisip Municipal Police Station (MPS) in Basilan.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, pakadto sa trabaho si Anang sang nasiplatan sini ang salakyan sang iya nga misis nga si Daisy nga nakaparada sa gwa sang isa ka apartment.
english: According to the investigation, Anang was on his way to work when he saw his wife Daisy's car parked outside an apartment.

text: Nagpundo ini kag makaligad ang pila ka minutos, nakita niya nga naggwa ang misis kag kaupod ang suspek.
english: He stopped and after a few minutes, he saw his wife come out with the suspect.

text: Nakita man sang asawa ang iya bana kag nagbalik naman sa apartment ang pulis.
english: The wife also saw her husband and the policeman returned to the apartment.

text: Pagbalik sini sa gwa, may dala na ini nga pusil kag gintiro si Anang.
english: When he came back outside, he had a gun and shot Anang.

text: Madasig nga nalagyo ang suspek sakay sa motorsiklo apang natigayon man nga nadakpan.
english: The suspect quickly fled the scene on a motorcycle but was arrested.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa kaso.
english: The investigation into the case is ongoing.

text: NAHAM-OT kita sa pila ka opisyales sang gobyerno, lakip na ang isa ukon duha ka myembro sang Kongreso, nga naga-rekomendar nga patawan sing death penalty ang bugok nga pulis nga wala kaluoy nga nagpatay gid sa helpless nga mag-iloy sa Paniqui, Tarlac.
english: WE ARE sick of some government officials, including one or two members of Congress, who are recommending that the death penalty be imposed on the stupid policeman who mercilessly killed a helpless mother and daughter in Paniqui, Tarlac.

text: Tani magbasa-basa man kamo sang panit ibos.
english: I hope you read the skin ibos.

text: Indi pwede ang inyo gina-rekomendar nga death penalty kay Nuezca kay labag ina sa aton 1987 Constitution.
english: Your recommended death penalty for Nuezca is not acceptable because it is against our 1987 Constitution.

text: Ang Sec.
english: The Sec.

text:
22 sang Bill of Rights nagasiling: “No ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted.”

Ina nga section sang Bill of Rights sa ex post facto law naga-prohibir sa pagpataw sing penalidad sa isa ka krimen nga wala ginapataw sang kasuguan sadtong paghimo sang krimen.
english:
22 of the Bill of Rights states: “No ex post facto law or bill of attainder shall be enacted.”

That section of the Bill of Rights in ex post facto law prohibits the imposition of a penalty for a crime that was not imposed by law at the time of the commission of the crime.

text: Ang aton kasuguan sa karon nagapataw lang sang pinakataas nga penalidad nga life imprisonment, lakip na ang multiple life imprisonment, gani ang pagpataw sang death penalty indi applicable sa kaso nga murder ni Nuezca.
english: Our current law only imposes the maximum penalty of life imprisonment, including multiple life imprisonment, so the imposition of the death penalty is not applicable to Nuezca's murder case.

text: In other words, sa murder case ni Nuezca, indi ini siya madutlan sang death penalty, kundi ang bagay lang nga penalidad nga life imprisonment sa iya murder case sa subong nga kasuguan.
english: In other words, in Nuezca's murder case, he will not face the death penalty, but the only appropriate penalty is life imprisonment in his murder case under the current law.

text: Luas sa criminal case, gina-consider man sang husgado nga ex post facto law “which increases the punishment, or, in short, which, in relation to the offense or its consequences, alters the situation of a party to his disadvantage (Lindsay vs Washington, 301 U.S. 397)”.
english: Beyond the criminal case, the court also considers ex post facto law “which increases the punishment, or, in short, which, in relation to the offense or its consequences, alters the situation of a party to his disadvantage (Lindsay vs Washington, 301 U.S. 397)”.

text: Wala ugaling naga-apply ang ex post facto law, sunu sa Republic vs Capan Vda.
english: However, the ex post facto law does not apply, according to Republic vs Capan Vda.

text: Herandez (99 Phil.
english: Herandez (99 Phil.

text: 935), sa civil statutes katulad sang internal revenue laws kag executive orders.
english: 935), in civil statutes such as internal revenue laws and executive orders.

text: Wala man ini naga-apply sa kaso sang deportation (Galvan vs Press, 347 U.S. 522).
english: Nor does it apply in a deportation case (Galvan vs Press, 347 U.S. 522).

text: On the other hand, ang bill of attainder “is a legislative act which convicts persons of and punishes them for crimes without judicial trial.” Gina-prohibir ini sang Constitution tungod naga-violate ini sang Principle of Separation of Powers.
english: On the other hand, the bill of attainder “is a legislative act which convicts persons of and punishes them for crimes without judicial trial.” The Constitution prohibits this because it violates the Principle of Separation of Powers.

text: Ina tungod naga-usurp ini sang judicial function.
english: That's because it usurps the judicial function.

text:
***

Kon nabakunahan ka na, sunu sa mga health expert, katulad sang Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) sang United States, kinahanglan pa anay ang dugang nga panahon bag-o mo untatan ang pagtuman sang mga health measures.
english:
***

If you have been vaccinated, according to health experts, such as the Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) of the United States, it will take more time before you stop following health measures.

text: In other words, kinahanglan nga sigehon mo anay ang pagtuman sang mga health protocols.
english: In other words, you need to keep following the health protocols.

text: Katulad sang social distancing; paggamit sang face mask; pagpanghugas sang kamot gamit ang habon; likawan nga matandug sang imo mahigko nga kamot ang ilong, baba kag mata; kag iban pa nga hygienic practice.
english: Like social distancing; use of face masks; hand washing with soap; avoid touching the nose, mouth and eyes with your dirty hands; and other hygienic practice.

text: Subong man ang indi pagpakigsimpon (gathering) sa iban sing malapitan labi na gid kon wala sing proteksyon kag naga-ubo pa, nagapangatsi, ukon matalsikan sang laway sang nagahambal.
english: Also, do not gather with others in close proximity, especially if there is no protection and the speaker is still coughing, sneezing, or spitting.

text: Ngaa man?
english: Why else?

text: Sa duha ka mayor nga rason: Una, tungod posible ka pa ma-reinfect, ukon ma-infect liwat, kag kon ma-reinfect ka basi isa pa ini ka asymptomatic infection nga wala gapakita sing sintoma sang COVID-19 nga makalaton gihapon sa iban.
english: For two main reasons: First, because you can still be reinfected, or reinfected, and if you are reinfected it may be another asymptomatic infection that does not show symptoms of COVID-19 that can still spread to others.

text: Ikaduha, tungod lubos lang ma-control ang COVID-19 kon at least 7 ukon 8 sa 10 ka tawo na ang na-immune sang bakuna.
english: Second, because COVID-19 can only be fully controlled if at least 7 or 8 out of 10 people have been vaccinated.

text: Herd immunity kon tawgon ini sang mga health authorities.
english: Herd immunity if the health authorities call it.

text: That means kinahanglan gid nga ma-immune anay ang mga 70 ukon 80 ka milyon sang aton sobra 100 ka milyon nga populasyon sa Filipinas, nga syempre indi dali-dali malab-ut bakunahan sang aton mga health personnel.
english: That means it is necessary to immunize about 70 or 80 million of our more than 100 million population in the Philippines, which of course cannot be easily vaccinated by our health personnel.

text: In other word, hulaton gid naton nga mabakunahan ang ini nga kadamuon sang aton populasyon bag-o makasiling ang aton health authorities nga lubos na kita hilway sa COVID-19./PN
english: In other words, we must wait for this number of our population to be vaccinated before our health authorities can say that we are completely free from COVID-19./PN

text: Ginsiguro sang lider sang militar nga nagsipa sa pwesto kay President Alpha Conde sang Guinea nga sila ang magatukod sang bag-o nga gobyerno sa masunod nga semana.
