english: The military leader who ousted President Alpha Conde of Guinea has assured that they will form a new government next week.

text: Suno kay Col.
english: According to Col.

text: Mamady Doumbouya, indi nila pagsakiton ang mga anay opisyal.
english: Mamady Doumbouya, they will not hurt the former officials.

text: Samtang magapabilin pahayag niya sa presohan ang Presidente.
english: Meanwhile, he said the President will remain in jail.

text: Nagpanawagan pa si Doumbouya sa mga opisyal nga antes maghalin sa ila pwesto, nagakadapat nga ihatag nila ang ila mga salakyan sa militar.
english: Doumbouya also appealed to the officers that before leaving their posts, they should hand over their vehicles to the military.

text: Una na nga ginpakamalaot sang United Nations kag African Union ang ginahimo sang mga militar.
english: The United Nations and the African Union have previously condemned the military's actions.

text: Nagpain ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang P1.25 billion agud mabuligan ang hog industry nga makabangon sa African swine fever (ASF) ilabi na bangud nagapanglakaak sa gihapon ang presyo sang karne sang baboy bangud sa limitado nga suplay.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has allocated P1.25 billion to help the hog industry recover from African swine fever (ASF) especially as the price of pork is still rising due to limited supply.

text: Sa gin-isyu ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: In a statement issued by Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga Memorandum Circular No.
english: Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2, nakasaad ang pag-implementar sang swine industry recovery project (SIRP) agud nga maduso ang modernisasyon sa swine industry.
english: 2, promises the implementation of the swine industry recovery project (SIRP) to promote modernization in the swine industry.

text: Suno kay Laurel, tuyo sini nga programa nga mapabaskog ang biosecurity, mangin mas moderno ang farm infrastructure, mapaayo ang genetic quality kag mapasangkad ang market access.
english: According to Laurel, the program aims to strengthen biosecurity, modernize farm infrastructure, improve genetic quality and expand market access.

text: Paagi sini suno sa natungdan, mas malapad ang malab-utan kaangay sang magagmay nga farmers, kooperatiba, commercial breeders, kag at-risk agricultural communities nga nagatanyag sang customized assistance nga maka-restore, modernize kag maintain sang produksyon sang baboy sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: Through this, he said, the reach will be wider such as small farmers, cooperatives, commercial breeders, and at-risk agricultural communities who offer customized assistance to restore, modernize and maintain pig production nationwide.

text: Ginbasol ni Laurel sa outbreak sang ASF kun ngaa nagnubo ang pork output, nagsaka ang presyo, kag naapektuhan ang mga consumer kag kabug-usan nga food supply chain.
english: Laurel blamed the ASF outbreak for the decline in pork output, the increase in prices, and the impact on consumers and the overall food supply chain.

text: Apang pahayag sini, ginalantaw niya nga maka-recover na ang suplay sang baboy sa pungsod sa masunod nga tatlo ka semana.
english: However, he said he expects the country's pork supply to recover in the next three weeks.

text: Tapos na ang Christmas season suno sa natungdan gani nagnubo naman ang consumption, gani sa masunod nga duha-tatlo ka semana, magadamo na liwat ang suplay.
english: The Christmas season is over, he said, so consumption has decreased, so in the next two-three weeks, the supply will increase again.

text: Sa Metro Manila, ang pork liempo yara na sa P370 – 450/kg; samtang ang kasim naman yara sa P330/kg-P400/kg base sa DA Bantay Presyo (price watch).
english: In Metro Manila, pork liempo is now at P370 – 450/kg; while kasim is at P330/kg-P400/kg based on DA Bantay Presyo (price watch).

text: Bisan wala sang supply shortage sa pangkabug-usan suno sa DA, yara gihapon ang daku nga epekto sang ASF sa swine industry.
english: Although there is no supply shortage in general, the DA said, there is still a significant impact of ASF on the swine industry.

text: As of Dec.
english: As of Dec.

text: 27, 2024, 225 ang yara sa red zones ukon barangays nga may active ASF cases nga mas manubo sa 365 nga na-rekord sang Disyembre 6 sang tinalikdan nga tuig.
english: 27, 2024, 225 are in red zones or barangays with active ASF cases which is lower than the 365 recorded on December 6 last year.

text: Wala gihapon sa bungog sang China ang mga pag-radyo kag pagprotesta sang Pilipinas matapos nag-abante pa ang Chinese monster ship kag nagapalapit sa baybayon sang Zambales.
english: China is still ignoring the radio broadcasts and protests of the Philippines after the Chinese monster ship advanced and approached the coast of Zambales.

text: Kahapon lamang, nagradyo liwat ang BRP Gabriela Silang sa China Coast Guard vessel 5901 ukon sa ‘monster ship’ bangud sa iligal nga aktibidad sini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Just yesterday, BRP Gabriela Silang again radioed China Coast Guard vessel 5901 or the 'monster ship' due to its illegal activities in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Ulihi ini na-monitor sa kalayuon nga 60-70 nautical miles halin sa coastline sang Zambales nga maathag katama nga sulod sa exclusive economic zone (EEZ) sang Pilipinas.
english: It was last monitored at a distance of 60-70 nautical miles from the coastline of Zambales which is clearly within the exclusive economic zone (EEZ) of the Philippines.

text: Suno sa Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), nagpaguwa sila sang radio challenge agud nga kumprontahon ang China kag ipahanumdom sa ila nga teritoryo ini sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), they issued a radio challenge to confront China and remind them that it is Philippine territory.

text: Importante suno sa PCG nga mahibaluan nga sa idalom sang United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), ang freedom of navigation para sa foreign-flagged vessels wala nagakahulugan nga pwede man maka-conduct sang maritime patrols ang foreign vessels sa exclusive economic zone sang iban nga states ukon pungsod.
english: The PCG said it is important to note that under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), freedom of navigation for foreign-flagged vessels does not mean that foreign vessels can conduct maritime patrols in the exclusive economic zone of other states or countries.

text: Kun basehan ang report sang PCG, ini na ang pang-15 nga adlaw nga na-monitor ang monster ship sa teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: Based on the PCG report, this is the 15th day that the monster ship has been monitored in Philippine territory.

text: Una ini nga nasiplatan sang Enero 4 kag naka-file naman sang diplomatic protest ang Philippine government apang wala nagasapak ang Chinese vessel.
english: It was first spotted on January 4 and the Philippine government filed a diplomatic protest but the Chinese vessel ignored it.

text: Ini nga aktwasyon sang China ginakabig nga paglapas sa Philippine Maritime Zones Act, United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), kag 2016 Arbitral Award.
english: This action by China is considered a violation of the Philippine Maritime Zones Act, United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), and 2016 Arbitral Award.

text: Ginsipa sa pwesto sang Special forces soldiers ang long-serving President sang Guinea nga si Alpha Conde kag gindeklara nga wala na sang gobyerno kag konstitusyon kag sirado na ang land kag air borders.
english: Special forces soldiers ousted Guinea's long-serving President Alpha Conde and declared that there was no government and constitution and that land and air borders were closed.

text: Suno kay Mamady Doumbouya, Head sang Elite Guinea army unit, kapigaduhon kag kurapsyon ang nagtulod sa mga soldado nga kakason sa pwesto si Conde.
english: According to Mamady Doumbouya, Head of the Elite Guinea army unit, poverty and corruption led the soldiers to remove Conde from office.

text: Pahayag niya, sila mismo ang liwat nga magahimo sang konstitusyon.
english: He said they will draft the constitution themselves.

text: Antes pa man ang deklarasyon, may yara sang serye sang linukpanay malapit sa presidential palace sa Conakry, Guinea.
english: Even before the declaration, there was a series of clashes near the presidential palace in Conakry, Guinea.

text: Sa subong, indi pa mapat-od kun sa diin gindala ang Presidente matapos naglapta ang video nga ginpalibotan ini sang army special forces.
english: At present, it is not clear where the President was taken after a video circulated that he was surrounded by army special forces.

text: Ginpakamalaot naman ni United Nations Secretary General Antonio Guterres ang pwersahan nga pagkuha sang gahom sang gobyerno kag ginmanduan man ang mga responsable nga tawo nga buy-an na ang Presidente.
english: United Nations Secretary General Antonio Guterres condemned the forced seizure of power and ordered those responsible to release the President.

text: Wala sang may matabo nga impeachment kay US President Joe Biden kasunod sang withdrawal sang mga US troops gikan sa Afganistan.
english: There will be no impeachment of US President Joe Biden following the withdrawal of US troops from Afghanistan.

text: Ini ang pagpati ni Senate Republican Leader Mith McConnell bangud lunsay Democrats ang naga-kontrol sang House kag Senate.
english: This is the belief of Senate Republican Leader Mith McConnell because both Democrats control the House and Senate.

text: Suno sa iya, ang mas maayo nga himuon amo nga panumdumon sang maayo kun sin-o ang dapat nga botohon sa tion sang eleksyon.
english: He said the best thing to do is to think carefully about who to vote for during the election.

text: Matandaan nga 13 ka mga US service members kag masobra 170 ka mga sibilyan ang napatay sa suicide bombing attack sa Kabul airport sa diin gin-ako man sang Islamic State Khorasan ukon ISIS-K nga sila ang may kahimo-an.
english: It can be recalled that 13 US service members and more than 170 civilians were killed in the suicide bombing attack at Kabul airport in which the Islamic State Khorasan or ISIS-K also claimed responsibility.

text: Pila sa mga republicans kaangay nanday Tennessee Sen.
english: Some of the republicans like Tennessee Sen.

text: Marsha Blackburn kag South Carolina Sen.
english: Marsha Blackburn and South Carolina Sen.

text: Lindsey Graham ang nagpahayag nga nagakadapat nga mag-resign ukon magpangatubang sang impeachment si Biden.
english: Lindsey Graham said Biden should resign or face impeachment.

text: Madamo sang mga kritisismo ang ginahaboy sa Presidente sa diin nagapati ang kadam-an sa mga Republicans nga ang withdrawal gikan sa Afghanistan ang nagtuga sang “humanitarian disaster” kag nag-engganyo pa sang mga terorista.
english: Many criticisms are being thrown at the President with many Republicans believing that the withdrawal from Afghanistan has caused a “humanitarian disaster” and even encouraged terrorists.

text: Madayon gid ang deklarasyon sang food security emergency sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga semana.
english: The declaration of food security emergency in the Philippines will continue next week.

text: Ini matapos nga naghatag na sang suporta si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This comes after President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. has already given his support.

text: sa amo nga tikang sa rason nga mapwersa suno sa iya nga mapanubo ang presyo sang bugas sa mga merkado.
english: in such a move on the grounds that it will be forced, he said, to reduce the price of rice in the markets.

text: Suno kay President Marcos, bisan nga nagnubo na ang gasto sa produksyon, mataas gihapon ang presyo.
english: According to President Marcos, although the cost of production has decreased, the price is still high.

text: “Hindi nasusundan and supply and demand curve.
english: “It doesn’t follow the supply and demand curve.

text: Dahil hanggang ngayon kahit ibaba mo lahat ng inputs, ang pagbenta pa rin mataas pa rin,” pahayag sang chief executive.
english: Because until now even if you lower all the inputs, sales are still high,” the chief executive said.

text: “And so we have to force that price down and we have to make sure that the market works properly,” dugang sini.
english: “And so we have to force that price down and we have to make sure that the market works properly,” it added.

text: Sang Hulyo sang nagligad nga tuig, nagsiling ang economic managers nga mabuhinan sang P5-P6 per kilo ang presyo pag-abot sang Agusto kun matapyasan na sang gobyerno ang taripa sa imported rice sa 15% halin sa 35%.
english: In July last year, economic managers said the price would be reduced by P5-P6 per kilo by August if the government cuts the tariff on imported rice to 15% from 35%.

text: Gin-aprubahan ni Marcos ang amo nga tikang, apang santo sa monitoring sang Department of Agriculture, nagnubo matuod ang presyo sa imported well-milled kag regular milled rice varieties apang mataas gihapon ang special kag premium rice.
english: Marcos approved the move, but according to the monitoring of the Department of Agriculture, the price of imported well-milled and regular milled rice varieties has decreased but the price of special and premium rice is still high.

text: Sini nga semana, gin-aprubahan sang National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) ang resolution nga magatulod sa DA nga magdeklarar sang “food security emergency for rice”.
english: This week, the National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) approved a resolution that will prompt the DA to declare a “food security emergency for rice”.

text: Kun mahimo na sang DA ang deklarasyon, matugutan naman ang National Food Authority (NFA) nga mapaguwa ang ila nga buffer stock sang bugas para ma-stabilize ang presyo.
english: Once the DA makes the declaration, the National Food Authority (NFA) will be allowed to release its buffer stock of rice to stabilize prices.

text: Ang stocks nga iga-release ang paga-islan sang locally produced rice para nga masuportahan naman ang Filipino farmers.#
english: The stocks that will be released will be replaced with locally produced rice to support Filipino farmers.

text: ILOILO – Nagnubo ang numero sang eight focus crimes nga narekord sang Police Regional Office 6 sang Disyembre 16, 2024 tubtob Enero 1, 2025 kun ipaanggid sang kaangay nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: ILOILO – The number of eight focus crimes recorded by the Police Regional Office 6 from December 16, 2024 to January 1, 2025 decreased compared to the same period last year.

text: Ang eight focus crimes ang nagatumod sa murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, theft, robbery, carnapping sang salakyan kag motorsiklo.
english: The eight focus crimes refer to murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, theft, robbery, carnapping of vehicles and motorcycles.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLt.Col.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLt.Col.

text: Arnel Solis, Spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahahayag nga nakarekord lamang ang talatapan sang 54 ka mga insidente humalin sang holiday season tubtob sa pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig sa diin mas manubo ini sa 175 ka mga insidente nga narekord sang Disyembre 16, 2023 tubtob Enero 1, 2024.
english: Arnel Solis, Spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the office recorded only 54 incidents from the holiday season to the New Year's Eve which is lower than the 175 incidents recorded from December 16, 2023 to January 2024.

text: Ini ang may katumbas nga 69.32 percent nga pagnubo.
english: This corresponds to a 69.32 percent decrease.

text: Suno kay Solis, sa iban nga mga crime incidents sa amo nga period, 907 ang narekord sang PRO 6 kag mas manubo ini sa gihapon sa 1,264 nga narekord sang holiday season sang tuig 2023 tubtob 2024.
english: According to Solis, in other crime incidents during the period, 907 were recorded by PRO 6 and this is still lower than the 1,264 recorded during the holiday season of 2023 to 2024.

text: Pahayag sang natungdan, may kontribusyon ang mga pumuluyo, stakeholders, law enforcement agencies kag media sa pagnubo sang insidente sa Western Visayas bangud sa kooperasyon sang tanan sa pagpabilin nga matawhay kag malinong ang komunidad.
english: He said the residents, stakeholders, law enforcement agencies and media have contributed to the reduction of incidents in Western Visayas due to the cooperation of everyone in maintaining peace and tranquility in the community.

text: Samtang sa firework-related injury, nakarekord ang PRO 6 sang 80 cases sa diin mas manubo ini sa masobra 200 ka mga kaso nga narekord sang tinalikdan nga tuig.
english: Meanwhile, in firework-related injury, PRO 6 recorded 80 cases, which is lower than the more than 200 cases recorded last year.

text: Apang nagakasubo si Solis bangud may reported stray bullet incidents sa rehiyon nga nagapatimaan nga may yara pa sa gihapon sang mga tig-a ulo nga nagapalupok sang armas apisar sa liwat-liwat kag hugot na nga kampanya sang mga kapulisan.
english: However, Solis is saddened by the reported stray bullet incidents in the region which indicates that there are still stubborn people who fire their weapons despite the repeated and intense campaigns of the police.

text: Wala sang mangin pagbag-o sa bayaran sa fuel surcharge sa masunod nga bulan matapos gin-anunsyo sang Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) nga magapabilin ini sa Level 4.
english: There will be no change in the fuel surcharge next month after the Civil Aeronautics Board (CAB) announced that it will remain at Level 4.

text: Ini na ang pang-lima nga sunod-sunod nga bulan nga wala sang fuel surcharge adjustment halin sang ginpasaka ini sa Level 5 sang Septyembre 2024.
english: This is the fifth consecutive month without a fuel surcharge adjustment since it was raised to Level 5 in September 2024.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 4, magabayad ang pasahero sang dugang nga P117 tubtub sa P342 para sa domestic flights kag P385.70 tubtub sa P2,867.82 para naman sa mga flight sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Under Level 4, passengers will pay an additional P117 to P342 for domestic flights and P385.70 to P2,867.82 for international flights.

text: Ang fuel surcharge amo ang dugang nga fees nga ginasukot sang airlines agud nga makabawi man sila sa fuel costs.
english: A fuel surcharge is additional fees charged by airlines so that they can also recover from fuel costs.

text: Separado ini sa base fare nga amo naman ang actual amount nga ginabayaran sang pasahero para makapuwesto sa sulod sang eroplano.
english: This is separate from the base fare which is the actual amount a passenger pays to get a seat inside the plane.

text: Sa idalom sang Level 4, ang mga pasahero pakadto sa Caticlan, Legaspi, Kalibo kag Roxas ang ginasukot sang dugang nga P184 samtang ang magabyahe naman pakadto sa Laoag, Iloilo, Bacolod, Cebu kag Puerto Princesa ang magabayad sang P232 sa fuel surcharge.
english: Under Level 4, passengers to Caticlan, Legaspi, Kalibo and Roxas will be charged an additional P184 while those traveling to Laoag, Iloilo, Bacolod, Cebu and Puerto Princesa will pay P232 in fuel surcharge.

english: Photo: Russel Palma

text: ILOILO CITY- Doble ang ginapangatubang nga kabudlay sang estado sang Louisiana, USA, matapos nga ginlaslasan ini sang makahahalit nga hurricane Ida sa tunga sang krisis dala sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: ILOILO CITY – The state of Louisiana, USA, is facing double hardship after it was hit by devastating hurricane Ida in the midst of the crisis caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Sonia Provido Short direkta sa Estados Unidos, mayor nga problema amo ang pagkadula sang supply sang kuryente rason nga nabudlayan ang mga ospital nga mag- function ilabi na nga mayorya sang mga pasyente ang nagasuprir sang COVID-19.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Sonia Provido Short directly in the United States, the main problem is the loss of electricity supply which makes it difficult for hospitals to function especially as the majority of patients are suffering from COVID-19.

text: Magluwas diri, may mga ospital man nga nagkalaguba rason nga ginpatigayon man ang evacuation sang mga pasyente.
english: In addition, some hospitals were also damaged, which led to the evacuation of patients.

text: Ginpahayag ni Short nga masobra 1 million ka mga tawo ang wala sang kuryente kadungan sang landfall sang hurricane kon sa diin duha na ang narecord nga napatay kag naghatag pa gid sang kakugmat sa mga pumuluyo sa ginbahaan nga mga lugar bangud sa presensya sang mga buwaya kon sa diin isa na ang nareport nga gin-atake sang amo nga sapat.
english: Short said more than 1 million people were without electricity during the landfall of the hurricane with two recorded deaths and further panic among residents in the flooded areas due to the presence of crocodiles where one was reported to have been attacked by the animal.

text: Dugang pa niya nga sa subong, nagapanghanda naman ang Mississippi kon sa diin siya nagaistar bangud ginalauman nga sunod nga magalabay ang hurricane sa nasambit nga estado kon sa diin nagpaandam na ang otoridad sa posibilidad sang pagluntad sang flash flood.
english: He added that Mississippi is currently preparing where he lives because the next hurricane is expected to pass through the state where authorities have warned of the possibility of flash floods.

text: Nagpasaka sang disbarment complaint batuk kay former President Rodrigo Duterte sa Korte Suprema (SC)ang mga pamilya sang mga biktima sang extrajudicial killings (EJKs) kag human rights advocates.
english: Families of victims of extrajudicial killings (EJKs) and human rights advocates have filed a disbarment complaint against former President Rodrigo Duterte in the Supreme Court (SC).

text:
Sila ang nagabitbit sang mga plakard nga may laragway ni Duterte nga nagasiling: “Mamamatay tao hindi karapat-dapat na abogado (a killer shouldn’t be a lawyer)” kag “Bastos hindi karapat-dapat na abogado (ang bastos nga tawo indi dapat mangin abogado) .”

Suno kay Atty. Suno kay Vicente Jaime Topacio, isa sa mga tagreklamo, saksi ang tanan upod ang bug-os nga komunidad kon paano si Duterte mag-insulto sa iban, kon paano niya ginpakanubo ang mga kababayin-an, kon paano niya ginkuha ang mga shortcut sa proseso, kon paano niya ginbalewala ang nagakaigo nga proseso, kag kon paano ini nga tawo nagkuha sang mga kabuhi.
english:
They carried placards with Duterte's picture that read: “Mamamata tao hindi karapat-papat na lawyer (a killer shouldn't be a lawyer)” and “Bastos hindi karapat-lopat na lawyer (a rude person should not be a lawyer).”

According to Atty. According to Vicente Jaime Topacio, one of the complainants, everyone along with the entire community is a witness to how Duterte would insult others, how he demeaned women, how he took shortcuts in the process, how he ignored due process, and how this man took lives.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag man ni Topacio nga dapat dal-on sa Korte Suprema ang mga pahayag ni Duterte sa atubang sang House Quad Committee.
english: Besides, Topacio also said that Duterte's statements before the House Quad Committee should be brought to the Supreme Court.

text: Sa isa sa mga hearings sang QuadComm, gin-claim ni Duterte nga “nakapatay” siya sang indi magnubo sa anum ka tawo sa iya pagpungko bilang alkalde sang Davao City.
english: In one of the QuadComm hearings, Duterte claimed that he “killed” at least six people during his tenure as mayor of Davao City.

text: Sang ulihi, ginpahayag ni Duterte nga madamo man siya sang napatay nga tiko nga opisyal sang pulis.
english: Later, Duterte said he also killed many corrupt police officers.

text: Suno kay Topacio, siya sang peace consultants nanday Agaton Topacio kag Eugenia Magpantay nga ginpatay sa panahon ni Duterte administration.
english: According to Topacio, he is one of the peace consultants Agaton Topacio and Eugenia Magpantay who were killed during the Duterte administration.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni anay chief presidential legal counsel Salvador Panelo nga wala sang korte nga naka-convict kay Duterte sa anuman nga krimen nga may kaangtanan sa extrajudicial killings.
english: Former chief presidential legal counsel Salvador Panelo said no court has convicted Duterte of any crime related to extrajudicial killings.

text: Nagapati naman si ACT Teachers Party-list Rep.
english: ACT Teachers Party-list Rep.

text: France Castro nga dapat i-disbar si anay presidente Rodrigo Duterte kasunod sang disbarment complaint sang mga human rights advocates kag pamilya sang mga biktima sang EJK.
english: France Castro that former president Rodrigo Duterte should be disbarred following the disbarment complaint of human rights advocates and families of EJK victims.

text: Patay ang 45 Indian pilgrims matapos masunog ang bus na kanilang sinasakyan habang papalapit sa lungsod ng Medina sa Saudi Arabia.
english: Forty-five Indian pilgrims were killed after a bus they were traveling in caught fire while approaching the city of Medina in Saudi Arabia.

text: Ayon sa ulat, 46 ang kabuuang bilang ng mga sakay ng bus at agad na dinala ang mga nakaligtas sa intensive care unit.
english: According to the report, the total number of passengers on the bus was 46 and the survivors were immediately taken to the intensive care unit.

text: Gayunman, hindi na naisalba ang karamihan sa kanila.
english: However, most of them were not saved.

text: Karamihan sa mga biktima ay mula sa Hyderabad sa Southern Telangana State.
english: Most of the victims are from Hyderabad in Southern Telangana State.

text: Nagmula ang grupo sa Mecca at patungo sana sa Medina nang mangyari ang trahedya.
english: The group left Mecca and was heading to Medina when the tragedy occurred.

text: Ang mga pilgrims ay nasa Saudi Arabia para sa Umrah pilgrimage, isang mas maikling bersyon ng Hajj na ang itinuturing na pinakamalaking Islamic pilgrimage.
english: The pilgrims are in Saudi Arabia for the Umrah pilgrimage, a shorter version of the Hajj that is considered the largest Islamic pilgrimage.

text: Nagpahayag naman ng pakikiramay si Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi sa mga pamilyang naiwan ng mga biktima.
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences to the families of the victims.

text: Patuloy pa rin ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad hinggil sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: May mga “sabaw moments” gid kita nga kun kaisa kaladlawan, pero kun kaisa, budlay gid ya bawion!
english: We have “soup moments” that are sometimes funny, but sometimes, it's hard to take back!

text: Kaangay sining isa ka lalaki sa Michigan, USA nga si Corey Harris.
english: Like this one guy in Michigan, USA named Corey Harris.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, schedule sini sa hearing sa korte apang wala siya pisikal nga nagtambong kundi nag-connect lamang paagi sa Zoom call.
english: Last day, he was scheduled for a hearing in court but he did not physically attend but only connected through a Zoom call.

text: Ang problema ugaling, sang amo nga tion, ang hearing ang naangot sa suspendido nga driver’s license ni Harris, apang timing man nga sang naga-tambong siya via Zoom, nagamaneho siya sang iya salakyan.
english: The problem however, at the time, the hearing was linked to Harris’ suspended driver’s license, but also timing that when he was attending via Zoom, he was driving his car.

text: Gilayon nga nabisto ni Judge Cedric Simpson ang akusado nga yara sa sulod sang iya salakyan kag iya pa ginpamangkot kun naga-drive ini.
english: Judge Cedric Simpson immediately recognized the accused inside his vehicle and asked him if he was driving.

text: Napilitan si Harris nga papunduhon ang iya salakyan kag ginrason sini nga pakadto siya sa iya nga doctor gani nga nagamaneho siya.
english: Harris was forced to stop his car and reasoned that he was going to his doctor so he was driving.

text: Daw indi pa makapati ang judge gani namangkot pa ini sa isa ka partisipante sa hearing kun husto bala ang kaso nga ila ginatutukan nga amo ang parte sa kaso ni Harris nga may suspendido nga lisensya.
english: The judge couldn't believe it and asked a participant in the hearing if the case they were focusing on was right, which was about Harris' case with a suspended license.

text: Nahibaluan nga antes sini, temporaryo nga nahilway si Harris bangud sa piyansa kag naga-apelar pa kuntani ang abogado nga ipaiway pa kuntani sang apat ka semana ang hearing sa iya kaso.
english: Earlier, Harris was temporarily released on bail and the lawyer was appealing to postpone the hearing for another four weeks.

text: Apang bangud nga nabisto siya sang judge nga naga-drive samtang naga-attend sang hearing, ginkanselar ang iya pyansa kag ginsugo ini nga magsungka sa otoridad para ma-detain.
english: However, since the judge recognized him driving while attending the hearing, his bail was canceled and he was ordered to surrender to the authorities for detention.

text: Sang nabatian ni Harris ang desisyon sang judge, napa-“Oh my God” na lang siya sa iya nahimo nga kapalpakan.
english: When Harris heard the judge's decision, he was shocked.

text: Sang ikaw lamharon, nagaka-excite ka man bala magpaligo sa ulan?
english: When you were young, did you get excited about taking a bath in the rain?

text: Nakaeksperyensya ka man bala mag-inom sang tubig nga nagahalin sa langit?
english: Have you ever experienced drinking water from the sky?

text: Santo sa rainwatertanksdirect.com, madamo sang benepisyo nga mahatag sa ikaayong lawas ang pag-inom sang tubig-ulan.
english: According to rainwatertanksdirect.com, there are many health benefits to drinking rainwater.

text: Ini bangud may yara ini sang alkaline pH nga may detoxifying effects nga nagapromote sang healthy digestion.
english: This is because it has an alkaline pH with detoxifying effects that promote healthy digestion.

text: Bangud man sa alkaline pH nga yara sa tubig-ulan, mabuligan sini ang lawas nga makafunction sang normal.
english: Because of the alkaline pH in rainwater, it helps the body to function normally.

text: Ini ang may yara man sang manubo nga mineral content ipaanggid sa public drinking water nga masami may yara sang flouride kag chlorine nga nagaresulta sa gastritis, sakit sang ulo kag pagkaguba sang body organs.
english: It also has a low mineral content compared to public drinking water which often contains flouride and chlorine which results in gastritis, headaches and damage to body organs.

text: Ang pag-inom sang tubig ulan ang makahatag man sang healthy skin kag buhok bangud ang alkaline pH nga content sini ang nagabulig agud mapabilin ang natural nga moisture sang panit kag nagapromote sang healthy hair growth.
english: Drinking rainwater can also provide healthy skin and hair because its alkaline pH content helps to maintain the skin's natural moisture and promotes healthy hair growth.

text: Ang pag-inom sang tubig ulan ang wala lamang nagapa-improve sang ikaayong lawas kundi nagabulig man sa imo sa pagconserve sang enviroment.
english: Drinking rainwater not only improves your health but also helps you conserve the environment.

text: Nagdepensa si Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. defended.

text: nga may bastante nga basehan sa pagdeklarar sang food security emergency sa Pilipinas.
english: with sufficient grounds to declare a food security emergency in the Philippines.

text: Pahayag sini, tuman ka klaro ang data nga ginpresentar sang National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) nga mataas gihapon ang presyo sang bugas bisan pa nga ginpanubuan na sang gobyerno ang taripa sa imported rice.
english: He said the data presented by the National Price Coordinating Council (NPCC) is very clear that the price of rice is still high even though the government has reduced the tariff on imported rice.

text: “The data was very clear when we presented it to the NPCC.
english: “The data was very clear when we presented it to the NPCC.

text: We have solid data that show that it is really justified,” pahayag ni Tiu Laurel sa press briefing sa Malacañang.
english: We have solid data that shows that it is really justified,” Tiu Laurel said in a press briefing in Malacañang.

text: Dugang sini, ginahulat na lang sini ang council nga pormal nga makapasa sang rekomendasyon sa Department of Agriculture (DA) para sa deklarasyon sang emergency.
english: He added that he is waiting for the council to formally submit a recommendation to the Department of Agriculture (DA) for the declaration of emergency.

text: Kun mabaton na niya ini, magapangayo si Tiu Laurel sang komento halin kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: Once he receives it, Tiu Laurel will seek comment from President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: “End of January siguro (declaration).
english: “End of January probably (declaration).

text: Ang target namin i-offer (NFA stocks) sa LGUs and other government agencies in February,” pahayag sini sa separado nga interview matapos ginkumpirma nga “approved in principle” na ang resolution sang council.
english: Our target is to offer (NFA stocks) to LGUs and other government agencies in February,” he said in a separate interview after confirming that the council resolution was “approved in principle”.

text: Sa idalom sang bag-o lang napirmahan nga Republic Act 12078 ukon ang Agricultural Tariffication Act, kun may rekomendasyon na ang NPCC, may gahum na ang DA nga magdeklarar sang amo nga emerhensya.
english: Under the recently signed Republic Act 12078 or the Agricultural Tariffication Act, once the NPCC has a recommendation, the DA has the power to declare such an emergency.

text: Ini ang ginalantaw nga sabat kun kulang ang suplay ukon may ‘extraordinary increase’ ukon indi kinaandan nga pagsaka sa presyo sang bugas.
english: This is expected to be the response to a shortage of supply or an extraordinary increase in the price of rice.

text: Kun madeklarar na ang food security emergency, pahanugutan na ang National Food Authority (NFA) nga ma-release ang rice buffer stocks sa market kag buslan ini sang locally produced palay.
english: Once the food security emergency is declared, the National Food Authority (NFA) will be allowed to release rice buffer stocks in the market and replace them with locally produced rice.

text: Nagpasalig ang Association of Iloilo Provincial Government Employees nga ila tinguhaan subong nga 2025 nga mapataasan pa ang incentives nga mabaton sang mga empleyado.
english: The Association of Iloilo Provincial Government Employees has assured that they will try to increase the incentives received by employees in 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Airis Penetrante, Presidente sang nasambit nga asosasyon, iya ginpahayag nga nakit-an man niya kun ano ang ikasarang sang mga empleyado sang provincial government sang 2024 gani nagakadapat lang nga sa 2025 madugangan man ang ila benepisyo nga mabaton.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Airis Penetrante, President of the association, said she has seen the ability of provincial government employees in 2024 so it is appropriate that in 2025 their benefits will be increased.

text: Ginakalipay gid sang natungdan nga antes ang pagsulod sang 2025, nahatag na ang tanan nga insentibo sang mga empleyado — regular man, contractual, job order ukon contract of service workers.
english: He is pleased that before the entry of 2025, all incentives of employees — whether regular, contractual, job order or contract of service workers — have been given.

text: Matandaan man nga ginsiling ni Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: It can also be recalled that Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga luyag sini nga magpartisipar ang tanan nga opisina sa mga pasidungog kag nagasalig mismo si Penetrante nga sa 2025 makuha sang mga opisina ang mga dapat dag-on sa bulig sang mga empleyado.
english: that he wants all offices to participate in the awards and Penetrante himself hopes that by 2025 the offices will get the winners with the help of employees.

text: Dugang pa niya, nagapati sila sa asosasyon sang liderato ni Gov Defensor nga nakahibalo magtatap kag magbalikid sa ila nga mga empleyado.
english: He added that they believe in the association of Gov Defensor's leadership that knows how to take care of their employees.

text: Nagtukod sang pila ka emergency outdoor tents ang duha ka mayor nga ospital sa Sydney, Australia.
english: Two major hospitals in Sydney, Australia, have set up several emergency outdoor tents.

text: Ini matapos naglumapaw sa 1,000 ang new cases sang COVID-19 sa nasambit nga pungsod — pinakataas nga numero nga narekord sa sulod sang isa lang ka-adlaw humalin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya.
english: This comes after the new cases of COVID-19 in the country exceeded 1,000 — the highest number recorded in just one day since the beginning of the pandemic.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede direkta sa Sydney, Australia, narekord ang 1,029 new locally acquired cases sa New South Wales (NSW) state, sang Huwebes, Agusto 26.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Denmark Suede directly in Sydney, Australia, 1,029 new locally acquired cases were recorded in New South Wales (NSW) state, on Thursday, August 26.

text: Ginalantaw nga ang manubo nga vaccination rate ang rason sang pagsaka sang kaso sang virus.
english: The low vaccination rate is believed to be the reason for the increase in cases of the virus.

text: Pahayag niya, sa 116 ka frontliners nga assigned sa intensive care sa New South Wales , 102 pa diri indi vaccinated.
english: He said of the 116 frontliners assigned to intensive care in New South Wales, 102 are still unvaccinated.

text: Bangud sini, ginatinguhaan subong sang federal government ang mas masangkad nga COVID-19 vaccination kag contact tracing agud matapna ang madasig nga paglapta sang COVID-19.
english: As a result, the federal government is now pursuing more extensive COVID-19 vaccination and contact tracing to prevent the rapid spread of COVID-19.

text: Nakarecord ang Iloilo City sang pinakauna nga stray bullet incident subong nga 2025.
english: Iloilo City recorded its first stray bullet incident in 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Isaac Nerios, imbestigador sang Iloilo City Police Station 8, iya ginpahayag nga nakit-an ang stray bullet sa katre sa sulod sang kuwarto sang balay sang pamilya Senina sa Villa San Lorenzo sa Loboc, Lapuz.
english: Police Staff Sergeant Isaac Nerios, investigator of Iloilo City Police Station 8, said the stray bullet was found on the bed inside the room of the Senina family's house in Villa San Lorenzo in Loboc, Lapuz.

text: Suno kay Nerios, nadiskubre na lang sang bata nga babaye sang amo nga pamilya nga may buho sa ila kisame.
english: According to Nerios, the daughter of the family discovered that there was a hole in their ceiling.

text: Bangud nga nagdumdom sila nga possible agi ini sang bala, ila ini ginpangita kag nakit-an ini sa ila hiligdaan.
english: Because they thought it was a possible bullet, they looked for it and found it in their bed.

text: Ang slug ang posible nga iya sang 45 caliber pistol.
english: The slug probably belonged to a 45 caliber pistol.

text: Pahayag ni Nerios, maswerte nga wala sang tawo sa amo nga balay bangud nga sa hotel nagselebrar sang new year ang amo nga pamilya.
english: Nerios said he was lucky that there was no one in the house because the family celebrated the new year at the hotel.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan sa amo nga stray bullet incident.
english: Police are still investigating the stray bullet incident.

text: Ginkakas na sa trabaho ang security guard nga nagkompronta kag nagsipa sa isa ka bata nga nagabaligya sang sampaguita sa atubang sang isa ka mall sa Mandaluyong City.
english: A security guard who confronted and kicked a child selling sampaguita in front of a mall in Mandaluyong City has been fired.

text: Sa video makit-an nga ginkuha kag ginwas-ag sang guard ang mga garland sang bata.
english: The video shows the guard taking and throwing away the child's garlands.

text: Gilayon nga nagpagwa sang pahayag ang nasambit nag mall matapos naglapta ang video.
english: The mall owner immediately issued a statement after the video went viral.

text: “We regret and sympathize with the young girl who experienced an unfortunate incident outside our mall.
english: “We regret and sympathize with the young girl who experienced an unfortunate incident outside our mall.

text: We have called the attention of the security agency to conduct an immediate and thorough investigation.
english: We have called the attention of the security agency to conduct an immediate and thorough investigation.

text: The Security Guard has been dismissed and will no longer be allowed to service any of our malls.”
english: The Security Guard has been dismissed and will no longer be allowed to service any of our malls.”

text: Naghatag si Pope Francis sang iya personal nga pondo nga nagdangat sa 350,000 euro ukon masobra 20.5 million pesos para sa emergency relief sa Haiti, Bangladesh kag Vietnam.
english: Pope Francis has donated 350,000 euros or more than 20.5 million pesos for emergency relief in Haiti, Bangladesh and Vietnam.

text: Suno sa Vatican, 200,000 euros ukon 11.7 million pesos ang nagkadto sa Haiti agud buligan ang mga apektado ang August 14 nga 7.2 magnitude nga linog nga nagbilin sang masobra 2,000 ka mga patay.
english: According to the Vatican, 200,000 euros or 11.7 million pesos went to Haiti to help those affected by the August 14 7.2 magnitude earthquake that left more than 2,000 dead.

text: 70,000 euros ukon 3.4 million pesos ang nagkadto sa Bangladesh para sa recovery assistance sa mga biktima sang Bagyo Yaas nga naglaslas sang Mayo kag nagwasak sang linibo ka mga balay.
english: 70,000 euros or 3.4 million pesos went to Bangladesh for recovery assistance to victims of Typhoon Yaas that struck in May and destroyed thousands of homes.

text: 100,000 euros ukon 5.8 million pesos ang ginpain naman sa Vietnam bangud kulang ang food supplies sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: 100,000 euros or 5.8 million pesos was allocated to Vietnam due to the shortage of food supplies in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ini nga pondo ang inisyal pa lang suno sa Vatican kag ipanagtag paagi sa embahada sang amo nga mga pungsod.
english: The funds are initial, according to the Vatican, and will be distributed through the embassies of those countries.

text: Indi matago ang yuhom sang isa ka firecracker vendor matapos nga nakaginansya sang kapin P20,000 subong nga tuig sa pagbaligya sang palupok.
english: A firecracker vendor could not hide his smile after making a profit of more than P20,000 this year from selling fireworks.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dave Balmatero, manugbaligya sang palupok, iya ginpahayag nga sang nagligad nga tuig, naubos man ang ila baligya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dave Balmatero, a fireworks vendor, said that last year, they also ran out of goods.

text: Suno kay Balmatero, ang mabakal sa ila subong nga tuig amo ang fireworks nga nauna gid ubos.
english: According to Balmatero, the fireworks that will be purchased from them this year will be the first to be sold.

text: Dako naman ang pasalamat sini bangud sa wala nagbubo ang matodo nga ulan nga ginakabig man sini nga rason kon ngaa madamo ang nagbakal sa iya.
english: He is very grateful that the heavy rain did not fall which he also considers the reason why many people bought from him.

text: Gilayon naman nga naghimos pauli si Balmatero nga may yuhom sa nawong matapos nga ‘na-sold out’ ang iya mga palupok.
english: Balmatero immediately got ready to go home with a smile on his face after his fireworks were sold out.

text: Nagtanyag na sang bulig bisan ang pinaka-notorious nga gangsters sa Haiti kasunod sang tuman ka daku nga halit tuga sang 7.2 magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa amo nga pungsod sang nagligad nga semana.
english: Even Haiti's most notorious gangsters have offered to help following the devastating 7.2 magnitude earthquake that rocked the country last week.

text: Suno kay Jimmy Cherizier alias ‘Barbecue’, lider sang gang nga G9 Revolutionary Forces, magabulig ang iya nga grupo kag ang ila kaalyado nga mga gangs para sa pagpadasig sang relief efforts.
english: According to Jimmy Cherizier alias 'Barbecue', leader of the G9 Revolutionary Forces gang, his group and their allied gangs will help to accelerate the relief efforts.

text: Sandig sa data sang civil defence agency sang Haiti, nagsaka na subong sa 2,207 ang numero sang patay samtang 344 naman ang nagapabilin nga missing.
english: According to data from Haiti's civil defense agency, the death toll has now risen to 2,207 while 344 remain missing.

text: Nagsaka pa ang numero sang patay samtang ginapatigayon ang relief operations kag nabudlayan man ang otoridad sa security sa mga distribution points.
english: The death toll rose as relief operations were conducted and authorities also faced difficulties in security at distribution points.

text: Ini bangud may mga gangs man nga nag-hijack sa aid trucks kag sa mga ambulansya rason nga helicopter na lang ang gingamit sa pag-transport sang bulig.
english: This is because there are gangs that hijacked aid trucks and ambulances so that helicopters were used to transport aid.

text: Nangin mahina ang baklanay sang palupok para sa pila ka mga manogbaligya subong nga tuig kon ikumpara sa nagligad nga 2023.
english: Fireworks sales have been sluggish for some retailers this year compared to last 2023.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fernando Sugarno, manugbaligya sang palupok, iya ginpahayag nga madugay nga naubos ang iya mga baligya kag nalab-otan pa sang Enero 1 kag natigayon nga maubos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fernando Sugarno, a fireworks vendor, said he ran out of goods for a long time and reached them on January 1 and managed to run out.

text: Suno kay Sugarno, apisar sang mahina nga baligyaanay, mabakal naman ang mga pasirit kag higad nga palupok.
english: According to Sugarno, despite the weak sales, firecrackers and firecrackers can be bought.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga mas matalunsay ang baklanay sang palupok sang nagligad nga tuig kon sa diin, wala pa bag-ong tuig, ubos na ang iya baligya.
english: He also said that the sale of fireworks was smoother last year where, before the new year, he ran out of sales.

text: Plano man sang natungdan nga ibalik na lang sa bodega ang mga wala mabakal nga firecrackers.
english: He also plans to return the unpurchased firecrackers to the warehouse.

text: Gina-finalize na sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ang probe report kaangot sa death threats nga ginhimo ni Vice President Sara Duterte batok kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is finalizing the probe report on the death threats made by Vice President Sara Duterte against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Suno kay NBI Director Jaime Santiago, ginmanduan na sini ang iya team nga maid-id nga i-evaluate ang ebidensiya kag testimoniya nga ila natipon.
english: NBI Director Jaime Santiago said he has already ordered his team to thoroughly evaluate the evidence and testimony they have gathered.

text: Ginpahayag ni Santiago nga ila gid ginhatagan igtalupangod ang bag-o nga layi sang Department of Justice nahanungod sa preliminary investigations kag inquest proceedings.
english: Santiago said they have paid close attention to the new law of the Department of Justice regarding preliminary investigations and inquest proceedings.

text: Gintumod man sini nga kinahanglan nga may yara sang “reasonable certainty of conviction” (baliskad sa traditional “probable cause” standard).
english: It also specified that there needs to be “reasonable certainty of conviction” (as opposed to the traditional “probable cause” standard).

text: Ipasa sang NBI ang tanan nga natipon nga ebidensiya, testimonies, kag findings sa Department of Justice, kun sa diin itugyan ang desisyon sa prosecutors nga mag-file sang charges.
english: The NBI will forward all gathered evidence, testimonies, and findings to the Department of Justice, which will leave the decision to prosecutors to file charges.

text: Patay ang yara sa 45 ka mga Indian pilgrims matapos nga masunog ang ginasakyan nila nga bus.
english: At least 45 Indian pilgrims were killed after their bus caught fire.

text: Natabo ang insidente samtang malapit na sila sa Medina sa Saudi Arabia.
english: The incident occurred as they approached Medina in Saudi Arabia.

text: May yara sang kabug-usan nga 46 ka mga pasahero ang sakay sang bus kun sa diin gilayon gindala ang mga ini sa intensive care unit, apang ang iban ang wala masalbar.
english: There were a total of 46 passengers on board the bus who were immediately taken to the intensive care unit, but others were not saved.

text: Kadam-an sa mga biktima ang naga-estar sa Hyderabad sa Southern Telangana State.
english: Most of the victims live in Hyderabad in Southern Telangana State.

text: Ang mga pilgrims ang naghalin sa Mecca kag padulong sa Medina sang matabo ang insidente.
english: The pilgrims were on their way from Mecca to Medina when the incident occurred.

text: Naghalin sila sa Saudi Arabia para sa Umrah pilgrimage nga mas manubo nga bersyon sang Hajj ang pinakadako nga Islamic pilgrimage.
english: They came from Saudi Arabia for Umrah pilgrimage which is a lesser version of Hajj the biggest Islamic pilgrimage.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang simpatiya si Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi sa mga napatay nga biktima.
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences to the victims.

text: Padayon naman nga gina-imbistigaran sang mga otoridad ang amo nga insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: ILOILO – Isa ka anay Ilonggo seaman ang nangin madinalag-on nga nagbaliskad sang iya banas agud sundan ang iya handom sa musika kag pelikula.
english: ILOILO – A former Ilonggo seaman has successfully reversed his path to pursue his dream of music and film.

text: Ini amo si Aleck Calata, sang Población Ilawod, Passi City.
english: This is Aleck Calata, of Población Ilawod, Passi City.

text: Si Calata ang nagtapos bilang bilang honor student sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Marine Transportation sa John B. Lacson Foundation Maritime University – Arevalo.
english: Calata graduated as an honor student in the Bachelor of Science in Marine Transportation course at the John B. Lacson Foundation Maritime University – Arevalo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Calata, iya ginpahayag nga antes nagsulod sa musika, nangin marino anay ini sa diin nakalayag na ini sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Calata said that before entering music, he became a sailor where he sailed to different parts of the world.

text: Apang sa pihak sang madinalag-on nga karera sa industriya sang maritime, wala niya ginbayaan ang hilig sa sining kag musika.
english: But despite a successful career in the maritime industry, he did not abandon a passion for art and music.

text: Si Calata ang isa na subong ka recording artist nga may duha ka mga kanta nga Ganito Ba Dapat?
english: Calata is now a recording artist with two songs Ganito Ba Dapat?

text: kag Right Love.
english: and Right Love.

text: Magluwas diri, aktibo man siya sa paghimo sang musika para sa pelikula bilang music supervisor sa grupo nga Cineastas A Vela, isa ka filmmaking team nga kinikilala indi lang sa Pilipinas kundi mangin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: In addition, he is also active in making music for films as a music supervisor in the group Cineastas A Vela, a filmmaking team that is recognized not only in the Philippines but also in other countries.

text: Ang mga komposisyon naman sini nga Dalagan kag Singkal ang ginkilala man bilang Best Music kag Best Original Score sa Cinekasimanwa 6 kag 7.
english: His compositions Dalagan and Singkal were also recognized as Best Music and Best Original Score in Cinekasimanwa 6 and 7 respectively.

text: Sa patag naman sang acting, gindala sini ang papel ni Humadapnon sa pelikula nga Sa Paglupad Ka Banog, nga nagdaog sang Golden Kinabalu Award for Best Indigenous Language Film sa 13th Kota Kinabalu International Film Festival 2022 sa Malaysia kag Best Short Film sa Gawad Urian 2023.
english: On the acting front, he played the role of Humadapnon in the film Sa Paglupad Ka Banog, which won the Golden Kinabalu Award for Best Indigenous Language Film at the 13th Kota Kinabalu International Film Festival 2022 in Malaysia and Best Short Film at Gawad Urian 2023.

text: Bangud sa iya talento, ginkilala man siya bilang Philippine Young Achievers Awardee para sa 2024 kag 2025.
english: For her talent, she was also recognized as the Philippine Young Achievers Awardee for 2024 and 2025.

text: Ang graduation amo ang isa sa pinakamalipayon nga adlaw sa kabuhi sang estudyante.
english: Graduation is one of the happiest days in a student’s life.

text: Apang tuhay nga adlaw ini para sa isa ka high school valedictorian sa Farmers Branch, Texas bangud sa amo man nga petsa, ginlubong ang iya amay.
english: But it was a different day for a high school valedictorian in Farmers Branch, Texas because on the same date, his father was laid to rest.

text: Apisar mahangpan man kuntani sang tanan kun indi na siya magtambong sa seremonya kag indi na maghatag sang speech, ginpadayon sini ang pag-deliver sang iya nga address nga amo ang rason kun ngaa emosyonal ang halos tanan.
english: Although everyone would have understood if he did not attend the ceremony and did not give a speech, he continued to deliver his address which is the reason why almost everyone was emotional.

text: Ini amo ang 18-anyos nga si Alem Hadzic naga-eskwela sa Dallas College Brookhaven Campus sa Texas.
english: This is 18-year-old Alem Hadzic attending Dallas College Brookhaven Campus in Texas.

text: Sang Mayo 15, napatay ang iya amay nga si Miralem bangud sa binulan nga pagpakigbato sa balatian nga pancreatic cancer.
english: On May 15, his father, Miralem, died after a months-long battle with pancreatic cancer.

text: Sang aga, nagbulig pa ini sa paghakwat sa lungon sang iya amay, ginlubong ini sa iya katapusan nga palahuwayan, kag sunod siya nga nagsuksok sang toga kag nagkadto sa iya graduation.
english: In the morning, he helped carry his father's coffin, buried it in his final resting place, and then he put on a toga and went to his graduation.

text: “My father died yesterday, May 15, 2024, and I attended his funeral today, right before graduation,” kabahin sang emosyonal nga speech.
english: “My father died yesterday, May 15, 2024, and I attended his funeral today, right before graduation,” was part of the emotional speech.

text: “That’s why my shoes are muddy and my arms are shaking.
english: “That’s why my shoes are muddy and my arms are shaking.

text:
I had to carry him to his grave and bury him.”

Gin-ako sini nga nagablangko na ang iya pinsar kag nagakurog ang tiil samtang naga-speech apang ginpadayon niya ang iya inughambal sang nakit-an sini nga nagahibi man ang audience.
english:
I had to carry him to his grave and bury him.”

He admitted that his mind was blank and his legs were shaking while speaking but he continued his speech when he saw that the audience was also crying.

text: Ginsugid sini sa iya speech nga Enero pa sang na-diagnose nga may cancer ang iya amay kag wala sila sang may ginsugidan.
english: She told in her speech that her father was diagnosed with cancer in January and they did not tell anyone.

text: Apisar nabudlayan siya mag-selebrar, ginpili sini nga magbalik sa eskwelahan bangud nakahibalo siya nga ginpangabudlayan ini sang iya amay.
english: Although it was difficult for him to celebrate, he chose to go back to school because he knew that his father worked hard for him.

text: Ini man ang rason suno sa iya nga magapadayon siya sa kolehiyo, manikasog, kag padayunon ang handom sang iya amay para sa iya.
english: This is also why he said he will continue in college, work hard, and continue his father's dream for him.

text: “I can’t stand up here and pretend I want to be doing this speech right now,” pagpadayon pa sini.
english: “I can’t stand up here and pretend I want to be doing this speech right now,” he continued.

text: “But I can’t throw something away that he worked so hard for me to achieve.
english: “But I can’t throw something away that he worked so hard for me to achieve.

text: I am going to spend every hour of every day working as hard as I can to achieve all my goals because that’s what he wanted and I’m going to do it for him,” dugang pa niya.
english: I am going to spend every hour of every day working as hard as I can to achieve all my goals because that’s what he wanted and I’m going to do it for him,” she added.

text: Pagkatapos sang speech, ginhatagan siya sang standing ovation sang mga estudyante, ila pamilya, mga manunudlo kag administrators.
english: After the speech, he was given a standing ovation by students, their families, teachers and administrators.

text: Matapos nakuha ang iya high school diploma kag ang associate of science degree halin sa Early College High School, plano sang valedictorian nga magsulod sa University of Texas sa Austin kag magsulod sa program nga chemical engineering.
english: After earning her high school diploma and an associate of science degree from Early College High School, the valedictorian plans to attend the University of Texas at Austin and enter the chemical engineering program.

text: Magadeploy sang masobra 1,900 ka mga police personnel ang Iloilo City Police Office para sa paalabuton nga 49th High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration sa Pebrero 25 tubtob Pebrero 27,2026.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office will deploy more than 1,900 police personnel for the upcoming 49th High-Level Task Force on ASEAN Economic Integration from February 25 to February 27, 2026.

text: Ini agud nga mahatag ang nagakaigo nga seguridad sang tanan nga mga delegado.
english: This is to ensure proper security for all delegates.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCOL.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCOL.

text: Wilbert Parilla, Officer-in-Charge sang ICPO, iya ginpahayag nga subong nga adlaw, may ara sang pagahiwaton nga send-off ceremony kun sa diin magaumpisa diri ang pagdeploy sang mga kapulisan sa nagkalain-lain nga area sa siudad.
english: Wilbert Parilla, Officer-in-Charge of the ICPO, said that today, there will be a send-off ceremony where the deployment of policemen in various areas of the city will begin.

text: Pahayag man niya nga magabukas man subong ang Multi-agency coordinating center bangud nga ginalauman nga amat-amat na nga magaabot ang mga participants sa sabado kag dominggo.
english: He also said that the Multi-agency coordinating center will also open now as it is expected that the participants will gradually arrive on Saturday and Sunday.

text: Agud man nga masiguro ang kalinungan sa siudad, naghatag man sang suhestyon si Parilla sa Regional Civil Security Unit para patigayunon ang gun ban sa siudad sang Iloilo.
english: In order to ensure peace in the city, Parilla also suggested to the Regional Civil Security Unit to implement a gun ban in Iloilo City.

text: Nahibaluan nga suspendido naman ang face-to-face classes sa Pebrero 25 tubtob Pebrero 27 matapos nga gin-aprubahan ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang rekomendasyon sang Iloilo City Police Office nga kanselahon ang klase para sa paalabuton nga aktibidad sa siudad
english: Face-to-face classes will be suspended from February 25 to February 27 after Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas approved the recommendation of the Iloilo City Police Office to cancel classes for upcoming activities in the city.

text: UNA sa tanan, luyag ta tamyawon ang aton Manunubos nga si Hesukristo sing “Happy Birthday!” sa adlaw nga Disyembre 25.
english: FIRST of all, we want to wish our Redeemer Jesus Christ a “Happy Birthday!” on December 25th.

text: Tungod wala ini mamitlang sa Bibliya, may nagakalain-lain nga pagpati kon san-o gid natawo si Kristo.
english: Since it is not mentioned in the Bible, there are different beliefs about the exact date of Christ's birth.

text: May gapati nga dapat sa Setyembre 11.
english: Some believe it should be on September 11th.

text: Luyag man sang iban hiwaton ini sa Enero 6.
english: Others also want to hold it on January 6th.

text:
May gapati man nga sa Disyembre 25 gid, nga ginasunod sa karon sang Simbahan Catolica sumugod pa sadtong tuig 336 A.D.

Well, katoliko ang amon pamilya gani gina-selebar namon ang pagkatawo ni Kristo sa Disyembre 25, nga Christmas Day kon tawgon naton sa karon.
english:
Some believe that on December 25, which the Catholic Church has been following since 336 A.D.

Well, our family is catholic so we celebrate the birth of Christ on December 25, which is Christmas Day if we call it today.

text: Ang Christmas season gasugod gani sa Oktubre diri sa Filipinas.
english: The Christmas season starts in October here in the Philippines.

text: Sa wala gapati sini, masiling lang naton nga indi man kinahanglan mag-selebrar sang birthday sa petsa gid sang pagkatawo.
english: For those who do not believe this, we can simply say that it is not necessary to celebrate a birthday on the date of birth.

text: Sa masami, luyag ta ibutang ini sa adlaw kon diin madamo sang aton mga himata kag mga abyan nga makatambong, katulad sang Sabado ukon Domingo nga wala sing ubra ang kalabanan.
english: Usually, we want to put it on a day when many of our relatives and friends can attend, such as a Saturday or Sunday when most people have no work.

text: Kon kis-a, luyag ta pa gani idungan ini sa iban nga importante nga kahiwatan.
english: Sometimes, we even want to coincide with another important event.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

Masakit nga “pamaskwa” ang naangkon sang mag-iloy sa kamot sang wala konsyensya nga pulis, si Staff Sergeant Jonel Nuezca, sadtong balaan pa nga adlaw sang Domingo, Disyembre 20, sa Paniqui, Tarlac.
english:
***

A mother and daughter suffered a painful “Christmas” at the hands of an unconscious policeman, Staff Sergeant Jonel Nuezca, on Sunday, December 20, in Paniqui, Tarlac.

text: Diyablo seguro ang nagahari sa iya sadto kay bisan sa adlaw sang Diyos amo pa sina kalain ang iya ginhimo.
english: The devil must have been ruling him because even on God's day he did that bad thing.

text: Tiniro patay sining sungayan nga pulis ang mag-iloy pagkatapos nga nagpuis sila sang sitahon sang pulis ang anak sini tungod sa pagpalupok sang kawayan nga kanyon sa atubangan sang balay sang mag-iloy.
english: The mother and daughter were shot dead by this horned policeman after they argued when the policeman fined his son for firing a bamboo cannon in front of the mother's house.

text: Ginkilala ang mag-iloy nga sanday Sonya Gregorio kag ang anak sini nga si Frank Anthony Gregorio.
english: The mother was identified as Sonya Gregorio and her son Frank Anthony Gregorio.

text: Una gintiro ang iloy sing duha ka beses sa likud sang ulo.
english: First the mother was shot twice in the back of the head.

text: Gindason si Anthony  sa ulo man samtang ginakup-an sang iloy.
english: Anthony was also stabbed in the head while his mother hugged him.

text: Indi man masiling nga nag-depensa lang sang iya kaugalingon ang pulis kay wala ang mag-iloy bisan lipak nga dala agud bisan hampakon lang siya.
english: It cannot be said that the policeman defended himself because the mother and daughter did not even have a stick with them to even beat him.

text: Ibutang ta pa nga nainsultuhan ang pulis sang mag-iloy sa ila pagpuis, rason bala ina agud tiruhon patay gid ang mag-iloy?
english: Suppose the policeman was insulted by the mother and daughter in their arrest, is that a reason to shoot the mother and daughter dead?

text: Pulis siya nga ang obligasyon amo ang mag-protejer sa mga pumuluyo.
english: He is a policeman whose obligation is to protect the people.

text: Kag kon makapatay gid man ang pulis, ina kon sa akto lang nga self-defense.
english: And if a policeman does kill, it's only in the act of self-defense.

text: Gali berdugo siya sang mga pumuluyo!
english: He is the executioner of the people!

text: Pero, ngaa ayhan nabuhat niya ato?
english: But, why might he have done that?

text: Nakatugda ang iban nga daw gapakita ining pulis sang culture of impunity, ukon untouchable siya nga indi makapanabat sa iya kasaypanan.
english: Some have suggested that this policeman seems to be showing a culture of impunity, or that he is untouchable and cannot be held accountable for his mistakes.

text: Tungod ayhan ini kay ginpasalig ni Presidente Duterte ang mga pulis nga kon makasala, bisan pa kon makapatay sila sa gyera kontra droga kag mga kriminal, nga yara siya nga magadepensa sa ila?
english: Is this because President Duterte assured the police that if they make mistakes, even if they kill in the war against drugs and criminals, that he will be there to defend them?

text:
Siling sadto ni Presidente Duterte: “I told you do not destroy my country because I will kill you!” Sa aton pa, “Indi ninyo paghalitan ang mga pumuluyo kay pamatyon ko kamo!”

Ginsiling man niya sa mga pulis: “Kon maghana sa pag-gabot sing armas tiruhon nyo dayon.
english:
President Duterte said: “I told you do not destroy my country because I will kill you!” In other words, “Don't harm the people or I will kill you!”

He also told the police: “If he tries to pull out a weapon, shoot him immediately.

text:
In fact, kon delikado ini sila nga personalidad tiruhon dayon bisan wala pa gahana sa pag-gabot sang ila armas!”

Tungod sining pinangbungat ni Presidente, sunu sa mga human rights advocates, ini ang rason nga madamo nga drug suspects ang nagkalamatay nga wala na nakalab-ut sa husgado.
english:
In fact, if they are dangerous personalities, shoot them immediately even before they draw their weapons!”

Because of the President's statement, according to human rights advocates, this is the reason why many drug suspects have died without reaching the court.

text: Gintawag nila ining pinatyanay nga extra-judicial killing, ukon pagpamatay nga wala sing due process nga ginapatuman sang kasuguan sa tanan, kriminal ka man ukon indi.
english: They called this killing extra-judicial killing, or killing without due process that the law requires of everyone, whether you are a criminal or not.

text:
***

Gaatubang karon si Nuezca sang duha ka counts of murder sa pagpatay sa mag-iloy.
english:
***

Nuezca is now facing two counts of murder in the killing of the mother and daughter.

text: Nangayo sing pasaylo si Nuezca, pero ginbalewala ini sang pamilya.
english: Nuezca apologized, but the family ignored it.

text: Hustisya ang ila ginapangayo kag mapatawad lang nila siya kon makapanabat na sang iya kasal-anan sa bagay nga silot.
english: They are asking for justice and they can only forgive him if he is held accountable for his crime.

text: Ang pagpangayo sing kapatawaran nagakinahanglan sang sinseridad.
english: Asking for forgiveness requires sincerity.

text: Kon wala sini, bisan ang Diyos indi makapatawad sa imo.
english: Without it, even God cannot forgive you.

text: Kag kon napatawad ka na gid man, kinahanglan man ang kabayaran pa sa kasal-anan  bag-o lubos ka batunon sa Langit.
english: And if you are truly forgiven, there must be a payment for sin before you can be fully accepted into Heaven.

text: Isa ini ka importante nga rason kon ngaa may Purgatoryo sa pagtuo sang mga katoliko.
english: This is an important reason why there is Purgatory in the catholic faith.

text: Maayo na lang seguro sa kay Nuezca nga direkta lang magpangayo sing kapatawaran sa Diyos, magbaton sang bagay nga silot, kag kon kulang pa nga mabayaran ini sa mga maayo nga buhat kag dapat sabton pa sa Purgatoryo sa pihak nga kinabuhi./PN
english: It would be better for Nuezca to ask God for forgiveness directly, accept the punishment he deserves, and if it is not enough, he will be paid for his good deeds and will be held accountable in Purgatory in the afterlife./PN

text: Wala sang dapat kabalak-an ang mga tawo nga may balatian sa tagipusuon nga luyag magpabakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: People with heart disease who want to get vaccinated against COVID-19 have nothing to worry about.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. James Catoto, Specialist in Internal Medicine – Cardiology sa West Visayas State University Medical Center, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga tawo nga may nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian sa tagipusuon ang may dako nga risgo nga maka-angkon sang COVID-19.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. James Catoto, Specialist in Internal Medicine – Cardiology at the West Visayas State University Medical Center, said that people with various heart diseases are at high risk of contracting COVID-19.

text: Ang COVID-19 ang may nagkalain-lain nga epekto sa lawas sang tawo sa diin ang iban nga pasyente ang maka-angkon sang asymptomatic condition ukon wala sa sintomas sa virus, mildy symptomatic ukon may yara sang indi malala nga sintomas kag severe COVID-19 sa diin ini ang pinakakritikal kag delikado.
english: COVID-19 has different effects on the human body where some patients can have an asymptomatic condition or no symptoms of the virus, mildy symptomatic or have mild symptoms and severe COVID-19 where it is the most critical and dangerous.

text: Suno kay Catoto, ang mga tawo nga may commorbidities kaangay sang nagkalain-lain nga balatian sa tagipusuon, ang may dako nga posibilidad nga maka-angkon sang severe COVID-19.
english: According to Catoto, people with comorbidities such as various heart diseases, are more likely to develop severe COVID-19.

text: Bangud sini, mas maayo nga dulaon sang mga tawo nga may immunodeficiency ukon may yara na sang balatian, ang kahangawa kag magdesisyon sa pagpabakuna batok sa nasambit nga virus.
english: Because of this, it is better for people who have immunodeficiency or already have the disease, to eliminate the anxiety and decide to get vaccinated against the said virus.

text: Importante suno kay Catoto nga magpangayo sang clearance sa iya doktor antes magpabakuna ang isa ka tawo nga may balatian sa tagipusuon.
english: Catoto said it is important to seek clearance from his doctor before a person with heart disease gets vaccinated.

text: Para naman sa mga tawo nga may maintenance ukon may gina-inom nga bulong, nagakadapat man nga magpangayo sang abiso sa doktor agud mahibaluan kun mahimo ini makapabakuna batok sa COVID-19 ukon indi.
english: For people who have maintenance or are taking medication, it is also advisable to seek medical advice to see if they can be vaccinated against COVID-19 or not.

text: Gin-athag man sang doktor nga ang isa ka tawo nga may balatian sa tagipusuon nga kompleto sa check-up sa doktor, wala sang hapo kag kontrolado ang sugar level sang lawas ang mahimo gid nga makapabakuna agud maproteksyunan ang kaugalingon sa makamamatay nga COVID-19.
english: The doctor also explained that a person with heart disease who has a complete check-up with the doctor, is not tired and has controlled sugar levels can be vaccinated to protect themselves from the deadly COVID-19.

text: Nanguna si Derrick White nga may 34 points lakip ang pito ka tres agud nga mapadaog ang Boston Celtics batok sa New York Knicks sa Game 5 sang NBA Eastern Conference semifinals, 127-102.
english: Derrick White led the way with 34 points including seven threes to lead the Boston Celtics over the New York Knicks in Game 5 of the NBA Eastern Conference semifinals, 127-102.

text: Nagsunod si Jaylen Brown nga may 26 points kag 12 assists, samtang nagdugang naman si Luke Kornet sang 10 points, nine rebounds kag seven blocks.
english: Jaylen Brown followed with 26 points and 12 assists, while Luke Kornet added 10 points, nine rebounds and seven blocks.

text: Nahimo ini sang team apisar wala si Jayson Tatum nga nagpaidalom sa surgery bangud sa ruptured right Achilles tendon nga naangkon sini sa Game 4.
english: The team did this despite the absence of Jayson Tatum, who underwent surgery on a ruptured right Achilles tendon he suffered in Game 4.

text: Tinguhaan sang Boston nga mangin ika-14 sa team sa NBA history nga makabangon halin sa 3-1 deficit.
english: Boston will try to become the 14th team in NBA history to rally from a 3-1 deficit.

text: Sa Sabado, 8:00 sa aga oras sa Pilipinas, tinguhaan naman sang Knicks nga makadaog kag kun mahimo nila ini, ini ang mangin labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang 25 ka tuig nga makatapak sila sa Conference finals.
english: On Saturday, 8:00 am Philippine time, the Knicks will try to win and if they do, it will be the first time in 25 years that they will reach the Conference finals.

text: Pananglitan magdaog naman ang reigning champions, mapwersa ang Game 7 sa ila home court sa Martes.
english: If the reigning champions win, Game 7 will be forced on their home court on Tuesday.

text: Ginalantaw nga indi na makabalik ang 27-anyos nga six-time All-Star nga si Tatum sa nabilin nga bahin sang playoffs.
english: Tatum, the 27-year-old six-time All-Star, is expected to miss the remainder of the playoffs.

text: Siya ang nagapanguna sa Celtics sa points (28.1), rebounds (11.5) kag assists (5.4) per game sa ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga postseason.
english: He leads the Celtics in points (28.1), rebounds (11.5) and assists (5.4) per game for the second straight postseason.

text: Tunga sang mga kompanya nga nagahimakas sa manufacturing, energy, kag iban pa nga sektor sang industriya sa Asia-Pacific region ang nawad-an sang indi magnubo sa $1 million bangud sang cyberattacks nga nagdisturbo sa ila operasyon.
english: Half of struggling companies in manufacturing, energy, and other industry sectors in the Asia-Pacific region have lost at least $1 million due to cyberattacks that have disrupted their operations.

text: Sa isa ka pagtuon nga ginhimo sang cybersecurity firm upod sa VDC Research, nagaguwa nga may mga respondent man nga nagsiling nga ang ila kapierdehan naglapaw pa sa $5 milyon.
english: In a study conducted by the cybersecurity firm in conjunction with VDC Research, it turns out that some respondents also said their losses exceeded $5 million.

text: Ini nagapakita sang kinahanglanon nga palig-onon pa gid ang proteksyon batuk sa mga hackers.
english: This highlights the need to further strengthen protection against hackers.

text: Nagaguwa man nga kon ang sistema sang isa ka kompanya mabuksan sang mga cybercriminal, nagakabig ini sang daku nga kapierdahan bangud sang unplanned downtime, pagkadula sang revenue, gasto sa pag-repair sang mga kagamitan, loss of inventory, kag bisan ransom payments.
english: It also turns out that when a company’s system is breached by cybercriminals, it incurs significant losses due to unplanned downtime, revenue loss, equipment repair costs, loss of inventory, and even ransom payments.

text: Ang downtime amo ang pinakadaku nga problema sang mga biktima, bangud ang pagkadula sang operasyon nagalawig halin apat tubtub 24 ka oras.
english: Downtime is the biggest problem for victims, as the loss of operation lasts from four to 24 hours.

text: Dugang pa sa pagdula sang revenue, ini mahimo man maka-impact sa pagsalig sang mga kustomer sa kompanya.
english: In addition to losing revenue, this can also impact customer confidence in the company.

text: Gin-suspend sang Commission on Elections (Comelec) ang printing sang official ballots kasunod sang ruling sang Supreme Court (SC) sa pagpugong sa poll body nga i- disqualify si ex-Caloocan City representative Edgar Erice kag iban pa gikan sa 2025 national and local elections (NLE).
english: The Commission on Elections (Comelec) has suspended the printing of official ballots following the ruling of the Supreme Court (SC) to prevent the poll body from disqualifying ex-Caloocan City representative Edgar Erice and others from the 2025 national and local elections (NLE).

text: Ini nga development kasunod sang ginpatigayon sang Comelec nga meeting agud istoryahan ang mga tikang kung paano mag- comply sa ruling sang Supreme Court.
english: This development follows a meeting held by the Comelec to discuss steps on how to comply with the Supreme Court's ruling.

text: Suno sa poll body, gilayon nila ginmando ang pagpauntat sang pag-print sang mga balota bilang kabahin sang contingency measures naangot sa desisyon sang High Court.
english: According to the poll body, they immediately ordered a halt to the printing of ballots as part of contingency measures related to the High Court's decision.

text: Ila man nga gin-amyendaran ang database sang mga kandidato, election management system (EMS), kag ang automated counting machine (ACM) kag consolidation and canvassing system (CCS).
english: They also amended the candidate database, election management system (EMS), and the automated counting machine (ACM) and consolidation and canvassing system (CCS).

text: Nag-generate man ang Comelec sang 1,667 ballot face templates nga nagapakita sang desisyon sang Supreme Court kag naghimo sang inventory sang tanan nga printed ballots.
english: The Comelec also generated 1,667 ballot face templates reflecting the Supreme Court decision and made an inventory of all printed ballots.

text: Ginkansela man sang poll body ang live test para sa trusted build sang online voting and counting system (OVCS) kag ang scheduled mock elections sa January 18,Sabado.
english: The poll body also canceled the live test for the trusted build of the online voting and counting system (OVCS) and the scheduled mock elections on January 18, Saturday.

text: Suno sa Comelec, ireprint man sini ang tanan nga affected ballots matapos nga mag-epekto na ang pagbag-o sa election management system.
english: According to the Comelec, it will also reprint all affected ballots after the change in the election management system takes effect.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-isyu ang Supreme Court sang temporary restraining order (TRO) nga nagadumili sa Comelec sa pag- disqualify kay Erice kag sa duha ka iban pa nga aspirants nga una na gindeklarar nga nuisance candidates.
english: The Supreme Court issued a temporary restraining order (TRO) prohibiting the Comelec from disqualifying Erice and two other aspirants who were previously declared nuisance candidates.

text: Ginmanduan ang poll body nga magkomento sa petisyon ni Erice sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw halin sang pagkabaton sang notice.
english: The poll body was directed to comment on Erice’s petition within 10 days of receipt of the notice.

text: Una na ginpahayag ni poll chairperson George Erwin Garcia nga ang aspirants nga may mga kaso nga gindeklarar nga final and executory sang Comelec en banc ang wala nalakip sa official ballot.
english: Earlier, poll chairperson George Erwin Garcia said aspirants with cases declared final and executory by the Comelec en banc were not included in the official ballot.
