text: Ini nagalakip kay Erice, nga ang disqualification ang gin-affirm sang poll body subong nga bulan samtang ang pangalan naman sang aspirants nga may pending decisions ang ilakip gihapon sa mga balota.
english: This includes Erice, whose disqualification was affirmed by the poll body this month while the names of aspirants with pending decisions will still be included in the ballots.

text: Sang Enero, ginpangabay ni Erice sa Supreme Court nga mag-isyu sang TRO ukon writ of preliminary injunction agud punggan ang Comelec sa pagpatuman sang resolusyon angot sa iya disqualification.
english: In January, Erice asked the Supreme Court to issue a TRO or writ of preliminary injunction to prevent the Comelec from implementing a resolution regarding his disqualification.

text: Sang Nobyembre sang gin-disqualify sang Comelec si Erice bangud sa paglapas sa Section 261 sang Omnibus Election Code angot sa gin-alegar pagpalapta sang “false and alarming” nga impormasyon.
english: In November, the Comelec disqualified Erice for violating Section 261 of the Omnibus Election Code for allegedly spreading “false and alarming” information.

text: Madumduman nga Enero 6 sang ginsuguran sang Comelec ang printing sang 73 million nga mga balota nga gamiton sa eleksyon.
english: The Comelec began printing 73 million ballots for the election on January 6.

text: Indi magbaton si Russian President Vladimir Putin sang mga tawo nga nag-evacuate halin sa Afghanistan.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin will not accept people evacuated from Afghanistan.

text: Rason sang presidente, posible nga magpakuno-kuno ang mga miltante bilang refugees kag magsulod sa ila nga pungsod.
english: The president said it is possible for militants to pretend to be refugees and enter their country.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Putin ang ideya sang Western countries nga i-relocate ang refugees halin sa Afghanistan padulong sa kaiping nga Central Asian countries samtang gina-proseso pa lang ang ila nga visa sa United States kag Europe.
english: Putin also condemned the idea of ​​Western countries to relocate refugees from Afghanistan to neighboring Central Asian countries while their visas are being processed in the United States and Europe.

text: “Does that mean that they can be sent without visas to those countries, to our neighbours, while they themselves (the West) don’t want to take them without visas?” pahayag ni Putin sa mga lider sang ruling United Russia party.
english: “Does that mean that they can be sent without visas to those countries, to our neighbours, while they themselves (the West) don’t want to take them without visas?” Putin told leaders of the ruling United Russia party.

text: “Why is there such a humiliating approach to solving the problem?” pahayag ni Putin.
english: “Why is there such a humiliating approach to solving the problem?” Putin stated.

text: Antes sini, nagpatigayon ang Estados Unidos sang secret talks sa pila ka mga pungsod agud nga mahatagan anay sang puluy-an ang Afghans nagaobra sa U.S. government apang nagpalagyo halin sa Afghanistan bangud sa kahangawa sa ila seguridad kasunod sang Taliban take-over sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Earlier, the United States held secret talks with several countries to provide shelter to Afghans who worked for the U.S. government but fled Afghanistan due to concerns about their security following the Taliban take-over of the country.

text: Ini nga ideya sang US ang ginapamatukan naman sang Russia, pungsod nga nagapahanugot sa visa-free travel sa mga residente sang ex-Soviet Central Asian countries.
english: This US idea is opposed by Russia, a country that allows visa-free travel to residents of ex-Soviet Central Asian countries.

text: “We don’t want militants showing up here under cover of refugees,” dugang ni Putin.
english: “We don’t want militants showing up here under cover of refugees,” Putin added.

text: Nagmandu ang Estados Unidos sa anum ka commercial airlines nga mag-provide sang mga eroplano nga gamiton agud mapadasig ang pag-evacuate sa mga Afghans nga nagbiya na sa ila nga pungsod.
english: The United States has ordered six commercial airlines to provide aircraft to be used to expedite the evacuation of Afghans who have already left their country.

text: Suno sa United States Department of Defense, indi direkta nga magalupad sa Kabul ang mga eroplano kundi gamiton lang agud nga matransport ang mga tawo nga nakahalin na sa Afghanistan kag dal-on sa military bases sa Europe kag sa Middle East.
english: According to the United States Department of Defense, the planes will not fly directly to Kabul but will only be used to transport people who have already left Afghanistan and take them to military bases in Europe and the Middle East.

text: Ang 18 ka commercial aircraft ang magahalin sa United Airlines, American Airlines, Delta Air kag iban pa.
english: The 18 commercial aircraft will come from United Airlines, American Airlines, Delta Air and others.

text: Tag-tatlo ka eroplano ang i-deploy sang American Airlines, Atlas Air, Delta Air Lines kag privately-held nga Omni Air, duha ang halin sa Hawaiian Airlines, kag apat ang halin sa United Airlines.
english: American Airlines, Atlas Air, Delta Air Lines and privately-held Omni Air will deploy three aircraft each, two from Hawaiian Airlines, and four from United Airlines.

text: Ini ang ikatatlo nga tion nga nag-deploy ang US military sang civilian aircraft bangud aminado mismo ang Estados Unidos nga nabudlayan ini sa pagdala sang mga evacuees sa ila temporary locations kasunod sang madasig nga takeover sang Taliban.
english: This is the third time the US military has deployed civilian aircraft as the United States itself admits that it is having difficulty transporting evacuees to their temporary locations following the rapid takeover by the Taliban.

text: Ini pa lang ang Stage One sang Programa suno sa Pentagon; buot silingon, mas madamo pa nga commercial aircraft ang iga-activate sa masunod.
english: This is just Stage One of the Program according to the Pentagon; that is, more commercial aircraft will be activated next.

text: Full force nga kakson kag utdon sang Iloilo City Engineers Office ang linya sang kable sang telecommunications company sa Enero 2, 2024 nga wala sa gihapon mahimos.
english: The Iloilo City Engineers Office has full force to remove and cut the cable line of the telecommunications company on January 2, 2024 which is still not done.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Electrical Inspector II, City Engineers Office, iya ginpahayag nga sa iya paglibot sa syudad, may mga dalagko-an sa gihapon nga mga wires ang wala pa nahimos sa pila ka mga poste.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Joel Gerasmia, Electrical Inspector II, City Engineers Office, said that during his tour of the city, there are still large wires that have not been repaired on some poles.

text: Suno kay Gerasmia, ang MORE Electric Corporation pa lang na-obserbahan sini nga obligado sa pagpangkakas sang ila nga linya.
english: According to Gerasmia, he has only observed that MORE Electric Corporation is obliged to remove their lines.

text: Gin-ako man sini nga ang exemption sang mga telco companies ang tubtob lamang subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 31, kag kon indi ini makakas, sila na mismo ang magabaklas sa Enero 2.
english: He also acknowledged that the exemption of telco companies is only until today, December 31, and if it is not removed, they will be removed on January 2.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga apisar nga expired na ang exemption sang mga telco companies sa Enero 1, pwede sa gihapon sila makahingagaw pangkakas sang ila linya tubtob wala pa nakabalik operation ang City Engineers Office.
english: He also said that although the exemption of telco companies expired on January 1, they can still remove their lines until the City Engineers Office returns to operation.

text: Sin-o lang bala ang indi pamilyar sa istorya sang kamatayon ni Hesukristo kag ang adlaw sang iya pagkabanhaw?
english: Who is not familiar with the story of the death of Jesus Christ and the day of his resurrection?

text: Espesyal ini nga istorya sa Bibliya kag ginasundan gid ini sang mga Kristyano.
english: This is a special story in the Bible and is closely followed by Christians.

text: Didto sa Zambia, extra effort pa gid ang ginhimo sang isa ka 22 anyos nga pastor nga si James Sakara.
english: In Zambia, a 22-year-old pastor named James Sakara made an extra effort.

text: Tuman ang pagpati ni Sakara sa iya abilidad nga mailog niya ang natabo sang pagbanhaw kay Hesukristo.
english: Sakara believed in her ability to imitate the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

text: Nakahibalo ka kun ano ang iya ginhimo?
english: Do you know what he did?

text: Ginkumbinse niya ang bilog nga kongregasyon nga kun ilugon niya si Hesus, mabuhi man siya pagkaligad sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: He convinced the whole congregation that if he imitated Jesus, he would live again after three days.

text: Ginbuligan siya sang tatlo ka miyembro sang ila simbahan agud magkutkot sang buho, ginhigot ang iya nga kamot, kag ginlubong siya nga buhi.
english: Three members of his church helped him dig a hole, tied his hands, and buried him alive.

text: Pagkaligad sang tatlo ka adlaw, ginkutkot ang lulubngan, kag syempre ano pa abi ang paabuton mo?
english: Three days later, the grave was dug, and of course what else would you expect?

text: Nadalayunan gid nga napatay si Sakara kag wala natuman ang iya promisa nga may mabanhaw sa iya.
english: Sakara died suddenly and his promise of a resurrection was not fulfilled.

text: Nagtinguha pa ang katapo sang simbahan nga maghimo sang ‘spiritual exercises’ agud nga mabuhi liwat ang bataon pa nga pastor, apang, wala na sang natabo — ginbawian gid sang kabuhi si Sakara.
english: The church members tried to do spiritual exercises to revive the young pastor, but nothing happened — Sakara died.

text: Bangud sang natabo, nawad-an sang bana ang nagabusong nga asawa ni Sakara.
english: As a result of the incident, Sakara's pregnant wife lost her husband.

text: Ginkakas sang Kamara si Ako Bicol party-list Rep.
english: The House removed Ako Bicol party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co bilang chairperson sang makagagahum nga Committee on Appropriations.
english: Zaldy Co as chairperson of the all-powerful Committee on Appropriations.

text: Mismo si presidential son kag Senior Deputy Majority Leader kag Ilocos Norte Rep.
english: Presidential son and Senior Deputy Majority Leader and Ilocos Norte Rep.

text: Sandro Marcos ang nag-mosyon nga bakantehon ang posisyon nga gina-uyatan anay ni Co.
english: Sandro Marcos motioned to vacate the position previously held by Co.

text: Wala sang anuman nga pagpamalabag nga natabo kag sunod nga gin-aprubahan ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez approved.
english: There was no objection and it was subsequently approved by House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Masobra isa ka oras matapos natabo ini sa session, nag-release sang statement si Co nga nagasiling nga ang iya ikaayong lawas amo ang nagtulod sa iya desisyon sa pagpanaog sa pwesto sa committee.
english: More than an hour after it happened in the session, Co released a statement saying his health was the driving force behind his decision to step down from the committee.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga kinahanglan niya nga pasulabihon ang pagpabulong.
english: He said he needed to prioritize treatment.

text: Dugang sini, nagapasalamat siya sa pagsalig nga ginhatag sa iya sang Kamara.
english: He added that he is grateful for the trust placed in him by the House.

text: “I extend my heartfelt gratitude to the majority in Congress for graciously accepting my decision to step down as Chairman of the House Committee on Appropriations.
english: “I extend my heartfelt gratitude to the majority in Congress for graciously accepting my decision to step down as Chairman of the House Committee on Appropriations.

text: This decision, made with a heavy heart, is driven by pressing health concerns.
english: This decision, made with a heavy heart, is driven by pressing health concerns.

text: The highly demanding nature of my role has taken its toll, and I now need to prioritize seeking the medical attention necessary for my well-being,” pahayag sini.
english: The highly demanding nature of my role has taken its toll, and I now need to prioritize seeking the medical attention necessary for my well-being,” it stated.

text: Si Co amo ang nag-oversee sa pagpasar sang Kamara sang 2025 budget nga balor P6.352 trillion.
english: Co oversaw the passage of the House of Representatives of the 2025 budget worth P6.352 trillion.

text: Nangin kontrobersyal ini bangud sa mga reklamo sa alokasyon sang pondo sa pila ka mga serbisyo kag paghatag man sang budget sa pila ka items nga gintawag sang iban nga kritiko nga pork barrel.
english: It was controversial because of complaints about the allocation of funds to some services and also the allocation of budget to some items that some critics called pork barrel.

text: Lakip diri ang P26 billion nga Ayuda para sa Kapos ang Kita Program (AKAP).
english: This includes the P26 billion Assistance for the Poor Program (AKAP).

text: Matandaan nga bangud sini nga mga kontrobersiya, naatrasar ang pagpirma ni President Bongbong Marcos sa budget antes dalayon nga gindayon sang Disyembre 30 matapos ang maid-id nga pagproseso.
english: It can be recalled that due to these controversies, President Bongbong Marcos' signing of the budget was delayed before it was immediately continued on December 30 after thorough processing.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini ang ikaduha nga termino ni Co bilang kongresista kag bantog siya nga negosyante sa Bicol region.
english: This is Co's second term as a congressman and he is a prominent businessman in the Bicol region.

text: Sa iya termino bilang appropriations panel chairperson, may mga kontrobersiya ini nga ginkaulamiran kaangay sang indi paghangpanay batok sa high-profile politicians lakip sanday Albay 1st District Representative Edcel Lagman, Senator Joel Villanueva, Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte, kag mangin si Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: During his term as appropriations panel chairperson, he was involved in controversies such as misunderstandings against high-profile politicians including Albay 1st District Representative Edcel Lagman, Senator Joel Villanueva, Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte, and Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Matandaan nga sang Septyembre 2024, ginmensyonar ni Sara si Speaker Martin Romualdez kag si Co nga amo ang nagakontrol sang national budget apang pareho nga ginpanginwala sang duha ini nga alegasyon.
english: It can be recalled that in September 2024, Sara mentioned Speaker Martin Romualdez and Co as controlling the national budget but both denied this allegation.

text: Magasapol virtually ang G7 leaders agud istoryahan ang krisis sa Afghanistan.
english: G7 leaders will meet virtually to discuss the crisis in Afghanistan.

text: Suno kay British Prime Minister Boris Johnson, diskusyunan man sang mga lider ang mga paagi agud malikawan nga maglala ang sitwasyon sa amo nga pungsod sa tunga sang pagkontrol sang militante nga Taliban.
english: British Prime Minister Boris Johnson said the leaders will also discuss ways to prevent the situation in the country from deteriorating amid the control of the militant Taliban.

text: “It is vital that the international community works together to ensure safe evacuations, prevent a humanitarian crisis and support the Afghan people to secure the gains of the last 20 years,” pahayag ni Johnson sa Twitter.
english: “It is vital that the international community works together to ensure safe evacuations, prevent a humanitarian crisis and support the Afghan people to secure the gains of the last 20 years,” Johnson said on Twitter.

text: Ang Britanya subong ang nagauyat sa rotating leadership sa G7: United States, Italy, France, Germany, Japan kag Canada.
english: Britain currently holds the rotating leadership in the G7: United States, Italy, France, Germany, Japan and Canada.

text: Si U.S. President Joe Biden, nga subong ginapakamalaot bangud sang iya pag-handle sa withdrawal sang U.S. forces sa Afghanistan, ang magasapol man virtually sa G7 leaders agud nga ma-coordinate ang mga polisa, kag maistoryahan ang evacuation efforts kag humanitarian assistance.
english: U.S. President Joe Biden, currently under fire for his handling of the withdrawal of U.S. forces from Afghanistan, will also meet virtually with G7 leaders to coordinate policies, and discuss evacuation efforts and humanitarian assistance.

text: Indi na magpatigayon ang Police Regional Office (PRO6) sang sealing and muzzling sang service firearms sa pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO6) will no longer conduct sealing and muzzling of service firearms to welcome the new year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jack Wanky, Regional Director sang Police Regional Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang tikang ang isa ka paghatag sang importansya nga disiplinado ang mga pulis subong nga Yuletide season.
english: Jack Wanky, Regional Director of the Police Regional Office, said the move is an emphasis on the discipline of the police this Yuletide season.

text: Suno kay Wanky, wala sila sang nakita nga rason agud ibalik ang tradisyon nga selyuhan ang mga armas luthang sang mga pulis.
english: Wanky said they saw no reason to reinstate the tradition of sealing police firearms.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nahatagan na sang warning ang katapo sang kapulisan nga indi na maggamit sang ila pusil sa pagsug-alaw sang 2025.
english: He also said that police officers have been warned not to use their firearms in the 2025 meeting.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang anaynagapatuman sang gun muzzling policy agud mapunggan ang mga pulis nga magpalupok sang ila mga pusil sa tion sang paskwa kag bag-ong tuig.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has been implementing a gun muzzling policy to prevent policemen from firing their guns during Christmas and New Year.

text: Halos 40,000 ka mga tinawo sang PNP ang gin-deploy para sa holidays, nga nagaseguro sang mga simbahan sa tion sang Simbang Gabi ukon dawn masses, mga transportation hub, mga mayor nga dalan, mga seaport, mga airport, mga establisimento komersyal, mga vital installations kag iban pa nga mga lugar.
english: Nearly 40,000 PNP personnel have been deployed for the holidays, securing churches during Simbang Gabi or dawn masses, transportation hubs, major roads, seaports, airports, commercial establishments, vital installations and other areas.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – All set na ang Iloilo City Government sa patigayunon sa Grand 2025 New Year’s Countdown.
english: Iloilo City Government is all set to hold the Grand 2025 New Year's Countdown.

text: Ini ang patigayunon sa Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.
english: It will be held at the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga maga-umpisa ang aktibidad las 10:00 karon sa gab-i kag magalawig tubtob las 2:00 bwas sa kaagahon, Enero 1, 2025.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, said the activity will start at 10:00 pm tonight and last until 2:00 am tomorrow, January 1, 2025.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, may yara sang banda nga magatukar kag balantayan man ang Fireworks Display.
english: According to Fantilaga, there will be a band playing and watching the Fireworks Display.

text: Masobra naman sa 300 ka mga personnel halin sa nagkalain-lain nga mga ahensya ang ipang-deploy agud masigurado ang seguridad sa kahiwatan.
english: More than 300 personnel from various agencies will be deployed to ensure security at the event.

text: Maga-deploy man ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sang masobra 100 ka mga personnel halin sa nagakalain-lain nga units.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) will also deploy more than 100 personnel from various units.

text: Dugang pa, masobra naman sa 50 ka mga multipliers lakip na ang mga barangay tanods ang magabulig sa ICPO.
english: In addition, more than 50 multipliers including barangay tanods will assist the ICPO.

text: Mapahamtang man ang Transportation Traffic Management Office (TTMO) sang masobra 50 ka mga personnel lakip na ang traffic enforcers, support staff, kag myembro sang Emergency Communication Team (ECT) agud mapasigurado ang matalunsay nga dalagan sang trapiko.
english: The Transportation Traffic Management Office (TTMO) will also deploy more than 50 personnel including traffic enforcers, support staff, and members of the Emergency Communication Team (ECT) to ensure the smooth flow of traffic.

text: Magabantay man ang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) sa mga strategic areas para sa health-related emergencies.
english: The City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) will also monitor strategic areas for health-related emergencies.

text: Naka-standby naman ang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) kag fire brigade volunteers sa tion nga may yara sang magluntad nga fire-related incidents kag iban pa nga emerhensya.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) and fire brigade volunteers are on standby in case of fire-related incidents and other emergencies.

text: Samtang, maga-deploy man ang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sang ila patrol vessels agud magbantay sa maritime activities sa tion sang selebrasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) will also deploy its patrol vessels to monitor maritime activities during the celebration.

text: Ginpahalin sa trabaho sang Broken Hill Propriety Company Ltd, — isa ka mining company ang 48 ka mga empleyado bangud sa sexual assaults kag harassment sa Western Australia mining camps humalin sang 2019.
english: Broken Hill Property Company Ltd, — a mining company has sacked 48 employees over sexual assaults and harassment at Western Australia mining camps since 2019.

text: Gina-imbestihan na ang mga dalagko nga mga mining companies sa Australia bangud sa mga reports sa pagtrato sa mga babaye sa ila isolated sites.
english: Major Australian mining companies are being investigated over reports of mistreatment of women at their isolated sites.

text: Bangud sini, nagpatigayon man sang state government inquiry ang nasambit nga pungsod may kaangtanan sa sexual harassment sa mining locations.
english: The country also conducted a state government inquiry into sexual harassment in mining locations.

text: Gin-ako man sang pila ka mga kompaniya ang ila kapaltahan kag nagpromisa nga bag-uhon ang ila mga polisa.
english: Some companies also admitted their shortcomings and promised to change their policies.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga kababainhan nga nagatrabaho sa mining company ang ginapatinir sa village camp-style accommodation sa diin umpisa sang 2019 tubtob 2021, nakabaton ang pulis sang 187 ka reports sang sexual assault kag 73 nga sexual harassment.
english: It was learned that women working for the mining company were housed in village camp-style accommodation where from 2019 to 2021, the police received 187 reports of sexual assault and 73 sexual harassment.

text: Ginklaro sang mataas nga opisyal sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga wala sang plano subong nga magdeklarar sang food security emergency sa Pilipinas.
english: A senior official of the Department of Agriculture (DA) clarified that there are no current plans to declare a food security emergency in the Philippines.

text: Ini bangud wala man sang kakulangan sa suplay sang bugas kag wala man sang nakit-an nga indi kinaandan nga pagsaka sa presyo.
english: This is because there is no shortage of rice supply and no unusual increase in prices.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesman Arnel de Mesa, makahimo lamang ang ahensya sang deklarasyon ukon ma-invoke ang Section Six sang Republic Act 12078 ukon Agricultural Tariffication Act kun makit-an na ini nga duha ka mga kondisyon.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesman Arnel de Mesa, the agency can only make a declaration or invoke Section Six of Republic Act 12078 or Agricultural Tariffication Act if these two conditions are met.

text: Dugang sini, nakitaan gani subong sang pagnubo ang presyo sang bugas base sa latest release sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) sa inflation.
english: He added that the price of rice has decreased based on the latest release of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) on inflation.

text: Ginalantaw man suno sa iya nga maga-us-os pa gid ang retail price sang bugas bangud nagnubo naman ang presyo sa international market.
english: He said the retail price of rice is also expected to fall further as the price in the international market has fallen.

text: “We also expect that the local production will recover this year, barring any major calamity issue, but looking at all possibilities, we could have a good harvest for the year,” pahayag ni De Mesa.
english: “We also expect that the local production will recover this year, barring any major calamity issue, but looking at all possibilities, we could have a good harvest for the year,” stated De Mesa.

text: Sang 2024, nagdangat ang total palay output sa 19.3 million metric tons samtang ang imported rice naman nagdangat sa malapit sa 4.7 MMT.
english: By 2024, total rice output will reach 19.3 million metric tons while imported rice will reach nearly 4.7 MMT.

text: Gin-untat temporaryo sang Estados Unidos ang evacuation gikan sa Kabul bangud sa overcrowding sa Qatar sa diin ginpangdala ang mga evacuees.
english: The United States has temporarily suspended evacuations from Kabul due to overcrowding in Qatar where the evacuees were taken.

text: Suno kay President Joe Biden, ang pagpa-untat sang evacuation ang magalawig man lang sang pila ka oras sa diin nakig-angot na sa Kabul ang US agud nga i-resume ang outbound flights.
english: According to President Joe Biden, the evacuation suspension will last only a few hours and the US has already contacted Kabul to resume outbound flights.

text: Gin-ako man sang presidente nga indi niya masiguro kun ano ang mangin final outcome sang emergency evacuation halin sa airport sang Kabul sa diin gintawag niya ini nga isa sa pinakamabudlay nga airlift operations sa kasaysayan.
english: The president also acknowledged that he cannot be sure what the final outcome of the emergency evacuation from Kabul airport will be, calling it one of the most difficult airlift operations in history.

text: Humalin sang Agusto 14, naka-airlift ang US forces sang 13,000 ka tawo halin sa Afghanistan kag 18,000 humalin sang Hulyo.
english: Since August 14, US forces have airlifted 13,000 people from Afghanistan and 18,000 since July.

english:

Meanwhile, the United Arab Emirates announced that it will accommodate Afghan citizens for 10 days until they are brought to a third country.

text: Sa subong, may yara na sang 8,500 ka tawo nagikan sa Afghanistan ang nagatinir temporaryo sa UAE.
english: Currently, there are 8,500 people from Afghanistan temporarily staying in the UAE.

text: Ginpaidalom sa Code White Alert ang tanan nga mga district hospitals sa Iloilo sa pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: All district hospitals in Iloilo have been placed under Code White Alert to welcome the new year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Paz Calopiz, head sang Iloilo Hospital Management Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang tanan nga health workers kaangay sang general kag orthopedic surgeons, anesthesiologists, internists, operating room nurses, ophthalmologists nga stationed sa ospital ang naka-standby ukon handa nga magresponde sa medical emergencies ano man nga oras subong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Paz Calopiz, head of the Iloilo Hospital Management Office, said that all health workers such as general and orthopedic surgeons, anesthesiologists, internists, operating room nurses, ophthalmologists stationed at the hospital are on standby or ready to respond to medical emergencies at any time.

text: Suno kay Dr. Calopiz, antes pa man ang holiday season, ginasiguro na sang Hospital Management Office nga bastante ang mga supplies kag equipment sa sulod sang ospital kaangay sang mga Intravenous therapy ukon IV fluids kag iban pa.
english: According to Dr. Calopiz, even before the holiday season, the Hospital Management Office is ensuring that there are sufficient supplies and equipment inside the hospital such as intravenous therapy or IV fluids and others.

text: Pahayag pa niya, makaakomodar ang outpatient department sa office hours samtang yara man ang emergency room kag triage nga mahimo makaakomodar sa mga pasyente sa tion nga magdamo gid.
english: He said the outpatient department can accommodate office hours while there is also an emergency room and triage that can accommodate patients in case of a surge.

text: Sa pagkamatuod dugang ni Dr. Calopiz, nagnubo ang numero sang hospital beds bangud madamo sang mga pasyente nga indi pa ma-discharge.
english: In fact, Dr. Calopiz, the number of hospital beds has decreased because there are many patients who have not yet been discharged.

text: Apang ginpasalig sini nga indi man overflowing ang mga pasyente kag may mga hospital beds pa nga available sa tion nga kinahanglan gid i-confine ang biktima.
english: However, he assured that the patients are not overflowing and there are still hospital beds available in case the victim needs to be confined.

text: Nagalaum ang natungdan nga magluwas sa mga firework-related injury, wala lang kuntani sang mabiktima sang nagtalang nga bala.
english: He hoped that apart from the firework-related injuries, no one would have been victimized by the stray bullet.
