text: Ginsaylo subong nga Lunes, Enero 13, ang trilateral phone call sa tunga nanday President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., outgoing US President Joe Biden kag Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba.
english: Moved to Monday, January 13, the trilateral phone call between President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., outgoing US President Joe Biden and Japanese Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba.

text: Suno sa Presidential Communications Office, ang US ang nag-request sang adjustment sa meeting bangud gintutukan anay ni Biden ang nagakatabo nga sunog sa Los Angeles county sa California.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office, the US requested the adjustment to the meeting because Biden had previously focused on the ongoing fires in Los Angeles county in California.

text: Kahapon kuntani sang aga ang nauna nga schedule sang ila virtual meeting.
english: The previous schedule of their virtual meeting was supposed to be yesterday morning.

text: “The Trilateral Leaders’ Phone Call with the US President, the Prime Minister of Japan and the President of the Philippines has been moved to 7 a.m. on Monday, Jan.
english: “The Trilateral Leaders’ Phone Call with the US President, the Prime Minister of Japan and the President of the Philippines has been moved to 7 a.m. on Monday, Jan.

text: 13 (Manila time),” suno kay Chavez.
english: 13 (Manila time),” Chavez said.

text: Wala ginsapubliko sang Malacañang kun ano ang mangin agenda sa meeting apang ginsiling sang PCO nga magapaguwa sila sang statement kun matapos na ang phone call.
english: Malacañang did not disclose the agenda of the meeting but the PCO said it would issue a statement after the phone call.

text: May nauna nga reports nga possible diskusyunan sang tatlo ka mga lider ang ila progress nga nahimo sa Philippines-Japan-US trilateral cooperation halin sang ginpatigayon ang maragtason nga trilateral summit sa Washington sang Abril 2024.
english: There were earlier reports that the three leaders may discuss their progress made in Philippines-Japan-US trilateral cooperation since the historic trilateral summit in Washington in April 2024.

text: Matabo man ini nga meeting sa tunga sang kahangawa dala sang China nga agresibo na gid sa pagsulod kag paglayag sa EEZ sang Pilipinas.
english: The meeting will also take place amid concerns over China's aggressive entry and navigation of the Philippine EEZ.

text: Ang latest nga tikang sang China amo ang pagpadala sang ila nga “monster ship” malapit sa Capones Island sa Zambales.
english: China's latest move is to send its monster ship near Capones Island in Zambales.

text: Indi na magdayon sa pagpadalagan sa pagka-senador si anay Ilocos Sur governor Chavit Singson.
english: Former Ilocos Sur governor Chavit Singson will not continue to run for senator.

text: Sa isa ka speech sa Pasay City, ginpahayag sang 83-anyos nga pulitiko nga nag-withdraw siya sang iya kandidatura sa 2025 elections para mas pasulabihon ang iya ikaayong lawas.
english: In a speech in Pasay City, the 83-year-old politician said he withdrew his candidacy for the 2025 elections to give priority to his health.

text: Pahayag sini, bisan nga may treatment na siya sa ginsuprer nga pneumonia, kinahanglan gihapon niya ang pahuway kag basi indi sini masarangan ang pagpangampanya.
english: He said that although he has been treated for pneumonia, he still needs rest and may not be able to campaign.

text: “Matapos ang mahabang pag iisp, ang desisyon ko po hindi na po ako tutuloy sa aking kandidatura sa senado,” pahayag sini.
english: “After much deliberation, I have decided not to continue my candidacy for the senate,” he said.

text:
“Ayokong ipilit kung ang aking kalusugan ang maaring magdusa.”

“Ramdam ko po ang inyong pagmamahal sa akin at inyong patuloy na paniniwala sa akin.
english:
“I don't want to insist if my health suffers.”

“I feel your love for me and your continued belief in me.

text: Ang overwheming na suporta, alam ko na puso ko panalo na ako,” dugang sini.
english: The overwheming support, I knew in my heart that I had won,” he added.

text: “Hindi po biro ang kampanya, lalo na ang trabaho ang isang senador, kung talagang magtatrabaho.
english: “The campaign is not a joke, especially the job of a senator, if he really works.

text: Ayaw kong ipilit.
english: Don't force me.

text: Ang aking kalusugan ay maaring magdusa… Sa totoo lang, tumakas na lang ako sa ospital dahil ayaw nila akong palabasin.
english: My health could suffer... In fact, I just ran away from the hospital because they didn't want to let me go.

text: Bagamat nagamot nila ang pneumonia, kailangan ko raw ng mahabang panahon ng pahinga,” kabahin pa sang iya nga speech.
english: Although they treated the pneumonia, I need a long rest,” he said in part of his speech.

text: Ginpromisa ni Singson nga bisan nag-atras na siya sa eleksyon, magapadayon siya sa paghatag sang electric vehicles sa transport groups.
english: Singson promised that even after withdrawing from the election, he will continue to provide electric vehicles to transport groups.

text: Sang ginpatigayon ang filing sang certificates of candidacy, matandaan nga ginpromisa man anay ni Singson nga maghatag sang bank accounts sa mga nagakinahanglan.
english: When the filing of certificates of candidacy was conducted, Singson also promised to provide bank accounts to those in need.

text: Ang pahuway tuman gid ka importante para sa mga atleta sa bisan ano nga kompetisyon kag amo man kadako ang ginahatag nga balor sa pahuway sa palaabuton nga Olimpiada.
english: Rest is extremely important for athletes in any competition and just as much value is placed on rest in the upcoming Olympics.

text: Ini ang rason kun ngaa nangita sang paagi ang Committee para sa Paris Olympics nga indi matemptar ang mga atleta nga maghimo sang aktibidad nga makapakapoy sa ila… halimbawa na lang ang pagpakighilawas.
english: This is why the Committee for the Paris Olympics is looking for ways to prevent athletes from being tempted to do activities that will make them tired... for example, sex.

text: Ang solusyon… amo ang anti-sex nga hiligdaan.
english: The solution… is an anti-sex bed.

text: Ini nga anti-sex bed ang human lang sa cardboard kag ini ang gamiton sang mga atleta sa Paris Olympic Village.
english: This anti-sex bed is made entirely of cardboard and will be used by athletes in the Paris Olympic Village.

text: Bangud nga human lamang ini sa cardboard, buot silingon, indi ini tuman ka bakod para higdaan sang duha ka tawo bangud gindesinyo ini nga mag-collapse kun mabug-at na katama ang nagahigda ukon nagatungtong sa ibabaw.
english: Because it is only made of cardboard, this means that it is not strong enough to sleep two people because it is designed to collapse if the person lying or standing on it is too heavy.

text: Buot silingon pa gid, indi maengganyo ang mga atleta nga magpakighilawas sa ila mga kama bangud pat-ud nga kun maguba ini, may kamala-malahan siya nga gin-ubra kag madulaan pa siya sang hiligdaan.
english: This means that athletes will not be encouraged to have sex on their beds because if it breaks, he will surely do something terrible and lose his bed.

text: Mayor nga katuyuan gid sini amo nga makapahuway gid ang mga atleta.
english: The main purpose of this is to give the athletes a good rest.

text: Ini nga mga kama ang nag-abot na sa Paris.
english: These beds have already arrived in Paris.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, ini man ang mga kama nga gin-gamit sa 2020 Tokyo Olympics sa Japan kag ginpahayag nga ini ang nangin epektibo man.
english: In fact, these are the same beds that were used in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in Japan and it was reported that they were just as effective.

text: SUNU sa historian nga si Demy Sonza, duha lang ang lubos ginahigugma sang aton Ilonggo national hero nga si Graciano Lopez Jaena – si Elena Fajardo kag ang Filipinas.
english: ACCORDING to historian Demy Sonza, our Ilonggo national hero Graciano Lopez Jaena loved only two things – Elena Fajardo and the Philippines.

text: Napabutyag ini ni Sonza sang nangin resource speaker siya sa pagsaulog sang National Literature Month sadtong Abril 22, 2017.
english: Sonza expressed this when he became a resource speaker in the celebration of National Literature Month on April 22, 2017.

text: Ugaling tubtub lang sa ngalan ni Elena ang nasugid sa aton sang isa ka partisipante sa amo nga okasyon.
english: However, one participant in the occasion told us only Elena's name.

text: Nangita kita sang mga libro parti kay Lopez Jaena.
english: We are looking for books about Lopez Jaena.

text: Nakita naton ang “The Ghost of Friar Botod”.
english: We see “The Ghost of Friar Botod”.

text: Ginhatag ini sang abyan naton nga si Leah Celiz, manager sang Iloilo Memorial Park, sa diin may lubong ang amon pamilya.
english: It was donated by our friend Leah Celiz, manager of the Iloilo Memorial Park, where our family is buried.

text: Sinulatan ini ni Ignacio V. Illenberger.
english: It was written by Ignacio V. Illenberger.

text: Isa ini ka “work of fiction”, sunu kay Ignacio, pero ang impression naton amo nga isa ini ka “fictionalized” story sa madamo nga bahin.
english: It is a “work of fiction”, according to Ignacio, but our impression is that it is a “fictionalized” story in many respects.

text: Ina tungod nagadala ini sang mga hitabo sa kabuhi ni Lopez Jaena kag pila ka tawo nga may kaangtanan sa iya kabuhi, nga gindugangan lang sang mga imaginary details.
english: That’s because it brings up events in the life of Lopez Jaena and several people related to her life, just added with imaginary details.

text: Lakip diri sanday Graciano, mga ginikanan niya nga sanday Placido Lopez kag Maria Jacoba Jaena; Colonel Enrique Fajardo (Jefe de la Guardia Civil, Comandancia Yloilo, 1865-1873; Governor Yloilo 1873-1879); Nicholas Loney (British vice consul of Yloilo, 1855-1869); Don Claudio Lopez (Honorary vice consul of Portugal to Yloilo) nga pakaisa ni Placido; kag si Elena nga solo nga anak ni Col.
english: They include Graciano, his parents Placido Lopez and Maria Jacoba Jaena; Colonel Enrique Fajardo (Chief of the Civil Guard, Yloilo Command, 1865-1873; Governor of Yloilo 1873-1879); Nicholas Loney (British vice consul of Yloilo, 1855-1869); Don Claudio Lopez (Honorary vice consul of Portugal to Yloilo) cousin of Placido; and Elena, only daughter of Col.

text: Fajardo.
english: Fajardo.

text: Na-mensyonar man diri ang madamo nga mga lugar sa Iloilo kag Guimaras, Daughter of Charity Elementary School kag San Vicente Ferrer Seminary sa Jaro, YMCA Iloilo, kag iban pa.
english: It also mentions many places in Iloilo and Guimaras, Daughter of Charity Elementary School and San Vicente Ferrer Seminary in Jaro, YMCA Iloilo, and others.

text: Dugang diri ang pila ka “fictional” nga karakter nga nagapakigbahin sa mga sugilanon kag ang mga naga-panaysayon.
english: In addition, there are some “fictional” characters who participate in the stories and the narrators.

text: Sunu sa sini nga libro, kasilingan sang mga Lopez sa Jaro ang Espanyol nga pamilya nanday Col.
english: According to this book, the Lopez family in Jaro was a neighbor of the Spanish family of Col.

text: Fajardo, asawa nga si Trinidad kag ila anak nga si Elena.
english: Fajardo, wife Trinidad and their daughter Elena.

text: Anom ka mag-ulutod naman sanday Graciano.
english: Graciano has six siblings.

text: Nangin mahirup sanday Graciano kag Elena sa ila masami pagkitaay sa playground sa bal-ut sang ila puluy-an.
english: Graciano and Elena became close during their frequent meetings at the playground in the backyard of their home.

text: Enjoy gid si Graciano sa gahod (chatter) nga ginahimo sang bataon pa kaayo nga si Elena kon ginagaris sang iloy kag ni Graciano.
english: Graciano enjoyed the chatter that the very young Elena made when her mother and Graciano scratched her.

text: Magulang si Graciano sing lima ka tuig kay Elena.
english: Graciano is five years older than Elena.

text: Nangin mahirup man ang ila mga ginikanan.
english: Their parents also became close.

text: Sang magsulod na sa seminario si Graciano kag nangin sekretaryo ni Don Claudio, gin-aha ni Col.
english: When Graciano entered the seminary and became Don Claudio's secretary, Col.

text: Fajardo ang maalam nga Graciano nga mag-tutor sa 7 anyos nga Elena.
english: Fajardo the wise Graciano to tutor 7 year old Elena.

text: Wala na ginapa-eskwela si Elena tungod masami ini nagamasakit kag ginapa-tutoran lang ini.
english: Elena is no longer allowed to go to school because she is often sick and is only tutored.

text: Sa ila balay, kon wala sila nagatuon, ginakawilihan ni Elena ang pagpinta sa pagtudlo sang iya iloy.
english: At home, when they are not studying, Elena enjoys painting under her mother’s instruction.

text: Nangin mahirup pa gid sanday Graciano kag Elena, kag sa amat-amat tubo sang buot ni Elena nagpakita na ini sing kahamuot kay Graciano.
english: Graciano and Elena became closer, and as Elena's heart grew, she showed interest in Graciano.

text: Sa isa ka sketch ni Elena ginpakita sini ang isa ka may edad nga lalake nga nagapungko, sa diin nagapasabak ang isa ka dalagita nga nagasandiay sa iya abaga.
english: In a sketch by Elena it showed a middle-aged man sitting, with a nursing girl leaning on his shoulder.

text: Siling ni Elena kay Graciano: “Sa ulihi, ining dalagita mangin kaupod sa pangabuhi sinang lalake.” Sa sina nga ginbungat ni Elena, hugot naglikop ang iya mga butkon sa dalagita.
english: Elena told Graciano: “Eventually, this girl will become that man's life partner.” With that, Elena wrapped her arms tightly around the girl.

text: Apang ang nadak-an nga binatasan nagpugong kay Graciano agud ipautwas ang iya kaluyag kay Elena.
english: But grown-up habit prevented Graciano from expressing his feelings for Elena.

text: Sadto 17 anyos pa lang siya.
english: He was only 17 years old.

text: Wala na nagtapos sa pagka-pari katulad sang luyag sang iya iloy kag luyag na lang mangin doktor.
english: He did not finish the priesthood as his mother wanted and wanted to become a doctor.

text: Nagbalik na sa Espanya sanday Elena kag iya mga ginikanan sadtong 1879.
english: Elena and her parents returned to Spain in 1879.

text: Nag-init ang mga prayle kay Graciano tungod sa iya libro nga  Fray Botod.
english: The friars became angry with Graciano because of his book Fray Botod.

text: Nalagyo siya pa-Espanya sadtong 1880.
english: He fled to Spain in 1880.

text: Nagduaw si Graciano kanday Elena bag-o mangita sang dalayunan para sa iya pagtuon sa medisina.
english: Graciano visited Elena before finding accommodations for his medical studies.

text: Sadto 24 anyos na si Graciano kag 19 si Elena.
english: Graciano was 24 years old and Elena was 19 years old.

text: Panahon na!
english: It's time!

text: Ugaling, duha pa lang ka bulan nga nag-abot si Graciano sang nagtaliwan si Elena tungod sa iya ginadala-dala nga balatian sa baga.
english: However, Graciano had only arrived for two months when Elena died of a lung disease.

text: Ginbatyag ini ni Graciano.
english: Graciano felt it.

text: Wala na siya nagpasige sa iya pagtuon sa pagka-doktor kag ginpangunahan ang Reform Movement sang mga Filipino sa Espanya.
english: He did not continue his medical studies and led the Reform Movement of the Filipinos in Spain.

text: Gin-islan man niya ang iya ngalan sa Graciano Lopez Jaena nga wala sing “y Jaena” sa punta.
english: He also changed his name to Graciano Lopez Jaena without the “y Jaena” at the end.

text: Napatay siya sa Epanya sa edad nga 39 sadtong Enero 20, 1896 dala ang kaakig sa nagahari nga mga Espanyol, nga subong bala ginkuha nila sa iya ang pinalangga niya nga si Elena./PN
english: He died in Spain at the age of 39 on January 20, 1896, angry with the Spanish rulers, who seemed to have taken away his beloved Elena.

text: Ginpakita sang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala kag Grand Slam champion nga si Coco Gauff ang ila abilidad matapos magbinuligay kag pagsulod sa quarterfinals sang 2025 Italian Open women’s doubles sa Rome.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala and Grand Slam champion Coco Gauff showed their skills after working together and making it to the quarterfinals of the 2025 Italian Open women’s doubles in Rome.

text: Una nga beses nga naghugpong sanday Eala kag Gauff kun sa diin nagpakita sang pwersa matapos nga ginlutos ang Italian tandem nga sanday Tyra Grant kag Lisa Pigato sa score nga 6-2, 6-3 sa round-of-16 match.
english: Eala and Gauff met for the first time and showed their strength after defeating the Italian tandem of Tyra Grant and Lisa Pigato 6-2, 6-3 in the round-of-16 match.

text: Madinalag-on ang una nga set para sa duo nga Eala kag Gauff, apang nagpakita man sang pwersa ang Italian tandem sa ikaduha nga set.
english: The first set was successful for the duo of Eala and Gauff, but the Italian tandem also showed force in the second set.

text: Sa ikawalo nga hampang, nagpakita liwat sang mabaskog nga depensa sanday Grant kag Pigato, kun sa diin nagpatas ang score matapos sang isa ka slice ni Grant nga nagdala man sang hampang sa deuce point.
english: In the eighth game, Grant and Pigato showed strong defense again, where the score was tied after a slice by Grant that also brought the game to deuce point.

text:
Apang, nagsala si Pigato sa masunod nga rally matapos nga naglapaw sa baseline ang ginpadala nga forehand, rason nga naka-abanse sanday Eala kag Gauff sa score nga 5-3

Nakuha sang magkapareha nga sanday Gauff kag Eala ang kadalag-an sa ila una nga match point matapos ang maalam nga drop shot ni Eala sa net.
english:
However, Pigato made a mistake in the next rally after a sent forehand crossed the baseline, giving Eala and Gauff a 5-3 lead

The pair of Gauff and Eala grabbed the win on their first match point after Eala’s clever drop shot into the net.

text: Sa masunod nga hampang, makontra nanday Gauff kag Eala ang defending champions sang Italy nga sanday Sara Errani kag Jasmine Paolini sa quarterfinals.
english: In the next match, Gauff and Eala will face Italy’s defending champions Sara Errani and Jasmine Paolini in the quarterfinals.

text: Plano sang Ukraine nga magbakal sang yara sa 100 ka mga fighter jets sa France.
english: Ukraine plans to buy around 100 fighter jets from France.

text: Yara sa France si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, sa diin personal sini nga nakaestorya si French President Emmanuel Macron.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is in France, where he held personal talks with French President Emmanuel Macron.

text: Lakip sa pagabaklon ang walo ka air defense system kag anom ka launchers.
english: The purchase includes eight air defense systems and six launchers.

text: Ginakabig ni Zelensky nga isa ka maragtason ang kasugtanan ang ginahimo nga sinapol niya kay Macron.
english: Zelensky considers his meeting with Macron a historic agreement.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Macron nga pagadasigon nila ang pag-deliver sang mga drones, interceptor drones kag guided bombs.
english: Macron said they will expedite the delivery of drones, interceptor drones and guided bombs.

text: Ini na ang pang-siyam nga pagbisita ni Macron sa France halin sang mag-umpisa ang pag-atake sang Russia sang 2022.
english: This is Macron’s ninth visit to France since Russia’s invasion began in 2022.

text: Kun ano ka “kalmado” ang general situation sa syudad sang Kabul sa Afghanistan umpisa sang pag-take over sang pwersa sang Taliban sang Domingo, amo man sini kagamo ang sitwasyon sa airport.
english: As “calm” as the general situation in the Afghan city of Kabul has been since the Taliban forces took over on Sunday, the situation at the airport is just as chaotic.

text: Mismo ang NATO kag isa ka Taliban official ang nagkumpirma nga 12 na ka tawo ang napatay sa airport halin sang adlaw sang Domingo — posible bangud sa igu sang pusil ukon sa stampede bangud sang desperado nga pagdali nga maka-gwa sa Afghan capital.
english: NATO itself and a Taliban official confirmed that 12 people have been killed at the airport since Sunday — possibly by gunfire or in a stampede due to the desperate rush to get out of the Afghan capital.

text: Kasunod sini, naghingyo ang Taliban sa publiko nga magtinir na lang sa ila nga balay bangud indi luyag sang militante nga grupo nga may mapatay ukon may masamaran bangud sang ginamo sa airport nga amo subong ang exit point sang kadam-an.
english: Subsequently, the Taliban urged the public to stay at home because the militant group does not want anyone to be killed or injured due to the violence at the airport which is now the exit point of the crowd.

text: Isa ang Ilongga nga si Lorena Aurelio sa nakasaksi sa sini nga mga hitabo.
english: Ilongga Lorena Aurelio was one of those who witnessed these events.

text: Si Aurelio ang nagatrabaho bilang operations manager sa isa ka logistics company sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Aurelio works as an operations manager for a logistics company in that country.

text: Isa man siya sa mga luyag na nga makahalin sa Afghanistan kag mabalik lang ugaling kun maayo na ang seguridad.
english: He is also one of those who want to leave Afghanistan and return only when security is improved.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Aurelio, iya ginpahayag nga isa pa lang ka kilometro halin sa airport, nagapugok na ang trapiko sa amo nga syudad.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Aurelio said that just one kilometer from the airport, traffic is already jammed in the city.

text: “Mayroon kaming naririnig na putok sa daan pero hindi naman malakas.
english: “We heard gunshots on the road but not loud.

text: Just a sign para itong mga tawo, tumabi o bumalik dahil ang hirap talaga ng daan,” pahayag ni Aurelio.
english: Just a sign for these people, step aside or go back because the road is really difficult,” Aurelio said.

text: Sang ulihi, ginbutangan na lang sang barikada ang palibot sang airport.
english: Eventually, barricades were put up around the airport.

text: Apisar may passport, wala nakasulod ang mga Pinoy nga may tuyo man kuntani nga makahalin sa amo nga syudad.
english: Despite having passports, Filipinos who intended to leave the city were not allowed to enter.

text: Bangud sang risgo, nag-abiso ang Philippine Embassy nga magbalik na lang ang mga Pinoy sa ila nga mga balay.
english: Due to the risk, the Philippine Embassy has advised Filipinos to return to their homes.

text: “We were there for two hours.
english: “We were there for two hours.

text:
Pabalik-balik ang mga tao, kaya polluted ang mga daan.”

Apang sa bahin sang Taliban, lain ang obserbasyon ni Aurelio.
english:
People are coming and going, so the roads are polluted.”

But on the Taliban side, Aurelio had a different observation.

text:
“Makikita mo sila sa police cars, tumatawa, nagpapa-picture… as if they are the kind of people na galing sa bundok na naninibago sa city.”

Nahadlok bala ang mga Pinoy sa lupok sang mga pusil?
english:
“You can see them in police cars, laughing, taking pictures… as if they are the kind of people from the mountains who are changing the city.”

Are Filipinos afraid of gunfire?

text: “Alam namin kasi na ang paputok nila, pataas.
english: “We know that their fireworks are up.

text:
Maliit na gun lang just to tell the people na bumalik or move back.”

Sa subong suno sa natungdan, nagapabilin anay ang mga Pilipino sa ila nga mga balay, sandig man sa abiso sang embahada, bangud apisar mag-abot man ang eroplano nga magsugat sa ila, pat-od nga dumugon man ini sang mga tawo nga yara sa airport.
english:
It's a small gun just to tell the people to come back or move back.”

For now, he said, Filipinos are staying at home, based on the embassy's notice, because even if the plane arrives to meet them, it will surely be crowded by the people at the airport.

text: Suno sa Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), subong nga Hwebes sang hapon, 90 pa ka mga Filipinos ang yara sa Afghanistan.
english: According to the Philippine Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), as of Thursday afternoon, 90 Filipinos are still in Afghanistan.

text: Duha na ka attempts ang ginhimo sang DFA para sa evacuation via New Delhi, India kag Islamabad, Pakistan, apang lunsay wala natigayon bangud cancelled ang commercial flights.
english: The DFA has made two attempts for evacuation via New Delhi, India and Islamabad, Pakistan, but both failed because commercial flights were cancelled.

text: Ang United States kag iban nga Western powers ang nagapatigayon man sang evacuation sa ila nationals kag iban nga Afghan staff halin sa airport nga amo ang ginalantaw magapasingki pa sang protesta batok sa mga Islamists.##
english: The United States and other Western powers are also evacuating their nationals and other Afghan staff from the airport, which is expected to intensify protests against the Islamists.##

text: Suportado sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) ang pagkakas sa lisensya sang driver nga nagsalakay sang mga flowerpots sa Diversion Road sang Disyembre 27.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) supports the cancellation of the license of the driver who attacked the flowerpots on Diversion Road on December 27.

text: Ang driver ang risidente sang Barangay Calubihan, Jaro kag natukiban nga yara sa impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sang natabo ang insidente.
english: The driver is a resident of Barangay Calubihan, Jaro and was found to be under the influence of alcohol when the incident occurred.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCOL.
english: PCOL.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, iya ginpahayag nga suportado sang talatapan ang ano man nga tikang nga tuyo iduso sang city government batok sa driver.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, said the office supports any action that the city government intends to take against the driver.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, kon kinahanglan nga ikanselar ang lisensya sang driver, sundon nila ini kag kon kinahanglan man nga mag-ubra sang report nahanungod sa insidente, magahimo ang ila opisina.
english: Garbanzos said that if the driver's license needs to be cancelled, they will follow it and if it is necessary to make a report about the incident, their office will do so.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang aktwasyon nga ginhimo sang driver ang ‘very unacceptable’.
english: He also said that the driver's actions were 'very unacceptable'

text: Nahibaluan nga ginkaugot ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang nangin ‘reckless actions’ sang driver.
english: It was learned that Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas was angry with the driver's reckless actions.

text: Gindayaw man sang alkalde ang madasig nga pagresponde sang Iloilo City Police Station 10 sa natabo nga insidente.
english: The mayor also praised the quick response of the Iloilo City Police Station 10 to the incident.

text: Indi kudeta ukon military junta ang sabat sa mga problema sa pungsod kundi ang pagboto sa maayo nga mga lider.
english: The answer to the country's problems is not a coup or a military junta but voting for good leaders.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief of staff Gen.
english: This was revealed by Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) chief of staff Gen.

text: Romeo Brawner Jr.
english: Romeo Brawner Jr.

text: kaangot sa nagahilapit na gid nga eleksyon sa Pilipinas.
english: in connection with the upcoming elections in the Philippines.

text: Kaangot man ini sa kontrobersyal anay nga panawagan ni former President Rodrigo Duterte nga dapat tadlungon sang militar ang mga gin-alegar sini nga “guba” sa administrasyon ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: This is also in line with former President Rodrigo Duterte's controversial call that the military should correct what he alleged were “broken” in the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: May mga nagakatublag kun tampad gid man ang military sa idalom sang Marcos administration, apang sa bahin ni Brawner, ginsiling sini nga indi sabat sa problema sang sosyudad ang mga tikang kaangay sa kudeta.
english: Some are concerned about whether the military is honest under the Marcos administration, but for Brawner's part, he said that measures such as the coup are not the answer to the problems of society.

text: “Because many are complaining now about our country’s problems, others think that the solution is to have a military coup d’etat or military junta.
english: “Because many are complaining now about our country’s problems, others think that the solution is to have a military coup d’etat or military junta.

text: This is not the solution.
english: This is not the solution.

text: Let us handle our election better,” suno kay Brawner.
english: Let us handle our election better,” according to Brawner.

text: Dapat lang suno sa iya nga magsalig sa proseso sang demokrasya kag gamiton ang eleksyon agud nga matuman ang ginalauman nga mga pagbag-o sa Pilipinas.
english: He said we should rely on the democratic process and use the elections to bring about the expected changes in the Philippines.

text: “Our call to the people is to use this election as a platform to express our desires by voting for the right individuals who will serve the country and our society,” pahayag pa sang AFP chief.
english: “Our call to the people is to use this election as a platform to express our desires by voting for the right individuals who will serve the country and our society,” the AFP chief said.

text:
“Let us use our voice to correct what we want to correct.”

Gindeklarar man sini nga committed ang military sa ila obligasyon nga ipabilin nga hilway kag malinong ang eleksyon para nga mabatian ang tingog sang mga Pilipino kag tahuron kun ano man ukon sin-o man ang ila nga pilion.
english:
“Let us use our voice to correct what we want to correct.”

He also declared that the military is committed to its obligation to keep the election free and peaceful so that the voice of the Filipinos can be heard and respected whatever or whoever they choose.

text: Ginhatagan ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH-6) sang tubob Enero 15, 2025 agud nga maghatag sang update sa mga delayed projects.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas gave the Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH-6) until January 15, 2025 to provide an update on the delayed projects.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga tubtob subong, wala pa nakabaton ang city administrator sang sabat sang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 kaangot sa ginpadala nga sulat sang Hulyo 1, 2024.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Jerry Treñas, said that so far, the city administrator has not received a response from the Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 regarding the letter sent on July 1, 2024.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, masobra anom na ka bulan sang nagsugod inquire ang city government sang update sang mga proyekto nga tubtob subong wala sa gihapon matapos.
english: According to Fantilaga, it has been more than six months since the city government started inquiring about the update of the projects that have not yet been completed.

text:
Lakip sa mga unfinished project sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office amo ang:

Wala pa man naka-reply sa sulat ang nasambit nga opisina nahanungod sa progress sang proyekto.
english:
Among the unfinished projects of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office are:

The office has not yet replied to the letter regarding the progress of the project.

text: Gin-set sang gobyerno sa P58 kada kilo ang maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) para sa imported rice.
english: The government has set the maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for imported rice at P58 per kilo.

text: Suno kay Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., inisyal ini nga i-cover ang Metro Manila umpisa sa Enero 20.
english: According to Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., it will initially cover Metro Manila starting January 20.

text: Pahayag ni Laurel, ini nga desisyon ang kasunod sang malawig nga konsultasyon sa mga tawo sa industriya kaangay sang importers kag retailers kag mga ahensya sang gobyerno.
english: Laurel said the decision follows a long consultation with people in the industry such as importers and retailers and government agencies.

text: Gindugang sini nga iga-repaso man ang MSRP kada bulan para nga makonsiderar ang bag-o nga mga rason nga nagaapekto sa presyo.
english: He added that the MSRP will also be reviewed monthly to take into account new factors affecting the price.

text: Una naman nga ginpasalig ni Trade chief Cristina Roque nga magabulig ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa pag-monitor kag pagpatuman sang presyo nga gin-set sang DA.
english: Earlier, Trade chief Cristina Roque assured that the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will assist in monitoring and enforcing the price set by the DA.

text: Gin-ako sang isa ka dispatcher sa Ceres Terminal sa Barangay Buhang, Jaro, Iloilo City nga nag-gamay ang mga nagabyahe subong nga holiday season kon ikumpara sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: A dispatcher at the Ceres Terminal in Barangay Buhang, Jaro, Iloilo City admitted that the number of passengers this holiday season has decreased compared to last year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Edgar Tomedo, dispatcher sang Vallacar Transit, iya ginpahayag nga mas kalma subong nga tuig ang dalagan sa mga byahero, apang padayon ang ila nga monitoring sa posibilidad nga pagdugok sang mga pasahero buwas nga adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Edgar Tomedo, dispatcher of Vallacar Transit, said that the flow of passengers is calmer this year, but they continue to monitor the possibility of passenger rush tomorrow.

text: Suno kay Tomedo, daw kaangay lang nga normal ang pagpauli subong sang mga pasahero sa tagsa ka probinsya.
english: According to Tomedo, it seems that the return of passengers from each province is normal.

text: Ginralagway man sini nga daw wala lang sang okasyon ukon indi holiday season ang kahimtangan sang ceres terminal.
english: He also described the condition of the Ceres terminal as if there was no occasion or not a holiday season.

text: Naghingagaw ang pila ka bumalakal nga magbakal sang palupok sa C1 Road, Arevalo, Iloilo City duha ka adlaw antes ang bag-ong tuig.
english: Some shoppers rushed to buy fireworks in C1 Road, Arevalo, Iloilo City two days before the new year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Niel Estoleros, bumalakal, iya ginpahayag nga nagbakal siya sang kwetis nga pulo ka bilog, samtang nagbakal man ini sang pasirit para sa mga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Niel Estoleros, a buyer, said he bought ten pieces of kwetis, while he also bought pasirit for the children.

text: Suno kay Estoleros, sang nagligad nga tuig wala siya nakabakal kag subong lang naka-tsansa nga magbakal agud madala sini pauli sa banwa sang Igbaras.
english: According to Estoleros, last year he did not buy and now he had the chance to buy to take it home to Igbaras town.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga para sa iya, bisan wala sang palupok, bastante tubtob nga may pagkaon ukon handa nga pagatiponan sa pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: He also said that for him, even without fireworks, it is enough until there is food or ready to gather to welcome the new year.

text: Mas ginpili man ni Estoleros nga magbakal sang kwitis bangud mas safe ini kag nagalupok sa kahanginan.
english: Estoleros also preferred to buy kwitis because it is safer and explodes in the air.

text: “Matuod kag indi propaganda lang” ang mga report nga tuman ka pintas ang Taliban nga grupo kag ginapang-pwersa sang katapo sini ang lamharon nga mga babayi agud pakaslan ang Taliban fighters.
english: “True and not just propaganda” are reports that the Taliban group is very brutal and its members force young women to marry Taliban fighters.

text: Una na nga nagpa-gwa sang pahayag ang Taliban spokesperson nga si Suhail Shaheen nga ‘totally wrong’ kag ‘poisonous propaganda’ ang statement nga ginapilit sang Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan ang mga bata nga pamanahon ang katapo sang militante nga grupo.
english: Earlier, Taliban spokesperson Suhail Shaheen said the statement that the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan is forcing children to marry members of the militant group is 'totally wrong' and 'poisonous propaganda'.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa Afghan Journalist nga si Mir Wais Jalalzai direkta sa Kabul City, iya ginpahayag nga indi mapatihan ang Taliban sa bisan diin nga aspeto bangud una na ini nga natabo sa norte nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Afghan journalist Mir Wais Jalalzai said the Taliban cannot be believed in any aspect because it has already happened in the northern part of the country.

text: As of press time suno kay Jalalzai, wala pa ini natabo sa Kabul City.
english: As of press time, Jalalzai said, this has not happened in Kabul City.

text: Apang pahayag niya, indi gihapon malimtan nga may mga 25-40 ka tawo nga ginpangpatay ang Taliban lakip na diri ang isa ka komedyante nga ginpatay mismo sa atubang sang iya mga anak.
english: However, he said, it is still unforgettable that the Taliban killed about 25-40 people, including a comedian who was killed in front of his children.

text: Wala man sang kaluoy suno sa iya ang ginabanta 50,000 – 70,000 ka mga Taliban militants sa mga soldado nga nagasungka sa ila.
english: He said the estimated 50,000-70,000 Taliban militants have no mercy on the soldiers who surrender to them.

text: MAPATIHAN BALA ANG PROMISA SANG TALIBAN?
english: IS THE TALIBAN’S PROMISE BELIEVABLE?

text: Nahibaluan nga una na nagpasalig ang Taliban sang kalinong kag normal nga kabuhi para sa nagatrabaho sa previous Afghan government kag nagpromisa man sang kahilwayan sa mga babayi agud nga makatrabaho.
english: The Taliban had previously promised peace and normal life for those working in the previous Afghan government and also promised freedom for women to work.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpahayag sang duda ang United Nations bangud pahayag sang UN, buron ini nga promisa kun basehan lang ang maragtas sang Taliban.
english: Subsequently, the United Nations expressed doubts because the UN said the promise was false if it was based on the history of the Taliban.

text: Sa bahin naman sang International Criminal Court (ICC), nagpahayag ang chief prosecutor nga gina-monitor sang husto ang hitabo sa Afghanistan bangud sa nagadamo nga reports nga may mga kapintas kag paglapas sa international humanitarian law.
english: On the part of the International Criminal Court (ICC), the chief prosecutor said the situation in Afghanistan is being closely monitored due to increasing reports of atrocities and violations of international humanitarian law.

text: Lakip diri ang extrajudicial executions paagi sa revenge killings sa detainees kag mga indibiwal nga naga-surrender, persecution sa women and girls, krimen batok sa mga kabataan, kag iban pa nga krimen nga nagaapekto sa ‘civilian population at large’.
english: These include extrajudicial executions through revenge killings of detainees and surrendering individuals, persecution of women and girls, crimes against children, and other crimes affecting the ‘civilian population at large’.

text: ILOILO – Nagapakita sa data sang Department of Health Western Visayas Center for Health Development nga boga ang mayor nga rason sang injuries nga naangkon sang mga biktima samtang nagahilapit ang pagsug-alaw sang Bag-ong Tuig.
english: ILOILO – Data from the Department of Health Western Visayas Center for Health Development shows that boga is the main cause of injuries sustained by victims as the New Year approaches.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Fritzi Ann Suzette Jeroso-Dequito, Head sang Health Promotion Unit sang DOH Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga humalin sang Disyembre 21, 2024 tubtob subong, nakarekord na ang ahensya sang 41 ka mga kaso sang firework-related injuries sa Western Visayas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Fritzi Ann Suzette Jeroso-Dequito, Head of the Health Promotion Unit of DOH Region 6, said that since December 21, 2024, the agency has recorded 41 cases of firework-related injuries in Western Visayas.

text: Ini ang mas mataas kun ipaangid sa 37 nga narekord sang ahensya sang tinalikdan nga tuig 2023 sa kapareho nga period.
english: This is higher compared to the 37 recorded by the agency last year 2023 in the same period.

text: Suno kay Dr. Dequito, 18 ka mga biktima ang mga nahalitan sang boga subong sa diin nakaangkon ang mga ini sang blast ukon burn injury nga wala sang amputation kag eye injury.
english: According to Dr. Dequito said 18 victims were injured by the boga today where they sustained blast or burn injuries without amputation and eye injuries.

text: Pahayag niya, masobra 70% sa mga biktima amo ang naga-edad isa tubtob 10 ka tuig.
english: He said more than 70% of the victims are between the ages of one and 10 years old.

text: Panugyan sang natungdan, kadam-an sa mga nakaangkon sang injuries bangud sa pagpalupok amo ang mga kabataan gani kinahanglan nga indi gid ang mga ini pagpabay-an sang ila ginikanan kag paandaman sa halit nga matuga sang firecrackers ilabi na sang ginadumilian nga boga.
english: He advised that most of those who sustained injuries due to firing are children so they should never be neglected by their parents and warned of the harm caused by firecrackers especially the prohibited boga.

text: Mas maayo dugang ni Dr. Dequito nga maggamit sang alternatibo sa paghimo sang matunog nga gahod kaangay sang torotot, kaldero kag pagpatukar sang musika agud mangin masadya kag hilway ang pagselebrar sang New Year sa balay kag indi sa ospital.
english: It is better, added Dr. Dequito urged the public to use alternatives to making loud noises such as torotot, pots and playing music to make the New Year celebration happy and safe at home and not in the hospital.

text: ILOILO Naglab-ot sa 18 cases ang narekord nga firework-related injury sa Iloilo Province nga amo ang pinakamataas nga numero sa Western Visayas.
english: ILOILO A total of 18 cases of firework-related injury were recorded in Iloilo Province, the highest number in Western Visayas.

text: Ang Miagao ang may yara sang apat ka kaso nga narekord; duha sa Oton kag tag-isa sa Ajuy, Anilao, Barotac Nuevo, Barotac Viejo, Cabatuan, Concepcion, Dumangas, Lambunao, San Enrique, San Joaquin, Santa Barbara kag Sara.
english: Miagao has four cases recorded; two in Oton and one each in Ajuy, Anilao, Barotac Nuevo, Barotac Viejo, Cabatuan, Concepcion, Dumangas, Lambunao, San Enrique, San Joaquin, Santa Barbara and Sara.

text: Lunsay mga kabataan nga lalaki naman naga edad isa tubtob 10 ka tuig ang biktima sang palupok.
english: The victims were all boys aged one to 10 years old.

text: Nakaangkon sang eye injury ang 12 ka mga pasyente samtang anom ka kaso naman ang may blast injury nga may amputation.
english: Twelve patients sustained eye injuries while six cases sustained blast injuries with amputation.

text: Sa sahi naman sang palupok nga gingamit sang mga biktima, 11 sa ila ang naggamit sang boga, tatlo ang naggamit sang water cannon, duha ang naggamit sang triangle, isa ang naggamit sang camara kag isa ang naggamit sang unlabeled firecracker.
english: As for the type of fireworks used by the victims, 11 of them used a boga, three used a water cannon, two used a triangle, one used a camera and one used an unlabeled firecracker.

text: Apat ka mga hagna ang hatagan-prayoridad sang Senado sa pagbalik sang session sa Martes, Enero 14.
english: Four bills will be prioritized by the Senate when session resumes on Tuesday, Jan. 14.

text: Suno kay Senate Majority Leader Francis Tolentino, lakip diri ang hagna nga nagaduso sa pag-postpone sang barangay elections kag pagtutok sa modernisasyon sang Phivolcs ukon Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology.
english: According to Senate Majority Leader Francis Tolentino, this includes a bill proposing to postpone barangay elections and focus on the modernization of the Phivolcs or Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology.

text: Hatagan man sang igtalupangod ang amendments sa Baguio City Charter kag ang pension adjustments sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
english: Attention will also be paid to amendments to the Baguio City Charter and pension adjustments to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).

text: Apang suno sa senador, nagapanguna gid sa ila prayoridad amo ang proposal nga i-reset ang barangay elections.
english: However, the senator said that the proposal to reset the barangay elections is at the forefront of their priority.

text: Sa idalom sang Senate Bill No.
english: Under Senate Bill No.

text: (SBN) 2816, ginaproponer nga ipaiway anay ang 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) kag ipatigayon na lang sa May 2029.
english: (SBN) 2816, proposes to postpone the 2025 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) and hold them in May 2029.

text: I-extend man ang termino sang mga barangay officials tubtub sa anum ka tuig.
english: The term of barangay officials will also be extended to six years.

text: Gin-sponsor ini sa Senate plenary ni Electoral Reforms Committee Chairperson Imee Marcos sang Nobyembre 2024.
english: It was sponsored in the Senate plenary by Electoral Reforms Committee Chairperson Imee Marcos in November 2024.

text: Tuyo sini suno sa senadora nga masigurado nga indi magdungan ang barangay elections sa national and local elections, para nga mas epektibo ang governance cycle kag mahatagan ang Commission on Elections sang tyempo para nga malinong kag matalunsay ang leksyon.
english: The senator said the aim is to ensure that the barangay elections do not coincide with the national and local elections, so that the governance cycle is more effective and the Commission on Elections is given time for a peaceful and smooth lesson.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Lunes gid kuntani naka-schedule ang pagbukas liwat sang plenary sessions apang ginkanselar sang Senado bangud sa “National Rally of Peace” sang Iglesia ni Cristo (INC) bilang pagpamatok sa impeachment complaints batok kay VP Sara Duterte.
english: The reopening of the plenary sessions was scheduled for Monday but was canceled by the Senate due to the National Rally of Peace of the Iglesia ni Cristo (INC) in opposition to the impeachment complaints against VP Sara Duterte.

text: Nagsaka na sa 304 ka indibidwal ang patay matapos gintay-og sang mabaskog nga linog ang southwestern Haiti.
english: The death toll from a powerful earthquake that struck southwestern Haiti has risen to 304.

text: Sa nasambit nga numero, 160 diri ang nagikan sa southern department sang pungsod, 42 sa Nippies, 100 sa Grand Anse kag duha sa northwest.
english: Of these, 160 are from the southern department of the country, 42 from Nippies, 100 from Grand Anse and two from the northwest.

text: Nagdangat naman sa kapin 1,800 ka indibidwal ang pilason.
english: More than 1,800 individuals were injured.

text: Matapos nag-igo ang 7.2 magnitude nga linog nga ginsundan sang mga aftershocks sa diin nagkalawasak ang pila ka mga simbahan, hotels, balay kag iban pa nga mga establisimyento, nagdeklara ang Haitian government sang state of emergency.
english: After a 7.2 magnitude earthquake followed by aftershocks that destroyed several churches, hotels, houses and other establishments, the Haitian government declared a state of emergency.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Ariel Henry, tuman ka dako ang pagkinahanglan subong sang pungsod sang mga medical personnel kag facilities.
english: According to Prime Minister Ariel Henry, the country is in dire need of medical personnel and facilities.

text: Ginpang-evacuate naman suno sa iya ang pila ka pumuluyo.
english: He said some residents were evacuated.

text: “For the people who need urgent special care, we have evacuated a certain number of them, and we will evacuate some more today and tomorrow.”
english: “For the people who need urgent special care, we have evacuated a certain number of them, and we will evacuate some more today and tomorrow.”

text: Naka-red alert status subong nga holiday season ang Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) tubtob sa Enero 2, 2025.
english: The Iloilo City Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is on red alert status this holiday season until January 2, 2025.

text: Ini ang preparasyon man sa pagsug-alaw sang publiko sa bag-ong tuig.
english: This is also in preparation for the public to welcome the new year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Iloilo City Fire Marshal, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa alert status, ang tanan nga mga personnel sang ila talatapan ang nagabalik sa tagsa ka istasyon agud magbantay sa mga posible fire related incidents.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Superintendent Melanie Habawel, Iloilo City Fire Marshal, said that based on the alert status, all personnel of their office are returning to each station to monitor possible fire related incidents.

text: Suno ka Habawel, operational ang ila equipment lakip na ang mga fire trucks kag pila ka mga kagamitan agud nga kon may emerhensya, mas madasig nga makaresponde.
english: According to Habawel, their equipment including fire trucks and some equipment is operational so that if there is an emergency, they can respond more quickly.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nagpatuman naman ang BFP sang inspeksyon sa mga designated areas sa syudad nga mahimo palupokan sang mga firecrackers.
english: He also explained that the BFP has conducted inspections in designated areas in the city where firecrackers can be fired.

text: May yara naman sang tatlo ka mga firecracker zone ang syudad nga pwede baligyaan sang mga vendors sang mga palupok.
english: The city has three firecracker zones where vendors can sell fireworks.

text:
Ini amo ang:

C1 Road sa ArevaloBuhang, JaroMulley Loney, City Proper
english:
These are:

C1 Road in ArevaloBuhang, JaroMulley Loney, City Proper

text: Pinakauna nga kahigayunan sa maragtas sang high school debates sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nakuha sang isa ka Filipino ang ‘gold medal’ sa ginakonsidera bilang Olympiada sang high school debates.
english: For the first time in the history of high school debates around the world, a Filipino won a gold medal in what is considered the Olympiad of high school debates.

text:
Ginpangalanan ang estudyante nagikan sa Baguio bilang ”world’s best high school debater.”

Siya amo si Robert “Toby” Leung, Grade 12 student sang Philippine Science High School – Baguio Campus, nakakuha sang Overall Best Speaker title.
english:
The student from Baguio was named the “world’s best high school debater.”

He is Robert “Toby” Leung, Grade 12 student of Philippine Science High School – Baguio Campus, won the Overall Best Speaker title.

text: Nakuha ni Leung ang average nga 73.17 speaker points sa (8) ka preliminary debate rounds kag nagpanguna sa 372 ka mga estudyante halin sa nanuhay-tuhay nga pungsod lakip na sa mga estudyante nga kilala bilang debate powerhouses nagikan sa Canada kag Singapore.
english: Leung scored an average of 73.17 speaker points in (8) preliminary debate rounds and led 372 students from various countries including students known as debate powerhouses from Canada and Singapore.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang World Schools Debate Championships (WSDC), ang ginakonsidera bilang ‘Olympics of high school debate’ sang debate societies, isa ka annual global debate competition nga nag-umpisa sang 1988.
english: It is known that the World Schools Debate Championships (WSDC), considered as the ‘Olympics of high school debate’ by debate societies, is an annual global debate competition that started in 1988.

text: Diri ginagamit ang World Schools format — isa ka global standard para sa high school debating.
english: This is where the World Schools format — a global standard for high school debating — is used.

text: Magluwas sa gold medal, nakuha man sang pungsod ang ‘bronze medal’ sa semifinals sa ika-duha nga kahigayunan humalin sang 2012.
english: Besides the gold medal, the country also won the bronze medal in the semifinals for the second time since 2012.

text: Nakarekord ang Pilipinas sang 6 ka daog kag 2 ka pyerde sa 8 ka preliminary rounds kag yara sa rank 3 sa knockout rounds.
english: The Philippines has recorded 6 wins and 2 losses in 8 preliminary rounds and is ranked 3rd in the knockout rounds.

text:
Gin-atubang kag ginlutos sang pungsod ang Czech Republic sa pre-octos, India sa octofinals, kag Romania sa quarterfinals tubtob nalab-ot ang semi-finals kag gin-atubang ang Hongkong sa debate topic nga may titulo nga “This House supports an individual carbon credit.”

Tatlo pa ka myembro sang Philippine high school debate team ang nahatagan sang best speaker awards sa 2021 edition sang WSDC.
english:
The country faced and defeated the Czech Republic in the pre-octos, India in the octofinals, and Romania in the quarterfinals until reaching the semi-finals and faced Hong Kong in the debate topic titled “This House supports an individual carbon credit.”

Three more members of the Philippine high school debate team were awarded best speaker awards in the 2021 edition of WSDC.

text: Ini amo sanday David Bloom, halin sa International School of Manila, kag gin-awardan sang 4th Best Speaker, Jake Peralta, sang Southridge High School, gin-awardan sang 6th Best Speaker kag Riva Fong, halin sa De La Salle Zobel, gin-awardan sang 11th Best Speaker.
english: They are David Bloom, from International School of Manila, and was awarded 4th Best Speaker, Jake Peralta, of Southridge High School, was awarded 6th Best Speaker and Riva Fong, from De La Salle Zobel, was awarded 11th Best Speaker.

text: Mas nagataas pa ang numero sang mga napatay sa Haiti.
english: The death toll in Haiti is rising even higher.

text: Ang 7.2 magnitude nga linog nga ginsundan sang mga aftershocks ang nagguba sa pila ka mga simbahan, hotels kag balay.
english: The 7.2 magnitude quake followed by aftershocks destroyed several churches, hotels and houses.

text: Suno kay Civil Protection Director Jerrry Chandler, padayon pa ang ginahimo nga search and rescue operation sa mga survivors ilabi na sa Les Cayes nga may populasyon nga 126,000 sa diin madamo nga mga buildings ang nag-collapse.
english: Civil Protection Director Jerrry Chandler said the search and rescue operation for survivors is still ongoing especially in Les Cayes with a population of 126,000 where many buildings collapsed.

text: Nagdeklara naman sang state of emergency si Prime Minister Ariel Henry.
english: Prime Minister Ariel Henry declared a state of emergency.

text: Masobra sa walo ka milyon nga mga Pilipino nga Katoliko nga deboto ni Hesus Nazareno ang nag-upod sa Traslacion subong nga 2025.
english: More than eight million Filipino Catholics who are devotees of Jesus of Nazareth will join the Traslacion this 2025.

text: Santo sa report sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) pasado ala una kaina sang kaagahon, yara sa 8,093,850 ang nag-upod sa prusisyon samtang nga ginadala ang milagroso nga imahe ni Hesus Nazareno halin sa Quirino Grandstand pakadto sa Quiapo church.
english: According to the report of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) around 1:00 am yesterday, 8,093,850 people joined the procession while carrying the miraculous image of Jesus Nazareno from the Quirino Grandstand to the Quiapo church.

text: Ginbase ini sa tatlo ka mga lugar nga gin-monitor sang otoridad nga amo ang Quirino (1,264,790), Quiapo (6,442,050), kag ang mismo nga prusisyon (387,010).
english: This is based on the three areas monitored by the authority namely Quirino (1,264,790), Quiapo (6,442,050), and the procession itself (387,010).

text: Ini nga tuigan nga prusisyon isa man sa pinakamalawig nga nagdugay sang 20 ka oras, 45 minutos, kag apat ka segundos suno sa mga opisyal sang simbahan sa Quiapo.
english: This annual procession is also one of the longest lasting 20 hours, 45 minutes, and four seconds according to church officials in Quiapo.

text: 4:41 sang Huwebes sang kaagahon sang nagsugod ang Traslacion kag nagtapos sang 1:26 na kaina sang kaagahon, Biyernes.
english: The Traslacion began at 4:41 am on Thursday and ended at 1:26 am on Friday.

text: Nalampasan sini ang kadamuon sang naglinigad nga mga tinuig.
english: This is more than the number in previous years.

text: Sang Enero 2017, madumduman nga masobra 1.4-million ka mga deboto ang nagkadto kag naglawig ini sang masobra 22 oras kag 19 minutos.
english: In January 2017, it can be recalled that more than 1.4-million devotees went and it lasted for more than 22 hours and 19 minutes.

text: Ang Traslacion amo ang re-enactment sang pagsaylo sang imahe halin sa Intramuros pakadto sa Quiapo Church sang 1787.
english: The Traslacion is the re-enactment of the transfer of the image from Intramuros to Quiapo Church in 1787.

text: ILOILO – Padayon pa nga ginapangita sang mga otoridad ang durugista nga subject sa drug buy bust operation sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) sa Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – Authorities are still searching for the drug pusher subject in the drug buy bust operation of the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) in Sitio Tuburan, Barangay Trapiche, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ini amo si Mike Cantera, residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: This is Mike Cantera, resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, pilason ang isa ka pulis matapos ginluthang sang 12 gauge homemade shotgun sang pakaisa sang subject nga kaupod sini nga nagpalagyo.
english: In the incident, a policeman was injured after being shot with a 12 gauge homemade shotgun by the cousin of the suspect who fled with him.

text: Ang pulis amo si Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya nga nagaserbe nga backup, residente sang Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: The policeman was identified as Police Corporal Gilbert Lingaya, a resident of Barangay Damires, New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje De Lima, head sang PDEU, iya ginpahayag nga nagapadayon pa subong ang hot pursuit operation agud madakpan si Cantera kag pakaisa sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje De Lima, head of the PDEU, said the hot pursuit operation is still ongoing to arrest Cantera and his cousin.

text: Suno kay De Lima, sang nagdeklarar sang buy bust ang police poseur buyer, gilayon nga nagpalupok sang armas ang pakaisa sang subject sa diin naigo si Lingaya.
english: According to De Lima, when the police poseur buyer declared a buy bust, the subject's cousin immediately fired his gun, hitting Lingaya.

text: Ginhingalitan naman ini ni Cantera agud makapalagyo.
english: Cantera tried to escape.

text: Naglawig pa sang tatlo ka oras ang negosasyon sang mga otoridad sa pagdumdom nga nagapanago lang si Cantera kag pakaisa sini sa sulod sang balay.
english: It took another three hours for the authorities to negotiate because Cantera and his cousin were hiding inside the house.

text: Lakip sa mga nag-negosyar amo ang misis ni Cantera, Oton, Iloilo Mayor Mayor Sofronio Fusin, Jr., Punong Barangay Jeorge Mediodia kag si Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan.
english: Among those who negotiated were the wife of Cantera, Oton, Iloilo Mayor Mayor Sofronio Fusin, Jr., Punong Barangay Jeorge Mediodia and Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan.

text: Matapos sini, nagdesisyon ang mga pulis nga sudlon ang balay sang subject kag didto natukiban nga nagpalagyo na ini.
english: After that, the police decided to enter the house of the subject and there it was discovered that he had fled.

text: Nagpanawagan man si De Lima sa subject kag sa pakaisa sini nga magsungka na sa mga otoridad kag atubangon ang mga panumbungon.
english: De Lima also called on the subject and his cousin to surrender to the authorities and face the charges.

text: GINA-selebrar naton sa adlaw nga ini, Disyembre 18, ang ika-164 nga pagkatawo sang Ilonggo national hero nga si Graciano Lopez Jaena.
english: WE celebrate today, December 18, the 164th birthday of Ilonggo national hero Graciano Lopez Jaena.

text: Una siya nakilala sa iya fictional nga libro nga Fray Botod.
english: He was first known for his fictional book Fray Botod.

text: Akig sini ang mga prayle sa Filipinas, gani nalagyo siya sa Espanya.
english: This angered the friars in the Philippines, so he fled to Spain.

text: Diri ginpundar niya ang pahayagan nga La Solidaridad kag ginpangunahan ang Reform Movement sang mga Filipino sa Madrid upod kay Dr. Jose Rizal kag Marcelo H. del Pilar.
english: Here he founded the newspaper La Solidaridad and led the Filipino Reform Movement in Madrid with Dr. Jose Rizal and Marcelo H. del Pilar.

text: Ginadumdum naton siya diri sa Iloilo paagi at least sa isa ka programa sa atubangan sang iya istatwa sa Jaro Plaza.
english: We remember him here in Iloilo through at least one program in front of his statue in Jaro Plaza.

text: Bugal ini si Lopez Jaena sang tanan nga mamahayag nga Ilonggo kag sang bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Lopez Jaena is the pride of all Ilonggo journalists and the entire country.

text: Mabuhay ang mga mamahayag nga Filipino!
english: Long live Filipino journalists!

text:
***

Mas importante sa aton nga mga Filipino ang mapaseguro nga maamligan kita sa peligro sang COVID-19 vaccine, labi na gid kay napasugtan lang ini sa karon sa idalom sang Emergency Use Authorization (EUA), sangsa itudlo lang kita sang aton gobyerno kon diin magkuha sini.
english:
***

It is more important for us Filipinos to ensure that we are protected from the dangers of the COVID-19 vaccine, especially since it is currently approved under the Emergency Use Authorization (EUA), than for our government to tell us where to get it.

text: Sunu kay President Duterte napasalig na siya sang China nga makakuha kita sang COVID-19 vaccine dira sa ila, although pwede man kita makakuha sa iban nga pungsod, katulad sang iya sang Pfizer sa United Kingdom.
english: President Duterte said he has been assured by China that we will get the COVID-19 vaccine from them, although we can also get it from other countries, such as Pfizer's in the United Kingdom.

text: Daku ang kabalaslan ni Presidente Duterte sa China tungod sa gin-utang sini sa China para sa iya Build.Buld.Build nga infra projects.
english: President Duterte owes China a lot of money for his Build.Buld.Build infra projects.

text: Amo gani nga indi siya seguro makapangindi nga makakuha sini sa China.
english: That's why he probably can't refuse to get it from China.

text: Apang lain man ang aton kabalaslan sa pagpatukod sini nga mga proyekto, nga pwede ta man mabayaran nga may interest pa.
english: But we also have a different reward for building these projects, which we can also pay with interest.

text: Kag lain man ang kabuhi kag ikaayong lawas sang aton pumuluyo nga, kon matabo, indi mabayaran sang ano man nga kantidad.
english: And another is the life and health of our people which, if it happens, cannot be compensated by any amount.

text: Tungod sini, seguruhon naton kon diin makakuha sang bagay nga  bakuna.
english: Therefore, let's make sure where to get the right vaccine.

text: Dapat tagaan naton sing kahilwayan ang mga pumuluyo sa pagpili kon diin sila magkuha sang bakuna nga may salig sila.
english: We must give citizens the freedom to choose where to get a vaccine that they can trust.

text: Indi kay piliton kita sang aton gobyerno sa luyag lang sini nga daw si Hitler nga nagadaga sang ila kabuhi agud matuman lang ang iya ambisyon.
english: Not that our government will force us to do whatever it wants like Hitler who sacrificed their lives to fulfill his ambition.

text: Gani upod kita sa tindug ni Quezon City Mayor Joy Bemonte nga mapabakuna lang pagkatapos nga maseguro sang aton Food and Drug Adminitrasyon (FDA) nga hilway gid kita sa peligroso sang side effects sang aton makuha sa luas nga vaccine.
english: Therefore, we agree with Quezon City Mayor Joy Bemonte's position that we should be vaccinated only after our Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has ensured that we are completely free from the dangerous side effects of the foreign vaccine.

text: Sang sini lang, ang United Arab Emirates, nagpahayag nga ang efficacy sang Chinese-made (Sinovac) vaccine tubtub 86 ka porsyento lang, samtang ang Moderna Inc, kag Pfizer upod sa BioNTech SE may efficacy rate nga 94.5 percent kag 95 percent, respectively.
english: Recently, the United Arab Emirates, stated that the efficacy of the Chinese-made (Sinovac) vaccine is only up to 86 percent, while Moderna Inc, and Pfizer with BioNTech SE have an efficacy rate of 94.5 percent and 95 percent, respectively.

text: Kon matuod ini, sa diin pa abe kita nga mga Filipino magpabakuna kundi sa sining mas masaligan nga mga manufacturer nga taga-Uropa.
english: If this is true, where else can we Filipinos get vaccinated but from these more reliable European manufacturers.

text: Of course, maayo gid ining suhestyon ni Mayor Belmonte nga maghimo ang aton FDA sang kaugalingon nga pagsiyasat kon ano gid ka “effective and safe” ang ining mga vaccine nga pwede kuhaon sang aton gobyerno.
english: Of course, Mayor Belmonte's suggestion that our FDA should conduct its own research on how “effective and safe” these vaccines are that our government can take is very good.

text: In other words, indi kita basta magsalig lang sa ining mga pahayag.
english: In other words, we cannot simply rely on these statements.

text: Dapat maghimo gid kita sang aton pagsiyasat sandig sa kon ano gid ang bagay sa kapinasahe sang mga Filipino sa ila pagkatawo bilang liwan nga rasa.
english: We must do our research based on what is really appropriate for the Filipinos in their identity as a different race.

text: Dapat seguruhon gid sang FDA kon ano gid ang bagay nga doses sang vaccine para sa ila sunu sa edad kag kahimtangan sang ikaayong lawas.
english: The FDA must ensure that the vaccine doses are appropriate for them according to their age and health status.

text: Subong man ang ingrediente sang vaccine nga bagay lang sa biological component sang Filipino kag ang posible makapalain sa iya.
english: Also the ingredient of the vaccine that is only suitable for the biological component of the Filipino and that may make him sick.

text: Katulad sang posible nga peligro sa allergic reaction halin sa composition sining vaccine, kag ang pagpangamdam in advance sa sining posible ng mga peligro.
english: Such as the possible risk of allergic reaction from the composition of this vaccine, and the preparation in advance of these possible risks.

text: In fact, dapat gid man nga may masusi nga review ang aton FDA sang resulta sang mga clinical test sang sining vaccine nga gina-rekomendar sa aton.
english: In fact, our FDA should have a thorough review of the results of the clinical tests of this vaccine that is being recommended to us.

text: Nga daan pang-Emergency Use pa lang ining mga vaccine.
english: That these vaccines are for Emergency Use.

text: Kag kon may idugang pa kita sa resulta sang mga clinical test nga ini, ipatuman ta gid ini agud maseguro gid nga hilway sa peligro ang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: And if we have anything to add to the results of these clinical tests, we will implement them to ensure that our citizens are safe.

text: Dapat may natun-an man kita sa natabo sang pagpabakuna sa dengue, nga tungod sa kakulangan sang pag-review sng husto sang paggamit sini madamo nga mga kabataan, sunu sa akusasyon sang mga ginikanan, ang napatay kag nabutang sa peligro.
english: We should also learn from the incident of dengue vaccination, which due to lack of proper review of its use many children, according to parents' accusations, died and were put at risk.

text: Ining mga akusasyon yara na sa korte sa pagpanguna ni Atty. Acosta sang Public Attorney’s Office (PAO)./PN
english: These charges are already in court led by Atty. Acosta of the Public Attorney's Office (PAO)./PN

Natigayon na nga mapasaka ang kaso nga rape with homicide batok sa lolo sang pito ka tuig nga bata nga babaye nga ginhimuslan, ginhigtan ang liog kag ginsulod sa sako sa Brgy.
english:
𝙍𝙚𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙧 𝙙𝙞𝙨𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 𝙞𝙨 𝙖𝙙𝙫𝙞𝙨𝙙.

A case of rape with homicide has been filed against the grandfather of a seven-year-old girl who was raped, strangled and put in a sack in Brgy.

text: Tampucao, Lambunao, Iloilo.
english: Tampucao, Lambunao, Iloilo.

text: Sa kumpirmasyon ni PCapt.
english: In the confirmation of PCapt.

text: Winston Biadog, hepe sang Lambunao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ang iloy amo ang nagtindog bilang complainant kag ginahulat pa nga maggwa ang warrant of arrest.
english: Winston Biadog, chief of Lambunao Municipal Police Station, said the mother is the complainant and is still waiting for the warrant of arrest to be issued.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Bebe, pito ka tuig ang edad, kag nasapwan sang iya nga lola sa ila banyo nga nasulod sa sako kag wala na sang pang-idalom nga panapton.
english: The victim was identified as Bebe, seven years old, and was found by her grandmother in their bathroom in a sack and without underwear.

text: Matandaan nga sa ginpatigayon nga autopsy, nakita nga ang gintunaan sang kamatayon sang biktima amo ang pagkakuga.
english: It can be recalled that the autopsy conducted revealed that the cause of death of the victim was strangulation.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang otoridad nga may natabo man nga sexual abuse sa bata.
english: Authorities also confirmed that the child was also sexually abused.

text: Sa tion nga masubayan ang aton pagkaon indi manigar nga nagainit ang aton nga ulo.
english: When we track our food, we can't deny that our heads get hot.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga natukiban sa mga pagtuon nga ang subay madamo sang protein, kag manggaranon sa vitamins kag minerals?
english: But did you know that studies have found that ant is high in protein, and rich in vitamins and minerals?

text: Suno kay Dr. Alyssa Crittenden, Associate Professor of Anthropology sang University of Nevada, Las Vegas, ang insekto nga subay ang manggaranon man sa unsaturated fatty acids nga amo ang nagapalikaw sa mataas nga cholesterol.
english: According to Dr. Alyssa Crittenden, Associate Professor of Anthropology at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, the ant insect is also rich in unsaturated fatty acids that prevent high cholesterol.

text: Ginpahayag ni Crittenden nga ang subay nga ‘Hormigas culonas’ ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga “big-butt ant” ang nagabalor sang kapin P5,000 kada kilo bangud sa tuman kataas nga nutritional value nga mahatag sini sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Crittenden said the 'Hormigas culonas' or better known as the “big-butt ant” is worth more than P5,000 per kilo due to its high nutritional value.

text: Nagapalikaw man sa sa balatian nga cancer suno sa doktor ang pagkaon sang subay bangud madamo ini sang cancer prevention agents.
english: The doctor also said that eating fish also prevents cancer because it contains many cancer prevention agents.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa China, ang pagkaon sang subay ang nangin kabahin na sang healthy diet sang mga tawo kag ginagamit man bilang bulong sa sulod na sang 3,000 ka-tuig.
english: In China, eating fish has been part of people's healthy diet and has been used as medicine for 3,000 years.

text: Suno kay Zhang Zhilin, vice chairman sang Chinese entomological society, bangud sa formic acid kag mga mineral traces nga makit-an sa subay, epektibo man ini agud matapna ang balatian nga rheumatism.
english: According to Zhang Zhilin, vice chairman of the Chinese entomological society, due to the formic acid and mineral traces found in ants, it is also effective in preventing rheumatism.

text: Mainit ang pag-umpisa sang tandem sang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala kag Grand Slam champion nga si Coco Gauff sa 2025 Italian Open doubles tournament.
english: The tandem of Filipina tennis star Alex Eala and Grand Slam champion Coco Gauff is off to a hot start in the 2025 Italian Open doubles tournament.

text: Nagdaog si Eala kag si Gauff batok kanday Alexandra Panova sang Russia kag Fanny Stollár sang Hungary sa score nga 6-3, 6-1, sang Sabado, kun sa diin isa ini ka mabaskog nga performance para sa una nga pagpareha sang duha.
english: Eala and Gauff won against Alexandra Panova of Russia and Fanny Stollár of Hungary 6-3, 6-1, on Saturday, in what was a strong performance for the first pairing of the two.

text: Pagkatapos sang 2-2 nga deadlock sa una nga set, tatlo ka sunod-sunod nga hampang ang ila nakuha, kag gikan didto nagpadayon na ang ila pagdominar tubtob sa katapusan.
english: After a 2-2 deadlock in the first set, they made it three games in a row, and from there they have continued their dominance until the end.

text: Para kay Eala, isa ini ka maayo nga rebound matapos ang mapyerde batok kay Marta Kostyuk sa singles tournament.
english: For Eala, it was a good rebound after losing to Marta Kostyuk in the singles tournament.

text: Sunod nga makaatubang sang Eala-Gauff tandem amo ang magadaog sa tunga sang pares nga Tyra Grant kag Lisa Pigato sang Italy, kag Irina Khromacheva sang Russia kag Anna Danilina sang Kazakhstan sa round-of-16.
english: Next to face the Eala-Gauff tandem will be the winner between the pair of Tyra Grant and Lisa Pigato of Italy, and Irina Khromacheva of Russia and Anna Danilina of Kazakhstan in the round-of-16.

text: Naghatag sang paglaum, kasanag, kag kasadya sa mga tumuluo ang pagbukas sang Jubilee Year 2025 nga may tema nga “Pilgrims of Hope”.
english: The opening of the Jubilee Year 2025 with the theme “Pilgrims of Hope” brought hope, light, and joy to the faithful.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Benny Loreta, tumuluo, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga hugot ang pagtuo sang mga tawo sa Ginoo agud makaangkon sang milagro sa kabuhi.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Benny Loreta, a believer, said that people need to have strong faith in the Lord in order to have miracles in life.

text: Suno kay Loreta, ang kahiwatan ang isa ka panawagan sa tagsa ka katoliko agud mag-upod kag mag-isa sa simbahang katolika.
english: According to Loreta, the event is a call to every Catholic to join and unite in the Catholic Church.

text: Apisar sang ulan, wala ini nangin upang sa ila agud magprosisyon humalin sa St.
english: Despite the rain, it did not stop them from marching from St.

text: Clement’s Church padulong sa National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles (Jaro Cathedral).
english: Clement’s Church to the National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles (Jaro Cathedral).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Jubilee Year ang ginahiwat agud mag-imbitar agud mag-reflect sa personal nga journey sang pagtuo, relasyon sa Ginoo, kag mga pamaagi nga maisakabuhi ang baptismal promises.
english: It is known that the Jubilee Year is held to invite to reflect on the personal journey of faith, relationship with the Lord, and ways to live the baptismal promises.

text: Kaangot diri, pito ka mga simbahan ang gindesignar sang Archdiocese of Jaro bilang pilgrimage churches may kaangtanan sa selebrasyon sang Jubilee year sa 2025.
english: In this regard, seven churches have been designated by the Archdiocese of Jaro as pilgrimage churches in connection with the celebration of the Jubilee year in 2025.

text: Ini ginalakipan sang mga masunod: Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral nga amo ang National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles Parish; St.
english: These include the following: Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral which is the National Shrine of Our Lady of Candles Parish; St.

text: Nicholas of Tolentino Parish sa Cabatuan; St.
english: Nicholas of Tolentino Parish in Cabatuan; St.

text: Michael the Archangel Parish sa San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras; St.
english: Michael the Archangel Parish in San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras; St.

text: Thomas of Villanova Parish sa Miagao; Patronage of St.
english: Thomas of Villanova Parish in Miagao; Patronage of St.

text: Joseph Parish sa Pototan; Sts.
english: Joseph Parish in Pototan; Sts.

text: Peter and Paul Parish sa Barotac Viejo; Holy Rosary Chapel sang Dominican Sisters of the Most Holy Rosary of the Philippines sa Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Peter and Paul Parish in Barotac Viejo; Holy Rosary Chapel of the Dominican Sisters of the Most Holy Rosary of the Philippines in Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Nagsaka na sa 31 ka mga indibidwal ang nagkalamatay sa lapnagon nga pagbaha sa Black Sea region sang Turkey.
english: At least 31 people have been killed in widespread flooding in Turkey's Black Sea region.

text: Doble nga pagpanghangkat ang ginapangatubag sang Turkey bangud sang tinalikdan nga mga semana, nagluntad man ang wildfire.
english: Turkey is facing a double challenge because in recent weeks, wildfires have also broken out.

text: Madamo sang mga establisimento ang nag-collapse pagkatapos hampakon sang dalagko nga mga balod.
english: Many of the establishments collapsed after being hit by huge waves.

text: May mga nagalinupad nga mga debris, may mga taytay nga nagguba, sirado ang mga dalan kag wala sang kuryente sa ginatos ka mga villages sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Debris was flying, bridges were destroyed, roads were closed and there was no power in hundreds of villages in that country.

text: Suno kay Interior Minister Suleyman Soylu, ini na ang pinakamalala nga baha nga iya na-eksperyensyahan matapos ang ginhimo nga survey sa mga damage nga tuga sang baha sa mga probinsya sang Bartin, Kastamonu kag Sinop.
english: According to Interior Minister Suleyman Soylu, this is the worst flood he has experienced after a survey was conducted on the damage caused by floods in the provinces of Bartin, Kastamonu and Sinop.

text: Tubtob subong, madamo pa sa gihapon ang missing kag posible nga mas magataas pa ang numero sang mga napatay.
english: So far, many are still missing and the death toll is likely to rise.

text: Wala nalab-ot sang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) ang target sini para sa tobacco excise tax collection bangud sa pagpadayon gihapon sang iligal nga baligyaanay sa Pilipinas.
english: The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) failed to meet its target for tobacco excise tax collection due to the continued illegal trade in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ang ila nga total tobacco excise tax collection sang nagligad nga tuig ang yara lamang sa P134 billion.
english: According to the agency, their total tobacco excise tax collection last year was only P134 billion.

text: Kulang ini sang P51 billion agud kuntani malab-ot ang P185 billion target collection sang 2023.
english: This is P51 billion short of the P185 billion target collection in 2023.

text: Ang nakolekta sang nagligad nga tuig ang mas manubo man ipaanggid sa P134.91 billion nga natipon sang BIR sang 2023.
english: Last year's collection was also lower compared to the P134.91 billion collected by the BIR in 2023.
