text: Ginalantaw sang bureau nga factors kun ngaa indi nila malab-ot ang ila target amo bangud naglain na ang consumption patterns sang mga nagasigarilyo lakip na ang pagsaylo sa vape, kag ang pagpabilin sang illicit trade sa market mangin sa online platforms.
english: The bureau believes that the factors why they cannot achieve their target are because the consumption patterns of smokers have changed including the switch to vape, and the persistence of illicit trade in the market through online platforms.

text: Naka-conduct ang BIR sang at least 141 raids sa illegal vapor products kag tatlo sa illicit cigarettes sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The BIR conducted at least 141 raids on illegal vapor products and three on illicit cigarettes last year.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Finance Secretary Ralph Recto nga nagakadulaan ang gobyerno sang P52 billion sa revenues bangud sa tobacco and vape smuggling.
english: Earlier, Finance Secretary Ralph Recto said the government is losing P52 billion in revenues due to tobacco and vape smuggling.

text: Nahatagan sang medical assistance ang Philippine Red Cross sa 401 ka mga deboto kadungan sang nagapadayon nga Traslacion sa Manila.
english: The Philippine Red Cross provided medical assistance to 401 devotees during the ongoing Traslacion in Manila.

text: Sa ala-1:00 sang hapon nga report, ginpahayag sang Philippine Red Cross nga sa kabug-usan nga pasyente, 15 na ang na-ospital bangud sa nausea, chest pain, deviated nose, dislocated shoulder, nose bleeding, pain sa left ankle, nabudlayan magginhawa, chills, kag back pain.
english: As of 1:00 pm, the Philippine Red Cross said that of the total number of patients, 15 have been hospitalized due to nausea, chest pain, deviated nose, dislocated shoulder, nose bleeding, pain in the left ankle, difficulty breathing, chills, and back pain.

text: May kabug-usan nga 215 ka mga deboto ang nagreklamo sang minor concerns pareho sang abrasion, puncture, neck pain, avulsion, burn, hyperacidity, dizziness, laceration, headache, open wound, ingrown mail pain, detached nail, difficulty of breathing, contusion, sprain, kag sore throat.
english: A total of 215 devotees complained of minor concerns such as abrasion, puncture, neck pain, avulsion, burn, hyperacidity, dizziness, laceration, headache, open wound, ingrown mail pain, detached nail, difficulty of breathing, contusion, sprain, and sore throat.

text: Sa dimagkubos walo ka mga deboto ang nagreport sang dalagku nga mga kabalaka pareho sang pagkalipong nga may indi maathag nga panan-awan, kasukaon, kaluya sang lawas, kag kabudlayan sa pagginhawa.
english: At least eight devotees reported major concerns such as dizziness with blurred vision, nausea, body weakness, and difficulty breathing.

text: Samtang, 150 ka mga deboto ang ginpa-check ang vital signs.
english: Meanwhile, 150 devotees were checked for vital signs.

text: Una diri, ginpahayag sang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) nga tatlo ang ginhatagan sang atensyon medikal matapos nga napilasan sa tion sang Traslacion.
english: Earlier, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said three people were given medical attention after being injured during the Traslacion.

text: Ang iban sa mga deboto napilasan samtang nagatinguha nga magsaka sa andas ukon sa karwahe nga may larawan ni Jesus Nazareno.
english: Some of the devotees were injured while trying to climb the scaffold or the chariot with the image of Jesus of Nazareth.

text: As of 8 a.m. tubtub 9 a.m., 91,800 ka mga deboto ang naobserbahan nga nagapasakop sa Traslacion suno sa Simbahan sang Quiapo.
english: As of 8 a.m. to 9 a.m., 91,800 devotees were observed participating in the Traslacion according to the Church of Quiapo.

text: Samtang 25,750 pa ka mga deboto ang na-monitor sa Quiapo Church kag 1,500 sa Rizal Park.
english: Meanwhile, another 25,750 devotees were monitored at Quiapo Church and 1,500 at Rizal Park.

text: I-review sang mga pulis sa United Kingdom ang alegasyon nga ginhaboy batuk kay Prince Andrew bangud sa ginaalegar sexual abuse.
english: Police in the United Kingdom will review allegations against Prince Andrew for alleged sexual abuse.

text: Suno kay Cressida Dick, head sang Metropolitan Police sa London, i-check liwat sang kapulisan ang alegasyon matapos ini sadto gindesisyonan nga indi na pagbuksan pa para sa imbestigasyon.
english: Cressida Dick, head of the Metropolitan Police in London, said the police will check the allegation again after it was decided not to open it for further investigation.

text: Una na nga nag-file sang kaso si Virginia Giuffre sa New York sa diin iya ginpahayag nga gin-abuso siya sexual sang Duke of York sa London sang naga edad pa lamang ini sang 18 anyos.
english: Virginia Giuffre had previously filed a lawsuit in New York alleging that she was sexually abused by the Duke of York in London when she was 18 years old.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang komento si Andrew — ang ika-duha nga anak ni Queen Elizabeth — tuhoy sa kaso nga ginpasaka sa iya apang sadto, ginpanginwala na niya ang mga alegasyon sang babaye bangud wala man sila gani nakaagi kitaay.
english: So far, Andrew — Queen Elizabeth's second son — has not commented on the lawsuit against him but has since denied the woman's allegations as they have never even met.

text: Gin-untat na sang Indonesian army ang kontrobersyal nga pagpaidalom sa virginity tests sang mga kababainhan nga luyag mangin kadete.
english: The Indonesian army has stopped controversial virginity tests for women who want to become cadets.

text: Suno sa New York based Human Rights watch, ang ini nga test ang ginatawag nga “Two-finger tests” — sa diin gina-check sang doctor ang hymen sang mga babaye.
english: According to the New York based Human Rights watch, this test is called “Two-finger tests” — where the doctor checks the hymen of the women.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang military sa nasambit nga pungsod nga importante ang pagpaidalom sa amo nga test sa pagdetermina sa moralidad sang isa ka babaye.
english: Earlier, the country's military said it was important to undergo the test to determine a woman's morality.

text: Apang nanindugan ang World Health Organization nga wala sang “scientific validity” kag ang appearance sang hymen ang indi reliable indicator sang pagpakighilawas.
english: But the World Health Organization insists that there is no “scientific validity” and the appearance of the hymen is not a reliable indicator of sexual intercourse.

text: Pahayag naman ni Andika Perkasa, Indonesian army chief of staff, patas na subong ang selection process sa mga babaye kag lalaki nga luyag mangin kabahin sang Indonesian army.
english: Andika Perkasa, Indonesian army chief of staff, said the selection process is now fair for women and men who want to be part of the Indonesian army.

text: Nagdangat sa 63% ukon ginabanta 17.4 million ka mga pamilya sa Pilipinas ang nagakonsiderar sang ila kaugalingon bilang pigado.
english: As many as 63% or approximately 17.4 million families in the Philippines consider themselves poor.

text: Santo ini sa resulta sang Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey nga ginpatigayon sang Disyembre 12-18, 2024.
english: This is based on the results of the Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey conducted on December 12-18, 2024.

text: Ginapakita sini nga ang porsyento sang Self-Rated Poor Families ang nagsaka sang kuatro porsyento halin sa 59% nga na-rekord sang September 2024.
english: It shows that the percentage of Self-Rated Poor Families rose four percentage points from the 59% recorded in September 2024.

text: Suno pa sa SWS, ang resulta sang Disyembre amo na ang pinakamataas nga porsyento nga na-rekord sa sulod sang 21 ka tuig halin sang nakuha ang 64% sang November 2003.
english: According to the SWS, the December result is the highest percentage recorded in 21 years since the 64% in November 2003.

text: Sa sini nga survey, nakasaad man nga 10% ang bag-o lang nagkabig sa ila pamilya nga pigado ukon mga non-poor ukon indi pa pigado sang isa tubtub apat ka tuig ang nagligad.
english: The survey also found that 10% had recently considered their family poor or non-poor or not yet poor one to four years ago.

text: 11% naman sang Filipino families ang nagasiling nga borderline sila ukon yara sa tunga-tunga sang klasipikasyon sang pigado kag indi pigado.
english: 11% of Filipino families say they are borderline or between the classification of poor and not poor.

text: 26% naman ang nagsiling nga indi sila pigado ukon “not poor” families.
english: 26% said they were not poor or “not poor” families.

text: Mas manubo ini sa 28% nga narekord sa kaangay man nga survey sang September 2024.
english: This is lower than the 28% recorded in a similar September 2024 survey.

text: Suno sa survey firm, pinakamataas ang self-rated poverty sa Mindanao nga may 76%, ginasundan sang Visayas nga may 74%, Balance Luzon nga may 55%, kag Metro Manila nga may 51%.
english: According to the survey firm, self-rated poverty is highest in Mindanao with 76%, followed by Visayas with 74%, Balance Luzon with 55%, and Metro Manila with 51%.

text: Ini nga non-commissioned survey ang ginapatigayon sa 2,160 adults sa Balance Luzon, Metro Manila, Visayas, kag Mindanao paagi sa face-to-face interviews.
english: This non-commissioned survey is being conducted among 2,160 adults in Balance Luzon, Metro Manila, Visayas, and Mindanao through face-to-face interviews.

text: Ang sampling error margins amo ang ±2% sa national percentages, ±3% sa Balance Luzon, kag tag±5% para sa Metro Manila, Visayas, kag Mindanao.
english: The sampling error margins are ±2% in national percentages, ±3% in Balance Luzon, and each±5% for Metro Manila, Visayas, and Mindanao.

text: Matapos ang masobra isa ka dekada nga serbisyo, gin-anunsyo ni New York Governor Andrew Cuomo ang iya resignation kasunod sang sexual harassment allegations batok sa iya.
english: After more than a decade of service, New York Governor Andrew Cuomo announced his resignation following sexual harassment allegations against him.

text: Epektibo ang resignation sang gobernador matapos ang 14 ka-adlaw.
english: The governor's resignation is effective after 14 days.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Alex Vidal, direkta sa New York, 11 ka mga babaye, nga ginalakipan sang pila ka mga staff kag mga indibidwal nga wala nagatrabaho sa idalom sang iya administrasyon ang ginapahayag gin-harass ni Governor Cuomo.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Alex Vidal, live in New York, 11 women, including some staff and individuals who do not work under his administration were allegedly harassed by Governor Cuomo.

text: Kadam-an sa New York Assembly ang nag-suporta sa pagpahalin sa gobernador.
english: A majority in the New York Assembly supported the removal of the governor.

text: Pahayag ni Vidal, sa pihak sang madamo nga reklamo nga naggwa angot sa mga harrasment ukon pagpang-hurikap ni Cuomo sa madamo nga kababainhan, ginpanindugan sang gobernador nga ‘bias” kag indi patas ang kritisismo nga ginhaboy sa iya.
english: Vidal said that despite the many complaints that have come out regarding Cuomo's harassment of many women, the governor insisted that the criticism thrown at him is biased and unfair.

text:
Nahibaluan nga 2010 sang nagdaog bilang gobernador si Coumo sa diin nalakip pa ang iya pangalan sang amo man nga tuig sa ‘People’s Sexiest Men Alive.’

Sang 2011, ginduso niya ang pagpasar sang same-sex marriage sa New York state, nga amo ang ginakabig sang gobernador bilang isa ka greatest accomplishment.
english:
It is known that Coumo won the governor's race in 2010 and his name was included in the same year in the 'People's Sexiest Men Alive.'

In 2011, he pushed for the passage of same-sex marriage in New York state, which the governor regards as a greatest accomplishment.

text: Naghalin na ang monster ship sang China Coast Guard (CCG) sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Zambales apang may nagbulos nga isa na naman ka Chinese ship.
english: The monster ship of the China Coast Guard (CCG) has left the waters of Zambales but was replaced by another Chinese ship.

text: Kahapon, Enero 8, sang nag-amat-amat biya ang CCG vessel 5901 nga amo ang pinakadaku nga Coast Guard vessel sa kalibutan.
english: Yesterday, January 8, when CCG vessel 5901, the largest Coast Guard vessel in the world, slowly left.

text: Suno sa Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), ulihi ini nga nakit-an sa kalayuon nga 90 nautical miles halin sa shoreline matapos ang apat ka adlaw nga pagtinir sa area nga 60 nautical miles ang distansya halin sa baybayon sang Zambales.
english: According to the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), it was last spotted 90 nautical miles from the shoreline after four days in an area 60 nautical miles from the coast of Zambales.

text: Inoras pa lang ang nakaligad, nag-abot ang isa na naman ka barko sang China nga CCG-3103 nga ginpadala sang Beijing halin sa Guangdong Province.
english: Just hours later, another Chinese ship, CCG-3103, sent by Beijing from Guangdong Province, arrived.

text: Nagposisyon ini 60 nautical miles halin sa Pandaquit, Zambales nga amo man ang area nga nabakante sang naghalin ang monster ship.
english: It positioned itself 60 nautical miles from Pandaquit, Zambales which is the same area that was vacated when the monster ship left.

text: Suno kay PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela, nagapati sila nga ginbulos ini sang China para masustiner ang ila iligal nga presensya sa sulod sang exclusive economic zone sang Pilipinas.
english: PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela said they believe China took advantage of this to sustain its illegal presence within the Philippines' exclusive economic zone.

text: Nagkadto naman ang PCG Islander aircraft para makumpirma ang presensya sang bag-o nga barko kag sunod man nga ginpadala ang PCG vessel BRP Cabra agud ma-monitor kag maradyuhan ang barko bangud sa paglapas sa sovereign rights sang Manila.
english: The PCG Islander aircraft went to confirm the presence of the new ship and the PCG vessel BRP Cabra was sent to monitor and radio the ship for violating Manila's sovereign rights.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga presensya sang monster ship kag isa pa ka barko ang kasunod man sang December 4 incident kun sa diin sa una nga bes, may duha ka Chinese warships (People’s Liberation Army Navy vessels) nga nagbalabag kag nag-ikog sa barko sang PCG sa Scarborough Shoal (Bajo de Masinloc).
english: The presence of the monster ship and another ship follows the December 4 incident where for the first time, two Chinese warships (People's Liberation Army Navy vessels) blocked and tailed the PCG ship in Scarborough Shoal (Bajo de Masinloc).

text: Nakakuha ang mga Italian police sang isa ka sobre nga may unod nga tatlo ka mga bala sang armas nga naka-address para kay Pope Francis.
english: Italian police recovered an envelope containing three rounds of ammunition addressed to Pope Francis.

text: Ang nakakita sang sobre sa Peschiera Borromeo sa Milan amo ang mga postal workers sa diin dali-dali nila nga gintawgan ang pulis.
english: The envelope was found at the Peschiera Borromeo in Milan by postal workers who immediately called the police.

text: Suno sa pulis, ang sobre ang nagikan sa France kag naka-address sa Santo Papa sa diin nakasulat ang “The Pope, Vatican City, St.
english: According to police, the envelope came from France and was addressed to the Pope with the words “The Pope, Vatican City, St.

text:
Peter’s Square.”

Sa subong, wala pa nakapaguwa sang pahayag ang Vatican tuhoy diri.
english:
Peter’s Square.”

So far, the Vatican has not issued a statement on the matter.

text: Bisan paborito mo pa ang isa ka putahe, siguro masum-udan ka man kun amo lang sini ang imo ginakaon sa sulod sang isa ka semana, indi bala?
english: Even if a dish is your favorite, you'll probably get bored if you eat it for a week, right?

text: Mas masum-od pa gid guro kun sa fast-food restaurant mo ini ginakaon adlaw-adlaw.
english: It's probably even more delicious if you eat it every day at a fast-food restaurant.

text: Dali lang kay mabilib ka sa sining isa ka lalaki didto sa California bangud 153 ka adlaw siya nga nagkaon sang salad sa isa lang ka restaurant!!
english: Come on, you'll be impressed by this one guy in California because he ate salad in one restaurant for 153 days!!

text: Suno kay Ben Boyles, kada Domingo lang siya nagalaktaw sa pagkaon sa restaurant bangud sirado ini.
english: Ben Boyles said he only skipped meals at the restaurant every Sunday because it was closed.

text: Kun kaisa, sa sulod sang isa ka adlaw, makaduha ka beses pa siya nga nagakaon sang salad.
english: Sometimes, in a day, he eats a salad twice.

text: Pero indi lang indi pagusto-gusto.
english: But it's not just reluctance.

text: Naghimo sang deal si Boyles sa tag-iya sang restaurant nga kun malapawan niya ang rekord sang iban nga diners, buligan siya sini nga magdonar sang kwarta sa charity.
english: Boyles made a deal with the restaurant owner that if he beat the record of the other diners, he would help him donate money to charity.

text: Pagkatapos sang 153 ka adlaw nga pagkaon sang salad, nakatipon si Boyles sang $15,300 ukon kapin 775,000 pesos kag iya ini gindonate sa Victory Family Services.
english: After 153 days of eating salad, Boyles raised $15,300 or more than 775,000 pesos and donated it to Victory Family Services.

text: Diri nagatinir ang mga kabataan nga naka-custody kag makabulig ang kwarta ni Boyles agud nga ma-treat ang mga bata sa amusement park ukon mabaklan sang ila paborito nga pagkaon.
english: The children in custody stay here and Boyles' money can help treat the children to the amusement park or buy them their favorite food.

text: Nagpapahayag ng pagnanais na umuwi sa kanilang tahanan si Chief Presidential Legal Counsel at dating Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile, ayon kay dating Senador Gregorio “Gringo” Honasan.
english: Chief Presidential Legal Counsel and former Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile is expressing his desire to return home, according to former Senator Gregorio “Gringo” Honasan.

text: Ayon kay Honasan, ayaw na raw ni Enrile na manatili pa sa ospital sa kabila ng kanyang kasalukuyang kalagayan.
english: According to Honasan, Enrile does not want to stay in the hospital despite his current condition.

text: Sa ngayon, nananatili pa rin ang 101-taong-gulang na opisyal sa Intensive Care Unit (ICU) dahil sa pneumonia.
english: The 101-year-old official is still in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) due to pneumonia.

text: Dagdag pa ni Honasan, patuloy na binabantayan ng pamilya at mga doktor ang kondisyon ni Enrile.
english: Honasan added that Enrile's family and doctors are continuing to monitor his condition.

text: Matatandaang noong nakaraang Martes, ibinahagi ng anak nitong si Katrina Ponce Enrile na kritikal ang lagay ng dating Senate President.
english: Last Tuesday, his daughter Katrina Ponce Enrile shared that the former Senate President's condition is critical.

text: Ayon naman kay Sen.
english: According to Sen.

text: Jinggoy Estrada, “slim” o maliit na lamang ang posibilidad ng kanyang paggaling.
english: Jinggoy Estrada, “slim” or little chance of his recovery.

text: Kahapon, pinangunahan ni Sen.
english: Yesterday, led by Sen.

text: Joel Villanueva ang isang panalangin sa Senado para sa paggaling ni Enrile.
english: Joel Villanueva offered a blessing in the Senate for Enrile's recovery.

text: Si Enrile ay kilala bilang isa sa mga pinakamatagal na nagsilbi sa pamahalaan, mula sa pagiging Defense Minister noong panahon ng Martial Law, hanggang sa pagiging Senate President at kalaunan ay Chief Presidential Legal Counsel ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Enrile is known as one of the longest serving government officials, from being Defense Minister during Martial Law, to being Senate President and later Chief Presidential Legal Counsel to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Madamo gid ang natandog sa istorya sang kapid nga naseparar man sa madugay nga tion, apang nagapabilin nga pareho ang pila sa ila adbokasiya kag mangin ang ila nalab-ot nga kadalag-an sa lamharon pa lamang nga edad.
english: Many were touched by the story of the twins who were also separated for a long time, but remained the same in some of their advocacy and even the success they achieved at a young age.

text: Ini amo sanday Audrey Doering kag Gracie Rainsberry, pareho nga halin sa China, kag pareho nga gin-adoptar sang separado nga pamilya halin sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: These are Audrey Doering and Gracie Rainsberry, both from China, and both adopted by separate families from the United States of America.

text: 15 ka bulan pa lamang ang duha sang sila ang gin-adopt sang summer sang 2007.
english: The two were only 15 months old when they were adopted in the summer of 2007.

text: Sang amo nga tion, pareho man sanday Audrey kag Gracie nga nag-suprer sang balatian sa korason kag sang nag-abot sa US, pareho man sila nga nagpaidalom sa heart surgeries.
english: At the time, both Audrey and Gracie also suffered from heart disease and upon arriving in the US, both underwent heart surgeries.

text: Isa ka dekada pa ang nagligad sang nangin interesado ang nag-adopt kay Audrey nga usisaon ang nagligad sang iya bata, kag didto sini nahibaluan nga may kapid gali ini nga si Gracie.
english: Another decade passed when Audrey's adopter became interested in investigating her daughter's past, and it was there that she learned that she had a twin daughter, Gracie.

text: Sa dalayon sini nga pagpangita, natultulan sini nga sa US man na-adopt si Gracie apang lain-lain ang ila nga states.
english: In his continuous search, he found that Gracie was also adopted in the US but they are in different states.

text: Una nga nagkit-anay sanday Audrey kag Gracie sang naga-edad sila sang 10 ka tuig kag pareho sila nga emosyonal.
english: Audrey and Gracie first met when they were 10 years old and both were emotional.

text: Halin sadto, nagakitaay na sila sang duha ka beses sa kada tuig ilabi na sa ila birthday kag byahe pakadto sa iban nga pungsod kag paagi diri, napabilin na ang ila bond apisar separado ang ila ginapaulian nga pamilya.
english: Since then, they have been seeing each other twice a year especially on their birthdays and trips to other countries and through this, they have maintained their bond despite their separate families.

text: Subong, naga-edad na ang duha sang 18-anyos kag pareho man nga valedictorians sa ila tagsa ka high school classes.
english: The two are now 18-years-old and are both valedictorians in their respective high school classes.

text: Nagbyahe si Gracie halin sa ila balay sa Washington pakadto sa Wisconsin agud maglantaw sa graduation ni Audrey kag amo man sini ang plano ni Audrey kun si Gracie naman ang maga-graduate.
english: Gracie traveled from her home in Washington to Wisconsin to watch Audrey's graduation and Audrey plans to do the same when Gracie graduates.

text: Pareho man ang duha nga suod sa American Heart Association nga “Hearts on the Hill Fly In” bilang suporta sa organisasyon nga nagabulig sa kaangay nila nga may balatian sa korason.
english: Both are also close to the American Heart Association’s “Hearts on the Hill Fly In” in support of the organization that helps others with heart disease.

text: Daku man nga tikang ang himuon sang duha bangud updan nila ang supporters sang nonprofit agud iduso sa Kongreso sa US nga magpasar sang polisa para mabuligan ang mga estudyante, staff kag mga bisita sa mga eskwelahan nga mangin preparado pananglitan may matabo nga mga cardiac emergency.
english: The two will also take a big step as they will join supporters of the nonprofit to push the US Congress to pass a policy to help students, staff and visitors to schools be prepared in case of cardiac emergencies.

text:
Mahimo matapna ang severe nga balatian sa mata pinaagi sa pagkaon sang mga utanon nga manggaranon sa lutein kag Vitamin A.

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Karen Francia, isa ka Opthalmologist, iya ginpahayag nga nagakadapat nga indi pagpabay-an ang mga mata bangud naga-angkon man ini sang balatian kag posible nga maguba kun indi pagtipigan kag hatagan sang igtalupangod.
english:
Severe eye disease can be prevented by eating vegetables rich in lutein and Vitamin A.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Karen Francia, an Ophthalmologist, said that the eyes should not be neglected because they also suffer from diseases and can be damaged if not maintained and given attention.

text:
Suno kay Francia, agud makalikaw sa mga seryoso kag severe nga balatian sa mata kaangay sang glaucoma, diabetic eye disease kag catarata, mahimo sundon ang mga masunod:

Dugang nga abiso sang doktor, mas maayo nga ipahuway sang masami ang mga mata kun may tinion kag magtulog sa sulod sang pito tubtob walo ka oras adlaw-adlaw.
english:
According to Francia, to avoid serious and severe eye diseases such as glaucoma, diabetic eye disease and cataracts, the following can be followed:

The doctor added that it is better to rest your eyes often when you have time and sleep for seven to eight hours a day.

text: Kumpyansa ang Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) nga wala sang suspension nga idagdag batok kay Justin Brownlee kag makaupod gihapon ini sa hampang sang Gilas Pilipinas sa FIBA Asia Cup sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: The Philippine Basketball Association (SBP) is confident that no suspension will be added against Justin Brownlee and he will still be able to participate in the Gilas Pilipinas match in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni SBP president Al Panlilio apisar sang reports nga nagpositibo liwat si Brownlee sa isa ka ginadumilian nga substance nga amo na ang ikaduha nga tion sa sulod sang duha ka tuig.
english: SBP president Al Panlilio said this despite reports that Brownlee tested positive again for a banned substance for the second time in two years.

text: Sang damlag lang sang nabaton sang naturalized star ang notice sang adverse analytical finding.
english: It was only recently that the naturalized star received notice of the adverse analytical finding.

text: Suno sa World Anti-Doping Agency, isa ini ka report nga naga-identify sang presensya sang prohibited substance ukon ang iya metabolites sa sample sang isa ka player.
english: According to the World Anti-Doping Agency, it is a report that identifies the presence of a prohibited substance or its metabolites in a player’s sample.

text: Apang suno kay Panlilio, may yara sang therapeutic exemption for medicinal purposes si Brownlee kun sa diin nakasaad sa sini nga exemption ang lebel sang marijuana nga dapat makit-an sa dugo kag indi dapat maglapaw diri ang makit-an sa sample.
english: However, Panlilio said Brownlee has a therapeutic exemption for medicinal purposes which stipulates the level of marijuana that should be found in the blood and should not exceed that found in the sample.

text: Gin-athag sini nga inisyal pa lang nga report ang iya nabaton kag wala pa sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon.
english: He explained that he received only initial reports and no official confirmation.

text: Matandaan nga sang nakuha sang Pilipinas ang maragtason nga gold medal sa Asian Games sa China sang 2023, nagpanguna man sa team si Brownlee apang nagpositibo man ini sa Carboxy-THC nga isa ka prohibited substance nga naangot sa cannabis rason nga gindagdagan siya sang tatlo ka bulan nga suspension.
english: When the Philippines won the historic gold medal at the Asian Games in China in 2023, Brownlee also led the team but also tested positive for Carboxy-THC, a prohibited substance linked to cannabis, which led to an additional three-month suspension.

text: Magluwas sa isyu sa iligal nga substance, isa man sa ginaatubang sang 37-anyos nga player amo ang injuries sa iya tudlo kasunod sang PBA Commissioner s Cup finals sang Marso.
english: Aside from the illegal substance issue, the 37-year-old is also facing injuries to his finger following the PBA Commissioner's Cup finals in March.

text: Siya ang ginasaligan sa Gilas ilabi na bangud sigurado na nga indi makahampang ang big man nga si Kai Sotto bangud sa injury.
english: He is the most reliable in the Gilas especially since it is certain that big man Kai Sotto will not be able to play due to injury.

text: Sa Asia Cup sa Agusto, nagtupa ang Pilipinas sa Group D kun sa diin makaatubang sini ang New Zealand, Chinese Taipei, kag Iraq.
english: In the Asia Cup in August, the Philippines dropped to Group D where they will face New Zealand, Chinese Taipei, and Iraq.

text: ISA AKO sa madamo nga nadulaan sing trabaho tungod sa COVID-19 pandemic sugod sadtong Abril 2020.
english: I AM one of the many who have lost their jobs because of the COVID-19 pandemic since April 2020.

text: Natabo ini sang manira ang semanal nga English weekly, sa diin naga-part-time online editing ako, tungod halos wala na sing nagasulod nga advertisement, nga amo lang ang ginapangabuhian sini.
english: This happened when the weekly English weekly, where I was doing part-time online editing, closed down, because there was almost no advertising coming in, which was its only source of income.

text: Syempre nadula man ang akon ginakita diri.
english: Of course I lost my income here.

text: Pero wala na ako nangayu pa sing separation pay tungod pigado man ining akon gina-trabahuan.
english: But I didn't ask for separation pay because my job is poor.

text: Okey lang kay may iban pa man ako nga source, although pang-survival lang kag pangbakal sang akon mga bulong.
english: It's okay because I have another source, although it's just for survival and buying my medicines.

text: Salamat man kay ang gamay nga mahanda namon sa kapanganakan sang aton Manunubos nga si Hesukristo igakalipay man gihapon Niya, nga wala sing kulang sa iya pagtamod sa pagtililipon namon sa amo nga okasyon.
english: Thank you also that the little we can prepare for the birth of our Savior Jesus Christ will still be pleasing to Him, who has nothing less in His view of our gathering on that occasion.

text: Malipayon nga Paskwa sa tanan!
english: Merry Christmas to all!

text:
***

Samtang nagalanog na ang mga balita nga pwede na tagaan sing otorisasyon ang madamo nga mga manufacturer sa paghatag sang COVID-19 vaccine, ang problema na lang kon diin makakuha sining bakuna.
english:
***

As news circulates that more manufacturers may be authorized to provide the COVID-19 vaccine, the problem is where to get the vaccine.

text: May yara na ang Pfizer sang United Kingdom, ang Chinese vaccine, Sputnik V sang Rusya, kag iban pa nga pwede na ma-commercialize, ukon mabakal, ukon maangkon sing libre halin sa World Health Organization para sa mga kubos.
english: There is already the United Kingdom's Pfizer, the Chinese vaccine, Russia's Sputnik V, and others that can be commercialized, or bought, or acquired for free from the World Health Organization for the poor.

text: Ugaling, ining otorisasyon isa lang ka Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) tungod indi pa sapat ang kadamuon sang mga subject sa Clinical 3, ang final nga bahin sang experimento,  although pwede na ini ipatuman tungod sa maka-alarma na nga sitwasyon sang pagpang-atake sang COVID-19.
english: However, this authorization is only an Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) because the number of subjects in Clinical 3, the final phase of the experiment, is not yet sufficient, although it can be implemented due to the alarming situation of the COVID-19 outbreak.

text: Sa kaso sang Pfizer vaccine sang United Kingdom (Great Britain), por ejemplo, mga 40,000 pa lang ang ila natestingan nga madinalag-on, nga kon may problema pa nahandaan man sini base sa ila experiencia sa nagliligad nga mga vaccine sa iban nga balatian sang ila pumuluyo.
english: In the case of the Pfizer vaccine of the United Kingdom (Great Britain), for example, they have only tested about 40,000 successfully, which if there are problems is also prepared based on their experience with previous vaccines against other diseases of their population.

text: Ang dugang nga pag-experimento sini sa sulod pa sang dugang nga anom ka bulan, sunu sa mga siyentipiko, pwede na maka-confirm nga lubos na nga “effective and safe” ang bakuna sini.
english: Further experimentation for another six months, according to scientists, could confirm that the vaccine is fully “effective and safe”.

text: Samtang, nahibal-an man nga ang China kag Russia may EUA na sang ila FDA agud mangbakuna.
english: Meanwhile, it is also known that China and Russia already have EUAs from their FDA to vaccinate.

text:
***

Siyempre pa indi ang tanan ang may lubos nga pagsalig sa pagpabakuna.
english:
***

Of course not everyone is completely confident in getting vaccinated.

text: Una, tungod gani nga EUA pa lang ang nauyatan nila nga otorisasyon.
english: First, because they only have EUA authorization.

text: Kag, ikaduha, tungod man sa credibilidad sang mga manufacturer.
english: And, secondly, also because of the credibility of the manufacturers.

text: Indi man malikawan nga iangot diri ang pulitika kag economic interest sang mga nasyon kon sa diin sila makakuha sining bakuna.
english: It is also inevitable that the political and economic interest of the countries from which they will obtain this vaccine will be linked to this.

text: Ang United States kag Canada nagpahibalo na nga makuha sila sang bakuna sa ila kaalyado nga United Kingdom sa Free World, samtang naghulat pa sila sang ila EUA.
english: The United States and Canada have already announced that they will get the vaccine from their ally the United Kingdom in the Free World, while they still waited for their EUA.

text: Ang iban, sa kaalyado man nila sa Komunista nga mga pungsod.
english: Others, even to their allies in Communist countries.

text: Ang pila naman ka mga pungsod luyag lang mag-co-exist sa iban nga pungsod nga wala nagapasin-o kon ano ang pamulitika ukon ideolohiya sini, ukon bisan pa may conflicto sa iban nga interes.
english: Other countries simply want to co-exist with other countries regardless of their politics or ideology, or even if there is a conflict of interest.

text: Nothing personal, negosyo lang.
english: Nothing personal, just business.

text:
“Kon diin makabakal sing bakuna, okey lang!”

Si Presidente Duterte, nga sosyalista (apang indi komunista), may pasalig na nga makakuha ang Filipinas sing bakuna sa China kag Russia.
english:
“Where to buy a vaccine, it's fine!”

President Duterte, who is a socialist (but not a communist), has already assured that the Philippines will get vaccines from China and Russia.

text: Pwede man kuno sa pila ka pungsod sa Free World, katulad sang UK.
english: It is also possible in some countries in the Free World, such as the UK.

text: Ano naman ayhan ang luyag matabo sang mga political opposition?
english: What do the political opposition want to happen?

text: Gapati kita nga indi luyag sang political opposition nga magkuha sing bakuna sa China.
english: We believe that the political opposition does not want to get vaccines from China.

text: Una, tungod sa record sang China sa ila substandard nga mga produkto, nga basi amo man sina ang klase sang bakuna sini.
english: First, because of China's record with their substandard products, that might be the case with its vaccine.

text: Ikaduha, importante sa Demokrasya nga may alternative position ang political opposition agud malikawan nga matuga ang diktadurya.
english: Second, it is important for democracy that the political opposition has an alternative position to avoid creating a dictatorship.

text: Tungod identified na gid man sila sa pamulitika ni anay Presidente Cory Aquino nga maki-Kano, nagapati ako nga ang maki-Kano nga position ang ila tindugan.
english: Since they are already identified with the pro-Kano politics of former President Cory Aquino, I believe that they will stand for the pro-Kano position.

text: Wala man sing pwersa pulitikal nga makuha ang grupo ni VP Robredo sa tulod-butong (ambivalent) nga foreign policy ni Presidente Duterte, kundi sa solido lang nga panindugan sang United States kag sang iya kaaalyado sa Free World angot sa interes sang Filipinas sa South China Sea kag sa isyu sang human rights sa pungsod.
english: VP Robredo's group has no political force to draw from President Duterte's ambivalent foreign policy, but only from the solid position of the United States and its allies in the Free World regarding the Philippines' interest in the South China Sea and the issue of human rights in the country.

text: Gani, gapati kita nga kon sila lang ang pamangkuton luyag nila palabihon ang pagkuha sang bakuna sa United Kingdom, sa US kag Canada, kag wala bisan isa ka bakuna sa China, nga kaaway sang United States kag sang iya kaalyado.
english: Therefore, we believe that if they were asked alone they would prefer to get the vaccine in the United Kingdom, in the US and Canada, and not a single vaccine in China, which is an enemy of the United States and its allies.

text: Ano abe sa inyo?/PN
english: What do you think?/PN

text: Pursigido nga nagpadulong sa Estados Unidos ang isa ka Ilonggo teacher agud mapamatud-an sa kaugalingon nga bisan diin man siya makalab-ot, wala sang pagpanghangkat nga indi niya masarangan.
english: An Ilonggo teacher is determined to go to the United States to prove to herself that no matter where she goes, there is no challenge she cannot overcome.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay John Andy Selibio, isa ka special education teacher direkta sa New York City, USA, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa iya madamo nga teaching experience sa Iloilo, wala siya ginbudlayan nga makatrabaho sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, John Andy Selibio, a special education teacher directly in New York City, USA, said that because of his extensive teaching experience in Iloilo, he did not find it difficult to work abroad.

text: Sa sulod sang pila ka-tuig, nakatudlo si Selibio sa pila ka elementary school kag university sa Iloilo.
english: Over the years, Selibio taught at several elementary schools and universities in Iloilo.

text: Suno sa iya, bag-o siya nangin isa ka Special Education Teacher sa New York, una siya nagpadulong nga nagaisahanon sa North Carolina agud magtudlo kag magkabuhi nga independent.
english: She said before she became a Special Education Teacher in New York, she first went alone to North Carolina to teach and live independently.

text: Sa subong, tatlo na ka-tuig nga nagatrabaho bilang manunudlo si Selibio sa New York City kag humalin sang naglupok ang pandemya, nagapasalamat siya nga wala man naapektuhan ang iya trabaho sa diin nagapadayon ang iya pagtudlo via online kun sa tion nga may lockdown nga ipatuman.
english: Currently, Selibio has been working as a teacher in New York City for three years and since the outbreak of the pandemic, he is grateful that his job has not been affected where he continues to teach via online in case of lockdown.

text: Nagbanggi-anay sang mga mainit tinaga nga “disrespectful” kag “unethical” si Mayor Jerry Treñas kag Iloilo City District Engineering Office Head Engineer Roy Pacanan bangud sa ginapasuni delayed nga drainage project sa JM Basa Street, Iloilo City Proper.
english: Mayor Jerry Treñas and Iloilo City District Engineering Office Head Engineer Roy Pacanan exchanged hot words “disrespectful” and “unethical” over the alleged delayed drainage project in JM Basa Street, Iloilo City Proper.

text: Santo sa sulat ni Engineer Roy Pacanan, ginapanindugan sini nga sugod sang gindeklarar siya nga persona non grata ni Treñas, lunsay ‘personal’ na ang mga ginahaboy nga akusasyon sang alkalde kag sa iya nga opisina.
english: According to Engineer Roy Pacanan's letter, he insists that since he was declared persona non grata by Treñas, the accusations thrown by the mayor and his office are all personal.

text: Ginpat-od man ni Pacanan nga ginpabuyan-buyanan lang sang city government ang ila requests nga masuguran na kontani ang drainage project paagi sa meeting sang nagligad nga Prebrero, kon sa diin, Septyembre na sang nakabaton sila sang sabat.
english: Pacanan also confirmed that the city government ignored their requests to start the drainage project through a meeting last February, where they received a response in September.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang natungdan nga nagpasalig ang ila opisina nga matapos ang proyekto sa Disyembre 13, baliskad sa ginpahayag sang alkalde.
english: He also denied that his office promised to complete the project by December 13, contrary to the mayor's statement.

text: Sa pahayag naman nga ginpaguwa ni Mayor Treñas, nagagawa nga nanghugas sang ila kamot ang opisina ni Engineer Roy Pacanan sa kon sin-o ang dapat basulon sa natuga nga perwisyo sa drainage project.
english: In a statement issued by Mayor Treñas, it appears that the office of Engineer Roy Pacanan washed their hands of who should be blamed for the damage caused to the drainage project.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Treñas nga natukiban nga wala nakakuha sang pila ka permits ang proyekto sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office, bagay nga gintawag sini si Pacanan nga “disrespectful kag unethical” bangud sa kakulangan sini sa pagkumpleto sang mga requirements.
english: Treñas also revealed that it was discovered that the project did not obtain several permits from the Iloilo City District Engineering Office, which he called Pacanan “disrespectful and unethical” for his failure to complete the requirements.

text: Nagapati man ang alkalde nga ginapalayo lang sang District Engineering Office ang isyu sa delayed nga proyekto nga nagtuga sang huol sa trapiko kag vendors paagi sa paghaboy sang basol sa city government.
english: The mayor also believes that the District Engineering Office is just distancing the issue of the delayed project that caused inconvenience to traffic and vendors by blaming the city government.

text: Dako nga pasensya kag pagtinguha ang nagdala sa isa ka Pinay Parlorista sa iya handom nga mangin nurse kag subong supervisor na sa Spain.
english: Great patience and perseverance brought a Filipina Parlorista to her dream of becoming a nurse and now a supervisor in Spain.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maria Edzel Lamparero-Lopez, isa ka Overseas Filipino Worker direkta sa Madrid sa Espanya, iya ginpahayag nga indi nangin mahapos ang iya gintaris nga dalanon agud makapadulong sa iya ginatindugan subong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Maria Edzel Lamparero-Lopez, an Overseas Filipino Worker directly in Madrid, Spain, said that the path she has taken to get to where she is now has not been easy.

text: Graduate na sa kurso nga nurse si Lopez sang nag-apas siya sang 2004 sa pungsod Spain sa iya mga ginikanan nga nagatrabaho bilang domestic helper.
english: Lopez was a graduate of nursing when she joined her parents in Spain in 2004 who worked as domestic helpers.

text: Suno kay Lopez, wala siya gilayon nangin isa ka nurse sa nasambit nga pungsod bangud required nga tun-an ang lenggwahe kag pasaron ang isa ka-tuig nga nursing course agud makakuha sang new recognized diploma.
english: According to Lopez, she did not immediately become a nurse in the country because she was required to learn the language and pass a one-year nursing course to obtain a newly recognized diploma.

text: Apang sa baylo nga magparalisa ini sa iya, gingamit ni Lopez ang mga libre nga tinion sa pagtrabaho sa isa ka Parlor kun sa diin niya nabubo ang iya abilidad sa paggunting sang buhok sa ulo kag pagpang-make-up samtang nagadalagan gihapon sa paglab-ot sang iya handom nga mangin isa ka nurse.
english: But instead of letting it paralyze her, Lopez used the free moments to work in a Parlor where she poured her haircutting and make-up skills while still running to achieve her dream of becoming a nurse.

text: 2013 na sang nalab-ot niya ang iya handom, kag sang nagligad nga tuig, na-promote siya bilang nursing supervisor bangud sa iya masangkad nga performance sa trabaho.
english: It was 2013 when she achieved her goal, and last year, she was promoted to nursing supervisor due to her strong work performance.

text: Sang naglupok naman ang pandemya kag ginakulang sang madamo nga nurse ang ospital nga ginatrabahuan ni Lopez, indi magnubo sa 20 ang iya ginbuligan nga mapasulod sa trabaho nga kaangay niya sadto, nagahandom man nga mangin isa ka registered nurse.
english: When the pandemic broke out and the hospital where Lopez worked was short of nurses, she helped at least 20 people who, like her, dreamed of becoming registered nurses.

text: Ginpamatud-an ni Lopez nga sa paglab-ot sang handom, indi ang kadasigon ang talaksan, kundi ang batasan kag pagkatawo sang isa ka indibidwal samtang nagadalagan padulong sa iya kadalag-an.
english: Lopez proved that in achieving the dream, it is not speed that is the criterion, but the attitude and personality of an individual while running towards his success.

text: Linibo nga mga turista kag residente ang nag-evacuate sa naaminhan nga bahin sang Greece samtang nagapadayon ang wildfire sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: Thousands of tourists and residents have evacuated northern Greece as wildfires continue in the country.

text: Nangin mabudlay ang pagkontrol sang kalayo bangud sa mabaskog nga hangin kag mataas nga temperatura sa diin duha na ka tawo ang patay lakip diri ang isa ka bombero.
english: The fire was difficult to control due to strong winds and high temperatures, killing two people, including a firefighter.

text: Mangin ang mga pumuluyo sa Athens ang naghalin naman sa ila mga balay bangud sa madamol nga aso.
english: Even residents in Athens left their homes because of the thick smoke.

text: Masobra 150 ang sunog nga nagakatabo subong sa Greece sa diin anom ka lugar ang ginbutang na sa high alert.
english: More than 150 fires are currently raging in Greece with six areas placed on high alert.

text: Nagpadala naman sang dugang nga bombero kag eroplano ang United Kingdom, France kag Estados Unidos agud nga mabuligan ang pagpalong sang kalayo.
english: The United Kingdom, France and the United States have sent additional firefighters and aircraft to help extinguish the fire.

text: Nag-suggest si Iloilo City Councilor Johnny Young sa Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) nga kon mahimo, paagyon ang mga two and three-wheel vehicle sa Ungka Flyover.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Johnny Young suggested to the Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) that if possible, two and three-wheel vehicles be allowed to pass through the Ungka Flyover.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Young, iya ginpahayag nga nakasaad sa ordinansa sang syudad nga mahimo maka-agi ang mga motorsiklo sa flyover.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Young said the city ordinance states that motorcycles can pass through the flyover.

text: Suno kay Young, ang flyover sa probinsya ang indi man tuman ka taas kag mlaba rason nga dapat lang ikonsiderar ang paglabay sang mga motor.
english: According to Young, the flyover in the province is not too high and long so the passage of motorcycles should be considered.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Young nga nagsunod lamang ang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) sa pagsulundan sang national kag ginpatuman diri sa local, apang para sa iya, indi ini applicable.
english: Young also said that the Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6 (DPWH 6) only followed the national guidelines and implemented them locally, but for him, it is not applicable.

text: Patay ang 17 ka tawo kag masobra 10 naman ang pilason sang gin-igo sang kilat ang wedding party nga ginahiwat sa isa ka sakayang pandagat sa northwestern Bangladesh.
english: At least 17 people were killed and more than 10 injured when lightning struck a wedding party on a boat in northwestern Bangladesh.

text: Suno sa police official nga si Farid Hossain, padulong na kuntani sa balay sang bride ang mga tawo sang gilayon nga nagkilat.
english: Police official Farid Hossain said the people were on their way to the bride's house when lightning struck.

text: Nahibaluan nga kada tuig, may yara sang ginatos ka tawo sa Bangladesh ang nagakalamatay bangud sang pagpangilat.
english: It is known that every year, there are hundreds of people in Bangladesh who die due to lightning.

text: Tuig 2016, 200 ka tawo ang napatay sa sulod lang sang bulan sang Mayo.
english: In 2016, 200 people died in the month of May alone.

text: Pahayag naman sang mga eksperto, ang lightnigh deaths ang masami nagakatabo kada bulan sang Marso tubtob Hulyo nga amo ang ginakabig nga warm months.
english: According to experts, lightnigh deaths usually occur every month from March to July which are considered warm months.

text: Base sa mga eksperto, ang pagtaas sang numero sang mga patay tuga sang pagpangilat ang may kaangtanan sa deforestation sa diin wala na sang mga matag-as nga puno sang kahoy sa palibot.
english: According to experts, the increase in the number of deaths caused by lightning is related to deforestation where there are no tall trees around.

text: Pasado na sa Iloilo City Council ang extension sang 40% nga reduction sa Real Property Tax tubtob sa 2026.
english: The Iloilo City Council has passed the extension of the 40% reduction in Real Property Tax until 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo City Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia, chairman sang Committee on Appropriations, iya ginpahayag nga indi ma-deny nga kinahanglan sang syudad nga magpasaka sang buwis bangud sa Mandanas ruling kon sa diin, ang function sang national government ang na-download sa Local Government Unit (LGU).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo City Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia, chairman of the Committee on Appropriations, said it cannot be denied that the city needs to raise taxes because of the Mandanas ruling where the function of the national government is downloaded to the Local Government Unit (LGU).

text: Bangud diri, mapilitan ang syudad nga magpangita sang sources of funds para mapondohan ang mga reponsibilidad sang local nga panguluhan.
english: Because of this, the city will be forced to find sources of funds to fund the responsibilities of the local government.

text: Gina-ako man sang natungdan nga nabatyagan man nila ang nangin reaksyon sang taxpayers ilabi na ang business community sang Iloilo City kasunod sang pagpalawig sang reduction sa Real Property Tax.
english: He also acknowledged that they have felt the reaction of taxpayers especially the business community of Iloilo City following the extension of the reduction in Real Property Tax.

text: Suno kay Sarabia, ang koleksyon sa buwis ang pabor man sa publiko bangud gamiton ini sa ila benepisyo.
english: According to Sarabia, the tax collection is also in favor of the public because it will be used for their benefit.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpatuman ang reduction sang Real Property Tax umpisa sang 2024 matapos gin-update sang syudad ang value sang mga proyedad sini.
english: The reduction of the Real Property Tax was implemented starting in 2024 after the city updated the value of its properties.

text: ILOILO – Gin-athag ni Duenas, Iloilo Mayor Robert Martin Pama nga may yara siya sang nabaton nga invitation halin sa Duenas Central Elementary School para sa Alumni Homecoming sang nagligad nga Disyembre 21.
english: ILOILO – Duenas, Iloilo Mayor Robert Martin Pama clarified that he received an invitation from Duenas Central Elementary School for the Alumni Homecoming last December 21.

text: Ini ang baliskad sa impormasyon nga naguwa nga wala gin-imbitar ang alkalde sang school principal nga si Mr. Joseph Pretal rason nga ginpahalin ini sa pwesto.
english: This is contrary to information that came out that the mayor was not invited by the school principal, Mr. Joseph Pretal causing him to be removed from office.

text: Gintinguhaan sang Bombo Radyo nga makuhaan sang sabat ang alkalde sa patas nga pagwaragwag.
english: Bombo Radyo tried to get a response from the mayor on fair broadcasting.

text: Suno kay Mayor Pama, wala ini sang ideya kun ginpahalin ukon ngaa ginpahalin ang principal.
english: Mayor Pama said he has no idea if the principal was fired or why.

text: Gin-athag sang alkalde nga wala siya naga-intra sa trabaho sang Department of Education.
english: The mayor clarified that he is not involved in the work of the Department of Education.

text: ILOILO – Nagapatigayon sang random inspection ang Philippine National Police sa mga nagabaligya sang palupok sa Western Visayas agud masiguro nga legal nga firecrackers lang ang ginabaligya.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Philippine National Police is conducting random inspections of fireworks vendors in Western Visayas to ensure that only legal firecrackers are sold.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PLt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PLt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Arnel Solis, Spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang Regional Civil Security 6 amo ang nagapatigayon sang inspeksyon sa store owners kun otorisdado kag kun may lisensya ang dealer ukon retailer sa pagbaligya sang firecrackers kag pyrotechnics.
english: Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said the Regional Civil Security 6 is conducting inspections of store owners if they are authorized and if the dealer or retailer has a license to sell firecrackers and pyrotechnics.

text: Suno kay Solis, kinahanglan nga naka-comply sang requirement ang manugbaligya sang palupok halin sa Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine National Police kag Local Government Unit.
english: According to Solis, the fireworks vendor must have complied with the requirements from the Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine National Police and Local Government Unit.

text: Sa tion nga may madakpan ang kapulisan nga nagabaligya sang illegal firecrackers, mahimo ini nga ma-confiscate sang otoridad bangud makatuga ini sang halit sa mga tawo ilabi na ang pagkapilas, pagkabulag ukon pagkabungol.
english: If the police catch someone selling illegal firecrackers, they can be confiscated by the authorities because they can cause harm to people especially injury, blindness or deafness.

text: Isa man sa hugot nga ginakampanya sang kapulisan amo ang pagdumili sa paggamit sang boga nga amo ang ginahimo nga alternatibo sang kadam-an sa pagpalupok.
english: One of the strong campaigns of the police is the ban on the use of boga which is a popular alternative to fireworks.

text: Pahayag ni Solis, naga-coordinate mismo ang Police Regional Office 6 sa mga barangay officials ilabi na sa barangay tanod sa paglibot kag pagpangita sa mga nagagamit sang boga agud makumpiska.
english: Solis said the Police Regional Office 6 is coordinating with the barangay officials especially the barangay tanod in patrolling and searching for those who use boga for confiscation.

text: Sa latest report sang Department of Health, ang boga amo ang mayor nga kabangdanan sang firecracker-related injuries sa diin naglab-ot sa 47 cases sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: According to the latest report of the Department of Health, boga is the main cause of firecracker-related injuries with 47 cases across the Philippines.

text: Sandig sa Executive Order 28 kag Republic Act 7183, nakalista ang Philippine National Police sang 28 banned firecrackers lakip na diri ang watusi, piccolo, five star, pla-pla, lolo thunder kag iban pa.
english: According to Executive Order 28 and Republic Act 7183, the Philippine National Police has listed 28 banned firecrackers including watusi, piccolo, five star, pla-pla, lolo thunder and others.

text: Panugyan sang natungdan, mas maayo nga likawan na lang ang pagpalupok sa baylo maggamit na lang sang torotot , kaldero kag iban pa sa pagsug-alaw sang bag-ong tuig.
english: He advised that it is better to avoid fireworks instead of using torotot, pots and others to welcome the new year.

text: Handa na ang Ilongga beauty queen nga tumandok sang Leon nga si Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks sa iya pagtiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Miss Eco International 2025 pageant nga patigayunon sa Egypt sa Abril 8.
english: Ilongga beauty queen Alexie Mae Caimoso Brooks is ready to represent the Philippines in the Miss Eco International 2025 pageant to be held in Egypt on April 8.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga send-off, iya ginpahayag nga tuman ang iya preparasyon para sa pageant agud nga mahatag niya ang pinakamanami nga performance.
english: During the send-off, she said that she is very well prepared for the pageant so that she can give the best performance.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Brooks, iya ginsiling nga nag-focus siya sa training para sa interview ilabi na sa iya advocacy nga nagasentro sa women empowerment nga mas kilala sa tawag nga “Abanse Babaye.”

Pahayag pa niya, handa man siya mental kag emotional nga aspeto.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Brooks said she focused on training for the interview especially on her advocacy that focuses on women empowerment better known as “Abanse Babaye.”

He said he is also ready mentally and emotionally.

text: May yara man sang mga pasabog sila nga ginhanda sang iya team.
english: They also had explosives prepared by his team.

text: Dugang niya, gamiton gid niya ang mindset bilang isa ka atleta kag ini ang ginakabig niya nga bentaha para sa iya sa kompetisyon.
english: He added that he will always use the mindset as an athlete and this is what he considers an advantage for him in the competition.

text: Ginahalad man niya ini nga journey para sa iya nagtaliwan na nga lola nga si Lola Basing kag amo man sa mga Ilonggo nga nagasuporta sa iya.
english: He also dedicates this journey to his late grandmother Lola Basing and also to the Ilonggos who support him.

text: Aminado ang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative nga dako gid ang epekto sang ‘Anti Sardinas Policy’ sa ila nga mga pasahero.
english: The Western Visayas Transport Cooperative acknowledges that the 'Anti Sardinas Policy' has had a huge impact on its passengers.

text: Ang amo nga polisa ang nagadumili nga magsobra sa passenger capacity sang isa ka pampubliko nga salakyan ang mga sakay nga pasahero.
english: The policy prohibits passengers from exceeding the passenger capacity of a public vehicle.

text: Madumduman nga mas nangin hugot ang pagpatuman sang polisa matapos nga naglapta sa social media ang video kun sa diin nagaginutok nga daw sardinas ang mga pasahero sa isa ka modernized jeepney.
english: It can be recalled that the policy was tightened after a video showing passengers crowded like sardines in a modernized jeepney spread on social media.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chair sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sa mga pasahero ang nagapamilit pa sa gihapon nga magsakay sa ila unit bisan pa nga ginadumilian na magsulod bangud man sa kakulang sang mga salakyan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative, said many of the passengers still insist on boarding their units even though they are prohibited from entering due to lack of vehicles.

text: Apang hugot man nga nagapamalibad ang mga driver kag kundoktor sa ila nga mga unit bangud man sa dako nga penalidad nga ila pagaatubangun kun sila ang madakpan.
english: However, the drivers and conductors of their units are also strongly refusing because of the heavy penalties they will face if they are caught.

text: Dugang pa ni Parcon, may ginapaabot sila nga dugang nga mga unit agud nga mahagan-hagan naman ang pagpugok sang mga pasahero ilabi na kun rush hour.
english: Parcon added that they are expecting additional units to ease the congestion of passengers especially during rush hour.

text: Ang pagbayluhanay sang “I Do” amo ang isa sa pinakamatam-is nga tion para sa magkahagugma.
english: The exchange of “I Do” is one of the sweetest moments for lovers.

text: Ginatandaan gid ang adlaw sang kasal bangud ginaselebrar ini sa kada tuig bilang tanda sang promisa sa isa kag isa nga maga-updanay sila tubtub sa katubtuban.
english: Wedding day is celebrated every year as a sign of promise to each other that they will be together forever.

text: Apang sa New York, isa ka pinasahi nga drama ang nasaksihan antes pa man mabatian ini nga mga tinaga.
english: But in New York, a unique drama was witnessed even before those words were heard.

text: Sang amo nga adlaw, gindala sa sulod sang korte si Anthony Santiago, 33, tumandok sang Cleveland, Ohio nga isa ka suspek sa pagpangawat nga natabo sang nagligad pa nga 2022.
english: Later that day, Anthony Santiago, 33, a native of Cleveland, Ohio, was brought into the courtroom as a suspect in a robbery that occurred as recently as 2022.

text: Ginpahayag nga sang amo nga tuig, nagbyahe ini sa North Syracuse agud nga magbaligya lang kuntani sang salakyan.
english: That year, he reportedly traveled to North Syracuse to sell a car.

text: Apang sang didto na siya, hinali lang nga nagkalam ang iya kamot sang may nakit-an siya nga mga marijuana sa sulod sang balay.
english: But when he got there, his hand suddenly shook when he saw marijuana inside the house.

text: Bangud indi siya mahim-os kag indi gid makatulog sa pagpanumdom sang marijuana, ginkuntyaba sini ang iya duha ka abyan sa Cleveland agud nga balikan ang balay agud nga kawatan.
english: Because he was unwell and could not sleep because of the marijuana, he persuaded two of his friends in Cleveland to go back to the house to steal.

text: Isa ka bulan ang nakaligad, bangud nahitso na ang ila plano, nagpangita sila sang maayo nga timing agud matigayon ang pagpangawat.
english: A month later, with their plan in place, they looked for good timing to carry out the robbery.

text: Gin-alegar nga ila pa gin-pistolwhip ang babaye kag lalaki nga yara sa sulod sang balay, kag ginpahayag man nga wala man nila ginsakit ang apat ka kabataan nga nagatinir sa sulod apang ila man ini ginpahog samtang ginatakab nila ang pila ka kagamitan.
english: They allegedly pistolwhipped the woman and man inside the house, and also said they did not hurt the four children who were staying inside but they also threatened them while they were stealing some equipment.

text: Pagkatapos sadto, natukiban man nga indi man ini gali first time nga naka-komiter siya sang krimen.
english: After that, it was discovered that this was not the first time he had committed a crime.

text: Isa gali ini ka serial offender kag tatlo ka beses na nga na-convict antes pa man ini naaresto sang 2022.
english: He was actually a serial offender and had three previous convictions prior to his 2022 arrest.

text: Sang sini lang nga 2023, gindagdag ni New York Judge Melina McGuinnigle ang sentensya kay Anthony nga amo ang 10 ka tuig nga pagkapreso bangud sa iya krimen nga nahimo.
english: As recently as 2023, New York Judge Melina McGuinnigle increased Anthony’s sentence to 10 years in prison for the crime he committed.

text: Apang indi amo ina ang ending para sa iya bangud nga sang amo man nga adlaw natalana ang iya kasal.
english: But that was not the ending for her as her wedding was scheduled for the same day.

text: Apisar may posas na ang iya kamot, wala nag-atras ang bride nga si Victoria kag nagpakasal ini gihapon kay Anthony.
english: Although her hands were handcuffed, the bride, Victoria, did not back down and married Anthony.

text: Wala na sang madamo nga tyempo nga nauyang bangud pila ka oras pa lang ini nga nakaguwa sa courtroom, nagbalik ini sa amo gihapon nga hulot, nag-atubang sa amo gihapon nga judge… kag sila ang ginkasal.
english: Without much time to waste because he had only been out of the courtroom for a few hours, he returned to the same room, faced the same judge... and they were married.

text: Madamo naman ang na-amaze sa sini nga “courtroom drama” bangud isa ka dekada man si Anthony nga manimuron sa presuhan, apang pagka-guwa sini, ginalauman nga yara gihapon ang babaye nga amo naman ang iya makaupod sa iya bilog nga kabuhi.
english: Many were amazed by this “courtroom drama” because Anthony will spend a decade in prison, but after his release, he is expected to still have the woman who will be with him for the rest of his life.

text: ANG selebrasyon sang Paskwa, sadto pa, isa ka malipayon, mabugana kag ginadugukan nga okasyon, labi na gid sa inadlaw nga malapit sa pagkatawo ni Hesukristo nga aton Manunubos sa Disyembre 25.
english: THE celebration of Christmas has always been a joyful, abundant and crowded occasion, especially on the day close to the birth of Jesus Christ our Redeemer on December 25.

text: Nagaalawas ang mga sumilimba sa mga simbahan.
english: Worshipers flock to churches.

text: Bisan diin may matahum nga mga talan-awon – may parol sa mga pamalay, sa mga dalanon, kag bisan sa mga kakahuyan sa plaza kag kon ano pa nga naga-ingat-ingat nga mga puni sa palibut.
english: Everywhere there are beautiful scenery – there are lanterns in the houses, in the streets, and even in the trees in the plaza and whatever other decorations are around.

text: Ang mga empleyado, sa gobyerno kag sa pribado nga palamugnan, may pamaskwa nga 13th month agud magamit sa ila pagselebrar sang Paskwa.
english: Employees, both in the government and the private sector, have a 13th month Christmas to use in their Christmas celebrations.

text: Tungod kay may dugang nga galastuhon, madamo ang mga Christmas party kag kaangay nga mga kahiwatan sa bisan diin nga lugar – sa puluy-an, sa upisina, kag sa mga pagtililipon sa madamo pa nga lugar – kon diin bugana ang pagkaon kag pampainit sang dulunggan.
english: With extra expenses, there are many Christmas parties and similar events everywhere – at home, in the office, and at gatherings in many other places – where food and ear warmers are plentiful.

text: Ang mga kabataan nagaduaw sa ila mga maninoy kag maninay nga may ara-ara agud makabaton sing regalo.
english: Children visit their aunts and uncles to receive gifts.

text: Ang mga indi makabaton sing pamaskwa kag kubos makabaton man sang pamaskwa halin sa gobyerno, mga humanitarian ukon charity group, kag sa mga indibidwal kag pamilya nga nakaluag-luag nga makahatag sing pamaskwa sa mga bululigan agud mapahalipay man sila sa ngalan ni Kristo.
english: Those who cannot afford Christmas and the poor can also receive Christmas from the government, humanitarian or charity groups, and individuals and families who are willing to give Christmas to the needy so that they too can be happy in the name of Christ.

text: Pati na ang dapat ulikdan sa ila masubo nga kahimtangan nga mga tigulang sa asilo, mga kabataan nga na-ilo sa pagtatap sang ila mga ginikanan, kag mga bilanggo nga wala man ginakalimtan ni Kristo sa iya pagpalangga kag handom nga magbag-o na sing ila kabuhi.
english: Even the elderly in asylums, children orphaned in the care of their parents, and prisoners whom Christ does not forget in his love and desire to change their lives.

text:
***

Ugaling tungod yara kita sa panahon sang COVID-19 sa karon, daku gid ang kakulangan sang aton selebrasyon sa Paskwa.
english:
***

But since we are in the time of COVID-19 now, there is a great lack of our Christmas celebration.

text: Minilyon ang nagapabilin nga wala ubra kag palangitan-an tungod sa madamo nga ginadumilian nga panghulag.
english: Millions remain unemployed and homeless because of many illegal activities.

text: Kon may nabulig man ang aton gobyerno ina lang ang masarangan man sini paagi sa Social Amelioration Program (SAP), cash-for-work, pautang, bulig sa padayon nga husto nga pagtalauma sa kaumhan, lakip na ang nahalitan sang sunod-sunod nga mga bagyo sang sining karon lang.
english: If our government has helped anyone, it can only do so through the Social Amelioration Program (SAP), cash-for-work, loans, assistance in the continued proper management of rural areas, including those affected by the recent typhoons.

text: Nahibal-an sang gobyerno kag sang mga nasablagan nga pumuluyo nga indi sapat ining til-og nga bulig sa ila.
english: The government and the affected people know that this emergency relief is not enough for them.

text: Apang kon pang-survive man lang, kay amo lang ang masarangan ta, daw wala naman sang daku gid nga reklamo ang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: But if it's just for survival, because that's all we can afford, it seems that our people don't have much complaint.

text: Isa pa, ang gina-selebrar naton amo ang pagkatawo sang aton Manunubos nga wala man sing ginapangayo kundi ang aton pagpalangga kay palangga man Niya kita.
english: Furthermore, we are celebrating the birth of our Redeemer who asks for nothing but our love because He loves us.

text: In other words, ang pagselebrar sang Paskwa yara sa tagipusuon indi sa materyal nga bagay.
english: In other words, the celebration of Christmas is in the heart not in the material things.

text: Bisan diutay man lang ang aton handa para sa Iya upod sa aton pamilya, ikalipay na ina Niya.
english: Even if we have little to give to Him with our family, it is pleasing to Him.

text: Indi ina Siya malipay sa grande nga handa kon pakulahaw man lang ang aton pagdumdum sa Iya.
english: He will not be pleased with the grand readiness if our remembrance of Him is merely a shout.

text:
***

Meantime, mag-selebrar na lang kita sa aton masarangan nga tutok sa aton panimalay, labi na gid kay kinahanglan man naton mag-amlig gihapon sa COVID-19.
english:
***

Meantime, let's celebrate as best we can at home, especially since we still need to protect ourselves from COVID-19.

text: Sa gihapon, ang panugyan sang Departmen of Health amo ang pagtuman sang minimum health protocol: pagsuksok sang face mask kag face shield, masami nga pagpanghugas sang kamot, kag physical distancing, kag ang paglikaw sa sobra nga gahod sa kadam-an, labi na gid ang kinanta sa karoake.
english: Still, the Department of Health advises to follow the minimum health protocol: wearing face masks and face shields, frequent hand washing, and physical distancing, and avoiding excessive noise in public, especially karoake singing.

text: Pero, pwede bala ang pagtililipon nga malapitan ukon wala na gani sing face mask kag face shield?
english: But, is it possible to gather close or even without face masks and face shields?

text: Wala ini na-specify sang health authorities apang ginapahangop man sini nga pwede ini sa isa ka pamilya nga madugay na naga-upod nga wala man gapakita sang sintoma sang COVID-19 – at least sa sulod sang 14 ka adlaw nga pag-upod.
english: The health authorities did not specify this but it also implies that it can be in a family that has been together for a long time without showing symptoms of COVID-19 – at least within 14 days of being together.

text: Ginapahangop man ini sang DOH sa mga nagaangkasanay sa motor nga mag-asawa ukon magkahagugma nga naga-upod sing madugay na nga wala nagapakita sing sintoma sang COVID-19.
english: The DOH also explains this to motorcyclists who are married or in love and have been together for a long time without showing symptoms of COVID-19.

text: Subong man sa kaso sang mga humalampang sa basketball sa Filipinas (PBA) kag sa US (NBA) nga ginatugtan nga wala face mask basta napamatud-an nga hilway sila sa COVID-19 sa sulod sang 14 ka adlaw sa tion sang paghampang.
english: Similarly, in the case of basketball players in the Philippines (PBA) and the US (NBA) who are allowed not to wear face masks as long as they are proven free of COVID-19 within 14 days during the game.

text: Ang gina-istriktuhan lang amo ang mga bisita kag ang pwede makapalapit sa imo nga indi mo maseguro ang ila COVID-19 status, nga kinahanglan mo mag-atubang sa ila nga may distansya kag protektado ka.
english: The only restrictions are on visitors and those who can get close to you without being able to ensure their COVID-19 status, that you must face them with distance and protection.

text: Merry Christmas kag Happy New Year in advance sa tanan!
english: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year in advance to all!

text: Basi bala makadumduman man kamo sa akon ukon ako man makadumdum sa inyo.
english: Perhaps you will remember me or I will remember you.

text: Bisan kalendaryo lang, a…he-he-he!/PN
english: Even a calendar, a...he-he-he!/PN

text: Indi makaupod ang NBA superstar nga si Stephen Curry sa Game 2 kag sa duha pa ka mga hampang sang Golden State Warriors kag Minnesota Timberwolves sa semifinal series sa Western Conference.
english: NBA superstar Stephen Curry will miss Game 2 and the other two games of the Golden State Warriors and Minnesota Timberwolves semifinal series in the Western Conference.

text: Nagaguwa sa reports nga may Grade 1 hamstring strain ang four-time NBA champion kag two-time NBA MVP.
english: The four-time NBA champion and two-time NBA MVP is reportedly suffering from a Grade 1 hamstring strain.

text: “The Golden State Warriors are planning to play without Stephen Curry for at least the next three games of their second-round series against Minnesota, after an MRI exam on Wednesday confirmed a mild strain of the star guard’s left hamstring,” suno sa NBA.
english: “The Golden State Warriors are planning to play without Stephen Curry for at least the next three games of their second-round series against Minnesota, after an MRI exam on Wednesday confirmed a mild strain of the star guard’s left hamstring,” according to the NBA.

text: Ini kasunod sang natabo sa Game 1 kun sa diin nagbiya ini sa second quarter bangud sa left hamstring strain kag wala na ini nakabalik.
english: This follows what happened in Game 1 where he left the second quarter due to a left hamstring strain and did not return.

text: Indi man tuman ka malala ang Grade 1 hamstring strain apang nagakinahanglan ini sang isa tubtub duha ka semana nga recovery.
english: The Grade 1 hamstring strain is not too serious but requires one to two weeks of recovery.

text: Apisar wala si Curry sang Game 1, nasarangan sang Warriors nga makuha ang 1-0 series lead sang nagtakop ang hampang sa skor sa 99-88.
english: Despite Curry's absence in Game 1, the Warriors were able to take a 1-0 series lead when the game ended with a score of 99-88.

text: Antes pa man ang iya nga hamstring injury, may injured nga tudlo naman ang Warriors guard sa iya mismo nga shooting hand.
english: Even before his hamstring injury, the Warriors guard had an injured finger on his own shooting hand.

text: Matabo ang Game 2 sang Wolves kag Warriors, 8:30 buwas sa aga oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Game 2 of Wolves and Warriors will take place at 8:30 am Philippine time tomorrow.

text: Kakason sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang brand labels nga nakapaskil sa imported rice sa mga merkado agud nga matapna ang ginaalegar nagakatabo nga manipulasyon sa presyo.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will remove the brand labels posted on imported rice in the markets to curb alleged price manipulation.

text: Suno kay DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., sakop sini nga plano ang “premium” kag “special” imported rice labels nga amo ang ginagamit sa pag-justify sang pagsaka sa presyo.
english: According to DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the plan covers the “premium” and “special” imported rice labels that are used to justify the price increase.

text: Sa ila pagbisita sa mga merkado suno kay Laurel, natukiban nila nga may mga retailers kag traders nga hungod nga nagapatalang sa mga manugbakal bangud ginatapikan nila sang label nga branded imports ang baligya nga bugas para nga mapahangop sa kustomer kun ngaa mataas ang presyo.
english: During their visit to the markets, Laurel said, they discovered that there are retailers and traders who deliberately mislead consumers because they label the rice sold as branded imports to explain to the customer why the price is high.

text: Suno sa tiglikom, indi nila pagdal-on ang local rice sa kakasan sang brand label agud nga maproteksyunan ang farmers kag traders.
english: The secretary said they will not bring local rice to the brand label to protect farmers and traders.

text: Disyembre 19 sang naglibot ang DA kag ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa mga mercado para sa inspeksyon.
english: On December 19, the DA and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) toured the markets for inspection.

text: Posible naman suno kay DA Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa nga umpisahan nila sa pagpatuman ang ila plano sa masunod nga tuig.
english: DA Assistant Secretary Arnel de Mesa said it is possible that they will start implementing their plan next year.

text: Ang iban pa nga plano amo ang pagpanuno sang presyo sang imported rice lakip na ang pag-invoke sang food security emergency sa idalom sang amended Rice Tariffication Law.
english: Other plans include raising the price of imported rice including invoking a food security emergency under the amended Rice Tariffication Law.

text: Paagi sa sini, matugutan ang pagguwa sang buffer stocks halin sa National Food Authority (NFA).
english: This will allow the release of buffer stocks from the National Food Authority (NFA).

text: Ginalantaw man ang possible rice importation sang Food Terminal Inc.
english: The possible rice importation of Food Terminal Inc.

text: (FTI) agud nga maka-compete sa private importers.
english: (FTI) in order to compete with private importers.

text: Balantayan na alas nueve karon sa gab-i ang hampang sang Philippine Men’s National Football team batok sa powerhouse nga Thailand sa Leg 1 sang semifinals sa ASEAN championships.
english: The Philippine Men's National Football team will play against powerhouse Thailand in Leg 1 of the semifinals of the ASEAN championships at 9 pm tonight.

text: Apisar seven-time ASEAN champions ang kasumpong, hingalitan sang Pilipinas ang suporta sang Filipino football fans bangud patigayunon ang hampang sa Rizal Memorial Stadium sa Manila.
english: Although the opponent is seven-time ASEAN champions, the Philippines will take advantage of the support of Filipino football fans because the match will be held at the Rizal Memorial Stadium in Manila.

text:
Pang-150 ang Pilipinas sa world ranking kag nakasulod sa semis matapos ang 1-0 draw batok sa Indonesia sa Group B. Sa pihak nga bahin, rank 97 naman ang Thailand kag may matinlo pa nga 4-0 record sa Group A.

Mabudlay ang banas para sa mga Pinoy ilabi na bangud indi makahampang ang captain sini nga si Amani Aguinaldo bangud sa natipon nga yellow cards sa group stage.
english:
The Philippines is ranked 150th in the world rankings and entered the semis after a 1-0 draw against Indonesia in Group B. Meanwhile, Thailand is ranked 97th and has a clean 4-0 record in Group A.

The path will be difficult for the Filipinos especially since their captain Amani Aguinaldo will not be able to play due to accumulated yellow cards in the group stage.

text: Wala man si vice-captain Patrick Reichelt nga nag-anunsyo sang iya pag-retiro na sa national team sang nagligad lamang nga adlaw agud mas pasulabihon ang iya pamilya.
english: Vice-captain Patrick Reichelt, who announced his retirement from the national team yesterday, was also absent to give priority to his family.

text: Ang nagdugang para sa Philippine team amo ang 20-anyos nga winger nga si Santi Rublico nga ulihi nakahampang sa 2024 King’s Cup sa Thailand sang nagligad nga Oktubre.
english: Adding for the Philippine team is 20-year-old winger Santi Rublico who last played in the 2024 King’s Cup in Thailand last October.
